3915
3916bool DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
3917 std::uint32_t bs) {
3918 if (buf == nullptr)
3919 return false;
3920 // R2007 (AC1021) omits the footer when an object has no string stream;
3921 // the concrete readers using this helper have no detached text fields.
3922 if (version <= DRW::AC1021)
3923 return parseDwg(version, buf, nullptr, bs);
3924
3925 // Keep the publishing cursor transactional: a missing string footer is
3926 // legal for body-only R2007-era inputs and for the low-level entity test
3927 // API, but must not leave the cursor half-consumed before that fallback.
3928 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
3929 dwgBuffer stringProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
3930 if (parseDwg(version, &bodyProbe, &stringProbe, bs)) {
3931 *buf = bodyProbe;
3932 return true;
3933 }
3934 return parseDwg(version, buf, nullptr, bs);
3935}
3936
3937bool DRW_ProxyEntity::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
3938 std::uint32_t bs) {
3939 if (buf == nullptr || version < DRW::AC1012)
3940 return false;
3941
3942 DRW_Entity::reset();
3943 eType = DRW::PROXYENTITY;
3944 m_hasProxyClassId = false;
3945 m_proxyClassId = 0;
3946 m_hasProxyCarrierId = false;
3947 m_proxyCarrierId = 0;
3948 m_proxySubclass.clear();
3949 m_hasProxyDrawingFormat = false;
3950 m_proxyDrawingFormat = 0;
3951 m_proxyDwgVersion = 0;
3952 m_proxyMaintenanceVersion = 0;
3953 m_hasFromDxf = false;
3954 m_fromDxf = false;
3955 m_hasProxyGraphicsByteSize = false;
3956 m_proxyGraphicsByteSize = 0;
3957 m_hasEntityDataBitSize = false;
3958 m_entityData.clear();
3959 m_entityDataBitSize = 0;
3960 m_hasUnknownDataByteSize = false;
3961 m_unknownDataByteSize = 0;
3962 m_unknownData.clear();
3963 m_objectIdRefs.clear();
3964
3965 dwgBuffer stringBuffer = *buf;
3966 dwgBuffer *stringBuf = version > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringBuffer : buf;
3967 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, stringBuf, bs))
3968 return false;
3969
3970 std::uint64_t dataEndBit = 0;
3971 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = 0;
3972 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*stringBuf, version, objSize, dataEndBit,
3973 &stringEndBit)
3974 || dataEndBit > proxyEntityEndBit(*buf, 0))
3975 return false;
3976
3977 bool present = false;
3978 std::int32_t value = 0;
3979 if (!readProxyEntityOptionalBitLong(*buf, dataEndBit, present, value))
3980 return false;
3981 if (present) {
3982 m_hasProxyCarrierId = true;
3983 m_proxyCarrierId = value;
3984 }
3985
3986 if (version >= DRW::AC1018
3987 && proxyEntityHasBits(*stringBuf, stringEndBit, 2)) {
3988 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*stringBuf, stringEndBit, version,
3989 m_proxySubclass))
3990 return false;
3991 }
3992
3993 if (version >= DRW::AC1032) {
3994 bool hasDwgVersion = false;
3995 bool hasMaintenanceVersion = false;
3996 std::int32_t dwgVersion = 0;
3997 std::int32_t maintenanceVersion = 0;
3998 if (!readProxyEntityOptionalBitLong(*buf, dataEndBit,
3999 hasDwgVersion, dwgVersion)
4000 || !readProxyEntityOptionalBitLong(*buf, dataEndBit,
4001 hasMaintenanceVersion,
4002 maintenanceVersion)) {
4003 return false;
4004 }
4005 if (hasDwgVersion || hasMaintenanceVersion) {
4006 m_hasProxyDrawingFormat = true;
4007 m_proxyDwgVersion = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(dwgVersion);
4008 m_proxyMaintenanceVersion =
4009 static_cast<std::uint16_t>(maintenanceVersion);
4010 m_proxyDrawingFormat =
4011 (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m_proxyMaintenanceVersion) << 16u)
4012 | m_proxyDwgVersion;
4013 }
4014 } else if (!readProxyEntityOptionalBitLong(*buf, dataEndBit,
4015 present, value)) {
4016 return false;
4017 } else if (present) {
4018 m_hasProxyDrawingFormat = true;
4019 m_proxyDrawingFormat = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value);
4020 m_proxyDwgVersion = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
4021 m_proxyMaintenanceVersion = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(
4022 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value) >> 16u);
4023 }
4024
4025 if (version >= DRW::AC1015 && proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, dataEndBit, 1)) {
4026 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, dataEndBit, m_fromDxf))
4027 return false;
4028 m_hasFromDxf = true;
4029 }
4030
4031 const std::uint64_t payloadStartBit = currentDwgBit(buf);
4032 if (payloadStartBit > dataEndBit
4033 || !copyDwgBitRange(*buf, payloadStartBit, dataEndBit, m_entityData)) {
4034 return false;
4035 }
4036 m_entityDataBitSize = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
4037 dataEndBit - payloadStartBit);
4038
4039 dwgBuffer handleBuffer = *buf;
4040 if (!handleBuffer.setPosition(dataEndBit >> 3))
4041 return false;
4042 handleBuffer.setBitPos(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(dataEndBit & 7u));
4043 if (!handleBuffer.isGood())
4044 return false;
4045 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
4046 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*buf, version, objSize, bs, handleEndBit)
4047 || !DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleBuffer, true,
4048 handleEndBit))
4049 return false;
4050 while (proxyEntityHasBits(handleBuffer, handleEndBit, 8)) {
4051 dwgHandle rawHandle;
4052 dwgHandle resolvedHandle;
4053 if (!readBoundedDwgObjectId(handleBuffer, handleEndBit, handle,
4054 rawHandle, resolvedHandle))
4055 return false;
4056 if (rawHandle.code == 0 && rawHandle.ref64 == 0)
4057 break;
4058
4059 DRW_ProxyObjectIdRef ref;
4060 ref.m_dxfCode = proxyEntityDxfCode(rawHandle.code);
4061 ref.m_handleCode = rawHandle.code;
4062 ref.m_handle = resolvedHandle.ref64;
4063 ref.m_rawHandle = rawHandle.ref64;
4064 m_objectIdRefs.push_back(ref);
4065 }
4066
4067 return buf->isGood() && stringBuf->isGood() && handleBuffer.isGood();
4068}
4069
4070bool DRW_Point::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
4071 switch (code) {
4072 case 10:
4073 basePoint.x = reader->getDouble();
4074 break;
4075 case 20:
4076 basePoint.y = reader->getDouble();
4077 break;
4078 case 30:
4079 basePoint.z = reader->getDouble();
4080 break;
4081 case 39:
4082 thickness = reader->getDouble();
4083 break;
4084 case 50:
4085 // DXF code 50 is in degrees; the field is radians (matching the DWG
4086 // path, drw_entities.cpp:1787). degrees -> radians is /ARAD (x pi/180);
4087 // the prior *ARAD only canceled with the writer's /ARAD on DXF->DXF and
4088 // corrupted the value for DXF->DWG. ARAD = 180/pi.
4089 xAxisAngle = reader->getDouble() / ARAD57.29577951308232; // DXF degrees -> radians
4090 break;
4091 case 210:
4092 haveExtrusion = true;
4093 extPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
4094 break;
4095 case 220:
4096 extPoint.y = reader->getDouble();
4097 break;
4098 case 230:
4099 extPoint.z = reader->getDouble();
4100 break;
4101 default:
4102 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
4103 }
4104
4105 return true;
4106}
4107
4108// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
4109// Phase 4a (drafted 2026-05-15)
4110// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
4111// `DRW_Entity::encodeDwgCommon` and `encodeDwgEntHandle` mirror the common
4112// entity-header fragments parsed above. Version gates intentionally follow
4113// the DWG reader so newer headers retain their reference flags and handles.
4114//
4115// Discarded fields (Risk 4i):
4116// - haveNextLinks B — we emit 1 (no prev/next chain).
4117// - none of the common color side channels are discarded for R2004+;
4118// ENC names remain the byte-oriented TV fields defined by the DWG
4119// common-entity specification, while ordinary entity text uses strBuf.
4120//
4121// We still emit these fixed defaults:
4122// - entmode = 2 (modelspace, no owner-handle in stream — caller can
4123// override before calling encodeDwgCommon if entity needs an owner).
4124// - numReactors = 0 (reactor handles are emitted by the handle phase when
4125// present).
4126// - ltFlags = 0 (BYLAYER); plotFlags follows plotStyle.
4127// - invisibleFlag = 0 (visible)
4128//
4129// Caller must:
4130// - Pre-populate `eType`, `handle`, `color`, `ltypeScale`, `lWeight`,
4131// `layerH.ref` (handle of the layer this entity belongs to).
4132// - The body emit between encodeDwgCommon and encodeDwgEntHandle is
4133// per-entity (3BD basePoint for Point, etc.).
4134
4135// Phase-2a kill switch for the full common-entity-header write contract
4136// (entity reactors/xdict/EED/visibility/entmode emission). Default ON. The
4137// emission is gated by DATA PRESENCE (empty reactorHandles/extData + visible
4138// == today's hardcoded zeros), so flipping this OFF restores the legacy
4139// byte-identical output as an emergency escape hatch. The per-field emission
4140// arms land in 2a.1..2a.5; this scaffolding commit changes no bytes.
4141#ifndef LIBDXFRW_FULL_COMMON_HEADER1
4142#define LIBDXFRW_FULL_COMMON_HEADER1 1
4143#endif
4144
4145namespace {
4146
4147const DRW_Entity::PendingHandleRef* findEedWriteRef(
4148 const std::vector<DRW_Entity::PendingHandleRef>& refs,
4149 std::size_t index) {
4150 const auto it = std::find_if(refs.cbegin(), refs.cend(),
4151 [index](const auto& ref) {
4152 return ref.indexInExtData == index;
4153 });
4154 if (it == refs.cend())
4155 return nullptr;
4156 return &*it;
4157}
4158
4159bool parseEedHexHandle(const std::string& text, std::uint64_t& handle) {
4160 if (text.empty())
4161 return false;
4162 std::size_t index = 0;
4163 if (text.size() > 2 && text[0] == '0'
4164 && (text[1] == 'x' || text[1] == 'X')) {
4165 index = 2;
4166 }
4167 if (index == text.size())
4168 return false;
4169
4170 std::uint64_t parsed = 0;
4171 for (; index < text.size(); ++index) {
4172 const unsigned char character =
4173 static_cast<unsigned char>(text[index]);
4174 std::uint8_t digit = 0;
4175 if (character >= '0' && character <= '9')
4176 digit = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(character - '0');
4177 else if (character >= 'a' && character <= 'f')
4178 digit = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(character - 'a' + 10);
4179 else if (character >= 'A' && character <= 'F')
4180 digit = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(character - 'A' + 10);
4181 else
4182 return false;
4183 if (parsed > (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max() - digit) / 16U)
4184 return false;
4185 parsed = parsed * 16U + digit;
4186 }
4187 handle = parsed;
4188 return true;
4189}
4190
4191void putEedRawHandleBE(dwgBufferW& buffer, std::uint64_t handle) {
4192 for (int index = 7; index >= 0; --index) {
4193 buffer.putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(
4194 (handle >> (index * 8)) & 0xFFU));
4195 }
4196}
4197
4198void putEedRawHandleLE(dwgBufferW& buffer, std::uint64_t handle) {
4199 for (unsigned index = 0; index < 8; ++index) {
4200 buffer.putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(
4201 (handle >> (index * 8U)) & 0xFFU));
4202 }
4203}
4204
4205bool encodeEedItem(DRW::Version version, const DRW_Variant& value,
4206 dwgBufferW& textEncoder, dwgBufferW& output,
4207 std::uint64_t resolvedLayerHandle,
4208 std::uint16_t codePage) {
4209 const int groupCode = value.code();
4210 switch (groupCode) {
4211 case 1000: {
4212 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::STRING || value.content.s == nullptr)
4213 return false;
4214 const std::string encoded = textEncoder.encodeTextAreaString(
4215 *value.content.s, version > DRW::AC1018);
4216 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
4217 if ((encoded.size() & 1U) != 0
4218 || encoded.size() / 2U > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()) {
4219 return false;
4220 }
4221 output.putRawChar8(0);
4222 output.putRawShort16(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(encoded.size() / 2U));
4223 } else {
4224 if (encoded.size() > std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max())
4225 return false;
4226 output.putRawChar8(0);
4227 output.putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(encoded.size()));
4228 output.putBERawShort16(codePage);
4229 }
4230 output.putBytes(reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(encoded.data()),
4231 encoded.size());
4232 return output.isGood();
4233 }
4234 case 1002: {
4235 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::STRING || value.content.s == nullptr
4236 || (*value.content.s != "{" && *value.content.s != "}")) {
4237 return false;
4238 }
4239 output.putRawChar8(2);
4240 output.putRawChar8(*value.content.s == "{" ? 0 : 1);
4241 return output.isGood();
4242 }
4243 case 1003:
4244 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::STRING || resolvedLayerHandle == 0)
4245 return false;
4246 output.putRawChar8(3);
4247 putEedRawHandleLE(output, resolvedLayerHandle);
4248 return output.isGood();
4249 case 1004: {
4250 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::BINARY || value.binary() == nullptr
4251 || value.binary()->size() > std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max()) {
4252 return false;
4253 }
4254 output.putRawChar8(4);
4255 output.putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value.binary()->size()));
4256 output.putBytes(value.binary()->data(), value.binary()->size());
4257 return output.isGood();
4258 }
4259 case 1005: {
4260 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::STRING || value.content.s == nullptr)
4261 return false;
4262 std::uint64_t handle = 0;
4263 if (!parseEedHexHandle(*value.content.s, handle))
4264 return false;
4265 output.putRawChar8(5);
4266 putEedRawHandleBE(output, handle);
4267 return output.isGood();
4268 }
4269 case 1010:
4270 case 1011:
4271 case 1012:
4272 case 1013: {
4273 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::COORD || value.coord() == nullptr)
4274 return false;
4275 const DRW_Coord& coordinate = *value.coord();
4276 if (!std::isfinite(coordinate.x) || !std::isfinite(coordinate.y)
4277 || !std::isfinite(coordinate.z)) {
4278 return false;
4279 }
4280 output.putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(groupCode - 1000));
4281 output.putRawDouble(coordinate.x);
4282 output.putRawDouble(coordinate.y);
4283 output.putRawDouble(coordinate.z);
4284 return output.isGood();
4285 }
4286 case 1040:
4287 case 1041:
4288 case 1042:
4289 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::DOUBLE || !std::isfinite(value.d_val()))
4290 return false;
4291 output.putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(groupCode - 1000));
4292 output.putRawDouble(value.d_val());
4293 return output.isGood();
4294 case 1070:
4295 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::INTEGER
4296 || value.i_val() < std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::min()
4297 || value.i_val() > std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max()) {
4298 return false;
4299 }
4300 output.putRawChar8(70);
4301 output.putRawShort16(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(
4302 static_cast<std::int16_t>(value.i_val())));
4303 return output.isGood();
4304 case 1071: {
4305 std::int64_t integer = 0;
4306 if (value.type() == DRW_Variant::INTEGER)
4307 integer = value.i_val();
4308 else if (value.type() == DRW_Variant::INTEGER64)
4309 integer = value.i64_val();
4310 else
4311 return false;
4312 if (integer < std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min()
4313 || integer > std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()) {
4314 return false;
4315 }
4316 output.putRawChar8(71);
4317 output.putRawLong32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
4318 static_cast<std::int32_t>(integer)));
4319 return output.isGood();
4320 }
4321 default:
4322 return false;
4323 }
4324}
4325
4326} // namespace
4327
4328bool DRW_Entity::encodeDwgEed(
4329 DRW::Version version, const std::vector<DRW_Variant*>& extData,
4330 const std::vector<PendingHandleRef>& appIdRefs,
4331 const std::vector<PendingHandleRef>& layerRefs,
4332 std::uint16_t codePage, dwgBufferW& output) {
4333 if (extData.empty()) {
4334 output.putBitShort(0);
4335 return output.isGood();
4336 }
4337 if (extData.size() > dwgSafety::MaxEedTotalItems)
4338 return false;
4339
4340 std::size_t currentAppStart = 0;
4341 std::uint32_t appHandle = 0;
4342 std::uint32_t groupDepth = 0;
4343 std::uint32_t chunkCount = 0;
4344 dwgBufferW payload;
4345 const auto flush = [&]() {
4346 if (payload.data().empty() || payload.data().size()
4347 > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()
4348 || appHandle == 0 || ++chunkCount > dwgSafety::MaxEedChunks) {
4349 return false;
4350 }
4351 output.putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(payload.data().size()));
4352 dwgHandle appId;
4353 appId.code = 5;
4354 appId.ref = appHandle;
4355 output.putHandle(appId);
4356 output.putBytes(payload.data().data(), payload.data().size());
4357 payload.reset();
4358 return output.isGood();
4359 };
4360
4361 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < extData.size(); ++index) {
4362 const DRW_Variant* value = extData[index];
4363 if (value == nullptr)
4364 return false;
4365 if (value->code() == 1001) {
4366 if (index != currentAppStart) {
4367 if (groupDepth != 0 || !flush())
4368 return false;
4369 }
4370 const PendingHandleRef* appIdRef = findEedWriteRef(appIdRefs, index);
4371 if (appIdRef == nullptr || appIdRef->handleRef == 0) {
4372 return false;
4373 }
4374 appHandle = appIdRef->handleRef;
4375 currentAppStart = index + 1;
4376 groupDepth = 0;
4377 continue;
4378 }
4379 if (index < currentAppStart)
4380 return false;
4381 if (value->code() == 1002) {
4382 if (value->type() != DRW_Variant::STRING || value->content.s == nullptr)
4383 return false;
4384 if (*value->content.s == "{") {
4385 ++groupDepth;
4386 } else if (*value->content.s == "}") {
4387 if (groupDepth == 0)
4388 return false;
4389 --groupDepth;
4390 } else {
4391 return false;
4392 }
4393 }
4394
4395 std::uint64_t layerHandle = 0;
4396 if (value->code() == 1003) {
4397 const PendingHandleRef* layerRef = findEedWriteRef(layerRefs, index);
4398 if (layerRef == nullptr)
4399 return false;
4400 layerHandle = layerRef->useRawHandleRef
4401 ? layerRef->rawHandleRef : layerRef->handleRef;
4402 if (layerHandle == 0)
4403 return false;
4404 }
4405 dwgBufferW item;
4406 if (!encodeEedItem(version, *value, output, item, layerHandle,
4407 codePage))
4408 return false;
4409 if (item.data().size() > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
4410 return false;
4411 if (!payload.data().empty()
4412 && payload.data().size() + item.data().size()
4413 > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()) {
4414 if (groupDepth != 0 || !flush())
4415 return false;
4416 }
4417 payload.putBytes(item.data().data(), item.data().size());
4418 }
4419 if (currentAppStart == 0 || groupDepth != 0 || !flush())
4420 return false;
4421 output.putBitShort(0);
4422 return output.isGood();
4423}
4424
4425bool DRW_Entity::encodeDwgCommon(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
4426 dwgBufferW *strBuf) {
4427 (void)strBuf; // ENC names are byte-oriented TV fields in the data stream
4428 if (buf == nullptr || reactorHandles.size() > dwgSafety::MaxReactorCount ||
4429 (version != DRW::AC1015 && version != DRW::AC1018 &&
4430 version != DRW::AC1021 &&
4431 version != DRW::AC1024 && version != DRW::AC1027 &&
4432 version != DRW::AC1032)) return false;
4433
4434 // Object type: BS for AC1015/AC1018, OT for AC1024+.
4435 buf->putObjType(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(oType));
4436
4437 // objSize stub — back-patched for AC1015/AC1018 only. AC1024 derives
4438 // objSize from the body buffer size, so no RL is emitted.
4439 if (version < DRW::AC1024) {
4440 buf->putRawLong32(0);
4441 }
4442
4443 // Own handle: code 0 per spec §20.4.1.
4444 dwgHandle ownH;
4445 ownH.code = 0;
4446 ownH.ref = handle;
4447 ownH.size = 0;
4448 if (handle != 0) {
4449 std::uint32_t t = handle;
4450 while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++ownH.size; }
4451 }
4452 buf->putHandle(ownH);
4453
4454 std::vector<DRW_Variant*> eedValues;
4455 try {
4456 eedValues.reserve(extData.size());
4457 for (const auto& value : extData)
4458 eedValues.push_back(value.get());
4459 } catch (...) {
4460 return false;
4461 }
4462 if (!encodeDwgEed(version, eedValues, dwgEedAppIdWriteRefs,
4463 dwgEedLayerWriteRefs, dwgEedCodePage, *buf))
4464 return false;
4465
4466 // Proxy graphics lives in the common data stream. Preserve it when the
4467 // entity has a bounded byte stream; it is the cached fallback geometry
4468 // used for unrecognised custom/proxy entities.
4469 if (proxyGraphics.size()
4470 > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()
4471 / 8)) {
4472 return false;
4473 }
4474 const bool hasProxyGraphics = !proxyGraphics.empty();
4475 buf->putBit(hasProxyGraphics);
4476 if (hasProxyGraphics) {
4477 const auto graphDataSize = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
4478 proxyGraphics.size());
4479 if (version >= DRW::AC1024)
4480 buf->putBitLongLong(graphDataSize);
4481 else
4482 buf->putRawLong32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(graphDataSize));
4483 buf->putBytes(reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(
4484 proxyGraphics.data()),
4485 proxyGraphics.size());
4486 if (!buf->isGood())
4487 return false;
4488 }
4489
4490 const bool hasOwner = parentHandle != DRW::NoHandle;
4491 // entmode BB (ODA §20.4.1 / Open Design FE):
4492 // 0 = owner handle follows in the handle stream
4493 // 1 = paperspace entity without owner-relative handle
4494 // 2 = modelspace entity without owner-relative handle
4495 // Prefer owner when present; otherwise honor DRW_Entity::space.
4496 std::uint8_t entmode = 2;
4497 if (hasOwner)
4498 entmode = 0;
4499 else if (space == DRW::PaperSpace)
4500 entmode = 1;
4501 buf->put2Bits(entmode);
4502
4503 // numReactors (BL per spec §20.4.1). 2a.2: emit the real count; empty
4504 // reactorHandles → 0 → byte-identical to legacy.
4505#if LIBDXFRW_FULL_COMMON_HEADER1
4506 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(reactorHandles.size()));
4507#else
4508 buf->putBitLong(0);
4509#endif
4510
4511 // R2004/R2010 (AC1018, AC1024): reader reads xDictFlag bit (version > AC1015)
4512 // then forces haveNextLinks=1 (no bit in stream). We always emit
4513 // xDictFlag=0 (xdic-present) so the reader reads exactly one xdic handle
4514 // in the handle section — we emit the real handle when xDictHandle!=0 and
4515 // a null handle otherwise. This keeps the empty case byte-identical to the
4516 // legacy path (bit 0 + null handle) while round-tripping a real xdict.
4517 // R2000 (AC1015): no xDictFlag bit; reader's xDictFlag stays 0 so it ALWAYS
4518 // reads an xdic handle — same emit rule applies.
4519 // R2013+ (AC1027+): reader reads xDictFlag then reads haveNextLinks (bit restored).
4520 if (version == DRW::AC1015) {
4521 buf->putBit(1); // nolinks=1 (R2000: no prev/next chain)
4522 } else {
4523 buf->putBit(0); // xDictFlag=0 (xdic present; real-or-null handle follows)
4524 if (version > DRW::AC1024) {
4525 // libreDWG common_entity_data.spec — R2013+ has_ds_data (B). libdxfrw
4526 // never inlines an ACIS SAB datastore, so emit hasDsData (default 0).
4527 // The old code emitted literal 1 (mislabeled haveNextLinks), falsely
4528 // advertising an SAB blob and risking misparse in strict readers.
4529 buf->putBit(hasDsData);
4530 }
4531 }
4532
4533 // ENC color. R2004+ retains the true-color, transparency, DBCOLOR, and
4534 // byte-oriented color/book-name side channels; AC1015 falls back to BS.
4535 UTF8STRINGstd::string encColorName = colorName;
4536 UTF8STRINGstd::string encBookName;
4537 const std::string::size_type separator = encColorName.find('$');
4538 if (separator != std::string::npos) {
4539 encBookName = encColorName.substr(0, separator);
4540 encColorName.erase(0, separator + 1);
4541 }
4542 buf->putEnColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(color), color24,
4543 encColorName, encBookName,
4544 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(transparency),
4545 version >= DRW::AC1018 && hasAcDbColorH);
4546
4547 // ltypeScale BD.
4548 buf->putBitDouble(ltypeScale);
4549
4550 // ltFlags BB: 0=BYLAYER, 1=BYBLOCK, 2=CONTINUOUS, 3=lTypeH present.
4551 // Prefer an already-set ltFlags; otherwise derive from lineType / lTypeH.
4552 {
4553 auto upper = [](std::string s) {
4554 for (char& c : s)
4555 c = static_cast<char>(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
4556 return s;
4557 };
4558 std::uint8_t flags = ltFlags;
4559 if (flags > 3)
4560 flags = 0;
4561 if (flags == 0 && lTypeH.ref != 0)
4562 flags = 3;
4563 if (flags == 0) {
4564 const std::string lt = upper(lineType);
4565 if (lt.empty() || lt == "BYLAYER")
4566 flags = 0;
4567 else if (lt == "BYBLOCK")
4568 flags = 1;
4569 else if (lt == "CONTINUOUS")
4570 flags = 2;
4571 else
4572 flags = 3; // named linetype — handle required
4573 }
4574 ltFlags = flags;
4575 }
4576 buf->put2Bits(ltFlags);
4577 // plotFlags BB: a nonzero plot-style handle requires the hard-pointer
4578 // handle in the common handle stream. Keep the default zero path
4579 // unchanged for entities without an override.
4580 plotFlags = plotStyle > 0 ? 3 : 0;
4581 buf->put2Bits(plotFlags);
4582
4583 // R2010 (AC1024): materialFlag BB + shadowFlag RC (version > AC1018).
4584 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
4585 materialFlag = material == DRW::MaterialByLayer ? 0 : 3;
4586 shadowFlag = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(shadow) & 0x3;
4587 buf->put2Bits(materialFlag);
4588 buf->putRawChar8(shadowFlag);
4589 }
4590
4591 // R2010 (AC1024): three visual-style flag bits (version > AC1021).
4592 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
4593 hasFullVisualStyle = fullVisualStyleHandle != 0;
4594 hasFaceVisualStyle = faceVisualStyleHandle != 0;
4595 hasEdgeVisualStyle = edgeVisualStyleHandle != 0;
4596 buf->putBit(hasFullVisualStyle);
4597 buf->putBit(hasFaceVisualStyle);
4598 buf->putBit(hasEdgeVisualStyle);
4599 }
4600
4601 // invisibleFlag BS (DXF 60). 2a.1: emit from `visible` (bit 0 = invisible)
4602 // instead of a hardcoded 0. visible==true → 0 → byte-identical to legacy.
4603#if LIBDXFRW_FULL_COMMON_HEADER1
4604 buf->putBitShort(visible ? 0 : 1);
4605#else
4606 buf->putBitShort(0);
4607#endif
4608
4609 // lWeight RC (0 = byLayer per DRW_LW_Conv).
4610 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(lWeight));
4611
4612 return buf->isGood();
4613}
4614
4615bool DRW_Entity::encodeDwgEntHandle(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
4616 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
4617 if (buf == nullptr || reactorHandles.size() > dwgSafety::MaxReactorCount ||
4618 (version != DRW::AC1015 && version != DRW::AC1018 &&
4619 version != DRW::AC1021 &&
4620 version != DRW::AC1024 && version != DRW::AC1027 &&
4621 version != DRW::AC1032)) return false;
4622
4623 // For AC1024, handles are directed to handleBuf (the separate handle section);
4624 // for AC1015/AC1018, handles go into buf alongside the data.
4625 dwgBufferW *hb = (handleBuf != nullptr) ? handleBuf : buf;
4626
4627 // Owner handle is present only when encodeDwgCommon emitted entmode=0.
4628 if (parentHandle != DRW::NoHandle) {
4629 dwgHandle owner;
4630 owner.code = 4; // soft pointer owner, read via getOffsetHandle()
4631 owner.ref = parentHandle;
4632 owner.size = 0;
4633 std::uint32_t t = parentHandle;
4634 while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++owner.size; }
4635 hb->putHandle(owner);
4636 }
4637
4638 // Reactor handles (2a.2): emitted before xdic, one per numReactors written
4639 // in the DATA section, as ABSOLUTE handles (reader uses getHandle()). Empty
4640 // reactorHandles → nothing emitted → byte-identical to legacy.
4641#if LIBDXFRW_FULL_COMMON_HEADER1
4642 for (std::uint32_t ref : reactorHandles) {
4643 dwgHandle rh;
4644 rh.code = 4; // soft pointer
4645 rh.ref = ref;
4646 rh.size = 0;
4647 if (ref != 0) { std::uint32_t t = ref; while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++rh.size; } }
4648 hb->putHandle(rh);
4649 }
4650#endif
4651
4652 // XDic handle — xDictFlag=0 in the DATA section means the reader reads one
4653 // XDicObj handle here: emit the real handle when xDictHandle!=0, else the
4654 // null handle (matching the legacy byte-for-byte for the empty case).
4655 dwgHandle xDic;
4656 xDic.code = 3;
4657#if LIBDXFRW_FULL_COMMON_HEADER1
4658 xDic.ref = xDictHandle;
4659 xDic.size = 0;
4660 if (xDictHandle != 0) {
4661 std::uint32_t t = xDictHandle; while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++xDic.size; }
4662 }
4663#else
4664 xDic.ref = 0;
4665 xDic.size = 0;
4666#endif
4667 hb->putHandle(xDic);
4668
4669 // R2004+ stores the optional AcDbColor reference after the common owner,
4670 // reactor, and xdictionary handles. Keep this order aligned with the
4671 // reader and the cross-project handle-stream contract.
4672 if (version > DRW::AC1015 && hasAcDbColorH)
4673 putHardPointerHandle(hb, acDbColorHandle);
4674
4675 // Layer handle (R2000+ unconditional). Hard pointer.
4676 dwgHandle lH;
4677 lH.code = layerH.ref == 0 ? 0 : 5; // 5 = hard pointer for layer ref
4678 lH.ref = layerH.ref;
4679 lH.size = 0;
4680 if (lH.ref != 0) {
4681 std::uint32_t t = lH.ref;
4682 while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++lH.size; }
4683 }
4684 hb->putHandle(lH);
4685
4686 // ltFlags=3 → lTypeH (hard pointer, code 5) present; else omit.
4687 if (ltFlags == 3) {
4688 dwgHandle ltH;
4689 ltH.code = lTypeH.ref == 0 ? 0 : 5;
4690 ltH.ref = lTypeH.ref;
4691 ltH.size = 0;
4692 if (ltH.ref != 0) {
4693 std::uint32_t t = ltH.ref;
4694 while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++ltH.size; }
4695 }
4696 hb->putHandle(ltH);
4697 }
4698 auto putHardPointer = [hb](std::uint32_t ref) {
4699 dwgHandle h;
4700 h.code = ref == 0 ? 0 : 5;
4701 h.ref = ref;
4702 h.size = 0;
4703 if (ref != 0) {
4704 std::uint32_t t = ref;
4705 while (t != 0) {
4706 t >>= 8;
4707 ++h.size;
4708 }
4709 }
4710 hb->putHandle(h);
4711 };
4712
4713 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
4714 if (materialFlag == 3)
4715 putHardPointer(material);
4716 if (shadowFlag == 3)
4717 putHardPointer(shadowHandle);
4718 }
4719 if (plotFlags == 3)
4720 putHardPointer(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(plotStyle));
4721 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
4722 if (hasFullVisualStyle)
4723 putHardPointer(fullVisualStyleHandle);
4724 if (hasFaceVisualStyle)
4725 putHardPointer(faceVisualStyleHandle);
4726 if (hasEdgeVisualStyle)
4727 putHardPointer(edgeVisualStyleHandle);
4728 }
4729
4730 return buf->isGood() && hb->isGood();
4731}
4732
4733bool DRW_Point::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
4734 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
4735 oType = 27; // POINT class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1111 dispatch
4736 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
4737
4738 // Point body — mirror of DRW_Point::parseDwg below.
4739 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.x);
4740 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.y);
4741 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
4742 buf->putThickness(thickness, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
4743 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
4744 buf->putBitDouble(xAxisAngle); // ODA §20.4.31 code 50
4745
4746 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
4747}
4748
4749void DRW_Point::resetDwgState() {
4750 DRW_Entity::reset();
4751 basePoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
4752 thickness = 0.0;
4753 extPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
4754 xAxisAngle = 0.0;
4755}
4756
4757bool DRW_Point::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
4758 resetDwgState();
4759 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
4760 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
4761 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
4762 sourceBuf->invalidate();
4763 resetDwgState();
4764 return false;
4765 };
4766 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
4767 return fail();
4768
4769 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
4770 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs)
4771 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
4772 return fail();
4773 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
4774 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
4775 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
4776 double parsedThickness = 0.0;
4777 double parsedXAxisAngle = 0.0;
4778 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint)
4779 || !readBoundedThickness(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
4780 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedThickness)
4781 || !readBoundedExtrusion(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
4782 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedExtrusion)
4783 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedXAxisAngle)
4784 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.x)
4785 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.y)
4786 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.z)
4787 || !std::isfinite(parsedThickness)
4788 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.x)
4789 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.y)
4790 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.z)
4791 || !std::isfinite(parsedXAxisAngle))
4792 return fail();
4793
4794 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
4795 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
4796 handleEndBit))
4797 return fail();
4798 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
4799 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
4800 handleEndBit)
4801 || !handleProbe.isGood())
4802 return fail();
4803
4804 basePoint = parsedBasePoint;
4805 thickness = parsedThickness;
4806 extPoint = parsedExtrusion;
4807 xAxisAngle = parsedXAxisAngle;
4808 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
4809 return true;
4810}
4811
4812void DRW_Line::resetDwgState() {
4813 DRW_Point::resetDwgState();
4814 secPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
4815}
4816
4817bool DRW_Line::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
4818 switch (code) {
4819 case 11:
4820 secPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
4821 break;
4822 case 21:
4823 secPoint.y = reader->getDouble();
4824 break;
4825 case 31:
4826 secPoint.z = reader->getDouble();
4827 break;
4828 default:
4829 return DRW_Point::parseCode(code, reader);
4830 }
4831
4832 return true;
4833}
4834
4835bool DRW_Line::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
4836 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
4837 oType = 19; // LINE class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1105
4838 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
4839
4840 // R2000+ Line body — zIsZero shortcut: if both z's are 0, omit the
4841 // z fields entirely. Reader reads `zIsZero` first, then RD x +
4842 // DD secX (default = x), RD y + DD secY (default = y), and
4843 // conditionally RD z + DD secZ. Our putDefaultDouble always emits
4844 // the full RD via code 0b11; reader's getDefaultDouble with code
4845 // 0b11 returns the raw double.
4846 bool zIsZero = (basePoint.z == 0.0 && secPoint.z == 0.0);
4847 buf->putBit(zIsZero ? 1 : 0);
4848 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.x);
4849 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.x, secPoint.x);
4850 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.y);
4851 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.y, secPoint.y);
4852 if (!zIsZero) {
4853 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.z);
4854 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.z, secPoint.z);
4855 }
4856 buf->putThickness(thickness, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
4857 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
4858
4859 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
4860}
4861
4862bool DRW_3DLine::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
4863 std::uint32_t bs) {
4864 resetDwgState();
4865 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
4866 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
4867 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
4868 sourceBuf->invalidate();
4869 resetDwgState();
4870 return false;
4871 };
4872 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
4873 return fail();
4874
4875 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
4876 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs)
4877 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
4878 return fail();
4879
4880 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
4881 double values[10]{};
4882 for (double& value : values) {
4883 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value)
4884 || !std::isfinite(value))
4885 return fail();
4886 }
4887
4888 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
4889 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
4890 handleEndBit))
4891 return fail();
4892 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
4893 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
4894 handleEndBit)
4895 || !handleProbe.isGood())
4896 return fail();
4897
4898 basePoint = DRW_Coord{values[0], values[1], values[2]};
4899 secPoint = DRW_Coord{values[3], values[4], values[5]};
4900 extPoint = DRW_Coord{values[6], values[7], values[8]};
4901 thickness = values[9];
4902 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
4903 return true;
4904}
4905
4906bool DRW_3DLine::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
4907 std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf,
4908 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
4909 (void)bs;
4910 if (version < DRW::AC1015 || buf == nullptr)
4911 return false;
4912
4913 // 3DLINE is a modern custom class. Its class ordinal is writer-local,
4914 // while the body remains the fixed raw-double layout used by the reader.
4915 oType = kDwgClassNum;
4916 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf, strBuf))
4917 return false;
4918
4919 for (const double coordinate : {basePoint.x, basePoint.y, basePoint.z,
4920 secPoint.x, secPoint.y, secPoint.z,
4921 extPoint.x, extPoint.y, extPoint.z,
4922 thickness}) {
4923 buf->putRawDouble(coordinate);
4924 }
4925
4926 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
4927}

4929bool DRW_Circle::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
4930 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
4931 oType = 18; // CIRCLE class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1099
4932 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
4933
4934 // Circle body — mirror of DRW_Circle::parseDwg.
4935 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.x);
4936 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.y);
4937 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
4938 buf->putBitDouble(radious);
4939 buf->putThickness(thickness, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
4940 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
4941
4942 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);

4945bool DRW_Ray::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
4946 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
4947 // Ray = 40, Xline = 41 — derive from runtime type so DRW_Xline can
4948 // share this encoder (it inherits from DRW_Ray).
4949 oType = (eType == DRW::XLINE) ? 41 : 40;
4950 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
4951
4952 // 3 BD basePoint + 3 BD vector — same layout as parseDwg.
4953 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.x);
4954 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.y);
4955 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
4956 buf->putBitDouble(secPoint.x);
4957 buf->putBitDouble(secPoint.y);
4958 buf->putBitDouble(secPoint.z);
4959
4960 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);

4963bool DRW_Trace::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
4964 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;

4966 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
4967
4968 // Trace body — mirror of parseDwg. Note the unusual layout:
4969 // thickness FIRST, then elevation (basePoint.z) as BD, then 4
4970 // corners as 2RD (z values share basePoint.z).
4971 buf->putThickness(thickness, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
4972 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
4973 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.x);
4974 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.y);
4975 buf->putRawDouble(secPoint.x);
4976 buf->putRawDouble(secPoint.y);
4977 buf->putRawDouble(thirdPoint.x);
4978 buf->putRawDouble(thirdPoint.y);
4979 buf->putRawDouble(fourPoint.x);
4980 buf->putRawDouble(fourPoint.y);
4981 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
4982
4983 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
4984}

4986bool DRW_Spline::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
4987 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
4988 if (buf == nullptr || !validatePayloadFields())
4989 return false;
4990 oType = 36; // SPLINE class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1329
4991 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
4992 encodeDwgSplineBody(version, buf);
4993 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
4994}
4995
4996// Spline body encode: the scenario/degree/knots/ctrl/fit section, WITHOUT the
4997// leading encodeDwgCommon or the trailing encodeDwgEntHandle. Factored out so
4998// DRW_Helix::encodeDwg can reuse the identical payload (Phase 8a-1).
4999// Omits the DXF-only flag70/extrusion (210-230) which the DWG stream never
5000// carries here.
5001void DRW_Spline::encodeDwgSplineBody(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf) const {
5002 // Scenario:
5003 // 1 = control-point / rational / planar (uses knots + control + weights)
5004 // 2 = fit-point (uses fit points + tangents + tolerance)
5005 // When both lists are populated (e.g. DXF-sourced splines), prefer scenario 1
5006 // (ctrl + knots) and drop the fit list from the DWG stream — scenario 1 has no
5007 // fit-point section, so writing both would corrupt all subsequent entities.
5008 const bool hasFit = !fitlist.empty();
5009 const bool hasCtrl = !controllist.empty();
5010 std::int32_t scenario = (hasFit && !hasCtrl) ? 2 : 1;
5011 if (m_scenario == 1 && hasCtrl) {
5012 scenario = 1;
5013 } else if (m_scenario == 2 && hasFit) {
5014 scenario = 2;
5015 }
5016 buf->putBitLong(scenario);
5017 if (version > DRW::AC1024) {
5018 // splFlag1 bit 0: method = fit points; bit 2: closed;
5019 // bit 3: knotParam participates in R2013+ scenario selection.
5020 std::int32_t splFlag1 = m_splineFlags1;
5021 splFlag1 &= ~(kSplineFlagMethodFitPoints | kSplineFlagUseKnotParameter | kSplineFlagClosed);
5022 if (scenario == 2) {
5023 splFlag1 |= kSplineFlagMethodFitPoints | kSplineFlagUseKnotParameter;
5024 if (flags & 0x01) splFlag1 |= kSplineFlagClosed;
5025 } else {
5026 if (flags & 0x01) splFlag1 |= kSplineFlagClosed;
5027 }
5028 buf->putBitLong(splFlag1);
5029 std::int32_t knotParam = m_knotParam;
5030 if (scenario == 1) {
5031 knotParam = kSplineKnotParamCustom;
5032 } else if (knotParam == kSplineKnotParamCustom) {
5033 knotParam = 0;
5034 }
5035 buf->putBitLong(knotParam);
5036 }
5037 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(degree));
5038
5039 if (scenario == 2) {
5040 buf->putBitDouble(tolfit);
5041 buf->put3BitDouble(tgStart);
5042 buf->put3BitDouble(tgEnd);
5043 const std::int32_t nFit = static_cast<std::int32_t>(fitlist.size());
5044 buf->putBitLong(nFit);
5045 } else {
5046 // scenario == 1
5047 // Reader at parseDwg reads three flag bits in this order:
5048 // rational bit (flags bit 2 → 0x04)
5049 // closed bit (flags bit 0 → 0x01)
5050 // periodic bit (flags bit 1 → 0x02)
5051 const bool hasNonDefaultWeights = std::any_of(weightlist.begin(), weightlist.end(), differsFromUnitWeight);
5052 buf->putBit(((flags & 0x4) || hasNonDefaultWeights) ? 1 : 0); // rational
5053 buf->putBit((flags & 0x1) ? 1 : 0); // closed
5054 buf->putBit((flags & 0x2) ? 1 : 0); // periodic
5055 buf->putBitDouble(tolknot);
5056 buf->putBitDouble(tolcontrol);
5057 const std::int32_t nKnots = static_cast<std::int32_t>(knotslist.size());
5058 const std::int32_t nCtrl = static_cast<std::int32_t>(controllist.size());
5059 buf->putBitLong(nKnots);
5060 buf->putBitLong(nCtrl);
5061 // weight bit: caller populates weightlist when each control point
5062 // has a non-default weight (NURBS conics).
5063 bool hasWeights = !weightlist.empty();
5064 buf->putBit(hasWeights ? 1 : 0);
5065 }
5066
5067 // Data sections are scenario-gated to avoid stream corruption:
5068 // parseDwg reads knots+ctrl only for scenario 1, fit only for scenario 2.
5069 if (scenario == 1) {
5070 for (double k : knotslist) buf->putBitDouble(k);
5071 for (size_t i = 0; i < controllist.size(); ++i) {
5072 buf->put3BitDouble(*controllist[i]);
5073 if (!weightlist.empty()) {
5074 double w = (i < weightlist.size()) ? weightlist[i] : 1.0;
5075 buf->putBitDouble(w);
5076 }
5077 }
5078 } else {
5079 for (const auto& fp : fitlist) buf->put3BitDouble(*fp);
5080 }
5081}
5082
5083// DRW_Helix::encodeDwg — spline body (oType = HELIX class 503) + AcDbHelix
5084// trailer, then the common entity handle data. Trailer field order MUST match
5085// DRW_Helix::parseDwg (Phase 8a-1).
5086bool DRW_Helix::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5087 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
5088 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
5089 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
5090 && std::isfinite(point.z);
5091 };
5092 if (buf == nullptr || !validatePayloadFields()
5093 || !finite(axisBasePt) || !finite(startPt) || !finite(axisVector)
5094 || !std::isfinite(radius) || !std::isfinite(turns)
5095 || !std::isfinite(turnHeight))
5096 return false;
5097 oType = kDwgClassNum; // HELIX custom class 503
5098 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5099 encodeDwgSplineBody(version, buf);
5100
5101 // AcDbHelix trailer (same order as parseDwg):
5102 buf->putBitLong(m_majorVersion);
5103 buf->putBitLong(m_maintVersion);
5104 buf->put3BitDouble(axisBasePt);
5105 buf->put3BitDouble(startPt);
5106 buf->put3BitDouble(axisVector);
5107 buf->putBitDouble(radius);
5108 buf->putBitDouble(turns);
5109 buf->putBitDouble(turnHeight);
5110 buf->putBit(handedness ? 1 : 0);
5111 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(constraintType));
5112
5113 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
5114}
5115
5116bool DRW_MText::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5117 (void)bs;
5118 oType = 44; // MTEXT class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1215
5119 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5120
5121 // R2000/R2004/R2010 MTEXT body — mirror of DRW_MText::parseDwg.
5122 buf->put3BitDouble(basePoint); // insertion
5123 buf->put3BitDouble(extPoint); // extrusion
5124 buf->put3BitDouble(secPoint); // X-axis dir
5125 buf->putBitDouble(widthscale); // rect width
5126 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
5127 buf->putBitDouble(0.0); // rect height, R2007+
5128 }
5129 buf->putBitDouble(height); // text height
5130 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(textgen)); // attachment
5131 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(alignH)); // drawing dir
5132 buf->putBitDouble(0.0); // ext_ht (extents height; undocumented)
5133 buf->putBitDouble(0.0); // ext_wid (extents width; undocumented)
5134 // For AC1024: text goes to string buffer; for AC1015/AC1018: inline.
5135 (strBuf ? strBuf : buf)->putVariableText(version, text);
5136 // R2000+ extras:
5137 buf->putBitShort(linespacingStyle); // linespacing style BS 73
5138 buf->putBitDouble(interlin); // linespacing factor BD
5139 buf->putBit(0); // unknown bit
5140 if (version > DRW::AC1015) { // R2004+: background flags BL
5141 buf->putBitLong(m_backgroundFlags);
5142 if ((m_backgroundFlags & 0x01) || (version >= DRW::AC1032 && (m_backgroundFlags & 0x10))) {
5143 buf->putBitDouble(m_backgroundScale); // BitDouble (matches the read fix)
5144 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_backgroundColor));
5145 buf->putBitLong(m_backgroundTransparency);
5146 }
5147 }
5148 if (version >= DRW::AC1032) {
5149 buf->putBit(m_r2018IsNotAnnotative ? 1 : 0);
5150 if (m_r2018IsNotAnnotative) {
5151 buf->putBitShort(m_r2018Version);
5152 buf->putBit(m_r2018DefaultFlag ? 1 : 0);
5153 buf->putBitLong(m_r2018Attachment);
5154 buf->put3BitDouble(m_r2018XAxisDir);
5155 buf->put3BitDouble(m_r2018InsertionPoint);
5156 buf->putBitDouble(m_r2018RectWidth);
5157 buf->putBitDouble(m_r2018RectHeight);
5158 buf->putBitDouble(m_r2018ExtentsHeight);
5159 buf->putBitDouble(m_r2018ExtentsWidth);
5160 if (m_r2018ColumnType > 2
5161 || m_r2018ColumnCount < 0
5162 || m_r2018ColumnCount > kMaxMTextColumnHeights
5163 || m_r2018ColumnHeights.size()
5164 > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMTextColumnHeights))
5165 return false;
5166 buf->putBitShort(m_r2018ColumnType);
5167 if (m_r2018ColumnType != 0) {
5168 std::int32_t columnCount = m_r2018ColumnCount;
5169 if (!m_r2018ColumnAutoHeight && m_r2018ColumnType == 2
5170 && !m_r2018ColumnHeights.empty()) {
5171 columnCount = static_cast<std::int32_t>(m_r2018ColumnHeights.size());
5172 }
5173 if (!m_r2018ColumnAutoHeight && m_r2018ColumnType == 2
5174 && static_cast<std::size_t>(columnCount)
5175 != m_r2018ColumnHeights.size())
5176 return false;
5177 buf->putBitLong(columnCount);
5178 buf->putBitDouble(m_r2018ColumnWidth);
5179 buf->putBitDouble(m_r2018ColumnGutter);
5180 buf->putBit(m_r2018ColumnAutoHeight ? 1 : 0);
5181 buf->putBit(m_r2018ColumnFlowReversed ? 1 : 0);
5182 if (!m_r2018ColumnAutoHeight && m_r2018ColumnType == 2) {
5183 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < columnCount; ++i) {
5184 const double columnHeight = static_cast<size_t>(i) < m_r2018ColumnHeights.size()
5185 ? m_r2018ColumnHeights[static_cast<size_t>(i)]
5186 : 0.0;
5187 buf->putBitDouble(columnHeight);
5188 }
5189 }
5190 }
5191 }
5192 }
5193
5194 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
5195
5196 // styleH — hard pointer to STYLE table record (default STANDARD).
5197 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
5198 putHardPointerHandle(hb, (styleH.ref == 0) ? 0x13 : styleH.ref);
5199 if (version >= DRW::AC1032 && m_r2018IsNotAnnotative)
5200 putHardPointerHandle(hb, (m_r2018AppIdHandle == 0) ? 0x14 : m_r2018AppIdHandle);
5201 return buf->isGood() && hb->isGood();
5202}
5203
5204bool DRW_Insert::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5205 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
5206 if (buf == nullptr)
5207 return false;
5208 const bool hasAttrib = !attribHandles.empty();
5209 if (!hasAttrib) {
5210 if (seqendH.ref != DRW::NoHandle)
5211 return false;
5212 } else {
5213 if (seqendH.ref == DRW::NoHandle)
5214 return false;
5215 if (version < DRW::AC1018) {
5216 if (attribHandles.size() != 2 ||
5217 (attribHandles.front().ref == DRW::NoHandle) !=
5218 (attribHandles.back().ref == DRW::NoHandle)) {
5219 return false;
5220 }
5221 } else if (std::any_of(attribHandles.cbegin(), attribHandles.cend(),
5222 [](const dwgHandle& handle) {
5223 return handle.ref == DRW::NoHandle;
5224 })) {
5225 return false;
5226 }
5227 }
5228 if (attribHandles.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()))
5229 return false;
5230
5231 // 2b.6: emit MINSERT (oType 8) when a column/row grid is present;
5232 // otherwise a plain INSERT (oType 7). The reader keys the grid block off
5233 // oType==8 (parseDwg :3189).
5234 oType = isMInsert() ? 8 : 7;
5235 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5236
5237 // INSERT body — mirror of DRW_Insert::parseDwg for R2000.
5238 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.x);
5239 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.y);
5240 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
5241
5242 // dataFlags: pick the most compact form based on actual scales.
5243 // 3 → all scales default to 1.0 (no emit)
5244 // 2 → uniform scale (xscale RD only; yscale=zscale=xscale)
5245 // 1 → xscale defaults to 1, yscale/zscale as DD against xscale
5246 // 0 → xscale RD; yscale/zscale as DD against xscale
5247 if (sameStoredDouble(xscale, 1.0) && sameStoredDouble(yscale, 1.0)
5248 && sameStoredDouble(zscale, 1.0)) {
5249 buf->put2Bits(3);
5250 } else if (sameStoredDouble(xscale, yscale) && sameStoredDouble(yscale, zscale)) {
5251 buf->put2Bits(2);
5252 buf->putRawDouble(xscale);
5253 } else if (sameStoredDouble(xscale, 1.0)) {
5254 // xscale is exactly 1.0 (parseDwg leaves it at its 1.0 default and
5255 // never reads it in this branch), so it can be omitted; y and z are
5256 // independent and go through the same DD-against-1.0 path parseDwg
5257 // reads them with.
5258 buf->put2Bits(1);
5259 buf->putDefaultDouble(1.0, yscale);
5260 buf->putDefaultDouble(1.0, zscale);
5261 } else {
5262 // Use dataFlags=0 (general case): RD x + DD y + DD z.
5263 buf->put2Bits(0);
5264 buf->putRawDouble(xscale);
5265 buf->putDefaultDouble(xscale, yscale);
5266 buf->putDefaultDouble(xscale, zscale);
5267 }
5268
5269 buf->putBitDouble(angle); // radians
5270 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/false);
5271 buf->putBit(hasAttrib ? 1 : 0);
5272 if (hasAttrib && version > DRW::AC1015)
5273 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(attribHandles.size()));
5274 // hasAttrib==0 ⇒ the SINCE-R2004 num_owned BL is absent (parse :3184), so
5275 // the MINSERT grid (oType==8) follows the hasAttrib bit directly. Field
5276 // order mirrors parseDwg :3190-3193 (colcount BS, rowcount BS, colspace BD,
5277 // rowspace BD) and libreDWG dwg.spec num_cols/num_rows/col_spacing/row_spacing.
5278 if (oType == 8) { // MINSERT grid
5279 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(colcount));
5280 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(rowcount));
5281 buf->putBitDouble(colspace);
5282 buf->putBitDouble(rowspace);
5283 }
5284
5285 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
5286
5287 // BLOCK_RECORD hard pointer.
5288 dwgHandle bhH;
5289 bhH.code = (blockRecH.ref == 0) ? 0 : 5;
5290 bhH.ref = blockRecH.ref;
5291 bhH.size = 0;
5292 if (bhH.ref != 0) {
5293 std::uint32_t t = bhH.ref;
5294 while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++bhH.size; }
5295 }
5296 (handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf)->putHandle(bhH);
5297
5298 if (hasAttrib) {
5299 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
5300 if (version < DRW::AC1018) {
5301 for (const dwgHandle& attribHandle : attribHandles)
5302 putDwgReference(hb, DRW::DwgSoftPointer, attribHandle.ref);
5303 } else {
5304 const std::uint8_t attributeCode =
5305 oType == 8 ? DRW::DwgSoftPointer : DRW::DwgHardOwnership;
5306 for (const dwgHandle& attribHandle : attribHandles)
5307 putDwgReference(hb, attributeCode, attribHandle.ref);
5308 }
5309 putDwgReference(hb, DRW::DwgHardOwnership, seqendH.ref);
5310 }
5311 return buf->isGood() && (handleBuf == nullptr || handleBuf->isGood());
5312}
5313
5314bool DRW_3Dface::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5315 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
5316 oType = 28; // 3DFACE class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1237
5317 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5318
5319 // R2000+ 3DFACE body — mirror of parseDwg's z_is_zero / has_no_flag
5320 // optimization. Reader checks `invisibleflag != NoEdge`; if NoEdge,
5321 // emit has_no_flag=1 to suppress the BS read.
5322 bool hasNoFlag = (invisibleflag == /*NoEdge*/0);
5323 bool zIsZero = (basePoint.z == 0.0);
5324 buf->putBit(hasNoFlag ? 1 : 0);
5325 buf->putBit(zIsZero ? 1 : 0);
5326 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.x);
5327 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.y);
5328 if (!zIsZero) buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.z);
5329 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.x, secPoint.x);
5330 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.y, secPoint.y);
5331 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.z, secPoint.z);
5332 buf->putDefaultDouble(secPoint.x, thirdPoint.x);
5333 buf->putDefaultDouble(secPoint.y, thirdPoint.y);
5334 buf->putDefaultDouble(secPoint.z, thirdPoint.z);
5335 buf->putDefaultDouble(thirdPoint.x, fourPoint.x);
5336 buf->putDefaultDouble(thirdPoint.y, fourPoint.y);
5337 buf->putDefaultDouble(thirdPoint.z, fourPoint.z);
5338 if (!hasNoFlag) buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(invisibleflag));
5339
5340 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
5341}
5342
5343bool DRW_Solid::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5344 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
5345 oType = 31; // SOLID class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1305
5346 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5347
5348 // Same body layout as TRACE (4 corners + extrusion). Duplicated
5349 // here rather than delegating to DRW_Trace::encodeDwg because that
5350 // hardcodes oType=32.
5351 buf->putThickness(thickness, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
5352 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
5353 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.x);
5354 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.y);
5355 buf->putRawDouble(secPoint.x);
5356 buf->putRawDouble(secPoint.y);
5357 buf->putRawDouble(thirdPoint.x);
5358 buf->putRawDouble(thirdPoint.y);
5359 buf->putRawDouble(fourPoint.x);
5360 buf->putRawDouble(fourPoint.y);
5361 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
5362
5363 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
5364}
5365
5366bool DRW_LWPolyline::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5367 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
5368 if (buf == nullptr || !validatePayloadFields())
5369 return false;
5370 oType = 77; // LWPOLYLINE class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1202
5371 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5372
5373 // DRW_LWPolyline::flags carries DXF-side bits (1=closed, 128=plinegen).
5374 // DWG-side flags are different: they signal which optional fields are
5375 // present. Per parseDwg, bit 9 (0x200) = closed, bit 8 (0x100) =
5376 // plinegen. Build the DWG flags from the DXF flags plus the data.
5377 std::uint16_t dwgFlags = 0;
5378 if (flags & 1) dwgFlags |= 0x200; // closed
5379 if (flags & 128) dwgFlags |= 0x100; // plinegen
5380 if (thickness != 0.0) dwgFlags |= 0x2;
5381 if (width != 0.0) dwgFlags |= 0x4;
5382 if (elevation != 0.0) dwgFlags |= 0x8;
5383 bool defaultExt = (extPoint.x == 0.0 && extPoint.y == 0.0 && extPoint.z == 1.0);
5384 if (!defaultExt) dwgFlags |= 0x1;
5385 // Detect per-vertex bulge / width data.
5386 bool anyBulge = false;
5387 bool anyWidth = false;
5388 bool anyVertexId = false;
5389 for (const auto& v : vertlist) {
5390 if (v && v->bulge != 0.0) anyBulge = true;
5391 if (v && (v->stawidth != 0.0 || v->endwidth != 0.0)) anyWidth = true;
5392 if (v && v->identifier != 0) anyVertexId = true;
5393 }
5394 if (anyBulge) dwgFlags |= 0x10;
5395 if (anyWidth) dwgFlags |= 0x20;
5396 if (version > DRW::AC1021 && anyVertexId) dwgFlags |= 0x400;
5397
5398 buf->putBitShort(dwgFlags);
5399 if (dwgFlags & 0x4) buf->putBitDouble(width);
5400 if (dwgFlags & 0x8) buf->putBitDouble(elevation);
5401 if (dwgFlags & 0x2) buf->putBitDouble(thickness);
5402 if (dwgFlags & 0x1) buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/false);
5403
5404 const std::int32_t numVerts = static_cast<std::int32_t>(vertlist.size());
5405 buf->putBitLong(numVerts);
5406 if (dwgFlags & 0x10) buf->putBitLong(numVerts); // bulgesnum
5407 if (version > DRW::AC1021 && (dwgFlags & 0x400)) {
5408 buf->putBitLong(numVerts); // vertexIdCount
5409 }
5410 if (dwgFlags & 0x20) buf->putBitLong(numVerts); // widthsnum
5411
5412 if (numVerts > 0) {
5413 // First vertex as 2RD. Subsequent vertices as 2DD relative to
5414 // the previous, with putDefaultDouble always emitting code 0b11
5415 // (full RD); the reader's getDefaultDouble returns the raw value.
5416 buf->putRawDouble(vertlist[0]->x);
5417 buf->putRawDouble(vertlist[0]->y);
5418 for (size_t i = 1; i < vertlist.size(); ++i) {
5419 buf->putDefaultDouble(vertlist[i-1]->x, vertlist[i]->x);
5420 buf->putDefaultDouble(vertlist[i-1]->y, vertlist[i]->y);
5421 }
5422 if (dwgFlags & 0x10) {
5423 for (const auto& v : vertlist)
5424 buf->putBitDouble(v->bulge);
5425 }
5426 if (version > DRW::AC1021 && (dwgFlags & 0x400)) {
5427 for (const auto& v : vertlist)
5428 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(v->identifier));
5429 }
5430 if (dwgFlags & 0x20) {
5431 for (const auto& v : vertlist) {
5432 buf->putBitDouble(v->stawidth);
5433 buf->putBitDouble(v->endwidth);
5434 }
5435 }
5436 }
5437
5438 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
5439}
5440
5441bool DRW_Block::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5442 (void)bs;
5443 // BLOCK = 4, ENDBLK = 5 per DWG spec. isEnd controls which.
5444 oType = isEnd ? 5 : 4;
5445 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5446 if (!isEnd) {
5447 (strBuf ? strBuf : buf)->putVariableText(version, name);
5448 }
5449 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
5450 buf->putBit(0); // unknown bit (R2007+: always 0 for our output)
5451 }
5452 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
5453}
5454
5455bool DRW_Text::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5456 (void)bs;
5457 oType = 1; // TEXT class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1208
5458 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5459
5460 // R2000+ TEXT body — mirror of DRW_Text::parseDwg. We emit
5461 // data_flags=0 so the reader sees every optional field rather than
5462 // substituting defaults — keeps the encoder simple, costs ~30 bytes
5463 // per TEXT versus the most compressed form.
5464 buf->putRawChar8(0); // data_flags=0
5465 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.z); // elevation RD
5466 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.x); // insertion 2RD
5467 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.y);
5468 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.x, secPoint.x); // alignment 2DD
5469 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.y, secPoint.y);
5470 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
5471 buf->putThickness(thickness, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
5472 buf->putRawDouble(oblique); // oblique angle
5473 // Angle: struct holds degrees; on-disk format is radians. Reader
5474 // does `angle *= ARAD` (180/π) after read. Inverse: divide here.
5475 buf->putRawDouble(angle / ARAD57.29577951308232);
5476 buf->putRawDouble(height); // text height
5477 buf->putRawDouble(widthscale); // width factor
5478 (strBuf ? strBuf : buf)->putVariableText(version, text); // text string
5479 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(textgen));
5480 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(alignH));
5481 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(alignV));
5482
5483 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
5484
5485 // styleH — hard pointer to STYLE table record. Default points at
5486 // the STANDARD textstyle (handle 0x13) if caller hasn't set one.
5487 dwgHandle sH;
5488 std::uint32_t sref = (styleH.ref == 0) ? 0x13 : styleH.ref;
5489 sH.code = 5; // hard pointer
5490 sH.ref = sref;
5491 sH.size = 0;
5492 if (sref != 0) {
5493 std::uint32_t t = sref;
5494 while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++sH.size; }
5495 }
5496 (handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf)->putHandle(sH);
5497 return true;
5498}
5499
5500bool DRW_Ellipse::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5501 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
5502 oType = 35; // ELLIPSE class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1117
5503 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5504
5505 // Ellipse body — mirror of DRW_Ellipse::parseDwg.
5506 buf->put3BitDouble(basePoint); // center
5507 buf->put3BitDouble(secPoint); // major axis vector
5508 buf->put3BitDouble(extPoint); // extrusion
5509 buf->putBitDouble(ratio); // minor/major ratio
5510 buf->putBitDouble(staparam); // start parameter
5511 buf->putBitDouble(endparam); // end parameter
5512
5513 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
5514}
5515
5516bool DRW_Arc::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
5517 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
5518 oType = 17; // ARC class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1093
5519 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
5520
5521 // Arc body — Circle body + 2 BD angles.
5522 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.x);
5523 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.y);
5524 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
5525 buf->putBitDouble(radious);
5526 buf->putThickness(thickness, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
5527 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
5528 buf->putBitDouble(staangle);
5529 buf->putBitDouble(endangle);
5530
5531 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
5532}
5533
5534bool DRW_Line::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
5535 resetDwgState();
5536 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
5537 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
5538 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
5539 sourceBuf->invalidate();
5540 resetDwgState();
5541 return false;
5542 };
5543 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
5544 return fail();
5545
5546 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
5547 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs)
5548 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
5549 return fail();
5550 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
5551 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
5552 DRW_Coord parsedSecPoint;
5553 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
5554 double parsedThickness = 0.0;
5555 if (version < DRW::AC1015) {
5556 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint)
5557 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedSecPoint))
5558 return fail();
5559 } else {
5560 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, 1))
5561 return fail();
5562 const bool zIsZero = bodyProbe.getBit() != 0;
5563 if (!bodyProbe.isGood()
5564 || !readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5565 parsedBasePoint.x)
5566 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5567 parsedBasePoint.x,
5568 parsedSecPoint.x)
5569 || !readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5570 parsedBasePoint.y)
5571 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5572 parsedBasePoint.y,
5573 parsedSecPoint.y))
5574 return fail();
5575 if (zIsZero) {
5576 parsedBasePoint.z = 0.0;
5577 parsedSecPoint.z = 0.0;
5578 } else if (!readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5579 parsedBasePoint.z)
5580 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5581 parsedBasePoint.z,
5582 parsedSecPoint.z))
5583 return fail();
5584 }
5585 if (!readBoundedThickness(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5586 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedThickness)
5587 || !readBoundedExtrusion(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5588 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedExtrusion)
5589 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.x)
5590 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.y)
5591 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.z)
5592 || !std::isfinite(parsedSecPoint.x)
5593 || !std::isfinite(parsedSecPoint.y)
5594 || !std::isfinite(parsedSecPoint.z)
5595 || !std::isfinite(parsedThickness)
5596 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.x)
5597 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.y)
5598 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.z))
5599 return fail();
5600
5601 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
5602 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
5603 handleEndBit))
5604 return fail();
5605 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
5606 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
5607 handleEndBit)
5608 || !handleProbe.isGood())
5609 return fail();
5610
5611 basePoint = parsedBasePoint;
5612 secPoint = parsedSecPoint;
5613 thickness = parsedThickness;
5614 extPoint = parsedExtrusion;
5615 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
5616 return true;
5617}
5618
5619bool DRW_Ray::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
5620 resetDwgState();
5621 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;

5624 sourceBuf->invalidate();

5636 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;

5660 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
5661 return true;

5690bool DRW_Circle::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
5691 resetDwgState();
5692 radious = 0.0;
5693 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;

5695 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
5696 sourceBuf->invalidate();
5697 resetDwgState();
5698 return false;
5699 };
5700 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
5701 return fail();
5702
5703 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
5704 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs)
5705 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
5706 return fail();
5707 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
5708 DRW_Coord parsedCenter;
5709 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
5710 double parsedRadius = 0.0;
5711 double parsedThickness = 0.0;
5712 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedCenter)
5713 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedRadius)
5714 || !readBoundedThickness(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5715 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedThickness)
5716 || !readBoundedExtrusion(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5717 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedExtrusion)
5718 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.x)
5719 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.y)
5720 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.z)
5721 || !std::isfinite(parsedRadius)
5722 || !std::isfinite(parsedThickness)
5723 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.x)
5724 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.y)
5725 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.z))
5726 return fail();
5727
5728 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
5729 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
5730 handleEndBit))
5731 return fail();
5732 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
5733 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
5734 handleEndBit)
5735 || !handleProbe.isGood())
5736 return fail();
5737
5738 basePoint = parsedCenter;
5739 radious = parsedRadius;
5740 thickness = parsedThickness;
5741 extPoint = parsedExtrusion;
5742 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
5743 return true;

5746void DRW_Arc::applyExtrusion(){
5747 DRW_Circle::applyExtrusion();
5748
5749 if(haveExtrusion){
5750 // If the extrusion vector has a z value less than 0, the angles for the arc
5751 // have to be mirrored since DXF files use the right hand rule.
5752 // Note that the following code only handles the special case where there is a 2D
5753 // drawing with the z axis heading into the paper (or rather screen). An arbitrary
5754 // extrusion axis (with x and y values greater than 1/64) may still have issues.
5755 if (fabs(extPoint.x) < 0.015625 && fabs(extPoint.y) < 0.015625 && extPoint.z < 0.0) {
5756 staangle=M_PI3.14159265358979323846-staangle;
5757 endangle=M_PI3.14159265358979323846-endangle;
5758
5759 double temp = staangle;
5760 staangle=endangle;
5761 endangle=temp;
5762 }
5763 }
5764}

5766bool DRW_Arc::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
5767 switch (code) {
5768 case 50:
5769 staangle = reader->getDouble()/ ARAD57.29577951308232;
5770 break;
5771 case 51:
5772 endangle = reader->getDouble()/ ARAD57.29577951308232;
5773 break;
5774 default:
5775 return DRW_Circle::parseCode(code, reader);
5776 }
5777
5778 return true;
5779}

5781bool DRW_Arc::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
5782 DRW_Circle::resetDwgState();
5783 radious = 0.0;
5784 staangle = 0.0;
5785 endangle = 0.0;
5786 isccw = 1;
5787 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
5788 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
5789 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
5790 sourceBuf->invalidate();
5791 DRW_Circle::resetDwgState();
5792 staangle = 0.0;
5793 endangle = 0.0;
5794 isccw = 1;
5795 return false;
5796 };
5797 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
5798 return fail();
5799
5800 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
5801 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs)
5802 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
5803 return fail();
5804 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
5805 DRW_Coord parsedCenter;
5806 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
5807 double parsedRadius = 0.0;
5808 double parsedThickness = 0.0;
5809 double parsedStartAngle = 0.0;
5810 double parsedEndAngle = 0.0;
5811 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedCenter)
5812 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedRadius)
5813 || !readBoundedThickness(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5814 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedThickness)
5815 || !readBoundedExtrusion(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
5816 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedExtrusion)
5817 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedStartAngle)
5818 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedEndAngle)
5819 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.x)
5820 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.y)
5821 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.z)
5822 || !std::isfinite(parsedRadius)
5823 || !std::isfinite(parsedThickness)
5824 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.x)
5825 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.y)
5826 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.z)
5827 || !std::isfinite(parsedStartAngle)
5828 || !std::isfinite(parsedEndAngle))
5829 return fail();
5830
5831 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
5832 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
5833 handleEndBit))
5834 return fail();
5835 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
5836 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
5837 handleEndBit)
5838 || !handleProbe.isGood())
5839 return fail();
5840
5841 basePoint = parsedCenter;
5842 radious = parsedRadius;
5843 thickness = parsedThickness;
5844 extPoint = parsedExtrusion;
5845 staangle = parsedStartAngle;
5846 endangle = parsedEndAngle;
5847 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
5848 return true;
5849}

5851bool DRW_Ellipse::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
5852 switch (code) {
5853 case 40:
5854 ratio = reader->getDouble();
5855 break;
5856 case 41:
5857 staparam = reader->getDouble();
5858 break;
5859 case 42:
5860 endparam = reader->getDouble();
5861 break;
5862 default:
5863 return DRW_Line::parseCode(code, reader);
5864 }
5865
5866 return true;
5867}
5868
5869void DRW_Ellipse::applyExtrusion(){
5870 if (haveExtrusion) {
5871 calculateAxis(extPoint);
5872 extrudePoint(extPoint, &basePoint);
5873 extrudePoint(extPoint, &secPoint);
5874 double intialparam = staparam;
5875 if (extPoint.z < 0.){
5876 staparam = M_PIx26.283185307179586 - endparam;
5877 endparam = M_PIx26.283185307179586 - intialparam;
5878 }
5879 }
5880}
5881
5882//if ratio > 1 minor axis are greather than major axis, correct it
5883void DRW_Ellipse::correctAxis(){
5884 bool complete = false;
5885 if (staparam == endparam) {
5886 staparam = 0.0;
5887 endparam = M_PIx26.283185307179586; //2*M_PI;
5888 complete = true;
5889 }
5890 if (ratio > 1){
5891 if ( fabs(endparam - staparam - M_PIx26.283185307179586) < 1.0e-10)
5892 complete = true;
5893 double incX = secPoint.x;
5894 secPoint.x = -(secPoint.y * ratio);
5895 secPoint.y = incX*ratio;
5896 ratio = 1/ratio;
5897 if (!complete){
5898 if (staparam < M_PI_21.57079632679489661923)
5899 staparam += M_PI3.14159265358979323846 *2;
5900 if (endparam < M_PI_21.57079632679489661923)
5901 endparam += M_PI3.14159265358979323846 *2;
5902 endparam -= M_PI_21.57079632679489661923;
5903 staparam -= M_PI_21.57079632679489661923;
5904 }
5905 }
5906}
5907
5908bool DRW_Ellipse::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
5909 resetDwgState();
5910 ratio = 1.0;
5911 staparam = 0.0;
5912 endparam = 0.0;
5913 isccw = 1;
5914 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
5915 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
5916 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
5917 sourceBuf->invalidate();
5918 resetDwgState();
5919 ratio = 1.0;
5920 staparam = 0.0;
5921 endparam = 0.0;
5922 isccw = 1;
5923 return false;
5924 };
5925 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
5926 return fail();
5927
5928 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
5929 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs)
5930 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
5931 return fail();
5932 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
5933 DRW_Coord parsedCenter;
5934 DRW_Coord parsedAxis;
5935 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
5936 double parsedRatio = 1.0;
5937 double parsedStart = 0.0;
5938 double parsedEnd = 0.0;
5939 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedCenter)
5940 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedAxis)
5941 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedExtrusion)
5942 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedRatio)
5943 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedStart)
5944 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedEnd)
5945 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.x)
5946 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.y)
5947 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.z)
5948 || !std::isfinite(parsedAxis.x)
5949 || !std::isfinite(parsedAxis.y)
5950 || !std::isfinite(parsedAxis.z)
5951 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.x)
5952 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.y)
5953 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.z)
5954 || !std::isfinite(parsedRatio)
5955 || !std::isfinite(parsedStart)
5956 || !std::isfinite(parsedEnd))
5957 return fail();
5958
5959 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
5960 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
5961 handleEndBit))
5962 return fail();
5963 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
5964 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
5965 handleEndBit)
5966 || !handleProbe.isGood())
5967 return fail();
5968
5969 basePoint = parsedCenter;
5970 secPoint = parsedAxis;
5971 extPoint = parsedExtrusion;
5972 ratio = parsedRatio;
5973 staparam = parsedStart;
5974 endparam = parsedEnd;
5975 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
5976 return true;
5977}
5978
5979//parts are the number of vertex to split polyline, default 128
5980void DRW_Ellipse::toPolyline(DRW_Polyline *pol, int parts){
5981 double radMajor, radMinor, cosRot, sinRot, incAngle, curAngle;
5982 double cosCurr, sinCurr;
5983 radMajor = hypot(secPoint.x, secPoint.y);
5984 radMinor = radMajor*ratio;
5985 //calculate sin & cos of included angle
5986 incAngle = atan2(secPoint.y, secPoint.x);
5987 cosRot = cos(incAngle);
5988 sinRot = sin(incAngle);
5989 incAngle = M_PIx26.283185307179586 / parts;
5990 curAngle = staparam;
5991 int i = static_cast<int>(curAngle / incAngle);
5992 do {
5993 if (curAngle > endparam) {
5994 curAngle = endparam;
5995 i = parts+2;
5996 }
5997 cosCurr = cos(curAngle);
5998 sinCurr = sin(curAngle);
5999 double x = basePoint.x + (cosCurr*cosRot*radMajor) - (sinCurr*sinRot*radMinor);
6000 double y = basePoint.y + (cosCurr*sinRot*radMajor) + (sinCurr*cosRot*radMinor);
6001 pol->addVertex( DRW_Vertex(x, y, 0.0, 0.0));
6002 curAngle = (++i)*incAngle;
6003 } while (i<parts);
6004 if ( fabs(endparam - staparam - M_PIx26.283185307179586) < 1.0e-10){
6005 pol->flags = 1;
6006 }
6007 pol->layer = this->layer;
6008 pol->lineType = this->lineType;
6009 pol->color = this->color;
6010 pol->lWeight = this->lWeight;
6011 pol->extPoint = this->extPoint;
6012}

6057bool DRW_Trace::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
6058 std::uint32_t bs) {
6059 resetDwgState();
6060 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
6061 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
6062 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
6063 sourceBuf->invalidate();
6064 resetDwgState();
6065 return false;
6066 };
6067 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
6068 return fail();
6069
6070 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
6071 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs)
6072 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
6073 return fail();
6074
6075 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
6076 double parsedThickness = 0.0;
6077 double parsedElevation = 0.0;
6078 std::array<double, 8> coordinates{};
6079 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
6080 if (!readBoundedThickness(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
6081 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedThickness)
6082 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedElevation))
6083 return fail();
6084 for (double& coordinate : coordinates) {
6085 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, coordinate)
6086 || !std::isfinite(coordinate))
6087 return fail();
6088 }
6089 if (!std::isfinite(parsedThickness)
6090 || !std::isfinite(parsedElevation)
6091 || !readBoundedExtrusion(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
6092 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedExtrusion)
6093 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.x)
6094 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.y)
6095 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.z))
6096 return fail();
6097
6098 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
6099 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
6100 handleEndBit))
6101 return fail();
6102 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
6103 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
6104 handleEndBit)
6105 || !handleProbe.isGood())
6106 return fail();
6107
6108 thickness = parsedThickness;
6109 basePoint = DRW_Coord{coordinates[0], coordinates[1], parsedElevation};
6110 secPoint = DRW_Coord{coordinates[2], coordinates[3], parsedElevation};
6111 thirdPoint = DRW_Coord{coordinates[4], coordinates[5], parsedElevation};
6112 fourPoint = DRW_Coord{coordinates[6], coordinates[7], parsedElevation};
6113 extPoint = parsedExtrusion;
6114 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
6115 return true;
6116}

6119 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing Solid *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing Solid *********************************************\n"
);
6120 return DRW_Trace::parseDwg(v, buf, bs);
