6134
6135bool DRW_3Dface::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf,
6136 std::uint32_t bs) {
6137 DRW_Trace::resetDwgState();
6138 invisibleflag = 0;
6139 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
6140 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
6141 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
6142 sourceBuf->invalidate();
6143 DRW_Trace::resetDwgState();
6144 invisibleflag = 0;
6145 return false;
6146 };
6147 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
6148 return fail();
6149
6150 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
6151 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(v, &bodyProbe, bs)
6152 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
6153 return fail();
6154
6155 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
6156 std::array<DRW_Coord, 4> points{};
6157 std::uint16_t parsedInvisibleFlag = 0;
6158 if (v < DRW::AC1015) {
6159 for (DRW_Coord& point : points) {
6160 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, point.x)
6161 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, point.y)
6162 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, point.z))
6163 return fail();
6164 }
6165 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
6166 parsedInvisibleFlag))
6167 return fail();
6168 } else {
6169 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, 2))
6170 return fail();
6171 const bool hasNoFlag = bodyProbe.getBit() != 0;
6172 const bool zIsZero = bodyProbe.getBit() != 0;
6173 if (!bodyProbe.isGood()
6174 || !readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[0].x)
6175 || !readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[0].y))
6176 return fail();
6177 if (zIsZero) {
6178 points[0].z = 0.0;
6179 } else if (!readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
6180 points[0].z)) {
6181 return fail();
6182 }
6183
6184 if (!readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[0].x,
6185 points[1].x)
6186 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[0].y,
6187 points[1].y)
6188 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[0].z,
6189 points[1].z)
6190 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[1].x,
6191 points[2].x)
6192 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[1].y,
6193 points[2].y)
6194 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[1].z,
6195 points[2].z)
6196 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[2].x,
6197 points[3].x)
6198 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[2].y,
6199 points[3].y)
6200 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, points[2].z,
6201 points[3].z))
6202 return fail();
6203 if (hasNoFlag) {
6204 parsedInvisibleFlag = NoEdge;
6205 } else if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
6206 parsedInvisibleFlag)) {
6207 return fail();
6208 }
6209 }
6210
6211 for (const DRW_Coord& point : points) {
6212 if (!std::isfinite(point.x) || !std::isfinite(point.y)
6213 || !std::isfinite(point.z))
6214 return fail();
6215 }
6216 if (parsedInvisibleFlag > AllEdges)
6217 return fail();
6218
6219 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
6220 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
6221 return fail();
6222 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
6223 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit)
6224 || !handleProbe.isGood())
6225 return fail();
6226
6227 basePoint = points[0];
6228 secPoint = points[1];
6229 thirdPoint = points[2];
6230 fourPoint = points[3];
6231 invisibleflag = static_cast<int>(parsedInvisibleFlag);
6232 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
6233 return true;
6234}

6236void DRW_ModelerGeometry::resetDwgState() {
6237 DRW_Entity::reset();
6238 m_modelerVersion = 0;
6239 m_bodyBitSize = 0;
6240 m_objectSize = 0;
6241 m_isEmpty = false;
6242 m_hasModelerData = false;
6243 m_modelerDataUnknownBit = false;
6244 m_hasWireframe = false;
6245 m_historyHandle = 0;
6246 m_rawBytes.clear();
6247 m_payloadRanges.clear();
6248 m_wireframe = DRW_AcisBrep();
6249 m_wireframeDecoded = false;

6251
6252bool DRW_ModelerGeometry::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
6253 resetDwgState();
6254 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
6255 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
6256 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
6257 sourceBuf->invalidate();
6258 resetDwgState();
6259 return false;
6260 };
6261 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
6262 return fail();
6263
6264 dwgBuffer probe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
6265 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
6266 dwgBuffer *stringStream = v > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringProbe : nullptr;
6267 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(v, &probe, stringStream, bs);
6268 if (!ret)
6269 return fail();
6270 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing modeler geometry ******************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing modeler geometry ******************\n"
);
6271
6272 std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = 0;
6273 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(
6274 stringStream != nullptr ? *stringStream : probe,
6275 v, objSize, bodyEndBit))
6276 return fail();
6277 const std::uint64_t sourceEndBit = proxyEntityEndBit(*sourceBuf, 0);
6278 if ((v >= DRW::AC1015 && objSize == 0) || bodyEndBit > sourceEndBit
6279 || currentDwgBit(&probe) > bodyEndBit)
6280 return fail();
6281 bool parsedIsEmpty = false;
6282 bool parsedUnknownBit = false;
6283 std::uint16_t parsedModelerVersion = 0;
6284 if (!readBoundedBit(probe, bodyEndBit, parsedIsEmpty)
6285 || !readBoundedBit(probe, bodyEndBit, parsedUnknownBit))
6286 return fail();
6287 const bool parsedHasModelerData = !parsedIsEmpty;
6288 if (parsedHasModelerData
6289 && !readBoundedBitShort(probe, bodyEndBit, parsedModelerVersion))
6290 return fail();
6291 if (!probe.isGood() || (stringStream != nullptr && !stringStream->isGood()))
6292 return fail();
6293
6294 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
6295 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
6296 return fail();
6297 // R13-R2004 modeler bodies contain opaque ACIS/SAT data between this
6298 // header and the common handles. Do not interpret that payload: jump to
6299 // the bounded object-data end exactly as the surface/proxy readers do.
6300 dwgBuffer handleProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
6301 if (v <= DRW::AC1018) {
6302 if (!handleProbe.setPosition(bodyEndBit >> 3))
6303 return fail();
6304 handleProbe.setBitPos(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bodyEndBit & 7u));
6305 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
6306 return fail();
6307 }
6308 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit);
6309 if (!ret || !handleProbe.isGood())
6310 return fail();
6311 std::uint32_t parsedHistoryHandle = 0;
6312 if (eType == DRW::E3DSOLID && v > DRW::AC1018
6313 && proxyEntityHasBits(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 8)) {
6314 dwgHandle historyH;
6315 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
6316 historyH))
6317 return fail();
6318 parsedHistoryHandle = historyH.ref;
6319 DRW_DBG(" 3DSOLID history Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" 3DSOLID history Handle: ");
6320 DRW_DBGHL(historyH.code, historyH.size, historyH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(historyH.code, historyH.size, historyH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
6321 }
6322
6323 if (handleProbe.size() > std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())
6324 return fail();
6325 m_bodyBitSize = bs;
6326 m_objectSize = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(probe.size());
6327 m_isEmpty = parsedIsEmpty;
6328 m_hasModelerData = parsedHasModelerData;
6329 m_modelerDataUnknownBit = parsedUnknownBit;
6330 m_modelerVersion = parsedModelerVersion;
6331 m_historyHandle = parsedHistoryHandle;
6332 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
6333 return true;
6334}
6335
6336bool DRW_ModelerGeometry::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
6337 switch (code) {
6338 case 1:
6339 case 3:
6340 if (!appendTextBytesChecked(m_rawBytes, reader->getString(),
6341 dwgSafety::MaxBufferSize))
6342 return false;
6343 break;
6344 case 70: {
6345 const int value = reader->getInt32();
6346 if (value < 0 || value > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
6347 return false;
6348 m_modelerVersion = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
6349 break;
6350 }
6351 case 350:
6352 case 360:
6353 m_historyHandle = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getHandleString());
6354 break;
6355 case 310:
6356 {
6357 std::vector<std::uint8_t> decoded;
6358 if (!decodeHexBytes(reader->getString(), decoded))
6359 return false;
6360 if (!appendBytesChecked(m_rawBytes, decoded,
6361 dwgSafety::MaxBufferSize))
6362 return false;
6363 }
6364 break;
6365 default:
6366 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
6367 }
6368 return true;
6369}
6370
6371void DRW_Mesh::resetDwgState() {
6372 DRW_Entity::reset();
6373 version = 2;
6374 blendCrease = false;
6375 subdivisionLevel = 0;
6376 subdivVertices.clear();
6377 vertices.clear();
6378 faces.clear();
6379 edges.clear();
6380 creases.clear();
6381 unknown = 0;
6382 propertyOverrides.clear();
6383 m_dxfMeshSubclassSeen = false;
6384 m_dxfState = 0;
6385 m_dxfVertexCount = -1;
6386 m_dxfFaceItemsRemaining = -1;
6387 m_dxfEdgeValuesRemaining = -1;
6388 m_dxfCreaseValuesRemaining = -1;
6389 m_dxfPending = 0;
6390 m_dxfEdgeFrom = -1;
6391 m_dxfOverrideEntityCount = -1;
6392 m_dxfOverridePropertyCount = -1;
6393}
6394
6395// DRW_Mesh::parseDwg — AcDbSubDMesh, field order shared by ACadSharp and
6396// dwgTs. DWG group 91 is the subdivision level, not a refined-vertex count;
6397// the following BL is the level-0 vertex count.
6398bool DRW_Mesh::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
6399 resetDwgState();
6400 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
6401 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
6402 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
6403 sourceBuf->invalidate();
6404 resetDwgState();
6405 return false;
6406 };
6407 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
6408 return fail();
6409
6410 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
6411 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
6412 dwgBuffer *stringStream = v > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringProbe : nullptr;
6413 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(v, &bodyProbe, stringStream, bs))
6414 return fail();
6415 buf = &bodyProbe;
6416 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing MESH (AcDbSubDMesh) *****************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing MESH (AcDbSubDMesh) *****************\n"
);
6417 std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = 0;
6418 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(
6419 stringStream != nullptr ? *stringStream : bodyProbe,
6420 v, objSize, bodyEndBit))
6421 return fail();
6422
6423 auto readCount = [&](std::uint32_t minimumBitsPerItem,
6424 std::uint32_t& count) {
6425 return readTableBodyCount(
6426 v, buf, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(bodyEndBit),
6427 DRW_Mesh::kMaxMeshItems, minimumBitsPerItem, count);
6428 };
6429
6430 std::uint16_t parsedVersion = 0;
6431 bool parsedBlendCrease = false;
6432 std::int32_t parsedSubdivisionLevel = 0;
6433 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedVersion)
6434 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedBlendCrease)
6435 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedSubdivisionLevel)
6436 || parsedSubdivisionLevel < 0) {
6437 return fail();
6438 }
6439
6440 std::uint32_t nVert = 0; // BL vertex count (92)
6441 if (!readCount(6, nVert)) return fail(); // minimum 3BD width
6442 std::vector<DRW_Coord> parsedVertices;
6443 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedVertices, static_cast<int>(nVert)))
6444 return fail();
6445 std::vector<std::vector<std::int32_t>> parsedFaces;
6446 std::vector<std::pair<std::int32_t, std::int32_t>> parsedEdges;
6447 std::vector<double> parsedCreases;
6448 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nVert; ++i) {
6449 DRW_Coord point;
6450 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, point))
6451 return fail();
6452 parsedVertices.push_back(point);
6453 }
6454 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
6455 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
6456 && std::isfinite(point.z);
6457 };
6458 if (!buf->isGood()
6459 || (stringStream != nullptr && !stringStream->isGood())
6460 || !std::all_of(parsedVertices.begin(), parsedVertices.end(), finite))
6461 return fail();
6462
6463 // faces (93) is a FLAT BL stream of length num_faces; each face is
6464 // [count, idx0, idx1, ...]. num_faces is the stream length, not the polygon
6465 // count — group on the fly.
6466 std::uint32_t faceItems = 0; // BL face-list size (93)
6467 if (!readCount(2, faceItems)) return fail();
6468 std::int32_t remaining = static_cast<std::int32_t>(faceItems);
6469 while (remaining > 0 && buf->isGood()) {
6470 std::int32_t cnt = 0;
6471 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, cnt))
6472 return fail();
6473 --remaining;
6474 if (cnt < 0 || cnt > remaining)
6475 return fail();
6476 std::vector<std::int32_t> face;
6477 if (!DRW::reserve(face, cnt))
6478 return fail();
6479 for (std::int32_t j = 0; j < cnt; ++j) {
6480 std::int32_t index = 0;
6481 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, index))
6482 return fail();
6483 if (index < 0 || static_cast<std::uint32_t>(index) >= nVert)
6484 return fail();
6485 face.push_back(index);
6486 --remaining;
6487 }
6488 if (!buf->isGood()) return fail();
6489 parsedFaces.push_back(std::move(face));
6490 }
6491 if (remaining != 0 || !buf->isGood()) return fail();
6492
6493 std::uint32_t nEdges = 0; // BL edge count (94)
6494 if (!readCount(4, nEdges)) return fail(); // two minimum-width BL values
6495 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedEdges, static_cast<int>(nEdges)))
6496 return fail();
6497 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nEdges; ++i) {
6498 std::int32_t from = 0;
6499 std::int32_t to = 0;
6500 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, from)
6501 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, to))
6502 return fail();
6503 if (from < 0 || to < 0
6504 || static_cast<std::uint32_t>(from) >= nVert
6505 || static_cast<std::uint32_t>(to) >= nVert)
6506 return fail();
6507 parsedEdges.emplace_back(from, to);
6508 }
6509 if (!buf->isGood()) return fail();
6510
6511 std::uint32_t nCrease = 0; // BL crease count (95)
6512 if (!readCount(2, nCrease)) return fail(); // minimum-width BD value
6513 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedCreases, static_cast<int>(nCrease)))
6514 return fail();
6515 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nCrease; ++i) {
6516 double crease = 0.0;
6517 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, crease))
6518 return fail();
6519 parsedCreases.push_back(crease);
6520 }
6521 if (!buf->isGood()
6522 || !std::all_of(parsedCreases.begin(), parsedCreases.end(),
6523 [](double value) { return std::isfinite(value); }))
6524 return fail();
6525
6526 std::int32_t parsedUnknown = 0;
6527 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedUnknown))
6528 return fail(); // trailing unknown (BL)
6529
6530 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
6531 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
6532 return fail();
6533 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
6534 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit)
6535 || !handleProbe.isGood())
6536 return fail();
6537 vertices = std::move(parsedVertices);
6538 faces = std::move(parsedFaces);
6539 edges = std::move(parsedEdges);
6540 creases = std::move(parsedCreases);
6541 version = parsedVersion;
6542 blendCrease = parsedBlendCrease;
6543 subdivisionLevel = parsedSubdivisionLevel;
6544 unknown = parsedUnknown;
6545 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
6546 return true;
6547}
6548
6549// DRW_Mesh::parseCode — DXF read (codes 71/72/91/92/10·20·30/93/90/94/95/140).
6550// The 90 stream is shared by faces (after 93) and edges (after 94); m_dxfState
6551// sequences which one is being filled (mirrors DRW_Image::parseCode's stateful
6552// 91/14/24 WIPEOUT-vertex accumulation). After the crease stream, group 90
6553// starts the bounded property-override records described by AcDbSubDMesh.
6554bool DRW_Mesh::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
6555 try {
6556 switch (code) {
6557 case 71: {
6558 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
6559 if (value < 0 || value > std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max())
6560 return false;
6561 version = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
6562 return true;
6563 }
6564 case 72: {
6565 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
6566 if (value != 0 && value != 1)
6567 return false;
6568 blendCrease = value != 0;
6569 return true;
6570 }
6571 case 91: {
6572 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
6573 if (m_dxfOverrideEntityCount >= 0) {
6574 if (m_dxfState != 96
6575 || (!propertyOverrides.empty() && m_dxfOverridePropertyCount != 0)
6576 || propertyOverrides.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfOverrideEntityCount))
6577 return false;
6578 propertyOverrides.push_back({value, {}});
6579 m_dxfOverridePropertyCount = -1;
6580 return true;
6581 }
6582 if (value < 0)
6583 return false;
6584 subdivisionLevel = value;
6585 return true;
6586 }
6587 case 100:
6588 if (reader->getString() == "AcDbSubDMesh")
6589 m_dxfMeshSubclassSeen = true;
6590 return true;
6591 case 92: { // base-vertex count; later 92 values belong to overrides
6592 if (!m_dxfMeshSubclassSeen)
6593 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
6594 if (m_dxfVertexCount >= 0) {
6595 if (m_dxfOverrideEntityCount < 0 || m_dxfState != 96
6596 || propertyOverrides.empty() || m_dxfOverridePropertyCount >= 0)
6597 return false;
6598 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
6599 if (!isValidCount(count, 4))
6600 return false;
6601 if (!DRW::reserve(propertyOverrides.back().propertyTypes, count))
6602 return false;
6603 m_dxfOverridePropertyCount = count;
6604 return true;
6605 }
6606 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
6607 if (!isValidCount(count, DRW_Mesh::kMaxMeshItems))
6608 return false;
6609 if (!DRW::reserve(vertices, count))
6610 return false;
6611 m_dxfVertexCount = count;
6612 m_dxfState = 92;
6613 return true;
6614 }
6615 case 10:
6616 if (m_dxfState != 92 || m_dxfVertexCount < 0
6617 || vertices.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfVertexCount))
6618 return false;
6619 {
6620 const double value = reader->getDouble();
6621 if (!std::isfinite(value))
6622 return false;
6623 vertices.emplace_back();
6624 vertices.back().x = value;
6625 }
6626 return true;
6627 case 20:
6628 if (m_dxfState != 92 || vertices.empty())
6629 return false;
6630 {
6631 const double value = reader->getDouble();
6632 if (!std::isfinite(value))
6633 return false;
6634 vertices.back().y = value;
6635 }
6636 return true;
6637 case 30:
6638 if (m_dxfState != 92 || vertices.empty())
6639 return false;
6640 {
6641 const double value = reader->getDouble();
6642 if (!std::isfinite(value))
6643 return false;
6644 vertices.back().z = value;
6645 }
6646 return true;
6647 case 93: { // face-list item count
6648 if (m_dxfVertexCount < 0
6649 || vertices.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfVertexCount))
6650 return false;
6651 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
6652 if (!isValidCount(count, DRW_Mesh::kMaxMeshItems))
6653 return false;
6654 m_dxfState = 93;
6655 m_dxfFaceItemsRemaining = count;
6656 m_dxfPending = 0;
6657 return true;
6658 }
6659 case 94: { // edge count; each edge consumes two code-90 values
6660 if (m_dxfFaceItemsRemaining != 0 || m_dxfPending != 0)
6661 return false;
6662 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
6663 if (!isValidCount(count, DRW_Mesh::kMaxMeshItems))
6664 return false;
6665 m_dxfState = 94;
6666 m_dxfEdgeValuesRemaining = count * 2;
6667 m_dxfEdgeFrom = -1;
6668 if (!DRW::reserve(edges, count))
6669 return false;
6670 return true;
6671 }
6672 case 90: {
6673 const std::int32_t val = reader->getInt32();
6674 if (m_dxfState == 95) {
6675 if (m_dxfCreaseValuesRemaining != 0)
6676 return false;
6677 if (m_dxfOverrideEntityCount >= 0)
6678 return false;
6679 if (!isValidCount(val, DRW_Mesh::kMaxMeshItems))
6680 return false;
6681 m_dxfOverrideEntityCount = val;
6682 m_dxfOverridePropertyCount = val == 0 ? 0 : -1;
6683 m_dxfState = 96;
6684 } else if (m_dxfState == 96) {
6685 if (m_dxfOverrideEntityCount < 0 || propertyOverrides.empty()
6686 || m_dxfOverridePropertyCount <= 0 || val < 0 || val > 3)
6687 return false;
6688 propertyOverrides.back().propertyTypes.push_back(val);
6689 --m_dxfOverridePropertyCount;
6690 } else if (m_dxfState == 93) {
6691 if (m_dxfFaceItemsRemaining <= 0)
6692 return false;
6693 if (m_dxfPending == 0) {
6694 if (val < 3 || val > m_dxfFaceItemsRemaining - 1)
6695 return false;
6696 faces.emplace_back();
6697 m_dxfPending = val;
6698 --m_dxfFaceItemsRemaining;
6699 } else {
6700 if (val < 0 || val >= m_dxfVertexCount)
6701 return false;
6702 if (!faces.empty())
6703 faces.back().push_back(val);
6704 --m_dxfFaceItemsRemaining;
6705 --m_dxfPending;
6706 }
6707 } else if (m_dxfState == 94) {
6708 if (m_dxfEdgeValuesRemaining <= 0 || val < 0 || val >= m_dxfVertexCount)
6709 return false;
6710 --m_dxfEdgeValuesRemaining;
6711 if (m_dxfEdgeFrom < 0)
6712 m_dxfEdgeFrom = val;
6713 else {
6714 edges.emplace_back(m_dxfEdgeFrom, val);
6715 m_dxfEdgeFrom = -1;
6716 }
6717 } else {
6718 return false;
6719 }
6720 return true;
6721 }
6722 case 95: { // edge crease count
6723 if (m_dxfEdgeValuesRemaining != 0 || m_dxfEdgeFrom != -1)
6724 return false;
6725 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
6726 if (!isValidCount(count, DRW_Mesh::kMaxMeshItems))
6727 return false;
6728 m_dxfState = 95;
6729 m_dxfCreaseValuesRemaining = count;
6730 if (!DRW::reserve(creases, count))
6731 return false;
6732 return true;
6733 }
6734 case 140:
6735 if (m_dxfState != 95 || m_dxfCreaseValuesRemaining <= 0)
6736 return false;
6737 {
6738 const double value = reader->getDouble();
6739 if (!std::isfinite(value))
6740 return false;
6741 creases.push_back(value);
6742 }
6743 --m_dxfCreaseValuesRemaining;
6744 return true;
6745 default:
6746 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
6747 }
6748 } catch (...) {
6749 return false;
6750 }
6751}
6752
6753bool DRW_Mesh::validateGeometry() const {
6754 if (subdivisionLevel < 0
6755 || vertices.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMeshItems)
6756 || edges.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMeshItems)
6757 || faces.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMeshItems)
6758 || creases.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMeshItems))
6759 return false;
6760
6761 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
6762 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
6763 && std::isfinite(point.z);
6764 };
6765 if (!std::all_of(vertices.cbegin(), vertices.cend(), finite)
6766 || !std::all_of(creases.cbegin(), creases.cend(),
6767 [](double value) { return std::isfinite(value); }))
6768 return false;
6769 std::int32_t faceStreamCount = 0;
6770 for (const auto& face : faces) {
6771 if (face.size() < 3
6772 || face.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMeshItems - 1)
6773 || faceStreamCount > kMaxMeshItems
6774 - static_cast<std::int32_t>(face.size() + 1))
6775 return false;
6776 for (std::int32_t index : face) {
6777 if (index < 0
6778 || static_cast<std::size_t>(index) >= vertices.size())
6779 return false;
6780 }
6781 faceStreamCount += static_cast<std::int32_t>(face.size() + 1);
6782 }
6783 for (const auto& edge : edges) {
6784 if (edge.first < 0 || edge.second < 0
6785 || static_cast<std::size_t>(edge.first) >= vertices.size()
6786 || static_cast<std::size_t>(edge.second) >= vertices.size())
6787 return false;
6788 }
6789 return true;
6790}
6791
6792bool DRW_Mesh::validateDxf() const {
6793 if (!m_dxfMeshSubclassSeen
6794 || m_dxfVertexCount < 0
6795 || vertices.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfVertexCount)
6796 || m_dxfFaceItemsRemaining != 0
6797 || m_dxfPending != 0
6798 || m_dxfEdgeValuesRemaining != 0
6799 || m_dxfEdgeFrom != -1
6800 || m_dxfCreaseValuesRemaining != 0
6801 || (m_dxfOverrideEntityCount >= 0
6802 && (m_dxfOverridePropertyCount < 0
6803 || m_dxfOverridePropertyCount != 0
6804 || propertyOverrides.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfOverrideEntityCount))))
6805 return false;
6806 for (const auto& overrideData : propertyOverrides) {
6807 if (overrideData.subEntityMarker < 0
6808 || overrideData.propertyTypes.size() > 4u)
6809 return false;
6810 if (!std::all_of(overrideData.propertyTypes.cbegin(),
6811 overrideData.propertyTypes.cend(),
6812 [](std::int32_t type) { return type >= 0 && type <= 3; }))
6813 return false;
6814 }
6815 return validateGeometry();
6816}
6817
6818bool DRW_Mesh::validateDxfOutput() const {
6819 if (version > static_cast<std::uint16_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max())
6820 || propertyOverrides.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMeshItems))
6821 return false;
6822 for (const auto& overrideData : propertyOverrides) {
6823 if (overrideData.subEntityMarker < 0
6824 || overrideData.propertyTypes.size() > 4u
6825 || !std::all_of(overrideData.propertyTypes.cbegin(),
6826 overrideData.propertyTypes.cend(),
6827 [](std::int32_t type) { return type >= 0 && type <= 3; }))
6828 return false;
6829 }
6830 return validateGeometry();
6831}
6832
6833bool DRW_Mesh::encodeDwg(DRW::Version dwgVersion, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
6834 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
6835 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
6836 if (!validateGeometry())
6837 return false;
6838
6839 std::int32_t faceStreamCount = 0;
6840 for (const auto& face : faces)
6841 faceStreamCount += static_cast<std::int32_t>(face.size() + 1);
6842
6843 oType = kDwgClassNum;
6844 if (!encodeDwgCommon(dwgVersion, buf)) return false;
6845
6846 buf->putBitShort(version);
6847 buf->putBit(blendCrease ? 1 : 0);
6848
6849 buf->putBitLong(subdivisionLevel);
6850
6851 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(vertices.size()));
6852 for (const DRW_Coord& vertex : vertices)
6853 buf->put3BitDouble(vertex);
6854
6855 buf->putBitLong(faceStreamCount);
6856 for (const auto& face : faces) {
6857 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(face.size()));
6858 for (std::int32_t index : face)
6859 buf->putBitLong(index);
6860 }
6861
6862 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(edges.size()));
6863 for (const auto& edge : edges) {
6864 buf->putBitLong(edge.first);
6865 buf->putBitLong(edge.second);
6866 }
6867
6868 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(creases.size()));
6869 for (double crease : creases)
6870 buf->putBitDouble(crease);
6871
6872 buf->putBitLong(unknown);
6873
6874 return encodeDwgEntHandle(dwgVersion, buf, handleBuf);
6875}
6876
6877bool DRW_Shape::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
6878 switch (code) {
6879 case 2:
6880 m_styleName = reader->getUtf8String();
6881 break;
6882 case 10:
6883 m_insertionPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
6884 break;
6885 case 20:
6886 m_insertionPoint.y = reader->getDouble();
6887 break;
6888 case 30:
6889 m_insertionPoint.z = reader->getDouble();
6890 break;
6891 case 39:
6892 m_thickness = reader->getDouble();
6893 break;
6894 case 40:
6895 m_scale = reader->getDouble();
6896 break;
6897 case 41:
6898 m_widthFactor = reader->getDouble();
6899 break;
6900 case 50:
6901 m_rotation = reader->getDouble() / ARAD57.29577951308232;
6902 break;
6903 case 51:
6904 m_oblique = reader->getDouble() / ARAD57.29577951308232;
6905 break;
6906 case 210:
6907 m_extrusion.x = reader->getDouble();
6908 break;
6909 case 220:
6910 m_extrusion.y = reader->getDouble();
6911 break;
6912 case 230:
6913 m_extrusion.z = reader->getDouble();
6914 break;
6915 default:
6916 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
6917 }
6918 return true;
6919}
6920
6921void DRW_Shape::resetDwgState() {
6922 DRW_Entity::reset();
6923 m_insertionPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
6924 m_scale = 1.0;
6925 m_rotation = 0.0;
6926 m_widthFactor = 1.0;
6927 m_oblique = 0.0;
6928 m_thickness = 0.0;
6929 m_shapeIndex = 0;
6930 m_extrusion = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
6931 m_shapeFileHandle = 0;
6932 m_objectSize = 0;
6933 m_bodyBitSize = 0;
6934 m_rawBytes.clear();
6935}
6936
6937bool DRW_Shape::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
6938 resetDwgState();
6939 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
6940 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
6941 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
6942 sourceBuf->invalidate();
6943 resetDwgState();
6944 return false;
6945 };
6946 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
6947 return fail();
6948
6949 m_bodyBitSize = bs;
6950 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
6951 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(v, &bodyProbe, bs))
6952 return fail();
6953 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing SHAPE *****************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing SHAPE *****************************\n"
);
6954
6955 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
6956 DRW_Coord insertionPoint;
6957 DRW_Coord extrusion;
6958 double scale = 0.0;
6959 double rotation = 0.0;
6960 double widthFactor = 0.0;
6961 double oblique = 0.0;
6962 double thickness = 0.0;
6963 std::uint16_t shapeIndex = 0;
6964 if (!readBounded3BitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, insertionPoint)
6965 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, scale)
6966 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, rotation)
6967 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, widthFactor)
6968 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, oblique)
6969 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, thickness)
6970 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, shapeIndex)
6971 || !readBounded3BitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, extrusion))
6972 return fail();
6973 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
6974 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
6975 && std::isfinite(point.z);
6976 };
6977 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || !finite(insertionPoint) || !finite(extrusion)
6978 || !std::isfinite(scale) || !std::isfinite(rotation)
6979 || !std::isfinite(widthFactor) || !std::isfinite(oblique)
6980 || !std::isfinite(thickness))
6981 return fail();
6982
6983 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
6984 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
6985 return fail();
6986 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
6987 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit)
6988 || !handleProbe.isGood())
6989 return fail();
6990
6991 // DwgObjectFrame removes the CRC trailer before exposing the body. The
6992 // SHAPEFILE hard pointer is therefore mandatory and must be parsed even
6993 // when only its exact handle bytes remain.
6994 dwgHandle shapeFileH;
6995 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
6996 shapeFileH)
6997 || shapeFileH.ref == 0)
6998 return fail();
6999
7000 m_insertionPoint = insertionPoint;
7001 m_scale = scale;
7002 m_rotation = rotation;
7003 m_widthFactor = widthFactor;
7004 m_oblique = oblique;
7005 m_thickness = thickness;
7006 m_shapeIndex = shapeIndex;
7007 m_extrusion = extrusion;
7008 m_shapeFileHandle = shapeFileH.ref;
7009 DRW_DBG(" SHAPEFILE Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" SHAPEFILE Handle: ");
7010 DRW_DBGHL(shapeFileH.code, shapeFileH.size, shapeFileH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(shapeFileH.code, shapeFileH.size, shapeFileH.ref
);
7011 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
7012 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
7013 return true;
7014}
7015
7016// Phase 6.1: SHAPE encoder (fixed oType 33). Exact inverse of parseDwg above.
7017// Without this override a SHAPE would encode as a LINE (default DRW_Entity).
7018bool DRW_Shape::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
7019 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
7020 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
7021 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
7022 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
7023 && std::isfinite(point.z);
7024 };
7025 if (!finite(m_insertionPoint) || !finite(m_extrusion)
7026 || !std::isfinite(m_scale) || !std::isfinite(m_rotation)
7027 || !std::isfinite(m_widthFactor) || !std::isfinite(m_oblique)
7028 || !std::isfinite(m_thickness) || m_shapeFileHandle == 0) {
7029 return false;
7030 }
7031 oType = 33; // SHAPE class id — see dwgreader.cpp case 33
7032 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
7033
7034 buf->put3BitDouble(m_insertionPoint);
7035 buf->putBitDouble(m_scale);
7036 buf->putBitDouble(m_rotation);
7037 buf->putBitDouble(m_widthFactor);
7038 buf->putBitDouble(m_oblique);
7039 buf->putBitDouble(m_thickness);
7040 buf->putBitShort(m_shapeIndex);
7041 buf->put3BitDouble(m_extrusion);
7042
7043 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
7044
7045 // Trailing SHAPEFILE style hard pointer (code 5), byte-count-sized.
7046 dwgHandle sH;
7047 sH.code = 5;
7048 sH.ref = m_shapeFileHandle;
7049 sH.size = 0;
7050 if (m_shapeFileHandle != 0) {
7051 std::uint32_t t = m_shapeFileHandle;
7052 while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++sH.size; }
7053 } else {
7054 sH.code = 0; // null handle
7055 }
7056 (handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf)->putHandle(sH);
7057 return true;
7058}
7059
7060bool DRW_Ole2Frame::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
7061 const auto readUnsigned = [&](std::uint32_t maximum,
7062 std::uint32_t& target) {
7063 const int value = reader->getInt32();
7064 if (value < 0 || static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value) > maximum)
7065 return false;
7066 target = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value);
7067 return true;
7068 };
7069
7070 switch (code) {
7071 case 3:
7072 m_oleClient = reader->getUtf8String();
7073 break;
7074 case 10:
7075 m_pt1.x = reader->getDouble();
7076 break;
7077 case 20:
7078 m_pt1.y = reader->getDouble();
7079 break;
7080 case 30:
7081 m_pt1.z = reader->getDouble();
7082 break;
7083 case 11:
7084 m_pt2.x = reader->getDouble();
7085 break;
7086 case 21:
7087 m_pt2.y = reader->getDouble();
7088 break;
7089 case 31:
7090 m_pt2.z = reader->getDouble();
7091 break;
7092 case 70: {
7093 std::uint32_t value = 0;
7094 if (!readUnsigned(std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max(), value))
7095 return false;
7096 m_oleVersion = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
7097 break;
7098 }
7099 case 71: {
7100 std::uint32_t value = 0;
7101 if (!readUnsigned(std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max(), value))
7102 return false;
7103 m_flags = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
7104 break;
7105 }
7106 case 72: {
7107 std::uint32_t value = 0;
7108 if (!readUnsigned(std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max(), value))
7109 return false;
7110 m_mode = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
7111 break;
7112 }
7113 case 73: {
7114 std::uint32_t value = 0;
7115 if (!readUnsigned(std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max(), value))
7116 return false;
7117 m_lockAspect = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value);
7118 break;
7119 }
7120 case 90: {
7121 std::uint32_t value = 0;
7122 if (!readUnsigned(kMaxOlePayloadBytes, value))
7123 return false;
7124 m_declaredPayloadLength = value;
7125 m_dxfPayloadLengthSpecified = true;
7126 m_payloadPresent = value != 0;
7127 break;
7128 }
7129 case 310: {
7130 std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
7131 if (!decodeHexBytes(reader->getString(), bytes))
7132 return false;
7133 if (!appendBytesChecked(m_payloadBytes, bytes,
7134 kMaxOlePayloadBytes)) {
7135 m_payloadTooLarge = m_payloadBytes.size() > kMaxOlePayloadBytes
7136 || bytes.size() > kMaxOlePayloadBytes -
7137 std::min(m_payloadBytes.size(),
7138 static_cast<std::size_t>(
7139 kMaxOlePayloadBytes));
7140 return false;
7141 }
7142 m_payloadPresent = true;
7143 break;
7144 }
7145 default:
7146 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
7147 }
7148 return true;
7149}
7150
7151void DRW_Ole2Frame::resetDwgState() {
7152 DRW_Entity::reset();
7153 m_flags = 0;
7154 m_mode = 0;
7155 m_declaredPayloadLength = 0;
7156 m_payloadByteCount = 0;
7157 m_payloadStartBit = 0;
7158 m_payloadPresent = false;
7159 m_payloadTruncated = false;
7160 m_payloadTooLarge = false;
7161 m_hasR2000TrailingByte = false;
7162 m_r2000TrailingByte = 0;
7163 m_objectSize = 0;
7164 m_bodyBitSize = 0;
7165 m_payloadBytes.clear();
7166 m_pt1 = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
7167 m_pt2 = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
7168 m_lockAspect = 3;
7169 m_dxfPayloadLengthSpecified = false;
7170 m_oleVersion = 2;
7171 m_oleClient = "OLE";
7172 m_rawBytes.clear();
7173}
7174
7175bool DRW_Ole2Frame::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
7176 resetDwgState();
7177 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
7178 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
7179 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
7180 sourceBuf->invalidate();
7181 resetDwgState();
7182 return false;
7183 };
7184 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
7185 return fail();
7186
7187 m_bodyBitSize = bs;
7188 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
7189 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(v, &bodyProbe, bs))
7190 return fail();
7191 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing OLE2FRAME ************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing OLE2FRAME ************************\n"
);
7192
7193 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
7194 std::uint16_t parsedFlags = 0;
7195 std::uint16_t parsedMode = 0;
7196 std::int32_t declaredLength = 0;
7197 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedFlags)
7198 || (v > DRW::AC1014
7199 && !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedMode))
7200 || !readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, declaredLength)
7201 || declaredLength < 0
7202 || static_cast<std::uint32_t>(declaredLength) > kMaxOlePayloadBytes)
7203 return fail();
7204
7205 const std::uint64_t payloadStartBit = currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe);
7206 const auto bodyRemainingBits = [&](const dwgBuffer& cursor,
7207 std::uint64_t& remaining) {
7208 const std::uint64_t currentBit = currentDwgBit(&cursor);
7209 if (v > DRW::AC1014 && objSize != 0) {
7210 if (currentBit > bodyEndBit)
7211 return false;
7212 remaining = bodyEndBit - currentBit;
7213 return true;
7214 }
7215 const int bytes = cursor.numRemainingBytes();
7216 if (bytes < 0)
7217 return false;
7218 remaining = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(bytes) * 8u;
7219 return true;
7220 };
7221
7222 std::uint64_t remainingBits = 0;
7223 if (!bodyRemainingBits(bodyProbe, remainingBits))
7224 return fail();
7225 const std::uint64_t trailingBits = v > DRW::AC1014 ? 8u : 0u;
7226 if (remainingBits < trailingBits
7227 || static_cast<std::uint64_t>(declaredLength)
7228 > (remainingBits - trailingBits) / 8u)
7229 return fail();
7230
7231 std::vector<std::uint8_t> payload;
7232 if (!DRW::resize(payload, declaredLength))
7233 return fail();
7234 if (!readBoundedBytes(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, payload.data(),
7235 payload.size()))
7236 return fail();
7237
7238 std::uint8_t trailingByte = 0;
7239 bool hasTrailingByte = false;
7240 if (v > DRW::AC1014) {
7241 if (!bodyRemainingBits(bodyProbe, remainingBits)
7242 || (remainingBits != 0 && remainingBits < 8))
7243 return fail();
7244 if (remainingBits >= 8) {
7245 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, trailingByte))
7246 return fail();
7247 hasTrailingByte = true;
7248 }
7249 }
7250
7251 // Decode the frame rectangle (DXF 10/11) from the OLE header. AutoCAD/ODA do
7252 // NOT store pt1/pt2 as DWG fields; they live in the first ~0x80 bytes of the
7253 // payload as raw little-endian doubles. Guarded so a non-finite/short
7254 // payload simply leaves both points at the origin.
7255 DRW_Coord point1;
7256 DRW_Coord point2;
7257 if (payload.size() >= 0x4a && payload[0] == 0x80) {
7258 auto rd = [&](std::size_t off) {
7259 double value = 0.0;
7260 std::memcpy(&value, payload.data() + off, sizeof(double));
7261 return value;
7262 };
7263 const DRW_Coord upperLeft(rd(0x02), rd(0x0a), rd(0x12));
7264 const DRW_Coord lowerRight(rd(0x32), rd(0x3a), rd(0x42));
7265 if (std::isfinite(upperLeft.x) && std::isfinite(upperLeft.y)
7266 && std::isfinite(upperLeft.z) && std::isfinite(lowerRight.x)
7267 && std::isfinite(lowerRight.y) && std::isfinite(lowerRight.z)) {
7268 point1 = upperLeft;
7269 point2 = lowerRight;
7270 }
7271 }
7272
7273 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
7274 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
7275 return fail();
7276 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
7277 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit)
7278 || !handleProbe.isGood())
7279 return fail();
7280
7281 m_flags = parsedFlags;
7282 m_mode = parsedMode;
7283 m_declaredPayloadLength = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(declaredLength);
7284 m_payloadStartBit = payloadStartBit;
7285 m_payloadPresent = declaredLength > 0;
7286 m_payloadByteCount = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(declaredLength);
7287 m_payloadBytes = std::move(payload);
7288 m_hasR2000TrailingByte = hasTrailingByte;
7289 m_r2000TrailingByte = trailingByte;
7290 m_pt1 = point1;
7291 m_pt2 = point2;
7292 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
7293 return true;
7294}
7295
7296// Phase 6.2: OLE2FRAME encoder (fixed oType 74). Inverse of parseDwg, emitting
7297// the captured opaque payload byte-for-byte. Without this override an OLE2FRAME
7298// would encode as a LINE.
7299bool DRW_Ole2Frame::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
7300 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
7301 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
7302 if (m_payloadTooLarge || m_payloadTruncated
7303 || m_payloadBytes.size() > kMaxOlePayloadBytes
7304 || (m_payloadPresent
7305 && m_declaredPayloadLength != m_payloadBytes.size())) {
7306 return false;
7307 }
7308 oType = 74; // OLE2FRAME class id — see dwgreader.cpp case 74
7309 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
7310
7311 buf->putBitShort(m_flags);
7312 if (version > DRW::AC1014)
7313 buf->putBitShort(m_mode);
7314 // Emit the actual captured length so the reader's data_size matches the
7315 // bytes that follow (avoids a declared-vs-actual mismatch on re-read).
7316 const std::uint32_t payloadLen = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m_payloadBytes.size());
7317 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(payloadLen));
7318 if (payloadLen > 0)
7319 buf->putBytes(m_payloadBytes.data(), m_payloadBytes.size());
7320 // R2000+ Unknown RC (ODA §20.4.88): emitted UNCONDITIONALLY for version >
7321 // AC1014. parseDwg reads it whenever bytes remain before the handle stream
7322 // (which is always — handle data always follows), so gating the write on
7323 // m_hasR2000TrailingByte desynced a directly-constructed OLE2FRAME (the
7324 // default false): the parser consumed the first handle byte as this RC and
7325 // shifted the entity handle stream. Default m_r2000TrailingByte is 0, so
7326 // constructed entities align and round-tripped ones keep the captured byte.
7327 if (version > DRW::AC1014)
7328 buf->putRawChar8(m_r2000TrailingByte);
7329
7330 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
7331}
7332
7333bool DRW_OleFrame::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
7334 switch (code) {
7335 case 70: {
7336 const int value = reader->getInt32();
7337 if (value < 0 || value > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
7338 return false;
7339 m_flags = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
7340 break;
7341 }
7342 case 90: {
7343 const int value = reader->getInt32();
7344 if (value < 0
7345 || static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value) > kMaxOlePayloadBytes) {
7346 m_payloadTooLarge = value >= 0;
7347 return false;
7348 }
7349 m_declaredPayloadLength = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value);
7350 m_dxfPayloadLengthSpecified = true;
7351 m_payloadPresent = value != 0;
7352 break;
7353 }
7354 case 310: {
7355 std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
7356 if (!decodeHexBytes(reader->getString(), bytes))
7357 return false;
7358 if (!appendBytesChecked(m_payloadBytes, bytes,
7359 kMaxOlePayloadBytes)) {
7360 m_payloadTooLarge = m_payloadBytes.size() > kMaxOlePayloadBytes
7361 || bytes.size() > kMaxOlePayloadBytes -
7362 std::min(m_payloadBytes.size(),
7363 static_cast<std::size_t>(
7364 kMaxOlePayloadBytes));
7365 return false;
7366 }
7367 m_payloadPresent = true;
7368 break;
7369 }
7370 default:
7371 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
7372 }
7373 return true;
7374}

7376void DRW_OleFrame::resetDwgState() {
7377 DRW_Entity::reset();
7378 m_flags = 0;
7379 m_mode = 0;
7380 m_declaredPayloadLength = 0;
7381 m_payloadByteCount = 0;
7382 m_payloadPresent = false;
7383 m_payloadTruncated = false;
7384 m_payloadTooLarge = false;
7385 m_objectSize = 0;
7386 m_bodyBitSize = 0;
7387 m_payloadBytes.clear();
7388 m_dxfPayloadLengthSpecified = false;
7389 m_rawBytes.clear();
7390}

7392bool DRW_OleFrame::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
7393 std::uint32_t bs) {
7394 resetDwgState();
7395 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
7396 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
7397 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
7398 sourceBuf->invalidate();
7399 resetDwgState();
7400 return false;
7401 };
7402 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
7403 return fail();
7404
7405 m_bodyBitSize = bs;
7406 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
7407 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs))
7408 return fail();
7409
7410 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
7411 std::uint16_t parsedFlags = 0;
7412 std::uint16_t parsedMode = 0;
7413 std::int32_t declaredLength = 0;
7414 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedFlags)
7415 || (version > DRW::AC1014
7416 && !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedMode))
7417 || !readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, declaredLength)
7418 || declaredLength < 0
7419 || static_cast<std::uint32_t>(declaredLength) > kMaxOlePayloadBytes)
7420 return fail();
7421
7422 std::uint64_t bodyRemainingBits = 0;
7423 const std::uint64_t currentBit = currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe);
7424 if (version > DRW::AC1014 && objSize != 0) {
7425 if (currentBit > bodyEndBit)
7426 return fail();
7427 bodyRemainingBits = bodyEndBit - currentBit;
7428 } else {
7429 const int remainingBytes = bodyProbe.numRemainingBytes();
7430 if (remainingBytes < 0)
7431 return fail();
7432 bodyRemainingBits = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(remainingBytes) * 8u;
7433 }
7434
7435 if (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(declaredLength) > bodyRemainingBits / 8u)
7436 return fail();
7437 std::vector<std::uint8_t> payload;
7438 if (!DRW::resize(payload, declaredLength))
7439 return fail();
7440 if (!readBoundedBytes(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, payload.data(),
7441 payload.size()))
7442 return fail();
7443
7444 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
7445 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
7446 handleEndBit))
7447 return fail();
7448 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
7449 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
7450 handleEndBit)
7451 || !handleProbe.isGood())
7452 return fail();
7453
7454 m_flags = parsedFlags;
7455 m_mode = parsedMode;
7456 m_declaredPayloadLength = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(declaredLength);
7457 m_payloadPresent = declaredLength != 0;
7458 m_payloadByteCount = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(declaredLength);
7459 m_payloadBytes = std::move(payload);
7460 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
7461 return true;
7462
7463}
7464
7465bool DRW_OleFrame::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
7466 std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf,
7467 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
7468 (void)bs;
7469 (void)strBuf;
7470 if (buf == nullptr || m_payloadTooLarge || m_payloadTruncated
7471 || m_payloadBytes.size() > kMaxOlePayloadBytes
7472 || (m_payloadPresent
7473 && m_declaredPayloadLength != m_payloadBytes.size())) {
7474 return false;
7475 }
7476
7477 oType = 43;
7478 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf))
7479 return false;
7480 buf->putBitShort(m_flags);
7481 if (version > DRW::AC1014)
7482 buf->putBitShort(m_mode);
7483 const std::uint32_t payloadLength =
7484 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m_payloadBytes.size());
7485 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(payloadLength));
7486 if (payloadLength != 0)
7487 buf->putBytes(m_payloadBytes.data(), m_payloadBytes.size());
7488 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
7489}

7528bool DRW_Light::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
7529 resetDwgState();
7530 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
7531 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
7532 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
7533 sourceBuf->invalidate();
7534 resetDwgState();
7535 return false;
7536 };
7537 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
7538 return fail();
7539
7540 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
7541 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
7542 dwgBuffer *stringStream = v > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringProbe : nullptr;
7543 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(v, &bodyProbe, stringStream, bs)
7544 || !bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood())
7545 return fail();
7546 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing LIGHT *****************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing LIGHT *****************************\n"
);
7547
7548 const std::uint64_t bodyDataEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
7549 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyDataEndBit;
7550 if (stringStream != nullptr && v > DRW::AC1021) {
7551 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
7552 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*stringStream, v, objSize,
7553 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
7554 return fail();
7555 }
7556
7557 std::int32_t parsedClassVersion = 0;
7558 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedName;
7559 std::int32_t parsedType = 0;
7560 bool parsedStatus = false;
7561 std::uint32_t parsedColor = 0;
7562 bool parsedPlotGlyph = false;
7563 double parsedIntensity = 0.0;
7564 DRW_Coord parsedPosition;
7565 DRW_Coord parsedTarget;
7566 std::int32_t parsedAttenuationType = 0;
7567 bool parsedUseAttenuationLimits = false;
7568 double parsedAttenuationStartLimit = 0.0;
7569 double parsedAttenuationEndLimit = 0.0;
7570 double parsedHotspotAngle = 0.0;
7571 double parsedFalloffAngle = 0.0;
7572 bool parsedCastShadows = false;
7573 std::int32_t parsedShadowType = 0;
7574 std::uint16_t parsedShadowMapSize = 0;
7575 std::uint8_t parsedShadowMapSoftness = 0;
7576 if (!readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, parsedClassVersion)
7577 || (stringStream != nullptr
7578 ? !readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, v,
7579 parsedName)
7580 : !readBoundedVariableText(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, v,
7581 parsedName))
7582 || !readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, parsedType)
7583 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, parsedStatus)
7584 || !readBoundedCmColor(bodyProbe, stringStream, bodyDataEndBit, v,
7585 parsedColor, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
7586 nullptr, stringEndBit)
7587 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, parsedPlotGlyph)
7588 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, parsedIntensity)
7589 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, parsedPosition)
7590 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, parsedTarget)
7591 || !readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7592 parsedAttenuationType)
7593 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7594 parsedUseAttenuationLimits)
7595 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7596 parsedAttenuationStartLimit)
7597 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7598 parsedAttenuationEndLimit)
7599 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7600 parsedHotspotAngle)
7601 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7602 parsedFalloffAngle)
7603 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, parsedCastShadows)
7604 || !readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, parsedShadowType)
7605 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7606 parsedShadowMapSize)
7607 || !readBoundedRawChar8(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7608 parsedShadowMapSoftness))
7609 return fail();
7610
7611 bool hasPhotometricData = false;
7612 bool hasWebFile = false;
7613 UTF8STRINGstd::string webFile;
7614 std::uint16_t physicalIntensityMethod = 0;
7615 double physicalIntensity = 0.0;
7616 double illuminanceDistance = 0.0;
7617 std::uint16_t lampColorType = 0;
7618 double lampColorTemperature = 0.0;
7619 std::uint16_t lampColorPreset = 0;
7620 DRW_Coord webRotation{1.0, 0.0, 0.0};
7621 std::uint16_t extendedLightShape = 0;
7622 double extendedLightLength = 0.0;
7623 double extendedLightWidth = 0.0;
7624 double extendedLightRadius = 0.0;
7625 if (v > DRW::AC1018
7626 && proxyEntityHasBits(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, 1)) {
7627 if (!readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, hasPhotometricData))
7628 return fail();
7629 if (hasPhotometricData) {
7630 if (!readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit, hasWebFile)
7631 || !readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, v,
7632 webFile)
7633 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7634 physicalIntensityMethod)
7635 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7636 physicalIntensity)
7637 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7638 illuminanceDistance)
7639 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7640 lampColorType)
7641 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7642 lampColorTemperature)
7643 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7644 lampColorPreset)
7645 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7646 webRotation)
7647 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7648 extendedLightShape)
7649 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7650 extendedLightLength)
7651 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7652 extendedLightWidth)
7653 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyDataEndBit,
7654 extendedLightRadius))
7655 return fail();
7656 }
7657 }
7658
7659 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
7660 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
7661 && std::isfinite(point.z);
7662 };
7663 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood()
7664 || currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe) > bodyDataEndBit
7665 || (stringStream != nullptr && currentDwgBit(&stringProbe) > stringEndBit)
7666 || parsedClassVersion < 0 || parsedType < 0
7667 || parsedAttenuationType < 0 || parsedShadowType < 0
7668 || !finite(parsedPosition) || !finite(parsedTarget)
7669 || !finite(webRotation)
7670 || !std::isfinite(parsedIntensity)
7671 || !std::isfinite(parsedAttenuationStartLimit)
7672 || !std::isfinite(parsedAttenuationEndLimit)
7673 || !std::isfinite(parsedHotspotAngle)
7674 || !std::isfinite(parsedFalloffAngle)
7675 || !std::isfinite(physicalIntensity)
7676 || !std::isfinite(illuminanceDistance)
7677 || !std::isfinite(lampColorTemperature)
7678 || !std::isfinite(extendedLightLength)
7679 || !std::isfinite(extendedLightWidth)
7680 || !std::isfinite(extendedLightRadius))
7681 return fail();
7682
7683 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
7684 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
7685 return fail();
7686 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
7687 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit)
7688 || !handleProbe.isGood())
7689 return fail();
7690
7691 m_classVersion = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parsedClassVersion);
7692 m_name = std::move(parsedName);
7693 m_type = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parsedType);
7694 m_status = parsedStatus;
7695 m_color = parsedColor;
7696 m_plotGlyph = parsedPlotGlyph;
7697 m_intensity = parsedIntensity;
7698 m_position = parsedPosition;
7699 m_target = parsedTarget;
7700 m_attenuationType = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parsedAttenuationType);
7701 m_useAttenuationLimits = parsedUseAttenuationLimits;
7702 m_attenuationStartLimit = parsedAttenuationStartLimit;
7703 m_attenuationEndLimit = parsedAttenuationEndLimit;
7704 m_hotspotAngle = parsedHotspotAngle;
7705 m_falloffAngle = parsedFalloffAngle;
7706 m_castShadows = parsedCastShadows;
7707 m_shadowType = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parsedShadowType);
7708 m_shadowMapSize = parsedShadowMapSize;
7709 m_shadowMapSoftness = parsedShadowMapSoftness;
7710 m_hasPhotometricData = hasPhotometricData;
7711 m_hasWebFile = hasWebFile;
7712 m_webFile = std::move(webFile);
7713 m_physicalIntensityMethod = physicalIntensityMethod;
7714 m_physicalIntensity = physicalIntensity;
7715 m_illuminanceDistance = illuminanceDistance;
7716 m_lampColorType = lampColorType;
7717 m_lampColorTemperature = lampColorTemperature;
7718 m_lampColorPreset = lampColorPreset;
7719 m_webRotation = webRotation;
7720 m_extendedLightShape = extendedLightShape;
7721 m_extendedLightLength = extendedLightLength;
7722 m_extendedLightWidth = extendedLightWidth;
7723 m_extendedLightRadius = extendedLightRadius;
7724 DRW_DBG("LIGHT name: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("LIGHT name: "); DRW_DBG(m_name.c_str())DRW_dbg::dbg(m_name.c_str()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
7725 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
7726 return true;
7727}

7729bool DRW_Camera::parseCode(int code,
7730 const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
7731 if (code == 340) {
7732 m_viewHandle = reader->getHandleString();
7733 return true;
7734 }
7735 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
7736}
7737
7738void DRW_Camera::resetDwgState() {
7739 DRW_Entity::reset();
7740 m_viewHandle = 0;
7741}
7742
7743bool DRW_Camera::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf,
7744 std::uint32_t bs) {
7745 resetDwgState();
7746 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
7747 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
7748 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
7749 sourceBuf->invalidate();
7750 resetDwgState();
7751 return false;
7752 };
7753 if (sourceBuf == nullptr || v < DRW::AC1015)
7754 return fail();
7755
7756 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
7757 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
7758 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(
7759 v, &bodyProbe, v > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringProbe : nullptr, bs)
7760 || !bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood())
7761 return fail();
7762
7763 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
7764 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
7765 return fail();
7766 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
7767 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit)
7768 || !handleProbe.isGood())
7769 return fail();
7770
7771 std::uint32_t viewHandle = 0;
7772 if (proxyEntityHasBits(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 8)) {
7773 dwgHandle viewH;
7774 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false, viewH))
7775 return fail();
7776 viewHandle = viewH.ref;
7777 } else if (currentDwgBit(&handleProbe) != handleEndBit) {
7778 return fail();
7779 }
7780
7781 m_viewHandle = viewHandle;
7782 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
7783 return true;
7784}
7785
7786bool DRW_Camera::encodeDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBufferW *buf,
7787 std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf,
7788 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
7789 (void)bs;
7790 if (v < DRW::AC1015 || buf == nullptr)
7791 return false;
7792
7793 oType = kDwgClassNum;
7794 if (!encodeDwgCommon(v, buf, strBuf)
7795 || !encodeDwgEntHandle(v, buf, handleBuf)) {
7796 return false;
7797 }
7798
7799 putHardPointerHandle(handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf, m_viewHandle);
7800 return true;
7801}
7802
7803bool DRW_GeoPositionMarker::parseCode(
7804 int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
7805 switch (code) {
7806 case 90:
7807 {
7808 int value = 0;
7809 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, std::numeric_limits<int>::max(), value))
7810 return false;
7811 m_classVersion = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value);
7812 }
7813 return true;
7814 case 10:
7815 m_position.x = reader->getDouble();
7816 return true;
7817 case 20:
7818 m_position.y = reader->getDouble();
7819 return true;
7820 case 30:
7821 m_position.z = reader->getDouble();
7822 return true;
7823 case 40:
7824 if (m_dxfDouble40Count++ == 0)
7825 m_radius = reader->getDouble();
7826 else if (m_dxfDouble40Count == 2)
7827 m_landingGap = reader->getDouble();
7828 else
7829 (void)reader->getDouble();
7830 return true;
7831 case 1:
7832 m_notes = reader->getUtf8String();
7833 return true;
7834 case 280:
7835 {
7836 const int value = reader->getInt32();
7837 if (value < 0 || value > std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max())
7838 return false;
7839 m_textAlignment = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value);
7840 }
7841 return true;
7842 case 290:
7843 {
7844 int value = 0;
7845 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 1, value))
7846 return false;
7847 if (m_dxfBool290Count++ == 0)
7848 m_mtextVisible = value != 0;
7849 else if (m_dxfBool290Count == 2)
7850 m_enableFrameText = value != 0;
7851 }
7852 return true;
7853 default:
7854 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
7855 }
7856}
7857
7858bool DRW_GeoPositionMarker::parseDxfVariant(const DRW_Variant& value) {
7859 switch (value.code()) {
7860 case 90:
7861 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::INTEGER)
7862 return false;
7863 if (value.i_val() < 0)
7864 return false;
7865 m_classVersion = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value.i_val());
7866 return true;
7867 case 10:
7868 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::DOUBLE)
7869 return false;
7870 m_position.x = value.d_val();
7871 return true;
7872 case 20:
7873 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::DOUBLE)
7874 return false;
7875 m_position.y = value.d_val();
7876 return true;
7877 case 30:
7878 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::DOUBLE)
7879 return false;
7880 m_position.z = value.d_val();
7881 return true;
7882 case 40:
7883 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::DOUBLE)
7884 return false;
7885 if (m_dxfDouble40Count++ == 0)
7886 m_radius = value.d_val();
7887 else if (m_dxfDouble40Count == 2)
7888 m_landingGap = value.d_val();
7889 return true;
7890 case 1:
7891 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::STRING)
7892 return false;
7893 m_notes = value.c_str();
7894 return true;
7895 case 280:
7896 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::INTEGER)
7897 return false;
7898 if (value.i_val() < 0
7899 || value.i_val() > std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max())
7900 return false;
7901 m_textAlignment = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value.i_val());
7902 return true;
7903 case 290:
7904 if (value.type() != DRW_Variant::INTEGER)
7905 return false;
7906 if (value.i_val() < 0 || value.i_val() > 1)
7907 return false;
7908 if (m_dxfBool290Count++ == 0)
7909 m_mtextVisible = value.i_val() != 0;
7910 else if (m_dxfBool290Count == 2)
7911 m_enableFrameText = value.i_val() != 0;
7912 return true;
7913 default:
7914 return true; // Common and unknown groups remain raw-authoritative.
7915 }
7916}

7918void DRW_GeoPositionMarker::resetDwgState() {
7919 DRW_Entity::reset();
7920 m_classVersion = 0;
7921 m_position = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
7922 m_radius = 0.0;
7923 m_notes.clear();
7924 m_landingGap = 0.0;
7925 m_mtextVisible = false;

7932
7933bool DRW_GeoPositionMarker::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf,
7934 std::uint32_t bs) {
7935 resetDwgState();
7936 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
7937 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
7938 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
7939 sourceBuf->invalidate();
7940 resetDwgState();
7941 return false;
7942 };
7943 if (sourceBuf == nullptr || v < DRW::AC1027)
7944 return fail();
7945
7946 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
7947 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
7948 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(v, &bodyProbe, &stringProbe, bs)
7949 || !bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood())
7950 return fail();
7951
7952 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
7953 std::uint64_t stringStartBit = bodyEndBit;
7954 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
7955 if (v > DRW::AC1018
7956 && (!bodyProbe.getR2007StringStreamBounds(objSize, stringStartBit,
7957 stringEndBit)
7958 || currentDwgBit(&stringProbe) > stringEndBit))
7959 return fail();
7960
7961 std::int32_t parsedClassVersion = 0;
7962 DRW_Coord position;
7963 double radius = 0.0;
7964 UTF8STRINGstd::string notes;
7965 double landingGap = 0.0;
7966 bool mtextVisible = false;
7967 std::uint8_t textAlignment = 0;
7968 bool enableFrameText = false;
7969 if (!readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedClassVersion)
7970 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, position)
7971 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, radius)
7972 || !readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, v, notes)
7973 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, landingGap)
7974 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, mtextVisible)
7975 || !readBoundedRawChar8(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, textAlignment)
7976 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, enableFrameText))
7977 return fail();
7978
7979 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
7980 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
7981 && std::isfinite(point.z);
7982 };
7983 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood()
7984 || !finite(position) || !std::isfinite(radius)
7985 || !std::isfinite(landingGap))
7986 return fail();
7987
7988 // AcDbMTextObjectEmbedded follows the marker body when framing is enabled.
7989 // Parse it on a bounded probe before the parent and embedded handle passes;
7990 // otherwise a truncated nested body can consume parent handle bytes.
7991 dwgBuffer bodyTailProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
7992 std::unique_ptr<DRW_MText> parsedMText;
7993 EmbeddedMTextHandleInfo embeddedHandles;
7994 if (enableFrameText) {
7995 if (objSize == 0
7996 || !(parsedMText = std::make_unique<DRW_MText>())
7997 || !parseEmbeddedMTextDwg(v, &bodyTailProbe, &stringProbe,
7998 *parsedMText, embeddedHandles,
7999 bodyEndBit, stringEndBit)
8000 || !bodyTailProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood())
8001 return fail();
8002 }
8003
8004 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
8005 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
8006 return fail();
8007
8008 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyTailProbe.forkIndependent();
8009 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit)
8010 || !handleProbe.isGood())
8011 return fail();
8012 if (enableFrameText) {
8013 if (!consumeEmbeddedMTextHandles(v, &handleProbe, embeddedHandles,
8014 parsedMText.get(), handleEndBit))
8015 return fail();
8016 }
8017
8018 m_classVersion = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parsedClassVersion);
8019 m_position = position;
8020 m_radius = radius;
8021 m_notes = notes;
8022 m_landingGap = landingGap;
8023 m_mtextVisible = mtextVisible;
8024 m_textAlignment = textAlignment;
8025 m_enableFrameText = enableFrameText;
8026 mtext = std::move(parsedMText);
8027 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
8028 return true;
8029}
8030
8031bool DRW_Light::encodeDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
8032 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
8033 (void)bs;
8034 if (v < DRW::AC1021)
8035 return false;
8036
8037 oType = kDwgClassNum;
8038 if (!encodeDwgCommon(v, buf, strBuf))
8039 return false;
8040
8041 dwgBufferW *sb = strBuf ? strBuf : buf;
8042 buf->putBitLong(m_classVersion);
8043 sb->putVariableText(v, m_name);
8044 buf->putBitLong(m_type);
8045 buf->putBit(m_status ? 1 : 0);
8046 buf->putCmColor(v, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_color));
8047 buf->putBit(m_plotGlyph ? 1 : 0);
8048 buf->putBitDouble(m_intensity);
8049 buf->put3BitDouble(m_position);
8050 buf->put3BitDouble(m_target);
8051 buf->putBitLong(m_attenuationType);
8052 buf->putBit(m_useAttenuationLimits ? 1 : 0);
8053 buf->putBitDouble(m_attenuationStartLimit);
8054 buf->putBitDouble(m_attenuationEndLimit);
8055 buf->putBitDouble(m_hotspotAngle);
8056 buf->putBitDouble(m_falloffAngle);
8057 buf->putBit(m_castShadows ? 1 : 0);
8058 buf->putBitLong(m_shadowType);
8059 buf->putBitShort(m_shadowMapSize);
8060 buf->putRawChar8(m_shadowMapSoftness);
8061
8062 buf->putBit(m_hasPhotometricData ? 1 : 0);
8063 if (m_hasPhotometricData) {
8064 buf->putBit(m_hasWebFile ? 1 : 0);
8065 sb->putVariableText(v, m_webFile);
8066 buf->putBitShort(m_physicalIntensityMethod);
8067 buf->putBitDouble(m_physicalIntensity);
8068 buf->putBitDouble(m_illuminanceDistance);
8069 buf->putBitShort(m_lampColorType);
8070 buf->putBitDouble(m_lampColorTemperature);
8071 buf->putBitShort(m_lampColorPreset);
8072 buf->put3BitDouble(m_webRotation);
8073 buf->putBitShort(m_extendedLightShape);
8074 buf->putBitDouble(m_extendedLightLength);
8075 buf->putBitDouble(m_extendedLightWidth);
8076 buf->putBitDouble(m_extendedLightRadius);
8077 }
8078
8079 return encodeDwgEntHandle(v, buf, handleBuf);
8080}
8081
8082bool DRW_SectionObject::parseCode(
8083 int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
8084 if (code != 100 && !m_dxfInBody)
8085 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
8086 switch (code) {
8087 case 100:
8088 m_dxfInBody = reader->getUtf8String() == "AcDbSection";
8089 return true;
8090 case 90:
8091 m_state = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getInt32());
8092 return true;
8093 case 91:
8094 m_flags = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getInt32());
8095 return true;
8096 case 1:
8097 m_name = reader->getUtf8String();
8098 return true;
8099 case 10:
8100 m_vertDir.x = reader->getDouble();
8101 return true;
8102 case 20:
8103 m_vertDir.y = reader->getDouble();
8104 return true;
8105 case 30:
8106 m_vertDir.z = reader->getDouble();
8107 return true;
8108 case 40:
8109 m_topHeight = reader->getDouble();
8110 return true;
8111 case 41:
8112 m_bottomHeight = reader->getDouble();
8113 return true;
8114 case 70:
8115 {
8116 const int value = reader->getInt32();
8117 if (value < 0 || value > 0xFFFF)
8118 return false;
8119 m_indicatorAlpha = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
8120 }
8121 return true;
8122 case 62:
8123 m_indicatorColor = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getInt32());
8124 return true;
8125 case 92:
8126 {
8127 const int value = reader->getInt32();
8128 if (value < 0
8129 || static_cast<std::size_t>(value) > DRW_SectionObject::kMaxVertices)
8130 return false;
8131 m_verts.clear();
8132 if (!DRW::reserve(m_verts, value))
8133 return false;
8134 return true;
8135 }
8136 case 93:
8137 {
8138 const int value = reader->getInt32();
8139 if (value < 0
8140 || static_cast<std::size_t>(value) > DRW_SectionObject::kMaxVertices)
8141 return false;
8142 m_blVerts.clear();
8143 if (!DRW::reserve(m_blVerts, value))
8144 return false;
8145 return true;
8146 }
8147 case 11:
8148 if (m_verts.size() >= DRW_SectionObject::kMaxVertices)
8149 return false;
8150 m_verts.emplace_back();
8151 m_verts.back().x = reader->getDouble();
8152 return true;
8153 case 21:
8154 if (m_verts.empty())
8155 return false;
8156 m_verts.back().y = reader->getDouble();
8157 return true;
8158 case 31:
8159 if (m_verts.empty())
8160 return false;
8161 m_verts.back().z = reader->getDouble();
8162 return true;
8163 case 12:
8164 if (m_blVerts.size() >= DRW_SectionObject::kMaxVertices)
8165 return false;
8166 m_blVerts.emplace_back();
8167 m_blVerts.back().x = reader->getDouble();
8168 return true;
8169 case 22:
8170 if (m_blVerts.empty())
8171 return false;
8172 m_blVerts.back().y = reader->getDouble();
8173 return true;
8174 case 32:
8175 if (m_blVerts.empty())
8176 return false;
8177 m_blVerts.back().z = reader->getDouble();
8178 return true;
8179 case 360:
8180 m_sectionSettingsHandle = reader->getHandleString();
8181 return true;
8182 default:
8183 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
8184 }
8185}
8186
8187// DRW_SectionObject::parseDwg — SECTIONOBJECT / AcDbSection, field order per
8188// libreDWG dwg2.spec DWG_ENTITY(SECTIONOBJECT): BL state, BL flags, T name,
8189// 3BD vert_dir, BD top/bottom height, BS indicator_alpha, CMTC indicator_color,
8190// BL num_verts + verts, BL num_blverts + blverts; then the common entity handle
8191// data followed by the section_settings hard reference (H 5, 360).
8192void DRW_SectionObject::resetDwgState() {
8193 DRW_Entity::reset();
8194 m_state = 0;
8195 m_flags = 0;
8196 m_name.clear();
8197 m_vertDir = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
8198 m_topHeight = 0.0;
8199 m_bottomHeight = 0.0;
8200 m_indicatorAlpha = 0;
8201 m_indicatorColor = 0;
8202 m_verts.clear();
8203 m_blVerts.clear();
8204 m_sectionSettingsHandle = 0;
8205 m_dxfInBody = false;
8206}
8207
8208bool DRW_SectionObject::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf,
8209 std::uint32_t bs) {
8210 resetDwgState();
8211 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
8212 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
8213 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
8214 sourceBuf->invalidate();
8215 resetDwgState();
8216 return false;
8217 };
8218 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
8219 return fail();
8220
8221 // R2007+ stores text in a separate stream. Independent cursors keep a
8222 // malformed field from consuming the source or a later handle stream.
8223 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
8224 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
8225 dwgBuffer *stringStream = v > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringProbe : &bodyProbe;
8226 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(v, &bodyProbe, stringStream, bs)
8227 || !bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringStream->isGood())
8228 return fail();
8229 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing SECTIONOBJECT *********************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing SECTIONOBJECT *********************\n"
);
8230
8231 // The common entity parser leaves bodyProbe at the first SECTIONOBJECT
8232 // field and stringStream at the detached string stream for R2007+.
8233 // Keep both cursors inside their declared data ranges while staging the
8234 // complete header before publishing it.
8235 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = tableBodyEndBit(v, stringStream, objSize);
8236 const std::uint64_t stringEndBit = v > DRW::AC1018
8237 ? objSize : bodyEndBit;
8238 std::int32_t stateValue = 0;
8239 std::int32_t flagsValue = 0;
8240 UTF8STRINGstd::string name;
8241 DRW_Coord vertDir;
8242 double topHeight = 0.0;
8243 double bottomHeight = 0.0;
8244 std::uint16_t indicatorAlpha = 0;
8245 std::uint32_t indicatorColor = 0;
8246 if (!readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, stateValue)
8247 || !readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, flagsValue)
8248 || !readBoundedVariableText(*stringStream, stringEndBit, v, name)
8249 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, vertDir)
8250 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, topHeight)
8251 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, bottomHeight)
8252 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, indicatorAlpha)
8253 || !readBoundedCmColor(bodyProbe, stringStream, bodyEndBit, v,
8254 indicatorColor, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
8255 nullptr, stringEndBit))
8256 return fail();
8257
8258 std::uint32_t numVerts = 0;
8259 if (!readTableBodyCount(
8260 v, &bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
8261 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(DRW_SectionObject::kMaxVertices), 6,
8262 numVerts)
8263 || !proxyEntityHasBits(
8264 bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(numVerts) * 6u))
8265 return fail();
8266 std::vector<DRW_Coord> verts;
8267 if (!DRW::reserve(verts, static_cast<int>(numVerts)))
8268 return fail();
8269 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < numVerts; ++i) {
8270 DRW_Coord vertex;
8271 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, vertex))
8272 return fail();
8273 verts.push_back(vertex);
8274 }
8275
8276 std::uint32_t numBl = 0;
8277 if (!readTableBodyCount(
8278 v, &bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
8279 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(DRW_SectionObject::kMaxVertices), 6,
8280 numBl)
8281 || !proxyEntityHasBits(
8282 bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(numBl) * 6u))
8283 return fail();
8284 std::vector<DRW_Coord> blVerts;
8285 if (!DRW::reserve(blVerts, static_cast<int>(numBl)))
8286 return fail();
8287 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < numBl; ++i) {
8288 DRW_Coord vertex;
8289 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, vertex))
8290 return fail();
8291 blVerts.push_back(vertex);
8292 }
8293
8294 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
8295 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
8296 && std::isfinite(point.z);
8297 };
8298 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringStream->isGood()
8299 || currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe) > bodyEndBit
8300 || !finite(vertDir) || !std::isfinite(topHeight)
8301 || !std::isfinite(bottomHeight))
8302 return fail();
8303 if (!std::all_of(verts.begin(), verts.end(), finite)
8304 || !std::all_of(blVerts.begin(), blVerts.end(), finite))
8305 return fail();
8306
8307 // The common entity handle stream starts at the object-data boundary for
8308 // R2007+ and follows the body inline in older versions. The section
8309 // settings reference is a hard pointer (H 5), after those common handles.
8310 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
8311 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
8312 return fail();
8313 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
8314 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit)
8315 || !handleProbe.isGood())
8316 return fail();
8317 std::uint32_t sectionSettingsHandle = 0;
8318 if (proxyEntityHasBits(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 8)) {
8319 dwgHandle settingsHandle;
8320 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, false,
8321 settingsHandle))
8322 return fail();
8323 sectionSettingsHandle = settingsHandle.ref;
8324 DRW_DBG(" section_settings Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" section_settings Handle: ");
8325 DRW_DBGHL(settingsHandle.code, settingsHandle.size,DRW_dbg::dbgHL(settingsHandle.code, settingsHandle.size, settingsHandle
.ref)
8326 settingsHandle.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(settingsHandle.code, settingsHandle.size, settingsHandle
.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
8327 }
8328 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
8329 return fail();
8330
8331 m_state = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(stateValue);
8332 m_flags = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(flagsValue);
8333 m_name = name;
8334 m_vertDir = vertDir;
8335 m_topHeight = topHeight;
8336 m_bottomHeight = bottomHeight;
8337 m_indicatorAlpha = indicatorAlpha;
8338 m_indicatorColor = indicatorColor;
8339 m_verts = std::move(verts);
8340 m_blVerts = std::move(blVerts);
8341 m_sectionSettingsHandle = sectionSettingsHandle;
8342 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
8343 DRW_DBG("SECTIONOBJECT name: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("SECTIONOBJECT name: "); DRW_DBG(m_name.c_str())DRW_dbg::dbg(m_name.c_str());
8344 DRW_DBG(" verts: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" verts: "); DRW_DBG(static_cast<int>(m_verts.size()))DRW_dbg::dbg(static_cast<int>(m_verts.size())); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
8345 return true;
8346}
8347
8348bool DRW_SectionObject::encodeDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBufferW *buf,
8349 std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf,
8350 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
8351 (void)bs;
8352 if (v < DRW::AC1021 || buf == nullptr
8353 || m_verts.size() > DRW_SectionObject::kMaxVertices
8354 || m_blVerts.size() > DRW_SectionObject::kMaxVertices)
8355 return false;
8356 oType = kDwgClassNum;
8357 if (!encodeDwgCommon(v, buf, strBuf))
8358 return false;
8359 dwgBufferW *stringBuffer = strBuf != nullptr ? strBuf : buf;
8360 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(m_state));
8361 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(m_flags));
8362 stringBuffer->putVariableText(v, m_name);
8363 buf->put3BitDouble(m_vertDir);
8364 buf->putBitDouble(m_topHeight);
8365 buf->putBitDouble(m_bottomHeight);
8366 buf->putBitShort(m_indicatorAlpha);
8367 buf->putCmColor(v, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_indicatorColor));
8368 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(m_verts.size()));
8369 for (const DRW_Coord& point : m_verts)
8370 buf->put3BitDouble(point);
8371 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(m_blVerts.size()));
8372 for (const DRW_Coord& point : m_blVerts)
8373 buf->put3BitDouble(point);
8374 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(v, buf, handleBuf))
8375 return false;
8376 putHardPointerHandle(handleBuf != nullptr ? handleBuf : buf,
8377 m_sectionSettingsHandle);
8378 return true;
8379}

8405 xAxisDirectionVector.z = reader->getDouble();
8406 break;
8407 case 210:
8408 extPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
8409 break;
8410 case 220:

8412 break;
8413 case 230:

8416 default:
8417 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
8418 }
