8431
8432bool DRW_Tolerance::parseDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBuffer *buf,
8433 std::uint32_t bs) {
8434 resetDwgState();
8435 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
8436 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
8437 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
8438 sourceBuf->invalidate();
8439 resetDwgState();
8440 return false;
8441 };
8442 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
8443 return fail();
8444
8445 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
8446 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
8447 dwgBuffer *stringStream = v > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringProbe : &bodyProbe;
8448 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(v, &bodyProbe, stringStream, bs)
8449 || !bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringStream->isGood())
8450 return fail();
8451
8452 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing tolerance *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing tolerance *********************************************\n"
);
8453 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
8454 const std::uint64_t stringStartBit = currentDwgBit(stringStream);
8455 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
8456 if (v > DRW::AC1021) {
8457 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
8458 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*stringStream, v, objSize,
8459 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
8460 return fail();
8461 }
8462 auto read3BitDoubleChecked = [&](DRW_Coord& point) {
8463 return readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, point.x)
8464 && readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, point.y)
8465 && readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, point.z);
8466 };
8467
8468 if (v < DRW::AC1015) {
8469 std::uint16_t unknown = 0;
8470 double heightAtCreation = 0.0;
8471 double dimGapAtCreation = 0.0;
8472 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, unknown)
8473 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
8474 heightAtCreation)
8475 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
8476 dimGapAtCreation)
8477 || !std::isfinite(heightAtCreation)
8478 || !std::isfinite(dimGapAtCreation))
8479 return fail();
8480 }
8481
8482 DRW_Coord parsedInsertionPoint;
8483 DRW_Coord parsedXAxisDirectionVector;
8484 DRW_Coord parsedExtPoint;
8485 if (!read3BitDoubleChecked(parsedInsertionPoint)
8486 || !read3BitDoubleChecked(parsedXAxisDirectionVector)
8487 || !read3BitDoubleChecked(parsedExtPoint))
8488 return fail();
8489 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedText;
8490 if (v > DRW::AC1018 && stringStartBit >= stringEndBit) {
8491 parsedText.clear();
8492 } else if (!readBoundedVariableText(*stringStream, stringEndBit, v,
8493 parsedText)) {
8494 return fail();
8495 }
8496
8497 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
8498 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
8499 && std::isfinite(point.z);
8500 };
8501 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringStream->isGood()
8502 || currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe) > bodyEndBit
8503 || currentDwgBit(stringStream) > stringEndBit
8504 || !finite(parsedInsertionPoint)
8505 || !finite(parsedXAxisDirectionVector)
8506 || !finite(parsedExtPoint))
8507 return fail();
8508
8509 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
8510 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, v, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
8511 return fail();
8512 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
8513 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(v, &handleProbe, true, handleEndBit)
8514 || !handleProbe.isGood())
8515 return fail();
8516 dwgHandle parsedDimStyleH;
8517 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, false,
8518 parsedDimStyleH)
8519 || !handleProbe.isGood())
8520 return fail();
8521
8522 insertionPoint = parsedInsertionPoint;
8523 xAxisDirectionVector = parsedXAxisDirectionVector;
8524 extPoint = parsedExtPoint;
8525 text = parsedText;
8526 dimStyleH = parsedDimStyleH;
8527 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
8528 DRW_DBG("insertionPoint: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("insertionPoint: ");
8529 DRW_DBGPT(insertionPoint.x, insertionPoint.y, insertionPoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(insertionPoint.x, insertionPoint.y, insertionPoint
.z);
8530 DRW_DBG("\ntolerance text: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ntolerance text: "); DRW_DBG(text.c_str())DRW_dbg::dbg(text.c_str()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
8531 DRW_DBG("dim style Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("dim style Handle: ");
8532 DRW_DBGHL(dimStyleH.code, dimStyleH.size, dimStyleH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(dimStyleH.code, dimStyleH.size, dimStyleH.ref);
8533 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
8534 return true;
8535}
8536
8537bool DRW_Tolerance::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
8538 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
8539 (void)bs;
8540 oType = 46;
8541 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf, strBuf))
8542 return false;
8543
8544 if (version < DRW::AC1015) {
8545 buf->putBitShort(0);
8546 buf->putBitDouble(0.0);
8547 buf->putBitDouble(0.0);
8548 }
8549
8550 buf->put3BitDouble(insertionPoint);
8551 buf->put3BitDouble(xAxisDirectionVector);
8552 buf->put3BitDouble(extPoint);
8553 (strBuf ? strBuf : buf)->putVariableText(version, text);
8554
8555 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf))
8556 return false;
8557
8558 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
8559 putHardPointerHandle(hb, (dimStyleH.ref == 0) ? 0x15 : dimStyleH.ref);
8560 return true;
8561}

8564bool DRW_Block::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){

8566 case 1:

8568 break;
8569 case 2:
8570 name = reader->getUtf8String();
8571 break;
8572 case 70:
8573 flags = reader->getInt32();

8578
8579 return true;

8582void DRW_Block::resetDwgState() {

8585 name = endBlock ? UTF8STRINGstd::string() : UTF8STRINGstd::string("*U0");
8586 flags = 0;

8592
8593bool DRW_Block::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
8594 resetDwgState();
8595 if (buf == nullptr)
8596 return false;
8597 auto fail = [this, buf]() {
8598 buf->invalidate();
8599 resetDwgState();
8600 return false;
8601 };
8602 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
8603 dwgBuffer sBuff = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
8604 dwgBuffer *sBuf = &bodyProbe;
8605 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
8606 sBuf = &sBuff; //separate buffer for strings
8607 }
8608 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, &bodyProbe, sBuf, bs);
8609 if (!ret)
8610 return fail();
8611
8612 // BLOCK/ENDBLK carry one entity-specific bit after the common data range;
8613 // the detached string stream begins at dwgDataEndBit and is independent.
8614 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = version > DRW::AC1018
8615 && dwgDataEndBit < std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max()
8616 ? dwgDataEndBit + 1 : dwgDataEndBit;
8617 std::uint64_t stringStartBit = bodyEndBit;
8618 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
8619 if (version > DRW::AC1018
8620 && (!bodyProbe.getR2007StringStreamBounds(objSize, stringStartBit,
8621 stringEndBit)
8622 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit))
8623 return fail();
8624
8625 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedName;
8626 if (!isEnd){
8627 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing block *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing block *********************************************\n"
);
8628 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
8629 parsedName))
8630 return fail();
8631 DRW_DBG("Block name: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Block name: "); DRW_DBG(parsedName.c_str())DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedName.c_str()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
8632 } else {
8633 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing end block *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing end block *********************************************\n"
);
8634 }
8635 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
8636 bool ignoredUnknown = false;
8637 if (!readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ignoredUnknown))
8638 return fail();
8639 DRW_DBG("unknown bit: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("unknown bit: "); DRW_DBG(ignoredUnknown)DRW_dbg::dbg(ignoredUnknown); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
8640 }
8641// X handleAssoc; //X
8642 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe) > bodyEndBit)
8643 return fail();
8644 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
8645 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*buf, version, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
8646 return fail();
8647 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &bodyProbe, true,
8648 handleEndBit);
8649 if (!ret || !bodyProbe.isGood())
8650 return fail();
8651 // RS crc; //RS */
8652 // R13-R2004 keep the handle stream inline and may consume the final
8653 // byte-alignment padding beyond the declared object-data bit count.
8654 // Only R2007+ has a separate string stream range to validate here.
8655 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
8656 || (version > DRW::AC1018 && currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit))
8657 return fail();
8658 *buf = bodyProbe;
8659 if (!isEnd)
8660 name = std::move(parsedName);
8661 return true;
8662}
8663
8664bool DRW_Insert::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
8665 switch (code) {
8666 case 2:
8667 name = reader->getUtf8String();
8668 break;
8669 case 41:
8670 xscale = reader->getDouble();
8671 break;
8672 case 42:
8673 yscale = reader->getDouble();
8674 break;
8675 case 43:
8676 zscale = reader->getDouble();
8677 break;
8678 case 50:
8679 angle = reader->getDouble();
8680 angle = angle/ARAD57.29577951308232; //convert to radian
8681 break;
8682 case 70: {
8683 int value = 0;
8684 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, kMaxMInsertCount, value))
8685 return false;
8686 colcount = value;
8687 break;
8688 }
8689 case 71: {
8690 int value = 0;
8691 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, kMaxMInsertCount, value))
8692 return false;
8693 rowcount = value;
8694 break;
8695 }
8696 case 44:
8697 colspace = reader->getDouble();
8698 break;
8699 case 45:
8700 rowspace = reader->getDouble();
8701 break;
8702 default:
8703 return DRW_Point::parseCode(code, reader);
8704 }
8705
8706 return true;
8707}
8708
8709bool DRW_Table::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
8710 auto ensureGrid = [this]() {
8711 if (m_dxfRowsExpected < 0 || m_dxfColumnsExpected < 0)
8712 return true;
8713
8714 const std::uint32_t rows = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m_dxfRowsExpected);
8715 const std::uint32_t columns = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m_dxfColumnsExpected);
8716 if (rows > kMaxTableRows || columns > kMaxTableColumns
8717 || (columns != 0 && rows > kMaxTableCells / columns)) {
8718 return false;
8719 }
8720
8721 if (m_content.m_columns.size() != columns) {
8722 m_content.m_columns.clear();
8723 if (!DRW::reserve(m_content.m_columns, static_cast<int>(columns)))
8724 return false;
8725 if (!DRW::resize(m_content.m_columns, static_cast<int>(columns)))
8726 return false;
8727 m_dxfColumnWidthsRead = 0;
8728 }
8729 if (m_content.m_rows.size() != rows) {
8730 m_content.m_rows.clear();
8731 if (!DRW::reserve(m_content.m_rows, static_cast<int>(rows)))
8732 return false;
8733 if (!DRW::resize(m_content.m_rows, static_cast<int>(rows)))
8734 return false;
8735 m_dxfRowHeightsRead = 0;
8736 }
8737 for (auto& row : m_content.m_rows) {
8738 if (!DRW::reserve(row.m_cells, static_cast<int>(columns)))
8739 return false;
8740 if (!DRW::resize(row.m_cells, static_cast<int>(columns)))
8741 return false;
8742 }
8743
8744 m_hasSemanticContent = true;
8745 m_semanticContentComplete = true;
8746 return true;
8747 };
8748
8749 auto currentCell = [this]() -> DRW_TableCell* {
8750 if (m_dxfCurrentCell < 0 || m_content.m_columns.empty()
8751 || m_content.m_rows.empty()) {
8752 return nullptr;
8753 }
8754
8755 const std::size_t columns = m_content.m_columns.size();
8756 const std::size_t cell = static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfCurrentCell);
8757 const std::size_t row = cell / columns;
8758 const std::size_t column = cell % columns;
8759 if (row >= m_content.m_rows.size()
8760 || column >= m_content.m_rows[row].m_cells.size()) {
8761 return nullptr;
8762 }
8763 return &m_content.m_rows[row].m_cells[column];
8764 };
8765
8766 auto currentContent = [&currentCell]() -> DRW_TableCellContent* {
8767 DRW_TableCell *cell = currentCell();
8768 if (cell == nullptr)
8769 return nullptr;
8770 if (cell->m_contents.empty() || cell->m_contents.back().m_type != 1) {
8771 DRW_TableCellContent content;
8772 content.m_type = 1;
8773 cell->m_contents.push_back(content);
8774 }
8775 return &cell->m_contents.back();
8776 };
8777
8778 if (code == 100) {
8779 const std::string subclass = reader->getString();
8780 if (subclass == "AcDbBlockReference") {
8781 m_dxfSubclass = DxfSubclass::BlockReference;
8782 } else if (subclass == "AcDbTable") {
8783 m_dxfSubclass = DxfSubclass::Table;
8784 } else if (subclass == "AcDbEntity") {
8785 m_dxfSubclass = DxfSubclass::Entity;
8786 }
8787 return true;
8788 }
8789
8790 if (m_dxfSubclass != DxfSubclass::Table)
8791 return DRW_Insert::parseCode(code, reader);
8792
8793 switch (code) {
8794 case 342:
8795 m_tableStyleHandle = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getHandleString());
8796 m_content.m_tableStyleHandle = m_tableStyleHandle;
8797 break;
8798 case 343:
8799 reader->getHandleString();
8800 break;
8801 case 11:
8802 m_horizontalDirection.x = reader->getDouble();
8803 break;
8804 case 21:
8805 m_horizontalDirection.y = reader->getDouble();
8806 break;
8807 case 31:
8808 m_horizontalDirection.z = reader->getDouble();
8809 break;
8810 case 90:
8811 if (m_dxfInCellValue) {
8812 if (DRW_TableCellContent *content = currentContent())
8813 content->m_value.m_dataType = reader->getInt32();
8814 else
8815 reader->getInt32();
8816 } else {
8817 m_valueFlag = reader->getInt32();
8818 }
8819 break;
8820 case 91:
8821 if (m_dxfRowsExpected < 0 && !m_dxfInCellValue) {
8822 int value = 0;
8823 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0,
8824 static_cast<int>(kMaxTableRows), value))
8825 return false;
8826 m_dxfRowsExpected = value;
8827 if (!ensureGrid())
8828 return false;
8829 } else {
8830 reader->getInt32();
8831 }
8832 break;
8833 case 92:
8834 if (m_dxfColumnsExpected < 0 && !m_dxfInCellValue) {
8835 int value = 0;
8836 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0,
8837 static_cast<int>(kMaxTableColumns), value))
8838 return false;
8839 m_dxfColumnsExpected = value;
8840 if (!ensureGrid())
8841 return false;
8842 } else {
8843 reader->getInt32();
8844 }
8845 break;
8846 case 93:
8847 case 94:
8848 case 95:
8849 case 96:
8850 case 172:
8851 case 173:
8852 case 174:
8853 case 175:
8854 case 176:
8855 case 178:
8856 reader->getInt32();
8857 break;
8858 case 141:
8859 if (!ensureGrid())
8860 return false;
8861 if (m_dxfRowHeightsRead < m_content.m_rows.size())
8862 m_content.m_rows[m_dxfRowHeightsRead++].m_height = reader->getDouble();
8863 else
8864 reader->getDouble();
8865 break;
8866 case 142:
8867 if (!ensureGrid())
8868 return false;
8869 if (m_dxfColumnWidthsRead < m_content.m_columns.size())
8870 m_content.m_columns[m_dxfColumnWidthsRead++].m_width = reader->getDouble();
8871 else
8872 reader->getDouble();
8873 break;
8874 case 145:
8875 reader->getDouble();
8876 break;
8877 case 171:
8878 if (!ensureGrid())
8879 return false;
8880 if (!m_content.m_rows.empty() && !m_content.m_columns.empty()
8881 && m_dxfNextCell < m_content.m_rows.size() * m_content.m_columns.size()) {
8882 m_dxfCurrentCell = static_cast<int>(m_dxfNextCell++);
8883 if (DRW_TableCell *cell = currentCell())
8884 cell->m_flags = reader->getInt32();
8885 else
8886 reader->getInt32();
8887 } else {
8888 m_dxfCurrentCell = -1;
8889 reader->getInt32();
8890 }
8891 m_dxfInCellValue = false;
8892 break;
8893 case 301:
8894 m_dxfInCellValue = reader->getString() == "CELL_VALUE";
8895 if (m_dxfInCellValue)
8896 currentContent();
8897 break;
8898 case 1:
8899 case 302: {
8900 const UTF8STRINGstd::string text = reader->getUtf8String();
8901 if (m_dxfInCellValue) {
8902 if (DRW_TableCellContent *content = currentContent()) {
8903 content->m_text = text;
8904 content->m_value.m_dataType = 4;
8905 content->m_value.m_value.addString(1, text);
8906 }
8907 }
8908 break;
8909 }
8910 case 300:
8911 if (m_dxfInCellValue) {
8912 if (DRW_TableCellContent *content = currentContent())
8913 content->m_value.m_valueString = reader->getUtf8String();
8914 else
8915 reader->getUtf8String();
8916 } else {
8917 reader->getUtf8String();
8918 }
8919 break;
8920 case 304:
8921 reader->getString();
8922 m_dxfInCellValue = false;
8923 break;
8924 default:
8925 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
8926 }
8927
8928 return true;
8929}
8930
8931void DRW_Insert::resetDwgState() {
8932 DRW_Point::resetDwgState();
8933 name.clear();
8934 xscale = yscale = zscale = 1.0;
8935 angle = 0.0;
8936 colcount = rowcount = 1;
8937 colspace = rowspace = 0.0;
8938 attlist.clear();
8939 blockRecH = dwgHandle{};
8940 seqendH = dwgHandle{};
8941 attribHandles.clear();

8943
8944bool DRW_Insert::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
8945 resetDwgState();
8946 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
8947 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
8948 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
8949 sourceBuf->invalidate();
8950 resetDwgState();
8951 return false;
8952 };
8953 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
8954 return fail();
8955
8956 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
8957 buf = &bodyProbe;
8958 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, buf, bs)
8959 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
8960 return fail();
8961
8962 std::int32_t objCount = 0;
8963 std::vector<dwgHandle> parsedAttribHandles;
8964 DRW_DBG("\n************************** parsing insert/minsert *****************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n************************** parsing insert/minsert *****************************************\n"
);
8965 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
8966 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
8967 DRW_Coord parsedExtPoint;
8968 double parsedXScale = 1.0;
8969 double parsedYScale = 1.0;
8970 double parsedZScale = 1.0;
8971 double parsedAngle = 0.0;
8972 bool hasAttrib = false;
8973
8974 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint))
8975 return fail();
8976 DRW_DBG("insertion point: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("insertion point: ");
8977 DRW_DBGPT(parsedBasePoint.x, parsedBasePoint.y, parsedBasePoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedBasePoint.x, parsedBasePoint.y, parsedBasePoint
.z);
8978 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
8979 if (version < DRW::AC1015) {//14-
8980 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale)
8981 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedYScale)
8982 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedZScale))
8983 return fail();
8984 } else {
8985 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, 2))
8986 return fail();
8987 const std::uint8_t dataFlags = buf->get2Bits();
8988 if (!buf->isGood())
8989 return fail();
8990 if (dataFlags == 3) {
8991 //none default value 1,1,1
8992 } else if (dataFlags == 1) { //x default value 1, y & z use DD(1)
8993 if (!readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, 1.0,
8994 parsedYScale)
8995 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, 1.0,
8996 parsedZScale))
8997 return fail();
8998 } else if (dataFlags == 2) {
8999 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale))
9000 return fail();
9001 parsedYScale = parsedZScale = parsedXScale;
9002 } else { //dataFlags == 0
9003 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale)
9004 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale,
9005 parsedYScale)
9006 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale,
9007 parsedZScale))
9008 return fail();
9009 }
9010 }
9011 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAngle)
9012 || !readBoundedExtrusion(*buf, bodyEndBit, false, parsedExtPoint)
9013 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, hasAttrib))
9014 return fail();
9015 DRW_DBG("scale : ")DRW_dbg::dbg("scale : ");
9016 DRW_DBGPT(parsedXScale, parsedYScale, parsedZScale)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedXScale, parsedYScale, parsedZScale);
9017 DRW_DBG(", angle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", angle: "); DRW_DBG(parsedAngle)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedAngle);
9018 DRW_DBG("\nextrusion: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nextrusion: ");
9019 DRW_DBGPT(parsedExtPoint.x, parsedExtPoint.y, parsedExtPoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedExtPoint.x, parsedExtPoint.y, parsedExtPoint
.z);
9020
9021 DRW_DBG(" has Attrib: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" has Attrib: "); DRW_DBG(hasAttrib)DRW_dbg::dbg(hasAttrib);
9022
9023 if (hasAttrib && version > DRW::AC1015) {//2004+
9024 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, objCount)
9025 || !dwgSafety::validOwnedObjectCount(
9026 objCount, buf->numRemainingBytes())) {
9027 DRW_DBG("\nWARNING: Invalid INSERT owned-attribute count\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nWARNING: Invalid INSERT owned-attribute count\n"
);
9028 return fail();
9029 }
9030 DRW_DBG(" objCount: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" objCount: "); DRW_DBG(objCount)DRW_dbg::dbg(objCount); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9031 }
9032 int parsedColCount = 1;
9033 int parsedRowCount = 1;
9034 double parsedColSpace = 0.0;
9035 double parsedRowSpace = 0.0;
9036 if (oType == 8) {//entity are minsert
9037 std::uint16_t colCount = 0;
9038 std::uint16_t rowCount = 0;
9039 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, colCount)
9040 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, rowCount)
9041 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedColSpace)
9042 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedRowSpace))
9043 return fail();
9044 parsedColCount = static_cast<int>(colCount);
9045 parsedRowCount = static_cast<int>(rowCount);
9046 }
9047 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
9048 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
9049 && std::isfinite(point.z);
9050 };
9051 if (!finite(parsedBasePoint) || !finite(parsedExtPoint)
9052 || !std::isfinite(parsedXScale) || !std::isfinite(parsedYScale)
9053 || !std::isfinite(parsedZScale) || !std::isfinite(parsedAngle)
9054 || !std::isfinite(parsedColSpace) || !std::isfinite(parsedRowSpace))
9055 return fail();
9056 DRW_DBG(" Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(buf->numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(buf->numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9057 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
9058 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
9059 handleEndBit))
9060 return fail();
9061 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
9062 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
9063 handleEndBit))
9064 return fail();
9065 dwgHandle parsedBlockRecH;
9066 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
9067 parsedBlockRecH))
9068 return fail();
9069 dwgHandle parsedSeqendH;
9070 DRW_DBG("BLOCK HEADER Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("BLOCK HEADER Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(parsedBlockRecH.code, parsedBlockRecH.size, parsedBlockRecH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(parsedBlockRecH.code, parsedBlockRecH.size, parsedBlockRecH
.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9071 DRW_DBG(" Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9072
9073 /*attribs follows*/
9074 if (hasAttrib) {
9075 const std::int32_t expectedCount =
9076 version < DRW::AC1018 ? 2 : objCount;
9077 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedAttribHandles, expectedCount))
9078 return fail();
9079 if (version < DRW::AC1018) {//2000-
9080 dwgHandle attH;
9081 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
9082 attH))
9083 return fail();
9084 DRW_DBG("first attrib Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("first attrib Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(attH.code, attH.size, attH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(attH.code, attH.size, attH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9085 parsedAttribHandles.push_back(attH);
9086 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
9087 attH))
9088 return fail();
9089 DRW_DBG("second attrib Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("second attrib Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(attH.code, attH.size, attH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(attH.code, attH.size, attH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9090 parsedAttribHandles.push_back(attH);
9091 } else {
9092 for (std::int32_t i=0; i < objCount; ++i){
9093 dwgHandle attH;
9094 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0,
9095 false, attH))
9096 return fail();
9097 DRW_DBG("attrib Handle #")DRW_dbg::dbg("attrib Handle #"); DRW_DBG(i)DRW_dbg::dbg(i); DRW_DBG(": ")DRW_dbg::dbg(": "); DRW_DBGHL(attH.code, attH.size, attH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(attH.code, attH.size, attH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9098 parsedAttribHandles.push_back(attH);
9099 }
9100 }
9101 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
9102 parsedSeqendH))
9103 return fail();
9104 DRW_DBG("seqendH Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("seqendH Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(parsedSeqendH.code, parsedSeqendH.size, parsedSeqendH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(parsedSeqendH.code, parsedSeqendH.size, parsedSeqendH
.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9105 }
9106 DRW_DBG(" Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9107
9108 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
9109 return fail();
9110 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
9111 basePoint = parsedBasePoint;
9112 xscale = parsedXScale;
9113 yscale = parsedYScale;
9114 zscale = parsedZScale;
9115 angle = parsedAngle;
9116 extPoint = parsedExtPoint;
9117 colcount = parsedColCount;
9118 rowcount = parsedRowCount;
9119 colspace = parsedColSpace;
9120 rowspace = parsedRowSpace;
9121 blockRecH = parsedBlockRecH;
9122 seqendH = parsedSeqendH;
9123 attribHandles = std::move(parsedAttribHandles);
9124 // RS crc; //RS */
9125 return true;
9126}
