9128void DRW_Table::resetDwgState() {
9129 DRW_Insert::resetDwgState();
9130 name.clear();
9131 xscale = yscale = zscale = 1.0;
9132 angle = 0.0;
9133 colcount = rowcount = 1;
9134 colspace = rowspace = 0.0;
9135 m_valueFlag = 0;
9136 m_horizontalDirection = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
9137 m_hasSemanticContent = false;
9138 m_semanticContentComplete = false;
9139 m_tableStyleHandle = 0;
9140 m_content = DRW_TableContent{};
9141 m_dxfSubclass = DxfSubclass::Entity;
9142 m_dxfRowsExpected = -1;
9143 m_dxfColumnsExpected = -1;
9144 m_dxfRowHeightsRead = 0;
9145 m_dxfColumnWidthsRead = 0;
9146 m_dxfNextCell = 0;
9147 m_dxfCurrentCell = -1;
9148 m_dxfInCellValue = false;
9149}
9150
9151bool DRW_Table::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
9152 resetDwgState();
9153 auto fail = [this, buf]() {
9154 if (buf != nullptr)
9155 buf->invalidate();
9156 resetDwgState();
9157 return false;
9158 };
9159 if (buf == nullptr || version < DRW::AC1015)
9160 return fail();
9161
9162 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
9163 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
9164 buf = &bodyProbe;
9165 auto commit = [&]() {
9166 *sourceBuf = bodyProbe;
9167 return true;
9168 };
9169
9170 dwgBuffer sBuff = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
9171 sBuff.setVariableTextByteLength(true);
9172 dwgBuffer *sBuf = &sBuff;
9173 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
9174 if (!ret)
9175 return fail();
9176
9177 DRW_DBG("\n************************** parsing table *****************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n************************** parsing table *****************************************\n"
);
9178 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
9179 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
9180 std::uint8_t dataFlags = 0;
9181 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint)
9182 || !proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, 2))
9183 return fail();
9184 dataFlags = buf->get2Bits();
9185 if (!buf->isGood())
9186 return fail();
9187
9188 double parsedXScale = 1.0;
9189 double parsedYScale = 1.0;
9190 double parsedZScale = 1.0;
9191 if (dataFlags == 3) {
9192 // default scale 1,1,1
9193 } else if (dataFlags == 1) {
9194 if (!readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale,
9195 parsedYScale)
9196 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale,
9197 parsedZScale))
9198 return fail();
9199 } else if (dataFlags == 2) {
9200 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale))
9201 return fail();
9202 parsedYScale = parsedZScale = parsedXScale;
9203 } else {
9204 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale)
9205 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale,
9206 parsedYScale)
9207 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXScale,
9208 parsedZScale))
9209 return fail();
9210 }
9211
9212 double parsedAngle = 0.0;
9213 DRW_Coord parsedExtPoint;
9214 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAngle)
9215 || !readBoundedExtrusion(*buf, bodyEndBit, false, parsedExtPoint))
9216 return fail();
9217
9218 if (!sBuf->isGood())
9219 return fail();
9220
9221 std::int32_t objCount = 0;
9222 bool hasAttrib = false;
9223 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, hasAttrib))
9224 return fail();
9225 if (hasAttrib && version > DRW::AC1015) {
9226 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, objCount)
9227 || !dwgSafety::validOwnedObjectCount(
9228 objCount, buf->numRemainingBytes())) {
9229 DRW_DBG("\nWARNING: Invalid TABLE owned-attribute count\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nWARNING: Invalid TABLE owned-attribute count\n"
);
9230 return fail();
9231 }
9232 }
9233
9234 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
9235 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
9236 handleEndBit))
9237 return fail();
9238 dwgBuffer hBuff = buf->forkIndependent();
9239 if (version <= DRW::AC1018) {
9240 // R2000/R2004: parseDwgEntHandle only re-seeks to the handle stream
9241 // for version > AC1018 (2007+ string area). For the legacy versions
9242 // seek the snapshot to the handle-stream start (objSize is the
9243 // bit offset of the handle stream, RL field read in
9244 // DRW_Entity::parseDwg) or every handle below reads mid-DATA garbage.
9245 if (!hBuff.setPosition(objSize >> 3))
9246 return fail();
9247 hBuff.setBitPos(objSize & 7);
9248 }
9249 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &hBuff, true,
9250 handleEndBit);
9251 if (!ret)
9252 return fail();
9253 dwgHandle parsedBlockRecH;
9254 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(hBuff, handleEndBit, 0, false,
9255 parsedBlockRecH))
9256 return fail();
9257
9258 std::vector<dwgHandle> parsedAttribHandles;
9259 dwgHandle parsedSeqendH;
9260
9261 if (hasAttrib) {
9262 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedAttribHandles, objCount))
9263 return fail();
9264 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < objCount; ++i) {
9265 dwgHandle attribHandle;
9266 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(hBuff, handleEndBit, 0, false,
9267 attribHandle))
9268 return fail();
9269 parsedAttribHandles.push_back(attribHandle);
9270 }
9271 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(hBuff, handleEndBit, 0, false,
9272 parsedSeqendH))
9273 return fail();
9274 }
9275
9276 if (!hBuff.isGood())
9277 return fail();
9278
9279 blockRecH = parsedBlockRecH;
9280 seqendH = parsedSeqendH;
9281 attribHandles = std::move(parsedAttribHandles);
9282 basePoint = parsedBasePoint;
9283 xscale = parsedXScale;
9284 yscale = parsedYScale;
9285 zscale = parsedZScale;
9286 angle = parsedAngle;
9287 extPoint = parsedExtPoint;
9288
9289 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
9290 std::uint8_t ignoredTableVersion = 0;
9291 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredTableVersion))
9292 return fail();
9293 dwgHandle parsedTableStyleHandle;
9294 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(hBuff, handleEndBit, 0, false,
9295 parsedTableStyleHandle))
9296 return fail();
9297 const std::uint32_t tableStyleHandle = parsedTableStyleHandle.ref;
9298 std::int32_t ignoredContentFlag = 0;
9299 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredContentFlag))
9300 return fail();
9301 if (version >= DRW::AC1027) {
9302 std::int32_t ignoredContentVersion = 0;
9303 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredContentVersion))
9304 return fail();
9305 } else {
9306 bool ignoredContentBit = false;
9307 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredContentBit))
9308 return fail();
9309 }
9310
9311 if (!buf->isGood() || !hBuff.isGood())
9312 return fail();
9313
9314 m_hasSemanticContent = true;
9315 // TABLECONTENT is an optional semantic tail. Decode it on independent
9316 // cursors so a newer/partially supported cell variant cannot poison the
9317 // already validated entity prefix and common handle stream.
9318 dwgBuffer contentBuf = buf->forkIndependent();
9319 dwgBuffer contentStringBuf = sBuf->forkIndependent();
9320 dwgBuffer contentHandleBuf = hBuff.forkIndependent();
9321 TableDwgBounds tableBounds;
9322 tableBounds.bodyEndBit = tableBodyEndBit(version, sBuf, objSize);
9323 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
9324 std::uint64_t stringStartBit = 0;
9325 if (!contentStringBuf.getR2007StringStreamBounds(
9326 objSize, stringStartBit, tableBounds.stringEndBit))
9327 return fail();
9328 } else {
9329 tableBounds.stringEndBit = proxyEntityEndBit(contentStringBuf, 0);
9330 }
9331 tableBounds.handleEndBit = handleEndBit;
9332 DRW_TableContent parsedContent;
9333 m_semanticContentComplete = parseTableContent(
9334 version, &contentBuf, &contentStringBuf, &contentHandleBuf,
9335 parsedContent, tableBounds);
9336 if (!m_semanticContentComplete || !contentBuf.isGood()
9337 || !contentStringBuf.isGood() || !contentHandleBuf.isGood()) {
9338 // The frame, entity prefix, and common handles remain valid. Keep
9339 // the typed table shell and allow the raw DWG frame to preserve
9340 // content that this reader does not yet model.
9341 m_semanticContentComplete = false;
9342 return commit();
9343 }
9344 *buf = contentBuf;
9345 *sBuf = contentStringBuf;
9346 hBuff = contentHandleBuf;
9347 m_content = std::move(parsedContent);
9348 if (m_content.m_tableStyleHandle != 0)
9349 m_tableStyleHandle = m_content.m_tableStyleHandle;
9350 else
9351 m_tableStyleHandle = tableStyleHandle;
9352 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood() || !hBuff.isGood())
9353 return fail();
9354 if (!m_semanticContentComplete) {
9355 DRW_DBG("TABLECONTENT parse incomplete; anonymous block insert kept\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("TABLECONTENT parse incomplete; anonymous block insert kept\n"
);
9356 return commit();
9357 }
9358
9359 std::uint16_t ignoredTableFlags = 0;
9360 DRW_Coord parsedHorizontalDirection;
9361 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredTableFlags)
9362 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9363 parsedHorizontalDirection))
9364 return fail();
9365 m_horizontalDirection = parsedHorizontalDirection;
9366
9367 const std::uint64_t breakStartBit = currentDwgBit(buf);
9368 std::int32_t breakDataFlag = 0;
9369 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, breakDataFlag))
9370 return fail();
9371 const bool hasBreakData = breakDataFlag != 0;
9372 if (hasBreakData) {
9373 std::int32_t ignoredBreakType = 0;
9374 double ignoredBreakDistance = 0.0;
9375 std::int32_t manualPositionCount = 0;
9376 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBreakType)
9377 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBreakType)
9378 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9379 ignoredBreakDistance)
9380 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBreakType)
9381 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBreakType)
9382 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9383 manualPositionCount))
9384 return fail();
9385 if (manualPositionCount < 0
9386 || static_cast<std::uint32_t>(manualPositionCount)
9387 > kMaxTableItems) {
9388 m_content.m_subrecordRanges.push_back(makeDwgSubrecordRange(
9389 "table-break-data", breakStartBit, currentDwgBit(buf),
9390 version, manualPositionCount, false));
9391 return commit();
9392 }
9393 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < manualPositionCount; ++i) {
9394 DRW_Coord ignoredPosition;
9395 double ignoredRotation = 0.0;
9396 std::int32_t ignoredPositionType = 0;
9397 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9398 ignoredPosition)
9399 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9400 ignoredRotation)
9401 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9402 ignoredPositionType))
9403 return fail();
9404 }
9405 m_content.m_subrecordRanges.push_back(makeDwgSubrecordRange(
9406 "table-break-data", breakStartBit, currentDwgBit(buf),
9407 version, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(manualPositionCount),
9408 buf->isGood()));
9409 }
9410
9411 const std::uint64_t rowRangeStartBit = currentDwgBit(buf);
9412 std::int32_t rowRangeCount = 0;
9413 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, rowRangeCount))
9414 return fail();
9415 if (rowRangeCount >= 0
9416 && static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rowRangeCount) <= kMaxTableItems) {
9417 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < rowRangeCount; ++i) {
9418 DRW_Coord ignoredRangePoint;
9419 std::int32_t ignoredRangeValue = 0;
9420 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9421 ignoredRangePoint)
9422 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9423 ignoredRangeValue)
9424 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9425 ignoredRangeValue))
9426 return fail();
9427 }
9428 if (rowRangeCount != 0) {
9429 m_content.m_subrecordRanges.push_back(makeDwgSubrecordRange(
9430 "table-row-ranges", rowRangeStartBit, currentDwgBit(buf),
9431 version, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rowRangeCount),
9432 buf->isGood()));
9433 }
9434 } else {
9435 m_content.m_subrecordRanges.push_back(makeDwgSubrecordRange(
9436 "table-row-ranges", rowRangeStartBit, currentDwgBit(buf),
9437 version, rowRangeCount, false));
9438 }
9439
9440 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood() || !hBuff.isGood())
9441 return fail();
9442 return commit();
9443 }
9444
9445 std::uint16_t parsedValueFlag = 0;
9446 DRW_Coord parsedHorizontalDirection;
9447 std::int32_t parsedColumnCount = 0;
9448 std::int32_t parsedRowCount = 0;
9449 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedValueFlag)
9450 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit,
9451 parsedHorizontalDirection)
9452 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedColumnCount)
9453 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedRowCount)
9454 || parsedColumnCount < 0 || parsedRowCount < 0)
9455 return fail();
9456 const std::uint32_t columns = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parsedColumnCount);
9457 const std::uint32_t rows = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parsedRowCount);
9458 if (columns > kMaxTableColumns || rows > kMaxTableRows
9459 || (columns != 0 && rows > kMaxTableCells / columns)) {
9460 return fail();
9461 }
9462
9463 m_hasSemanticContent = true;
9464 m_semanticContentComplete = false;
9465 m_content.m_columns.clear();
9466 m_content.m_rows.clear();
9467 if (!DRW::reserve(m_content.m_columns, static_cast<int>(columns))
9468 || !DRW::reserve(m_content.m_rows, static_cast<int>(rows)))
9469 return fail();
9470 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < columns; ++i) {
9471 DRW_TableColumn column;
9472 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, column.m_width))
9473 return fail();
9474 m_content.m_columns.push_back(column);
9475 }
9476 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
9477 DRW_TableRow row;
9478 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, row.m_height))
9479 return fail();
9480 if (!DRW::reserve(row.m_cells, static_cast<int>(columns)))
9481 return fail();
9482 if (!DRW::resize(row.m_cells, static_cast<int>(columns)))
9483 return fail();
9484 m_content.m_rows.push_back(row);
9485 }
9486 dwgHandle parsedTableStyleHandle;
9487 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(hBuff, handleEndBit, 0, false,
9488 parsedTableStyleHandle))
9489 return fail();
9490 m_tableStyleHandle = parsedTableStyleHandle.ref;
9491 if (!hBuff.isGood())
9492 return fail();
9493 m_content.m_tableStyleHandle = m_tableStyleHandle;
9494 m_semanticContentComplete = true;
9495 // For <=AC1018 (R2000/R2004) there is no separate R2007+ string stream:
9496 // DRW_Entity::parseDwg only seeks sBuf when version > AC1018 (see the
9497 // `strBuf != NULL && version > DRW::AC1018` guard there), so legacy cell
9498 // text is inline in `buf`. Passing the stale sBuf copy here would read
9499 // text from the wrong position and desync `buf`. Pass nullptr so the
9500 // cell readers' `textBuf = strBuf ? strBuf : buf` falls back to the
9501 // inline `buf`. R2007 (AC1021) keeps the separate sBuf stream.
9502 dwgBuffer *cellStrBuf = (version > DRW::AC1018) ? sBuf : nullptr;
9503 TableDwgBounds tableBounds;
9504 tableBounds.bodyEndBit = bodyEndBit;
9505 tableBounds.stringEndBit = cellStrBuf == nullptr
9506 ? bodyEndBit : proxyEntityEndBit(*cellStrBuf, 0);
9507 tableBounds.handleEndBit = handleEndBit;
9508 for (std::uint32_t row = 0; row < rows && m_semanticContentComplete; ++row) {
9509 for (std::uint32_t column = 0; column < columns; ++column) {
9510 if (!parseR2007TableCell(version, buf, cellStrBuf, &hBuff,
9511 m_content.m_rows[row].m_cells[column],
9512 &m_content.m_subrecordRanges,
9513 tableBounds)) {
9514 m_semanticContentComplete = false;
9515 break;
9516 }
9517 }
9518 }
9519
9520 if (m_semanticContentComplete)
9521 m_semanticContentComplete = skipR2007TableOverrides(
9522 version, buf, cellStrBuf, &hBuff, &m_content.m_subrecordRanges,
9523 tableBounds);
9524 if (!m_semanticContentComplete)
9525 DRW_DBG("R2007 TABLE cell parse incomplete; anonymous block insert kept\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("R2007 TABLE cell parse incomplete; anonymous block insert kept\n"
);
9526
9527 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood() || !hBuff.isGood())
9528 return fail();
9529 m_valueFlag = parsedValueFlag;
9530 m_horizontalDirection = parsedHorizontalDirection;
9531 return commit();
9532}
9533
9534bool DRW_TableContentObject::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
9535 reset();
9536 const auto fail = [this, buf]() {
9537 if (buf != nullptr)
9538 buf->invalidate();
9539 reset();
9540 return false;
9541 };
9542 if (buf == nullptr || version <= DRW::AC1018)
9543 return fail();
9544
9545 dwgBuffer sBuff = *buf;
9546 sBuff.setVariableTextByteLength(true);
9547 dwgBuffer *sBuf = &sBuff;
9548 bool ret = DRW_TableEntry::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
9549 DRW_DBG("\n************************** parsing table content object ************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n************************** parsing table content object ************************\n"
);
9550 if (!ret)
9551 return fail();
9552
9553 dwgBuffer bodyBuff = *buf;
9554 dwgBuffer *bodyBuf = &bodyBuff;
9555
9556 dwgBuffer hBuff = *buf;
9557 seekTableObjectHandleStream(version, &hBuff, objSize);
9558 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
9559 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*buf, version, objSize, bs, handleEndBit))
9560 return fail();
9561 std::uint32_t parsedParentHandle = 0;
9562 std::vector<std::uint32_t> parsedReactors;
9563 std::uint32_t parsedXDictHandle = 0;
9564 if (!readTableObjectCommonHandles(&hBuff, handle, numReactors, xDictFlag,
9565 &parsedParentHandle, &parsedReactors,
9566 &parsedXDictHandle, handleEndBit))
9567 return fail();
9568
9569 DRW_TableContent parsedContent;
9570 TableDwgBounds tableBounds;
9571 tableBounds.bodyEndBit = tableBodyEndBit(version, sBuf, objSize);
9572 tableBounds.stringEndBit = proxyEntityEndBit(*sBuf, 0);
9573 tableBounds.handleEndBit = handleEndBit;
9574 const bool parseComplete = parseTableContent(
9575 version, bodyBuf, sBuf, &hBuff, parsedContent, tableBounds);
9576 const std::uint64_t bodyBitOffset =
9577 bodyBuf->getPosition() * 8u + bodyBuf->getBitPos();
9578 if (!parseComplete || !bodyBuf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
9579 || !hBuff.isGood() || bodyBitOffset > objSize)
9580 return fail();
9581
9582 m_content = std::move(parsedContent);
9583 m_parseComplete = true;
9584 parentHandle = parsedParentHandle;
9585 reactorHandles = std::move(parsedReactors);
9586 xDictHandle = parsedXDictHandle;
9587 return true;
9588}
9589
9590void DRW_LWPolyline::applyExtrusion(){
9591 if (haveExtrusion) {
9592 calculateAxis(extPoint);
9593 for (unsigned int i=0; i<vertlist.size(); i++) {
9594 auto& vert = vertlist.at(i);
9595 DRW_Coord v(vert->x, vert->y, elevation);
9596 extrudePoint(extPoint, &v);
9597 vert->x = v.x;
9598 vert->y = v.y;
9599 }
9600 }
9601}
9602
9603bool DRW_LWPolyline::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
9604 switch (code) {
9605 case 10: {
9606 if (vertlist.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxLWPolylineVertices)
9607 || (m_dxfVertexCountSeen
9608 && vertlist.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(vertexnum)))
9609 return false;
9610 vertex = std::make_shared<DRW_Vertex2D>();
9611 vertlist.push_back(vertex);
9612 vertex->x = reader->getDouble();
9613 break; }
9614 case 20:
9615 if(vertex)
9616 vertex->y = reader->getDouble();
9617 break;
9618 case 40:
9619 if(vertex)
9620 vertex->stawidth = reader->getDouble();
9621 break;
9622 case 41:
9623 if(vertex)
9624 vertex->endwidth = reader->getDouble();
9625 break;
9626 case 42:
9627 if(vertex)
9628 vertex->bulge = reader->getDouble();
9629 break;
9630 case 91:
9631 if (vertex)
9632 vertex->identifier = reader->getInt32();
9633 break;
9634 case 38:
9635 elevation = reader->getDouble();
9636 break;
9637 case 39:
9638 thickness = reader->getDouble();
9639 break;
9640 case 43:
9641 width = reader->getDouble();
9642 break;
9643 case 70:
9644 flags = reader->getInt32();
9645 break;
9646 case 90:
9647 if (m_dxfVertexCountSeen)
9648 return false;
9649 vertexnum = reader->getInt32();
9650 if (!isValidCount(vertexnum, kMaxLWPolylineVertices))
9651 return false;
9652 m_dxfVertexCountSeen = true;
9653 return DRW::reserve(vertlist, vertexnum);
9654 case 210:
9655 haveExtrusion = true;
9656 extPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
9657 break;
9658 case 220:
9659 extPoint.y = reader->getDouble();
9660 break;
9661 case 230:
9662 extPoint.z = reader->getDouble();
9663 break;
9664 default:
9665 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
9666 }
9667
9668 return true;
9669}
9670
9671bool DRW_LWPolyline::validateDxf() const {
9672 return (!m_dxfVertexCountSeen
9673 || vertlist.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(vertexnum))
9674 && validatePayloadFields();
9675}
9676
9677bool DRW_LWPolyline::validatePayloadFields() const {
9678 const auto finite = [](double value) { return std::isfinite(value); };
9679 const auto finiteVertex = [&finite](const auto& vertex) {
9680 return vertex != nullptr && finite(vertex->x) && finite(vertex->y)
9681 && finite(vertex->stawidth) && finite(vertex->endwidth)
9682 && finite(vertex->bulge)
9683 && vertex->identifier >= std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min()
9684 && vertex->identifier <= std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max();
9685 };
9686
9687 // LWPOLYLINE group 70 has only the closed and linetype-generation bits.
9688 return flags >= 0 && (flags & ~0x81) == 0
9689 && finite(width) && finite(elevation) && finite(thickness)
9690 && finite(extPoint.x) && finite(extPoint.y) && finite(extPoint.z)
9691 && vertlist.size() <= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxLWPolylineVertices)
9692 && vertlist.size()
9693 <= static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max())
9694 && std::all_of(vertlist.cbegin(), vertlist.cend(), finiteVertex);
9695}
9696
9697bool DRW_LWPolyline::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
9698 const auto resetState = [this]() {
9699 DRW_Entity::reset();
9700 vertexnum = 0;
9701 flags = 0;
9702 width = 0.0;
9703 elevation = 0.0;
9704 thickness = 0.0;
9705 extPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
9706 vertlist.clear();
9707 vertex.reset();
9708 m_dxfVertexCountSeen = false;
9709 };
9710 resetState();
9711 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
9712 const auto fail = [sourceBuf, resetState]() {
9713 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
9714 sourceBuf->invalidate();
9715 resetState();
9716 return false;
9717 };
9718 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
9719 return fail();
9720
9721 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
9722 buf = &bodyProbe;
9723 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, buf, bs);
9724 if (!ret || !buf->isGood())
9725 return fail();
9726 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing LWPolyline *******************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing LWPolyline *******************************************\n"
);
9727
9728 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
9729 std::uint16_t rawFlagsValue = 0;
9730 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, rawFlagsValue))
9731 return fail();
9732 const int rawFlags = static_cast<int>(rawFlagsValue);
9733 double parsedWidth = 0.0;
9734 double parsedElevation = 0.0;
9735 double parsedThickness = 0.0;
9736 DRW_Coord parsedExtPoint{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
9737 if ((rawFlags & 4)
9738 && !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedWidth))
9739 return fail();
9740 if ((rawFlags & 8)
9741 && !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedElevation))
9742 return fail();
9743 if ((rawFlags & 2)
9744 && !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedThickness))
9745 return fail();
9746 if ((rawFlags & 1)
9747 && !readBoundedExtrusion(*buf, bodyEndBit, false, parsedExtPoint))
9748 return fail();
9749 DRW_DBG("flags value: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags value: "); DRW_DBG(rawFlags)DRW_dbg::dbg(rawFlags);
9750
9751 const std::uint32_t minimumVertexBits = version < DRW::AC1015 ? 128u : 4u;
9752 std::uint32_t parsedVertexCount = 0;
9753 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize,
9754 kMaxLWPolylineVertices, minimumVertexBits,
9755 parsedVertexCount)) {
9756 return fail();
9757 }
9758
9759 std::uint64_t vertexBits = 0;
9760 if (parsedVertexCount > 0) {
9761 if (version < DRW::AC1015) {
9762 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(parsedVertexCount, 128, vertexBits))
9763 return fail();
9764 } else {
9765 std::uint64_t deltaBits = 0;
9766 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(parsedVertexCount - 1, 4, deltaBits)
9767 || !dwgSafety::add(128, deltaBits, vertexBits))
9768 return fail();
9769 }
9770 }
9771 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, vertexBits))
9772 return fail();
9773
9774 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<DRW_Vertex2D>> parsedVertices;
9775 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedVertices, parsedVertexCount))
9776 return fail();
9777
9778 std::uint32_t bulgesnum = 0;
9779 if (rawFlags & 16) {
9780 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize,
9781 kMaxLWPolylineVertices, 2,
9782 bulgesnum))
9783 return fail();
9784 }
9785 std::uint32_t vertexIdCount = 0;
9786 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {//2010+
9787 if (rawFlags & 1024) {
9788 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize,
9789 kMaxLWPolylineVertices, 2,
9790 vertexIdCount))
9791 return fail();
9792 }
9793 }
9794 std::uint32_t widthsnum = 0;
9795 if (rawFlags & 32) {
9796 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize,
9797 kMaxLWPolylineVertices, 4,
9798 widthsnum))
9799 return fail();
9800 }
9801 std::uint64_t bulgeBits = 0;
9802 std::uint64_t vertexIdBits = 0;
9803 std::uint64_t widthBits = 0;
9804 std::uint64_t optionalBits = 0;
9805 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(bulgesnum, 2, bulgeBits)
9806 || !dwgSafety::multiply(vertexIdCount, 2, vertexIdBits)
9807 || !dwgSafety::multiply(widthsnum, 4, widthBits)
9808 || !dwgSafety::add(bulgeBits, vertexIdBits, optionalBits)
9809 || !dwgSafety::add(optionalBits, widthBits, optionalBits)) {
9810 return fail();
9811 }
9812 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, optionalBits))
9813 return fail();
9814 DRW_DBG("\nvertex num: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nvertex num: "); DRW_DBG(parsedVertexCount)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedVertexCount); DRW_DBG(" bulges num: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" bulges num: "); DRW_DBG(bulgesnum)DRW_dbg::dbg(bulgesnum);
9815 DRW_DBG(" vertexIdCount: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" vertexIdCount: "); DRW_DBG(vertexIdCount)DRW_dbg::dbg(vertexIdCount); DRW_DBG(" widths num: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" widths num: "); DRW_DBG(widthsnum)DRW_dbg::dbg(widthsnum);
9816
9817 if (parsedVertexCount > 0) { //verify if is lwpol without vertex (empty)
9818 // add vertexes
9819 auto parsedVertex = std::make_shared<DRW_Vertex2D>();
9820 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedVertex->x)
9821 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedVertex->y))
9822 return fail();
9823 parsedVertices.push_back(parsedVertex);
9824 auto pv = parsedVertex;
9825 for (std::uint32_t i = 1; i < parsedVertexCount; ++i){
9826 parsedVertex = std::make_shared<DRW_Vertex2D>();
9827 if (version < DRW::AC1015) {//14-
9828 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedVertex->x)
9829 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedVertex->y))
9830 return fail();
9831 } else {
9832 if (!readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, pv->x,
9833 parsedVertex->x)
9834 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, pv->y,
9835 parsedVertex->y))
9836 return fail();
9837 }
9838 pv = parsedVertex;
9839 parsedVertices.push_back(parsedVertex);
9840 }
9841 }
9842 // The optional vectors are independent DWG fields, not per-point
9843 // conditionals. Consume them even when num_points is zero so the handle
9844 // stream remains aligned; values without a corresponding vertex are
9845 // intentionally discarded by the existing model.
9846 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < bulgesnum; i++){
9847 double bulge = 0.0;
9848 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, bulge))
9849 return fail();
9850 if (i < parsedVertices.size())
9851 parsedVertices.at(i)->bulge = bulge;
9852 }
9853 //add vertexId
9854 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {//2010+
9855 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < vertexIdCount; i++){
9856 std::int32_t vertexId = 0;
9857 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, vertexId))
9858 return fail();
9859 if (i < parsedVertices.size())
9860 parsedVertices.at(i)->identifier = vertexId;
9861 }
9862 }
9863 //add widths
9864 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < widthsnum; i++){
9865 double staW = 0.0;
9866 double endW = 0.0;
9867 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, staW)
9868 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, endW))
9869 return fail();
9870 if (i < parsedVertices.size()) {
9871 parsedVertices.at(i)->stawidth = staW;
9872 parsedVertices.at(i)->endwidth = endW;
9873 }
9874 }
9875 if (DRW_DBGGLDRW_dbg::getInstance()->getLevel() == DRW_dbg::Level::Debug){
9876 DRW_DBG("\nVertex list: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nVertex list: ");
9877 for (auto& pv: parsedVertices) {
9878 DRW_DBG("\n x: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n x: "); DRW_DBG(pv->x)DRW_dbg::dbg(pv->x); DRW_DBG(" y: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" y: "); DRW_DBG(pv->y)DRW_dbg::dbg(pv->y); DRW_DBG(" bulge: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" bulge: "); DRW_DBG(pv->bulge)DRW_dbg::dbg(pv->bulge);
9879 DRW_DBG(" stawidth: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" stawidth: "); DRW_DBG(pv->stawidth)DRW_dbg::dbg(pv->stawidth); DRW_DBG(" endwidth: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" endwidth: "); DRW_DBG(pv->endwidth)DRW_dbg::dbg(pv->endwidth);
9880 DRW_DBG(" identifier: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" identifier: "); DRW_DBG(pv->identifier)DRW_dbg::dbg(pv->identifier);
9881 }
9882 }
9883
9884 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
9885 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
9886 && std::isfinite(point.z);
9887 };
9888 if (!finite(parsedExtPoint) || !std::isfinite(parsedWidth)
9889 || !std::isfinite(parsedElevation) || !std::isfinite(parsedThickness)
9890 || !std::all_of(parsedVertices.begin(), parsedVertices.end(),
9891 [](const std::shared_ptr<DRW_Vertex2D>& point) {
9892 return point != nullptr
9893 && std::isfinite(point->x)
9894 && std::isfinite(point->y)
9895 && std::isfinite(point->bulge)
9896 && std::isfinite(point->stawidth)
9897 && std::isfinite(point->endwidth);
9898 }))
9899 return fail();
9900
9901 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
9902 /* Common Entity Handle Data */
9903 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
9904 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
9905 handleEndBit))
9906 return fail();
9907 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
9908 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
9909 handleEndBit);
9910 if (!ret || !handleProbe.isGood())
9911 return fail();
9912
9913 // Translate DWG LWPLINE flag bits to DXF group 70 bits.
9914 int dxfFlags = 0;
9915 if (rawFlags & 512)
9916 dxfFlags |= 1;
9917 if (rawFlags & 256)
9918 dxfFlags |= 128;
9919 vertexnum = static_cast<std::int32_t>(parsedVertexCount);
9920 flags = dxfFlags;
9921 width = parsedWidth;
9922 elevation = parsedElevation;
9923 thickness = parsedThickness;
9924 extPoint = parsedExtPoint;
9925 vertlist = std::move(parsedVertices);
9926 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
9927 DRW_DBG("end flags value: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("end flags value: "); DRW_DBG(flags)DRW_dbg::dbg(flags);
9928 /* CRC X --- */
9929 return true;
9930}
9931
9932
9933// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
9934// DRW_MLine — multiline entity (ODA §19.4.78, fixed type 0x2F = 47).
9935// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
9936
9937bool DRW_MLine::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
9938 switch (code) {
9939 case 2:
9940 styleName = reader->getString();
9941 break;
9942 case 340:
9943 styleHandle = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getHandleString());
9944 break;
9945 case 40:
9946 scale = reader->getDouble();
9947 break;
9948 case 70:
9949 {
9950 int value = 0;
9951 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 2, value))
9952 return false;
9953 justification = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value);
9954 }
9955 break;
9956 case 71:
9957 openClosed = reader->getInt32();
9958 break;
9959 case 72:
9960 if (m_dxfVertexCountSeen)
9961 return false;
9962 {
9963 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
9964 if (!isValidCount(count, kMaxDxfVertices))
9965 return false;
9966 numVerts = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(count);
9967 m_dxfVertexCountSeen = true;
9968 }
9969 break;
9970 case 73:
9971 if (m_dxfLineCountSeen)
9972 return false;
9973 {
9974 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
9975 if (!isValidCount(count, kMaxDxfLines))
9976 return false;
9977 numLines = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(count);
9978 m_dxfLineCountSeen = true;
9979 }
9980 break;
9981 case 10:
9982 basePoint.x = reader->getDouble();
9983 break;
9984 case 20:
9985 basePoint.y = reader->getDouble();
9986 break;
9987 case 30:
9988 basePoint.z = reader->getDouble();
9989 break;
9990 case 210:
9991 extPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
9992 break;
9993 case 220:
9994 extPoint.y = reader->getDouble();
9995 break;
9996 case 230:
9997 extPoint.z = reader->getDouble();
9998 break;
9999 // Per-vertex block: code 11 starts a new vertex; 12/13 follow.
10000 case 11:
10001 if (m_currentSegExpected >= 0 || m_currentAreaExpected >= 0)
10002 return false;
10003 ++m_currentVertexIdx;
10004 m_currentElementIdx = 0;
10005 if (m_currentVertexIdx >= kMaxDxfVertices
10006 || (m_dxfVertexCountSeen
10007 && m_currentVertexIdx >= static_cast<int>(numVerts)))
10008 return false;
10009 vertlist.emplace_back();
10010 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].position.x = reader->getDouble();
10011 break;
10012 case 21:
10013 if (m_currentVertexIdx >= 0)
10014 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].position.y = reader->getDouble();
10015 break;
10016 case 31:
10017 if (m_currentVertexIdx >= 0)
10018 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].position.z = reader->getDouble();
10019 break;
10020 case 12:
10021 if (m_currentVertexIdx >= 0)
10022 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].vertexDir.x = reader->getDouble();
10023 break;
10024 case 22:
10025 if (m_currentVertexIdx >= 0)
10026 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].vertexDir.y = reader->getDouble();
10027 break;
10028 case 32:
10029 if (m_currentVertexIdx >= 0)
10030 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].vertexDir.z = reader->getDouble();
10031 break;
10032 case 13:
10033 if (m_currentVertexIdx >= 0)
10034 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].miterDir.x = reader->getDouble();
10035 break;
10036 case 23:
10037 if (m_currentVertexIdx >= 0)
10038 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].miterDir.y = reader->getDouble();
10039 break;
10040 case 33:
10041 if (m_currentVertexIdx >= 0)
10042 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].miterDir.z = reader->getDouble();
10043 break;
10044 // 74 = segment-param count for current element. Sets up the inner
10045 // vector and resets the running param count. 41 reads each param.
10046 // 75 = fill-param count; 42 reads each. After fills are consumed,
10047 // advance to the next element. AutoCAD emits 74/41*/75/42* per element.
10048 case 74:
10049 if (m_currentVertexIdx < 0
10050 || m_currentSegExpected >= 0 || m_currentAreaExpected >= 0)
10051 return false;
10052 {
10053 auto& v = vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx];
10054 if (m_currentElementIdx != static_cast<int>(v.segParms.size())
10055 || m_currentElementIdx >= kMaxDxfLines
10056 || (m_dxfLineCountSeen
10057 && m_currentElementIdx >= static_cast<int>(numLines)))
10058 return false;
10059 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
10060 if (!isValidCount(count, kMaxDxfParameters))
10061 return false;
10062 v.segParms.emplace_back();
10063 v.areaFillParms.emplace_back();
10064 m_currentSegExpected = count;
10065 m_currentSegFillCount = 0;
10066 }
10067 break;
10068 case 41:
10069 if (m_currentVertexIdx < 0 || m_currentSegExpected < 0
10070 || m_currentElementIdx >= static_cast<int>(vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].segParms.size()))
10071 return false;
10072 if (static_cast<std::int32_t>(
10073 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].segParms[m_currentElementIdx].size())
10074 >= m_currentSegExpected)
10075 return false;
10076 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].segParms[m_currentElementIdx]
10077 .push_back(reader->getDouble());
10078 break;
10079 case 75:
10080 if (m_currentVertexIdx < 0 || m_currentSegExpected < 0
10081 || m_currentAreaExpected >= 0
10082 || m_currentElementIdx >= static_cast<int>(vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].segParms.size()))
10083 return false;
10084 if (static_cast<std::int32_t>(
10085 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].segParms[m_currentElementIdx].size())
10086 != m_currentSegExpected)
10087 return false;
10088 m_currentSegExpected = -1;
10089 m_currentSegFillCount = reader->getInt32();
10090 if (!isValidCount(m_currentSegFillCount, kMaxDxfParameters))
10091 return false;
10092 m_currentAreaExpected = m_currentSegFillCount;
10093 if (m_currentAreaExpected == 0) {
10094 m_currentAreaExpected = -1;
10095 ++m_currentElementIdx;
10096 }
10097 break;
10098 case 42:
10099 if (m_currentVertexIdx < 0 || m_currentAreaExpected < 0
10100 || m_currentElementIdx >= static_cast<int>(vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].areaFillParms.size()))
10101 return false;
10102 if (static_cast<std::int32_t>(
10103 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].areaFillParms[m_currentElementIdx].size())
10104 >= m_currentAreaExpected)
10105 return false;
10106 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].areaFillParms[m_currentElementIdx]
10107 .push_back(reader->getDouble());
10108 if (static_cast<std::int32_t>(
10109 vertlist[m_currentVertexIdx].areaFillParms[m_currentElementIdx].size())
10110 == m_currentAreaExpected) {
10111 m_currentAreaExpected = -1;
10112 ++m_currentElementIdx;
10113 }
10114 break;
10115 default:
10116 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
10117 }
10118 return true;
10119}
10120
10121bool DRW_MLine::validateDxf() const {
10122 if (m_currentSegExpected >= 0 || m_currentAreaExpected >= 0)
10123 return false;
10124 if (m_dxfVertexCountSeen && vertlist.size() != numVerts)
10125 return false;
10126 if (!m_dxfLineCountSeen)
10127 return true;
10128 for (const DRW_MLineVertex& vertex : vertlist) {
10129 if (vertex.segParms.size() != numLines
10130 || vertex.areaFillParms.size() != numLines)
10131 return false;
10132 }
10133 return validatePayloadFields();
10134}
10135
10136bool DRW_MLine::validatePayloadFields() const {
10137 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
10138 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
10139 && std::isfinite(point.z);
10140 };
10141 if (!finite(basePoint) || !finite(extPoint) || !std::isfinite(scale)
10142 || openClosed < 0 || openClosed > 0xffff
10143 || numVerts > static_cast<std::uint16_t>(kMaxDxfVertices)
10144 || vertlist.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxDxfVertices)
10145 || vertlist.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(numVerts))
10146 return false;
10147
10148 for (const DRW_MLineVertex& vertex : vertlist) {
10149 if (!finite(vertex.position) || !finite(vertex.vertexDir)
10150 || !finite(vertex.miterDir)
10151 || vertex.segParms.size() != numLines
10152 || vertex.areaFillParms.size() != numLines)
10153 return false;
10154 const auto validParameters = [](const auto& parameterLists) {
10155 return std::all_of(
10156 parameterLists.cbegin(), parameterLists.cend(),
10157 [](const std::vector<double>& values) {
10158 return values.size() <= static_cast<std::size_t>(
10159 DRW_MLine::kMaxDxfParameters)
10160 && std::all_of(values.cbegin(), values.cend(),
10161 [](double value) {
10162 return std::isfinite(value);
10163 });
10164 });
10165 };
10166 if (!validParameters(vertex.segParms)
10167 || !validParameters(vertex.areaFillParms))
10168 return false;
10169 }
10170 return true;
10171}
10172
10173void DRW_MLine::resetDwgState() {
10174 DRW_Entity::reset();
10175 scale = 1.0;
10176 justification = 0;
10177 basePoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
10178 extPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
10179 openClosed = 1;
10180 numLines = 0;
10181 numVerts = 0;
10182 styleName.clear();
10183 styleHandle = 0;
10184 vertlist.clear();
10185 m_currentVertexIdx = -1;
10186 m_currentElementIdx = 0;
10187 m_currentSegFillCount = 0;
10188 m_currentSegExpected = -1;
10189 m_currentAreaExpected = -1;
10190 m_dxfVertexCountSeen = false;
10191 m_dxfLineCountSeen = false;
10192}
10193
10194bool DRW_MLine::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
10195 resetDwgState();
10196 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
10197 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
10198 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
10199 sourceBuf->invalidate();
10200 resetDwgState();
10201 return false;
10202 };
10203 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
10204 return fail();
10205
10206 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
10207 buf = &bodyProbe;
10208
10209 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, buf, bs)) return fail();
10210 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing MLINE *********************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing MLINE *********************\n"
);
10211 // Per ODA §19.4.78 / libreDWG dwg_decode_MLINE:
10212 // BD scale, RC justification, 3BD basePoint, BE extrusion,
10213 // BS open/closed flag, RC num_lines, BS num_verts,
10214 // then per-vertex: 3BD pos, 3BD vdir, 3BD mdir,
10215 // per-line: BS num_segparms × BD parm, BS num_areafillparms × BD parm.
10216 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
10217 double parsedScale = 0.0;
10218 std::uint8_t parsedJustification = 0;
10219 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
10220 DRW_Coord parsedExtPoint;
10221 std::uint16_t parsedOpenClosed = 0;
10222 std::uint8_t parsedNumLines = 0;
10223 std::uint16_t parsedNumVerts = 0;
10224 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedScale)
10225 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedJustification)
10226 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint)
10227 || !readBoundedExtrusion(*buf, bodyEndBit, false, parsedExtPoint)
10228 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedOpenClosed)
10229 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedNumLines)
10230 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedNumVerts))
10231 return fail();
10232 if (!std::isfinite(parsedScale)
10233 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.x)
10234 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.y)
10235 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.z)
10236 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtPoint.x)
10237 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtPoint.y)
10238 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtPoint.z))
10239 return fail();
10240 DRW_DBG(" mline scale: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" mline scale: "); DRW_DBG(parsedScale)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedScale);
10241 DRW_DBG(" just: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" just: "); DRW_DBG(static_cast<int>(parsedJustification))DRW_dbg::dbg(static_cast<int>(parsedJustification));
10242 DRW_DBG(" openClosed: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" openClosed: "); DRW_DBG(parsedOpenClosed)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedOpenClosed);
10243 DRW_DBG(" lines: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" lines: "); DRW_DBG(static_cast<int>(parsedNumLines))DRW_dbg::dbg(static_cast<int>(parsedNumLines));
10244 DRW_DBG(" verts: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" verts: "); DRW_DBG(parsedNumVerts)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedNumVerts); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10245 if (!buf->isGood()
10246 || !isValidCount(static_cast<std::int32_t>(parsedNumVerts), kMaxDxfVertices)
10247 || !isValidCount(static_cast<std::int32_t>(parsedNumLines), kMaxDxfLines))
10248 return fail();
10249
10250 // Each vertex always contains three minimum-width 3BD values and one
10251 // minimum-width BS for each segment/fill parameter count. Check this
10252 // before allocating the per-vertex/per-line vector grid.
10253 const std::uint64_t minimumBitsPerVertex =
10254 18u + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(parsedNumLines) * 4u;
10255 std::uint64_t minimumVertexBits = 0;
10256 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(parsedNumVerts),
10257 minimumBitsPerVertex, minimumVertexBits)
10258 || !proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, minimumVertexBits))
10259 return fail();
10260
10261 // The per-vertex parameter lists are also capped by the DWG spec. Keep a
10262 // combined budget so a valid per-list maximum cannot multiply into an
10263 // unbounded number of vector allocations on hostile input.
10264 constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxDwgParameters = 1000000;
10265 std::uint64_t totalParameters = 0;
10266 std::vector<DRW_MLineVertex> parsedVertices;
10267 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedVertices, parsedNumVerts))
10268 return fail();
10269 for (int vi = 0; vi < parsedNumVerts; ++vi) {
10270 DRW_MLineVertex vtx;
10271 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, vtx.position)
10272 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, vtx.vertexDir)
10273 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, vtx.miterDir))
10274 return fail();
10275 if (!DRW::reserve(vtx.segParms, parsedNumLines)
10276 || !DRW::reserve(vtx.areaFillParms, parsedNumLines))
10277 return fail();
10278 if (!DRW::resize(vtx.segParms, parsedNumLines)
10279 || !DRW::resize(vtx.areaFillParms, parsedNumLines))
10280 return fail();
10281 for (int li = 0; li < parsedNumLines; ++li) {
10282 std::uint16_t nSeg = 0;
10283 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, nSeg)
10284 || !proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit,
10285 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(nSeg) * 2u))
10286 return fail();
10287 if (!buf->isGood()
10288 || !isValidCount(static_cast<std::int32_t>(nSeg),
10289 kMaxDxfParameters)
10290 || totalParameters > kMaxDwgParameters - nSeg)
10291 return fail();
10292 totalParameters += nSeg;
10293 if (!DRW::reserve(vtx.segParms[li], nSeg))
10294 return fail();
10295 for (int s = 0; s < nSeg; ++s) {
10296 double value = 0.0;
10297 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, value)
10298 || !std::isfinite(value))
10299 return fail();
10300 vtx.segParms[li].push_back(value);
10301 }
10302 std::uint16_t nFill = 0;
10303 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, nFill)
10304 || !proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit,
10305 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(nFill) * 2u))
10306 return fail();
10307 if (!buf->isGood()
10308 || !isValidCount(static_cast<std::int32_t>(nFill),
10309 kMaxDxfParameters)
10310 || totalParameters > kMaxDwgParameters - nFill)
10311 return fail();
10312 totalParameters += nFill;
10313 if (!DRW::reserve(vtx.areaFillParms[li], nFill))
10314 return fail();
10315 for (int f = 0; f < nFill; ++f) {
10316 double value = 0.0;
10317 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, value)
10318 || !std::isfinite(value))
10319 return fail();
10320 vtx.areaFillParms[li].push_back(value);
10321 }
10322 }
10323 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
10324 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
10325 && std::isfinite(point.z);
10326 };
10327 if (!finite(vtx.position) || !finite(vtx.vertexDir)
10328 || !finite(vtx.miterDir))
10329 return fail();
10330 parsedVertices.push_back(std::move(vtx));
10331 }
10332 if (!buf->isGood())
10333 return fail();
10334
10335 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
10336 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
10337 handleEndBit))
10338 return fail();
10339 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
10340 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
10341 handleEndBit))
10342 return fail();
10343 // MLINE has one extra handle in the handle stream after the standard
10344 // entity handles: the MLINESTYLE reference. Read if available — some
10345 // older files (R14) store the style name inline instead.
10346 std::uint32_t parsedStyleHandle = 0;
10347 if (version > DRW::AC1014
10348 && proxyEntityHasBits(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 8)) {
10349 dwgHandle styleH;
10350 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, true,
10351 styleH))
10352 return fail();
10353 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
10354 return fail();
10355 parsedStyleHandle = styleH.ref;
10356 DRW_DBG(" MLINE style handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" MLINE style handle: ");
10357 DRW_DBGHL(styleH.code, styleH.size, styleH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(styleH.code, styleH.size, styleH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10358 }
10359 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
10360 return fail();
10361 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
10362 scale = parsedScale;
10363 justification = parsedJustification;
10364 basePoint = parsedBasePoint;
10365 extPoint = parsedExtPoint;
10366 openClosed = parsedOpenClosed;
10367 numLines = parsedNumLines;
10368 numVerts = parsedNumVerts;
10369 styleHandle = parsedStyleHandle;
10370 vertlist = std::move(parsedVertices);
10371 return true;
10372}
10373
10374
10375// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
10376// DRW_Underlay — UNDERLAY entity (PDFUNDERLAY/DGNUNDERLAY/DWFUNDERLAY).
10377// libreDWG UNDERLAYREFERENCE.spec field order:
10378// extrusion (BE) -> position (3BD) -> angle (BD radians) -> scale (BD x 3)
10379// -> flags (RC) -> contrast (RC) -> fade (RC) -> num_clip (BL)
10380// -> clip_verts (2RD × num_clip).
10381// Handle stream after standard entity handles: definition_id (H).
10382// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
10383
10384bool DRW_Underlay::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
10385 switch (code) {
10386 case 340:
10387 definitionHandle = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getHandleString());
10388 break;
10389 case 10: position.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
10390 case 20: position.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
10391 case 30: position.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
10392 case 41: scale.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
10393 case 42: scale.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
10394 case 43: scale.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
10395 case 50: rotation = reader->getDouble(); break; // degrees in DXF
10396 case 210: extPoint.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
10397 case 220: extPoint.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
10398 case 230: extPoint.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
10399 case 280: {
10400 int value = 0;
10401 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 0xFF, value))
10402 return false;
10403 flags = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value);
10404 break;
10405 }
10406 case 281: {
10407 int value = 0;
10408 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 100, value))
10409 return false;
10410 contrast = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value);
10411 break;
10412 }
10413 case 282: {
10414 int value = 0;
10415 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 100, value))
10416 return false;
10417 fade = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value);
10418 break;
10419 }
10420 case 11: {
10421 if (clipBoundary.size() >= kMaxClipVertices)
10422 return false;
10423 ++m_currentClipVertexIdx;
10424 if (m_currentClipVertexIdx >= static_cast<int>(clipBoundary.size())) {
10425 if (!DRW::resize(clipBoundary, m_currentClipVertexIdx + 1))
10426 return false;
10427 }
10428 clipBoundary[m_currentClipVertexIdx].x = reader->getDouble();
10429 break;
10430 }
10431 case 21:
10432 if (m_currentClipVertexIdx >= 0
10433 && m_currentClipVertexIdx < static_cast<int>(clipBoundary.size())) {
10434 clipBoundary[m_currentClipVertexIdx].y = reader->getDouble();
10435 }
10436 break;
10437 case 170: {
10438 const int count = reader->getInt32();
10439 if (!isValidCount(count, static_cast<std::int32_t>(kMaxClipVertices)))
10440 return false;
10441 m_inverseClipVertexCount = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(count);
10442 m_inverseClipCountSeen = true;
10443 if (!DRW::reserve(inverseClipBoundary, count))
10444 return false;
10445 break;
10446 }
10447 case 12: {
10448 if (inverseClipBoundary.size() >= kMaxClipVertices
10449 || (m_inverseClipCountSeen
10450 && inverseClipBoundary.size() >= m_inverseClipVertexCount))
10451 return false;
10452 ++m_currentInverseClipVertexIdx;
10453 if (m_currentInverseClipVertexIdx
10454 >= static_cast<int>(inverseClipBoundary.size())) {
10455 if (!DRW::resize(inverseClipBoundary,
10456 m_currentInverseClipVertexIdx + 1))
10457 return false;
10458 }
10459 inverseClipBoundary[m_currentInverseClipVertexIdx].x = reader->getDouble();
10460 break;
10461 }
10462 case 22:
10463 if (m_currentInverseClipVertexIdx >= 0
10464 && m_currentInverseClipVertexIdx
10465 < static_cast<int>(inverseClipBoundary.size())) {
10466 inverseClipBoundary[m_currentInverseClipVertexIdx].y = reader->getDouble();
10467 }
10468 break;
10469 default:
10470 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
10471 }
10472 return true;
10473}
10474
10475void DRW_Underlay::resetDwgState() {
10476 DRW_Entity::reset();
10477 // Entity carriers can be reused by callers. Clip payloads and their
10478 // parser counters belong to this record, not to the carrier lifetime.
10479 position = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
10480 scale = DRW_Coord{1.0, 1.0, 1.0};
10481 rotation = 0.0;
10482 extPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
10483 flags = 2;
10484 contrast = 100;
10485 fade = 0;
10486 clipBoundary.clear();
10487 inverseClipBoundary.clear();
10488 m_currentClipVertexIdx = -1;
10489 m_currentInverseClipVertexIdx = -1;
10490 m_inverseClipVertexCount = 0;
10491 m_inverseClipCountSeen = false;
10492 definitionHandle = 0;
10493}
10494
10495bool DRW_Underlay::validatePayloadFields() const {
10496 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
10497 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
10498 && std::isfinite(point.z);
10499 };
10500 const auto finiteClipPoint = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
10501 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y);
10502 };
10503 return finite(position) && finite(scale) && finite(extPoint)
10504 && std::isfinite(rotation)
10505 && std::all_of(clipBoundary.cbegin(), clipBoundary.cend(),
10506 finiteClipPoint)
10507 && std::all_of(inverseClipBoundary.cbegin(),
10508 inverseClipBoundary.cend(), finiteClipPoint);
10509}
10510
10511bool DRW_Underlay::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
10512 resetDwgState();
10513 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
10514 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
10515 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
10516 sourceBuf->invalidate();
10517 resetDwgState();
10518 return false;
10519 };
10520 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
10521 return fail();
10522
10523 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
10524 buf = &bodyProbe;
10525
10526 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, buf, bs)) return fail();
10527 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing UNDERLAY ***************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing UNDERLAY ***************\n"
);
10528 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
10529 DRW_Coord parsedExtPoint;
10530 DRW_Coord parsedPosition;
10531 DRW_Coord parsedScale;
10532 double parsedRotation = 0.0;
10533 std::uint8_t parsedFlags = 0;
10534 std::uint8_t parsedContrast = 0;
10535 std::uint8_t parsedFade = 0;
10536 if (!readBoundedExtrusion(*buf, bodyEndBit, false, parsedExtPoint)
10537 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedPosition)
10538 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedRotation)
10539 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedScale.x)
10540 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedScale.y)
10541 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedScale.z)
10542 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedFlags)
10543 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedContrast)
10544 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedFade))
10545 return fail();
10546 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
10547 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
10548 && std::isfinite(point.z);
10549 };
10550 if (!finite(parsedExtPoint) || !finite(parsedPosition)
10551 || !finite(parsedScale) || !std::isfinite(parsedRotation))
10552 return fail();
10553 std::uint32_t nClip = 0;
10554 DRW_DBG(" UNDERLAY pos: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" UNDERLAY pos: "); DRW_DBG(parsedPosition.x)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedPosition.x); DRW_DBG(",")DRW_dbg::dbg(",");
10555 DRW_DBG(parsedPosition.y)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedPosition.y); DRW_DBG(" rot: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" rot: "); DRW_DBG(parsedRotation)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedRotation);
10556 DRW_DBG(" flags: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" flags: "); DRW_DBGH(parsedFlags)DRW_dbg::dbgH(parsedFlags); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10557 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxClipVertices, 128,
10558 nClip)
10559 || !proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit,
10560 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(nClip) * 128u))
10561 return fail();
10562 std::vector<DRW_Coord> parsedClipBoundary;
10563 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedClipBoundary, static_cast<std::size_t>(nClip)))
10564 return fail();
10565 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nClip; ++i) {
10566 DRW_Coord p;
10567 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, p.x)
10568 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, p.y)
10569 || !std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y))
10570 return fail();
10571 p.z = 0.0;
10572 parsedClipBoundary.push_back(p);
10573 }
10574 std::vector<DRW_Coord> parsedInverseClipBoundary;
10575 if (version > DRW::AC1021 && (parsedFlags & 0x10) != 0) {
10576 std::uint16_t nInverse = 0;
10577 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, nInverse)
10578 || nInverse > kMaxClipVertices
10579 || !proxyEntityHasBits(
10580 *buf, bodyEndBit,
10581 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(nInverse) * 128u)
10582 || !DRW::reserve(parsedInverseClipBoundary,
10583 static_cast<std::size_t>(nInverse)))
10584 return fail();
10585 for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < nInverse; ++i) {
10586 DRW_Coord p;
10587 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, p.x)
10588 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, p.y)
10589 || !std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y))
10590 return fail();
10591 p.z = 0.0;
10592 parsedInverseClipBoundary.push_back(p);
10593 }
10594 }
10595 if (!buf->isGood())
10596 return fail();
10597
10598 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
10599 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
10600 handleEndBit))
10601 return fail();
10602 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
10603 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
10604 handleEndBit))
10605 return fail();
10606 std::uint32_t parsedDefinitionHandle = 0;
10607 if (version > DRW::AC1014
10608 && proxyEntityHasBits(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 16)) {
10609 dwgHandle defH;
10610 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, true,
10611 defH))
10612 return fail();
10613 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
10614 return fail();
10615 parsedDefinitionHandle = defH.ref;
10616 DRW_DBG(" UNDERLAY definitionHandle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" UNDERLAY definitionHandle: ");
10617 DRW_DBGHL(defH.code, defH.size, defH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(defH.code, defH.size, defH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10618 }
10619 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
10620 return fail();
10621 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
10622 extPoint = parsedExtPoint;
10623 position = parsedPosition;
10624 rotation = parsedRotation;
10625 scale = parsedScale;
10626 flags = parsedFlags;
10627 contrast = parsedContrast;
10628 fade = parsedFade;
10629 clipBoundary = std::move(parsedClipBoundary);
10630 inverseClipBoundary = std::move(parsedInverseClipBoundary);
10631 definitionHandle = parsedDefinitionHandle;
10632 return true;
10633}
10634
10635bool DRW_Underlay::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
10636 std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf,
10637 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
10638 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
10639 if (!validatePayloadFields()
10640 || clipBoundary.size() > kMaxClipVertices
10641 || inverseClipBoundary.size() > kMaxClipVertices
10642 || (version <= DRW::AC1021 && !inverseClipBoundary.empty()))
10643 return false;
10644
10645 switch (kind) {
10646 case DGN:
10647 oType = kDwgClassNumDgn;
10648 break;
10649 case DWF:
10650 oType = kDwgClassNumDwf;
10651 break;
10652 case PDF:
10653 default:
10654 oType = kDwgClassNumPdf;
10655 break;
10656 }
10657 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf))
10658 return false;
10659
10660 const bool hasInverseClip = !inverseClipBoundary.empty() || (flags & 0x10) != 0;
10661 const std::uint8_t wireFlags =
10662 hasInverseClip ? static_cast<std::uint8_t>(flags | 0x10) : flags;
10663
10664 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, false);
10665 buf->put3BitDouble(position);
10666 buf->putBitDouble(rotation);
10667 buf->putBitDouble(scale.x);
10668 buf->putBitDouble(scale.y);
10669 buf->putBitDouble(scale.z);
10670 buf->putRawChar8(wireFlags);
10671 buf->putRawChar8(contrast);
10672 buf->putRawChar8(fade);
10673 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(clipBoundary.size()));
10674 for (const auto& vertex : clipBoundary) {
10675 buf->putRawDouble(vertex.x);
10676 buf->putRawDouble(vertex.y);
10677 }
10678 if (version > DRW::AC1021 && hasInverseClip) {
10679 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inverseClipBoundary.size()));
10680 for (const auto& vertex : inverseClipBoundary) {
10681 buf->putRawDouble(vertex.x);
10682 buf->putRawDouble(vertex.y);
10683 }
10684 }
10685
10686 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf))
10687 return false;
10688 putNullableHardPointerHandle(handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf, definitionHandle);
10689 return true;
10690}
10691
10692
10693bool DRW_Text::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
10694 switch (code) {
10695 case 40:
10696 height = reader->getDouble();
10697 break;
10698 case 41:
10699 widthscale = reader->getDouble();
10700 break;
10701 case 50:
10702 angle = reader->getDouble();
10703 break;
10704 case 51:
10705 oblique = reader->getDouble();
10706 break;
10707 case 71:
10708 textgen = reader->getInt32();
10709 break;
10710 case 72:
10711 alignH = (HAlign)reader->getInt32();
10712 break;
10713 case 73:
10714 alignV = (VAlign)reader->getInt32();
10715 break;
10716 case 1:
10717 text = reader->getUtf8String();
10718 break;
10719 case 7:
10720 style = reader->getUtf8String();
10721 break;
10722 default:
10723 return DRW_Line::parseCode(code, reader);
10724 }
10725
10726 return true;
10727}

10729void DRW_Text::resetDwgState() {
10730 DRW_Entity::reset();
10731 basePoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
10732 secPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
10733 thickness = 0.0;
10734 extPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
10735 xAxisAngle = 0.0;
10736 height = 0.0;
10737 text.clear();
10738 angle = 0.0;
10739 widthscale = 1.0;
10740 oblique = 0.0;
10741 style = "STANDARD";
10742 textgen = 0;
10743 alignH = HLeft;
10744 alignV = VBaseLine;
10745 styleH = dwgHandle{};
10746}
10747
10748bool DRW_Text::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
10749 resetDwgState();
10750 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
10751 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
10752 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
10753 sourceBuf->invalidate();
10754 resetDwgState();
10755 return false;
10756 };
10757 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
10758 return fail();
10759
10760 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
10761 buf = &bodyProbe;
10762 dwgBuffer sBuff = buf->forkIndependent();
10763 dwgBuffer *sBuf = buf;
10764 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
10765 sBuf = &sBuff; //separate buffer for strings
10766 }
10767 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
10768 if (!ret)
10769 return fail();
10770 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing text *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing text *********************************************\n"
);
10771 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
10772
10773 // DataFlags RC Used to determine presence of subsequent data, set to 0xFF for R14-
10774 std::uint8_t data_flags = 0x00;
10775 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {//2000+
10776 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, data_flags))
10777 return fail(); /* DataFlags RC Used to determine presence of subsequent data */
10778 DRW_DBG("data_flags: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("data_flags: "); DRW_DBG(data_flags)DRW_dbg::dbg(data_flags); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10779 if ( !(data_flags & 0x01) ) { /* Elevation RD --- present if !(DataFlags & 0x01) */
10780 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint.z))
10781 return fail();
10782 }
10783 } else {//14-
10784 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint.z))
10785 return fail(); /* Elevation BD --- */
10786 }
10787 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint.x)
10788 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint.y))
10789 return fail(); /* Insertion pt 2RD 10 */
10790 DRW_DBG("Insert point: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Insert point: "); DRW_DBGPT(basePoint.x, basePoint.y, basePoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(basePoint.x, basePoint.y, basePoint.z); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10791 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {//2000+
10792 if ( !(data_flags & 0x02) ) { /* Alignment pt 2DD 11 present if !(DataFlags & 0x02), use 10 & 20 values for 2 default values.*/
10793 if (!readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint.x,
10794 secPoint.x)
10795 || !readBoundedDefaultDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint.y,
10796 secPoint.y))
10797 return fail();
10798 } else {
10799 secPoint = basePoint;
10800 }
10801 } else {//14-
10802 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, secPoint.x)
10803 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, secPoint.y))
10804 return fail(); /* Alignment pt 2RD 11 */
10805 }
10806 secPoint.z = basePoint.z;
10807 DRW_DBG("Alignment: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Alignment: "); DRW_DBGPT(secPoint.x, secPoint.y, basePoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(secPoint.x, secPoint.y, basePoint.z); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10808 if (!readBoundedExtrusion(*buf, bodyEndBit, version > DRW::AC1014,
10809 extPoint))
10810 return fail();
10811 DRW_DBG("Extrusion: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Extrusion: "); DRW_DBGPT(extPoint.x, extPoint.y, extPoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(extPoint.x, extPoint.y, extPoint.z); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10812 if (!readBoundedThickness(*buf, bodyEndBit, version > DRW::AC1014,
10813 thickness))
10814 return fail(); /* Thickness BD 39 */
10815
10816 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {//2000+
10817 if ( !(data_flags & 0x04) ) { /* Oblique ang RD 51 present if !(DataFlags & 0x04) */
10818 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, oblique))
10819 return fail();
10820 }
10821 if ( !(data_flags & 0x08) ) { /* Rotation ang RD 50 present if !(DataFlags & 0x08) */
10822 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, angle))
10823 return fail();
10824 }
10825 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, height))
10826 return fail(); /* Height RD 40 */
10827 if ( !(data_flags & 0x10) ) { /* Width factor RD 41 present if !(DataFlags & 0x10) */
10828 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, widthscale))
10829 return fail();
10830 }
10831 } else {//14-
10832 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, oblique)
10833 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, angle)
10834 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, height)
10835 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, widthscale))
10836 return fail(); /* Oblique/rotation/height/width BD */
10837 }
10838 angle *= ARAD57.29577951308232;
10839 if (!std::isfinite(basePoint.x) || !std::isfinite(basePoint.y)
10840 || !std::isfinite(basePoint.z) || !std::isfinite(secPoint.x)
10841 || !std::isfinite(secPoint.y) || !std::isfinite(secPoint.z)
10842 || !std::isfinite(extPoint.x) || !std::isfinite(extPoint.y)
10843 || !std::isfinite(extPoint.z) || !std::isfinite(thickness)
10844 || !std::isfinite(oblique) || !std::isfinite(angle)
10845 || !std::isfinite(height) || !std::isfinite(widthscale))
10846 return fail();
10847 DRW_DBG("thickness: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("thickness: "); DRW_DBG(thickness)DRW_dbg::dbg(thickness); DRW_DBG(", Oblique ang: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", Oblique ang: "); DRW_DBG(oblique)DRW_dbg::dbg(oblique); DRW_DBG(", Width: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", Width: ");
10848 DRW_DBG(widthscale)DRW_dbg::dbg(widthscale); DRW_DBG(", Rotation: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", Rotation: "); DRW_DBG(angle)DRW_dbg::dbg(angle); DRW_DBG(", height: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", height: "); DRW_DBG(height)DRW_dbg::dbg(height); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10849 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
10850 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
10851 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
10852 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*sBuf, version, objSize,
10853 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
10854 return fail();
10855 }
10856 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedText;
10857 if (version > DRW::AC1018
10858 && currentDwgBit(sBuf) >= stringEndBit) {
10859 parsedText.clear();
10860 } else if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
10861 parsedText)) {
10862 return fail();
10863 }
10864 DRW_DBG("text string: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("text string: "); DRW_DBG(parsedText.c_str())DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedText.c_str());DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10865 //textgen, alignH, alignV always present in R14-, data_flags set in initialisation
10866 if ( !(data_flags & 0x20) ) { /* Generation BS 71 present if !(DataFlags & 0x20) */
10867 std::uint16_t parsedTextgen = 0;
10868 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedTextgen))
10869 return fail();
10870 textgen = parsedTextgen;
10871 DRW_DBG("textgen: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("textgen: "); DRW_DBG(textgen)DRW_dbg::dbg(textgen);
10872 }
10873 if ( !(data_flags & 0x40) ) { /* Horiz align. BS 72 present if !(DataFlags & 0x40) */
10874 std::uint16_t parsedAlignH = 0;
10875 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAlignH))
10876 return fail();
10877 alignH = static_cast<HAlign>(parsedAlignH);
10878 DRW_DBG(", alignH: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", alignH: "); DRW_DBG(alignH)DRW_dbg::dbg(alignH);
10879 }
10880 if ( !(data_flags & 0x80) ) { /* Vert align. BS 73 present if !(DataFlags & 0x80) */
10881 std::uint16_t parsedAlignV = 0;
10882 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAlignV))
10883 return fail();
10884 alignV = static_cast<VAlign>(parsedAlignV);
10885 DRW_DBG(", alignV: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", alignV: "); DRW_DBG(alignV)DRW_dbg::dbg(alignV);
10886 }
10887 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10888
10889 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
10890 || currentDwgBit(buf) > bodyEndBit
10891 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit)
10892 return fail();
10893
10894 /* Common Entity Handle Data */
10895 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
10896 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
10897 handleEndBit))
10898 return fail();
10899 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
10900 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
10901 handleEndBit);
10902 if (!ret)
10903 return fail();
10904
10905 dwgHandle parsedStyleH;
10906 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
10907 parsedStyleH)
10908 || !handleProbe.isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
10909 return fail();
10910
10911 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
10912 text = std::move(parsedText);
10913 styleH = parsedStyleH;
10914 DRW_DBG("text style Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("text style Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(styleH.code, styleH.size, styleH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(styleH.code, styleH.size, styleH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
10915 /* CRC X --- */
10916 return true;
10917}
