10919// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
10920// RTEXT (RText, Express Tools) — read-only, mapped onto DRW_Text.
10921// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
10922bool DRW_RText::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
10923 // RTEXT's DXF layout is a TEXT subset (1 text, 7 style, 10/20/30 insertion,
10924 // 40 height, 50 rotation deg, 210/220/230 extrusion) plus a flags long (70)
10925 // that plain TEXT does not carry.
10926 if (70 == code) {
10927 m_rTextFlags = reader->getInt32();
10928 return true;
10929 }
10930 return DRW_Text::parseCode(code, reader);
10931}
10932
10933bool DRW_RText::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
10934 resetDwgState();
10935 m_rTextFlags = 0;
10936 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
10937 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
10938 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
10939 sourceBuf->invalidate();
10940 resetDwgState();
10941 m_rTextFlags = 0;
10942 return false;
10943 };
10944 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
10945 return fail();
10946
10947 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
10948 buf = &bodyProbe;
10949 dwgBuffer sBuff = buf->forkIndependent();
10950 dwgBuffer *sBuf = buf;
10951 if (version > DRW::AC1018) // 2007+ strings live in a separate stream
10952 sBuf = &sBuff;
10953 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
10954 if (!ret)
10955 return fail();
10956 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing rtext ********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing rtext ********************************************\n"
);
10957
10958 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
10959 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
10960 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
10961 double parsedAngle = 0.0;
10962 double parsedHeight = 0.0;
10963 std::uint16_t parsedFlags = 0;
10964 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint)
10965 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedExtrusion)
10966 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAngle)
10967 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedHeight)
10968 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedFlags)
10969 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.x)
10970 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.y)
10971 || !std::isfinite(parsedBasePoint.z)
10972 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.x)
10973 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.y)
10974 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.z)
10975 || !std::isfinite(parsedAngle)
10976 || !std::isfinite(parsedHeight))
10977 return fail();
10978 basePoint = parsedBasePoint; // insertion 3BD
10979 secPoint = parsedBasePoint; // no separate alignment point
10980 extPoint = parsedExtrusion; // extrusion 3BD
10981 angle = parsedAngle * ARAD57.29577951308232; // rotation BD (radians) -> degrees
10982 height = parsedHeight; // height BD
10983 m_rTextFlags = parsedFlags; // flags BS
10984 if (!std::isfinite(angle))
10985 return fail();
10986 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
10987 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
10988 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
10989 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*sBuf, version, objSize,
10990 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
10991 return fail();
10992 }
10993 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedText;
10994 if (version > DRW::AC1018
10995 && currentDwgBit(sBuf) >= stringEndBit) {
10996 parsedText.clear();
10997 } else if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
10998 parsedText)) {
10999 return fail();
11000 }
11001 DRW_DBG("rtext string: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("rtext string: "); DRW_DBG(parsedText.c_str())DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedText.c_str()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
11002
11003 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
11004 || currentDwgBit(buf) > bodyEndBit
11005 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit)
11006 return fail();
11007
11008 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
11009 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
11010 handleEndBit))
11011 return fail();
11012 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
11013 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
11014 handleEndBit);
11015 if (!ret)
11016 return fail();
11017 dwgHandle parsedStyleH;
11018 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
11019 parsedStyleH)
11020 || !handleProbe.isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
11021 return fail();
11022
11023 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
11024 text = std::move(parsedText);
11025 styleH = parsedStyleH;
11026 return true;
11027}
11028
11029// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
11030// ARCALIGNEDTEXT (AcDbArcAlignedText, Express Tools) — read-only, mapped onto
11031// DRW_Text as a 2D approximation (text at the arc mid-point, tangent baseline).
11032// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
11033bool DRW_RText::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
11034 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
11035 (void)bs;
11036 oType = kDwgClassNum;
11037 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
11038
11039 buf->put3BitDouble(basePoint);
11040 buf->put3BitDouble(extPoint);
11041 buf->putBitDouble(angle / ARAD57.29577951308232);
11042 buf->putBitDouble(height);
11043 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_rTextFlags));
11044 (strBuf ? strBuf : buf)->putVariableText(version, text);
11045
11046 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
11047 putHardPointerHandle(handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf,
11048 (styleH.ref == 0) ? 0x13 : styleH.ref);
11049 return true;
11050}
11051
11052void DRW_ArcAlignedText::applyArcApproximation(){
11053 const double mid = 0.5 * (m_startAngle + m_endAngle);
11054 basePoint.x = m_center.x + m_radius * std::cos(mid);
11055 basePoint.y = m_center.y + m_radius * std::sin(mid);
11056 basePoint.z = m_center.z;
11057 secPoint = basePoint;
11058 // Baseline tangent to the arc at the mid-point; angle stored in degrees to
11059 // match DRW_Text (which the DWG path fills via `angle *= ARAD`).
11060 angle = (mid + M_PI_21.57079632679489661923) * ARAD57.29577951308232;
11061 // Height from the text-size D2T string when parseable, else a fraction of
11062 // the radius so the approximation is at least visible.
11063 double h = 0.0;
11064 try { h = std::stod(m_textSize); } catch (...) { h = 0.0; }
11065 if (h > 0.0)
11066 height = h;
11067 else if (height <= 0.0)
11068 height = 0.1 * m_radius;
11069}
11070
11071// Format a D2T (double-to-text) field the way the ARCALIGNEDTEXT model stores
11072// it: the DWG body carries these as text ("2.5", "1", "0"), while the DXF path
11073// reads them as doubles (group codes 41-46 fall in the double range, so the
11074// reader populates doubleData and leaves strData stale — getString() is unsafe
11075// here). %g reproduces the same compact textual form.
11076static std::string arcAlignedD2T(double v){
11077 char buf[32];
11078 std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%g", v);
11079 return std::string(buf);
11080}
11081
11082static std::string arcAlignedStringOrDefault(const UTF8STRINGstd::string& value,
11083 const std::string& fallback) {
11084 return value.empty() ? fallback : value;
11085}
11086
11087bool DRW_ArcAlignedText::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
11088 std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf,
11089 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
11090 (void)bs;
11091 oType = kDwgClassNum;
11092 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
11093
11094 dwgBufferW *sb = strBuf ? strBuf : buf;
11095 sb->putVariableText(version, arcAlignedStringOrDefault(
11096 m_textSize, arcAlignedD2T(height > 0.0 ? height : 0.0)));
11097 sb->putVariableText(version, arcAlignedStringOrDefault(
11098 m_xScale, arcAlignedD2T(widthscale > 0.0 ? widthscale : 1.0)));
11099 sb->putVariableText(version, arcAlignedStringOrDefault(m_charSpacing, "1"));
11100 sb->putVariableText(version, style.empty() ? "Standard" : style);
11101 sb->putVariableText(version, m_fontName);
11102 sb->putVariableText(version, m_bigFontName);
11103 sb->putVariableText(version, text);
11104 sb->putVariableText(version, arcAlignedStringOrDefault(m_offsetFromArc, "0"));
11105 sb->putVariableText(version, arcAlignedStringOrDefault(m_rightOffset, "0"));
11106 sb->putVariableText(version, arcAlignedStringOrDefault(m_leftOffset, "0"));
11107
11108 buf->put3BitDouble(m_center);
11109 buf->putBitDouble(m_radius);
11110 buf->putBitDouble(m_startAngle);
11111 buf->putBitDouble(m_endAngle);
11112 buf->put3BitDouble(extPoint);
11113 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(m_rawColor));
11114 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_characterSet));
11115 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_pitchAndFamily));
11116 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_isShx));
11117 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_isBold));
11118 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_isItalic));
11119 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_isUnderlined));
11120 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_alignment));
11121 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_isReverse));
11122 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_wizardFlag));
11123 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_textPosition));
11124 buf->putBitShort(bitShortFromInt(m_textDirection));
11125
11126 if (version <= DRW::AC1018)
11127 putNullableHardPointerHandle(buf, m_arcHandle);
11128 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
11129 if (version > DRW::AC1018)
11130 putNullableHardPointerHandle(handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf, m_arcHandle);
11131 return true;
11132}
11133
11134bool DRW_ArcAlignedText::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
11135 // ARCALIGNEDTEXT repurposes several TEXT codes (2/10/40/41/50/51/70…), so it
11136 // must not delegate those to DRW_Text; unknown codes fall through to the
11137 // AcDbEntity common parser. Angles (50/51) are DXF degrees -> radians.
11138 switch (code) {
11139 case 1: text = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
11140 case 2: m_fontName = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
11141 case 3: m_bigFontName = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
11142 case 7: style = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
11143 case 10: m_center.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
11144 case 20: m_center.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
11145 case 30: m_center.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
11146 case 40: m_radius = reader->getDouble(); break;
11147 case 41: m_xScale = arcAlignedD2T(reader->getDouble()); break;
11148 case 42: m_textSize = arcAlignedD2T(reader->getDouble()); break;
11149 case 43: m_charSpacing = arcAlignedD2T(reader->getDouble()); break;
11150 case 44: m_offsetFromArc = arcAlignedD2T(reader->getDouble()); break;
11151 case 45: m_rightOffset = arcAlignedD2T(reader->getDouble()); break;
11152 case 46: m_leftOffset = arcAlignedD2T(reader->getDouble()); break;
11153 case 50: m_startAngle = reader->getDouble() / ARAD57.29577951308232; break;
11154 case 51: m_endAngle = reader->getDouble() / ARAD57.29577951308232; break;
11155 case 70: m_isReverse = reader->getInt32(); break;
11156 case 71: m_textDirection = reader->getInt32(); break;
11157 case 72: m_alignment = reader->getInt32(); break;
11158 case 73: m_textPosition = reader->getInt32(); break;
11159 case 74: m_isBold = reader->getInt32(); break;
11160 case 75: m_isItalic = reader->getInt32(); break;
11161 case 76: m_isUnderlined = reader->getInt32(); break;
11162 case 77: m_characterSet = reader->getInt32(); break;
11163 case 78: m_pitchAndFamily = reader->getInt32(); break;
11164 case 79: m_isShx = reader->getInt32(); break;
11165 case 90: m_rawColor = reader->getInt32(); break;
11166 case 210: extPoint.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
11167 case 220: extPoint.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
11168 case 230: extPoint.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
11169 case 280: m_wizardFlag = reader->getInt32(); break;
11170 default: return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
11171 }
11172 return true;
11173}

11204bool DRW_ArcAlignedText::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
11205 // The arc reference is an optional trailer whose position depends on the
11206 // DWG version. Never carry it across a reused or truncated record.
11207 resetDwgState();
11208 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
11209 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
11210 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
11211 sourceBuf->invalidate();
11212 resetDwgState();
11213 return false;
11214 };
11215 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
11216 return fail();
11217
11218 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
11219 buf = &bodyProbe;
11220
11221 dwgBuffer sBuff = buf->forkIndependent();
11222 dwgBuffer *sBuf = buf;
11223 if (version > DRW::AC1018) // 2007+ strings live in a separate stream
11224 sBuf = &sBuff;
11225 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
11226 if (!ret)
11227 return fail();
11228 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing arcalignedtext **********************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing arcalignedtext **********************************\n"
);
11229
11230 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
11231 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
11232 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
11233 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
11234 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*sBuf, version, objSize,
11235 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
11236 return fail();
11237 }
11238
11239 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedTextSize;
11240 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedXScale;
11241 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedCharSpacing;
11242 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedStyle;
11243 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedFontName;
11244 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedBigFontName;
11245 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedText;
11246 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedOffsetFromArc;
11247 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedRightOffset;
11248 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedLeftOffset;
11249 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11250 parsedTextSize)
11251 || !readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11252 parsedXScale)
11253 || !readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11254 parsedCharSpacing)
11255 || !readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11256 parsedStyle)
11257 || !readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11258 parsedFontName)
11259 || !readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11260 parsedBigFontName)
11261 || !readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11262 parsedText)
11263 || !readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11264 parsedOffsetFromArc)
11265 || !readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11266 parsedRightOffset)
11267 || !readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
11268 parsedLeftOffset))
11269 return fail();
11270
11271 DRW_Coord parsedCenter;
11272 double parsedRadius = 0.0;
11273 double parsedStartAngle = 0.0;
11274 double parsedEndAngle = 0.0;
11275 DRW_Coord parsedExtPoint;
11276 std::int32_t parsedRawColor = 0;
11277 std::uint16_t parsedCharacterSet = 0;
11278 std::uint16_t parsedPitchAndFamily = 0;
11279 std::uint16_t parsedIsShx = 0;
11280 std::uint16_t parsedIsBold = 0;
11281 std::uint16_t parsedIsItalic = 0;
11282 std::uint16_t parsedIsUnderlined = 0;
11283 std::uint16_t parsedAlignment = 0;
11284 std::uint16_t parsedIsReverse = 0;
11285 std::uint16_t parsedWizardFlag = 0;
11286 std::uint16_t parsedTextPosition = 0;
11287 std::uint16_t parsedTextDirection = 0;
11288 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedCenter)
11289 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedRadius)
11290 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedStartAngle)
11291 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedEndAngle)
11292 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedExtPoint)
11293 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedRawColor)
11294 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedCharacterSet)
11295 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedPitchAndFamily)
11296 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedIsShx)
11297 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedIsBold)
11298 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedIsItalic)
11299 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedIsUnderlined)
11300 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAlignment)
11301 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedIsReverse)
11302 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedWizardFlag)
11303 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedTextPosition)
11304 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedTextDirection))
11305 return fail();
11306 DRW_DBG("arcalignedtext string: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("arcalignedtext string: "); DRW_DBG(parsedText.c_str())DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedText.c_str());
11307 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
11308
11309 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
11310 || currentDwgBit(buf) > bodyEndBit
11311 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit
11312 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.x) || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.y)
11313 || !std::isfinite(parsedCenter.z) || !std::isfinite(parsedRadius)
11314 || parsedRadius < 0.0 || !std::isfinite(parsedStartAngle)
11315 || !std::isfinite(parsedEndAngle) || !std::isfinite(parsedExtPoint.x)
11316 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtPoint.y)
11317 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtPoint.z))
11318 return fail();
11319
11320 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
11321 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
11322 handleEndBit))
11323 return fail();
11324 // R2004- keeps the arc handle before the common handle stream; R2007+ after.
11325 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
11326 std::uint32_t parsedArcHandle = 0;
11327 if (version <= DRW::AC1018
11328 && proxyEntityHasBits(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 8)) {
11329 dwgHandle arcHandle;
11330 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
11331 arcHandle))
11332 return fail();
11333 parsedArcHandle = arcHandle.ref;
11334 }
11335
11336 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
11337 handleEndBit);
11338 if (!ret)
11339 return fail();
11340 if (version > DRW::AC1018
11341 && proxyEntityHasBits(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 8)) {
11342 dwgHandle arcHandle;
11343 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
11344 arcHandle))
11345 return fail();
11346 parsedArcHandle = arcHandle.ref;
11347 }
11348 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
11349 return fail();
11350
11351 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
11352 m_textSize = std::move(parsedTextSize);
11353 m_xScale = std::move(parsedXScale);
11354 m_charSpacing = std::move(parsedCharSpacing);
11355 style = std::move(parsedStyle);
11356 m_fontName = std::move(parsedFontName);
11357 m_bigFontName = std::move(parsedBigFontName);
11358 text = std::move(parsedText);
11359 m_offsetFromArc = std::move(parsedOffsetFromArc);
11360 m_rightOffset = std::move(parsedRightOffset);
11361 m_leftOffset = std::move(parsedLeftOffset);
11362 m_center = parsedCenter;
11363 m_radius = parsedRadius;
11364 m_startAngle = parsedStartAngle;
11365 m_endAngle = parsedEndAngle;
11366 extPoint = parsedExtPoint;
11367 m_rawColor = parsedRawColor;
11368 m_characterSet = parsedCharacterSet;
11369 m_pitchAndFamily = parsedPitchAndFamily;
11370 m_isShx = parsedIsShx;
11371 m_isBold = parsedIsBold;
11372 m_isItalic = parsedIsItalic;
11373 m_isUnderlined = parsedIsUnderlined;
11374 m_alignment = parsedAlignment;
11375 m_isReverse = parsedIsReverse;
11376 m_wizardFlag = parsedWizardFlag;
11377 m_textPosition = parsedTextPosition;
11378 m_textDirection = parsedTextDirection;
11379 m_arcHandle = parsedArcHandle;
11380 applyArcApproximation();
11381 return true;
11382}

11445namespace {
11446static bool parseEmbeddedMTextEntityMode(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
11447 std::uint64_t bodyEndBit,
11448 EmbeddedMTextHandleInfo& info,
11449 DRW_MText& mtext) {
11450 std::uint8_t entmode = 0;
11451 if (!readBounded2Bits(*buf, bodyEndBit, entmode))
11452 return false;
11453 info.m_ownerHandle = entmode == 0;
11454 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, info.m_numReactors)
11455 || !dwgSafety::validReactorCount(info.m_numReactors))
11456 return false;
11457 if (version > DRW::AC1015) {
11458 bool xDictFlag = false;
11459 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, xDictFlag))
11460 return false;
11461 info.m_xDictFlag = xDictFlag ? 1 : 0;
11462 }
11463 if (version > DRW::AC1024) {
11464 bool hasDataStorage = false;
11465 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, hasDataStorage))
11466 return false;
11467 mtext.setHasDataStorageBinaryData(hasDataStorage);
11468 } else if (version < DRW::AC1018) {
11469 bool noLinks = false;
11470 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, noLinks))
11471 return false; // nolinks / have-next-links
11472 }
11473 std::uint32_t color = 0;
11474 if (!readBoundedEnColor(*buf, bodyEndBit, version, color))
11475 return false;
11476 mtext.color = static_cast<int>(color);
11477 info.m_hasAcDbColorHandle = buf->lastEnColorHadDbColorRef;
11478 mtext.color24 = buf->lastEnColorRgb;
11479 if (!buf->lastEnColorName.empty()) {
11480 mtext.colorName = buf->lastEnColorBookName.empty()
11481 ? buf->lastEnColorName
11482 : (buf->lastEnColorBookName + "$" + buf->lastEnColorName);
11483 }
11484 if (buf->lastEnColorAlphaRaw != 0)
11485 mtext.transparency = static_cast<int>(buf->lastEnColorAlphaRaw);
11486 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, mtext.ltypeScale))
11487 return false;
11488 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {
11489 std::uint8_t ltFlags = 0;
11490 std::uint8_t plotFlags = 0;
11491 if (!readBounded2Bits(*buf, bodyEndBit, ltFlags)
11492 || !readBounded2Bits(*buf, bodyEndBit, plotFlags))
11493 return false;
11494 info.m_ltFlags = ltFlags;
11495 info.m_plotFlags = plotFlags;
11496 switch (info.m_ltFlags) {
11497 case 0:
11498 mtext.lineType = "BYLAYER";
11499 break;
11500 case 1:
11501 mtext.lineType = "BYBLOCK";
11502 break;
11503 case 2:
11504 mtext.lineType = "CONTINUOUS";
11505 break;
11506 default:
11507 mtext.lineType.clear();
11508 break;
11509 }
11510 }
11511 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
11512 std::uint8_t materialFlag = 0;
11513 std::uint8_t shadowFlag = 0;
11514 if (!readBounded2Bits(*buf, bodyEndBit, materialFlag)
11515 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, shadowFlag))
11516 return false;
11517 info.m_materialFlag = materialFlag;
11518 info.m_shadowFlag = shadowFlag;
11519 mtext.shadow = static_cast<DRW::ShadowMode>(info.m_shadowFlag & 0x3);
11520 }
11521 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
11522 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, info.m_hasFullVisualStyle)
11523 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, info.m_hasFaceVisualStyle)
11524 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, info.m_hasEdgeVisualStyle))
11525 return false;
11526 }
11527 std::uint16_t invisibleFlag = 0;
11528 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, invisibleFlag))
11529 return false;
11530 mtext.visible = (invisibleFlag & 1) == 0;
11531 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {
11532 std::uint8_t lineWeight = 0;
11533 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, lineWeight))
11534 return false;
11535 mtext.lWeight = DRW_LW_Conv::dwgInt2lineWidth(lineWeight);
11536 }
11537 return buf->isGood() && currentDwgBit(buf) <= bodyEndBit;
11538}
11539
11540static bool parseEmbeddedMTextDwgFields(
11541 DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, dwgBuffer *sBuf,
11542 DRW_MText& mtext, EmbeddedMTextHandleInfo& info,
11543 std::uint64_t bodyEndBit, std::uint64_t stringEndBit) {
11544 if (!parseEmbeddedMTextEntityMode(version, buf, bodyEndBit, info, mtext))
11545 return false;
11546
11547 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, mtext.basePoint)
11548 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, mtext.extPoint)
11549 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, mtext.secPoint))
11550 return false;
11551 mtext.angle = atan2(mtext.secPoint.y, mtext.secPoint.x) * ARAD57.29577951308232;
11552 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, mtext.widthscale))
11553 return false;
11554 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
11555 double ignoredRectangleHeight = 0.0;
11556 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
11557 ignoredRectangleHeight))
11558 return false;
11559 }
11560 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, mtext.height))
11561 return false;
11562 std::uint16_t textgen = 0;
11563 std::uint16_t alignH = 0;
11564 double ignoredExtentsHeight = 0.0;
11565 double ignoredExtentsWidth = 0.0;
11566 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, textgen)
11567 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, alignH)
11568 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredExtentsHeight)
11569 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredExtentsWidth))
11570 return false;
11571 mtext.textgen = textgen;
11572 mtext.alignH = static_cast<DRW_Text::HAlign>(alignH);
11573 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version, mtext.text))
11574 return false;
11575
11576 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {
11577 std::uint16_t ignoredLineSpacingStyle = 0;
11578 bool ignoredLineSpacingUnknown = false;
11579 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit,
11580 ignoredLineSpacingStyle)
11581 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, mtext.interlin)
11582 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit,
11583 ignoredLineSpacingUnknown))
11584 return false;
11585 }
11586 if (version > DRW::AC1015) {
11587 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, mtext.m_backgroundFlags))
11588 return false;
11589 if ((mtext.m_backgroundFlags & 0x01)
11590 || (version >= DRW::AC1032 && (mtext.m_backgroundFlags & 0x10))) {
11591 std::uint32_t backgroundColor = 0;
11592 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
11593 mtext.m_backgroundScale)
11594 || !readBoundedCmColor(*buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version,
11595 backgroundColor, nullptr, nullptr,
11596 nullptr, nullptr, stringEndBit)
11597 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit,
11598 mtext.m_backgroundTransparency))
11599 return false;
11600 mtext.m_backgroundColor = static_cast<int>(backgroundColor);
11601 }
11602 }
11603
11604 if (version >= DRW::AC1032) {
11605 mtext.m_r2018ColumnHeights.clear();
11606 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit,
11607 mtext.m_r2018IsNotAnnotative)
11608 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit,
11609 mtext.m_r2018ReallyLocked))
11610 return false;
11611 info.m_hasR2018AppIdHandle = mtext.m_r2018IsNotAnnotative;
11612 }
11613
11614 std::uint16_t annotativeSize = 0;
11615 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, annotativeSize))
11616 return false;
11617 if (annotativeSize > 0) {
11618 std::vector<std::uint8_t> annotativeData;
11619 if (!DRW::reserve(annotativeData, annotativeSize))
11620 return false;
11621 for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < annotativeSize; ++i) {
11622 std::uint8_t value = 0;
11623 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, value))
11624 return false;
11625 annotativeData.push_back(value);
11626 }
11627 mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeData = std::move(annotativeData);
11628 info.m_hasAnnotativeAppHandle = true;
11629 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit,
11630 mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeUnknown))
11631 return false;
11632 }
11633 return buf->isGood() && sBuf->isGood()
11634 && currentDwgBit(buf) <= bodyEndBit
11635 && currentDwgBit(sBuf) <= stringEndBit;
11636}
11637
11638static bool parseEmbeddedMTextDwg(
11639 DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, dwgBuffer *sBuf,
11640 DRW_MText& mtext, EmbeddedMTextHandleInfo& info,
11641 std::uint64_t bodyEndBit, std::uint64_t stringEndBit) {
11642 if (buf == nullptr || sBuf == nullptr || !buf->isGood()
11643 || !sBuf->isGood())
11644 return false;
11645
11646 const std::uint64_t bodyStartBit = currentDwgBit(buf);
11647 const std::uint64_t stringStartBit = currentDwgBit(sBuf);
11648 const auto totalBits = [](const dwgBuffer& buffer) {
11649 std::uint64_t bits = 0;
11650 return dwgSafety::multiply(buffer.size(), 8, bits) ? bits : 0;
11651 };
11652 if (bodyEndBit == std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max())
11653 bodyEndBit = totalBits(*buf);
11654 if (stringEndBit == std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max())
11655 stringEndBit = totalBits(*sBuf);
11656 if (bodyStartBit > bodyEndBit || stringStartBit > stringEndBit)
11657 return false;
11658
11659 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
11660 std::unique_ptr<dwgBuffer> separateStringProbe;
11661 dwgBuffer *stringProbe = &bodyProbe;
11662 if (sBuf != buf) {
11663 separateStringProbe = std::make_unique<dwgBuffer>(
11664 sBuf->forkIndependent());
11665 stringProbe = separateStringProbe.get();
11666 }
11667 if (!parseEmbeddedMTextDwgFields(version, &bodyProbe, stringProbe,
11668 mtext, info, bodyEndBit,
11669 stringEndBit))
11670 return false;
11671
11672 const std::uint64_t bodyConsumed = currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe);
11673 const std::uint64_t stringConsumed = currentDwgBit(stringProbe);
11674 if (bodyConsumed < bodyStartBit || stringConsumed < stringStartBit
11675 || bodyConsumed > bodyEndBit || stringConsumed > stringEndBit)
11676 return false;
11677
11678 const auto seekBits = [](dwgBuffer& buffer, std::uint64_t bit) {
11679 if (!buffer.setPosition(bit >> 3))
11680 return false;
11681 buffer.setBitPos(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bit & 7u));
11682 return buffer.isGood() && currentDwgBit(&buffer) == bit;
11683 };
11684 if (!seekBits(*buf, bodyConsumed))
11685 return false;
11686 if (sBuf != buf && !seekBits(*sBuf, stringConsumed))
11687 return false;
11688 return true;
11689}
11690
11691static bool consumeEmbeddedMTextHandles(
11692 DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
11693 const EmbeddedMTextHandleInfo& info, DRW_MText *mtext,
11694 std::uint64_t handleEndBit) {
11695 if (buf == nullptr || !buf->isGood())
11696 return false;
11697
11698 if (handleEndBit == std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max()) {
11699 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(buf->size(), 8, handleEndBit))
11700 return false;
11701 }
11702 dwgBuffer probe = buf->forkIndependent();
11703 auto readHandle = [&](bool offset, dwgHandle& value) {
11704 return readBoundedDwgHandle(probe, handleEndBit, 0, offset, value);
11705 };
11706
11707 dwgHandle owner;
11708 if (info.m_ownerHandle && !readHandle(false, owner))
11709 return false;
11710
11711 std::vector<std::uint32_t> reactors;
11712 if (info.m_numReactors < 0
11713 || !dwgSafety::validReactorCount(info.m_numReactors))
11714 return false;
11715 if (!DRW::reserve(reactors, info.m_numReactors))
11716 return false;
11717 for (int i = 0; i < info.m_numReactors; ++i) {
11718 dwgHandle reactor;
11719 if (!readHandle(false, reactor))
11720 return false;
11721 if (reactor.ref != 0)
11722 reactors.push_back(reactor.ref);
11723 }
11724
11725 dwgHandle xDict;
11726 const bool hasXDict = version <= DRW::AC1015 || info.m_xDictFlag != 1;
11727 if (hasXDict && !readHandle(false, xDict))
11728 return false;
11729
11730 dwgHandle color;
11731 if (info.m_hasAcDbColorHandle && !readHandle(false, color))
11732 return false;
11733
11734 dwgHandle layer;
11735 const bool hasLayer = version > DRW::AC1014;
11736 if (hasLayer && !readHandle(false, layer))
11737 return false;
11738
11739 dwgHandle lineType;
11740 const bool hasLineType = version > DRW::AC1014 && info.m_ltFlags == 3;
11741 if (hasLineType && !readHandle(false, lineType))
11742 return false;
11743
11744 dwgHandle material;
11745 const bool hasMaterial = version > DRW::AC1018 && info.m_materialFlag == 3;
11746 if (hasMaterial && !readHandle(false, material))
11747 return false;
11748
11749 dwgHandle shadow;
11750 const bool hasShadow = version > DRW::AC1018 && info.m_shadowFlag == 3;
11751 if (hasShadow && !readHandle(false, shadow))
11752 return false;
11753
11754 dwgHandle plotStyle;
11755 const bool hasPlotStyle = info.m_plotFlags == 3;
11756 if (hasPlotStyle && !readHandle(false, plotStyle))
11757 return false;
11758
11759 dwgHandle fullVisualStyle;
11760 const bool hasFullVisualStyle = version > DRW::AC1021
11761 && info.m_hasFullVisualStyle;
11762 if (hasFullVisualStyle && !readHandle(false, fullVisualStyle))
11763 return false;
11764
11765 dwgHandle faceVisualStyle;
11766 const bool hasFaceVisualStyle = version > DRW::AC1021
11767 && info.m_hasFaceVisualStyle;
11768 if (hasFaceVisualStyle && !readHandle(false, faceVisualStyle))
11769 return false;
11770
11771 dwgHandle edgeVisualStyle;
11772 const bool hasEdgeVisualStyle = version > DRW::AC1021
11773 && info.m_hasEdgeVisualStyle;
11774 if (hasEdgeVisualStyle && !readHandle(false, edgeVisualStyle))
11775 return false;
11776
11777 dwgHandle style;
11778 if (info.m_hasStyleHandle && !readHandle(false, style))
11779 return false;
11780
11781 dwgHandle appId;
11782 if (info.m_hasR2018AppIdHandle && !readHandle(false, appId))
11783 return false;
11784
11785 dwgHandle annotativeApp;
11786 if (info.m_hasAnnotativeAppHandle && !readHandle(false, annotativeApp))
11787 return false;
11788
11789 if (mtext != nullptr) {
11790 if (info.m_ownerHandle)
11791 mtext->parentHandle = owner.ref;
11792 mtext->reactorHandles = std::move(reactors);
11793 if (hasXDict)
11794 mtext->xDictHandle = xDict.ref;
11795 if (info.m_hasAcDbColorHandle)
11796 mtext->setDwgAcDbColorHandle(true, color.ref);
11797 if (hasLayer)
11798 mtext->setDwgLayerHandle(layer.ref);
11799 if (hasLineType)
11800 mtext->setDwgLinetypeHandle(lineType.ref);
11801 if (hasMaterial)
11802 mtext->material = material.ref;
11803 if (hasShadow)
11804 mtext->shadowHandle = shadow.ref;
11805 if (hasPlotStyle)
11806 mtext->plotStyle = static_cast<int>(plotStyle.ref);
11807 if (hasFullVisualStyle)
11808 mtext->fullVisualStyleHandle = fullVisualStyle.ref;
11809 if (hasFaceVisualStyle)
11810 mtext->faceVisualStyleHandle = faceVisualStyle.ref;
11811 if (hasEdgeVisualStyle)
11812 mtext->edgeVisualStyleHandle = edgeVisualStyle.ref;
11813 if (info.m_hasStyleHandle)
11814 mtext->styleH = style;
11815 if (info.m_hasR2018AppIdHandle)
11816 mtext->m_r2018AppIdHandle = appId.ref;
11817 if (info.m_hasAnnotativeAppHandle)
11818 mtext->m_r2018AnnotativeAppHandle = annotativeApp.ref;
11819 }
11820 *buf = probe;
11821 return true;
11822}
11823
11824static bool encodeEmbeddedMTextEntityMode(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
11825 const DRW_MText& mtext) {
11826 if (version < DRW::AC1032)
11827 return false;
11828
11829 // Embedded MTEXT begins at AcDbEntity mode, not with an object type,
11830 // object size, own handle, EED, or graphics data.
11831 if (mtext.reactorHandles.size()
11832 > static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()))
11833 return false;
11834 buf->put2Bits(mtext.parentHandle == DRW::NoHandle ? 2 : 0);
11835 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(mtext.reactorHandles.size()));
11836 buf->putBit(mtext.xDictHandle == 0 ? 1 : 0);
11837 buf->putBit(mtext.hasDataStorageBinaryData() ? 1 : 0);
11838 UTF8STRINGstd::string colorName = mtext.colorName;
11839 UTF8STRINGstd::string bookName;
11840 const std::string::size_type separator = colorName.find('$');
11841 if (separator != std::string::npos) {
11842 bookName = colorName.substr(0, separator);
11843 colorName.erase(0, separator + 1);
11844 }
11845 buf->putEnColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(mtext.color),
11846 mtext.color24, colorName, bookName,
11847 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mtext.transparency),
11848 mtext.hasDwgAcDbColorHandle());
11849 buf->putBitDouble(mtext.ltypeScale);
11850 std::uint8_t ltFlags = 0;
11851 if (mtext.dwgLinetypeHandle() != 0 || mtext.lineType.empty())
11852 ltFlags = 3;
11853 else if (mtext.lineType == "BYBLOCK")
11854 ltFlags = 1;
11855 else if (mtext.lineType == "CONTINUOUS")
11856 ltFlags = 2;
11857 buf->put2Bits(ltFlags);
11858 buf->put2Bits(mtext.plotStyle == DRW::DefaultPlotStyle ? 0 : 3);
11859 buf->put2Bits(mtext.material == DRW::MaterialByLayer ? 0 : 3);
11860 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(mtext.shadow));
11861 buf->putBit(mtext.fullVisualStyleHandle != 0);
11862 buf->putBit(mtext.faceVisualStyleHandle != 0);
11863 buf->putBit(mtext.edgeVisualStyleHandle != 0);
11864 buf->putBitShort(mtext.visible ? 0 : 1);
11865 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(mtext.lWeight));
11866 return true;
11867}
11868
11869static bool encodeEmbeddedMTextDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
11870 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf,
11871 const DRW_MText& mtext) {
11872 if (!encodeEmbeddedMTextEntityMode(version, buf, mtext))
11873 return false;
11874
11875 buf->put3BitDouble(mtext.basePoint);
11876 buf->put3BitDouble(mtext.extPoint);
11877 buf->put3BitDouble(mtext.secPoint);
11878 buf->putBitDouble(mtext.widthscale);
11879 buf->putBitDouble(mtext.m_r2018RectHeight);
11880 buf->putBitDouble(mtext.height);
11881 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(mtext.textgen));
11882 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(mtext.alignH));
11883 buf->putBitDouble(mtext.m_r2018ExtentsHeight);
11884 buf->putBitDouble(mtext.m_r2018ExtentsWidth);
11885 (strBuf ? strBuf : buf)->putVariableText(version, mtext.text);
11886
11887 buf->putBitShort(0); // linespacing style
11888 buf->putBitDouble(mtext.interlin);
11889 buf->putBit(0);
11890 buf->putBitLong(mtext.m_backgroundFlags);
11891 if ((mtext.m_backgroundFlags & 0x01)
11892 || (mtext.m_backgroundFlags & 0x10)) {
11893 buf->putBitDouble(mtext.m_backgroundScale); // BitDouble, not BitLong
11894 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(mtext.m_backgroundColor));
11895 buf->putBitLong(mtext.m_backgroundTransparency);
11896 }
11897
11898 buf->putBit(mtext.m_r2018IsNotAnnotative ? 1 : 0);
11899 buf->putBit(mtext.m_r2018ReallyLocked ? 1 : 0);
11900
11901 if (mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeData.size() > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
11902 return false;
11903 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeData.size()));
11904 for (std::uint8_t byte : mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeData)
11905 buf->putRawChar8(byte);
11906 if (!mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeData.empty()) {
11907 buf->putBitShort(mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeUnknown);
11908 }
11909
11910 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
11911 if (mtext.parentHandle != DRW::NoHandle)
11912 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.parentHandle);
11913 for (const std::uint32_t reactor : mtext.reactorHandles)
11914 putHardPointerHandle(hb, reactor);
11915 if (mtext.xDictHandle != 0)
11916 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.xDictHandle);
11917 if (mtext.hasDwgAcDbColorHandle())
11918 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.dwgAcDbColorHandle());
11919 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.dwgLayerHandle() == 0
11920 ? 0x12 : mtext.dwgLayerHandle());
11921 if (mtext.dwgLinetypeHandle() != 0 || mtext.lineType.empty())
11922 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.dwgLinetypeHandle());
11923 if (mtext.material != DRW::MaterialByLayer)
11924 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.material);
11925 if (mtext.shadow == DRW::IgnoreShadows)
11926 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.shadowHandle);
11927 if (mtext.plotStyle != DRW::DefaultPlotStyle)
11928 putHardPointerHandle(hb, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mtext.plotStyle));
11929 if (mtext.fullVisualStyleHandle != 0)
11930 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.fullVisualStyleHandle);
11931 if (mtext.faceVisualStyleHandle != 0)
11932 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.faceVisualStyleHandle);
11933 if (mtext.edgeVisualStyleHandle != 0)
11934 putHardPointerHandle(hb, mtext.edgeVisualStyleHandle);
11935 putHardPointerHandle(hb, (mtext.styleH.ref == 0) ? 0x13 : mtext.styleH.ref);
11936 if (mtext.m_r2018IsNotAnnotative)
11937 putHardPointerHandle(hb, (mtext.m_r2018AppIdHandle == 0) ? 0x14 : mtext.m_r2018AppIdHandle);
11938 if (!mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeData.empty())
11939 putHardPointerHandle(hb, (mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeAppHandle == 0)
11940 ? 0x14 : mtext.m_r2018AnnotativeAppHandle);
11941 return true;
11942}
11943}
11944
11945bool DRW_GeoPositionMarker::encodeDwg(DRW::Version v, dwgBufferW *buf,
11946 std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf,
11947 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
11948 (void)bs;
11949 if (v < DRW::AC1027 || buf == nullptr)
11950 return false;
11951 // The embedded AcDbMTextObjectEmbedded wire form was introduced with
11952 // AC1032. Reject an AC1027 framed marker rather than emitting a body that
11953 // a reader will interpret as the parent handle stream.
11954 if (m_enableFrameText && (v < DRW::AC1032 || mtext == nullptr))
11955 return false;
11956
11957 oType = kDwgType;
11958 if (!encodeDwgCommon(v, buf, strBuf))
11959 return false;
11960
11961 dwgBufferW *stringBuffer = strBuf ? strBuf : buf;
11962 buf->putBitLong(m_classVersion);
11963 buf->put3BitDouble(m_position);
11964 buf->putBitDouble(m_radius);
11965 stringBuffer->putVariableText(v, m_notes);
11966 buf->putBitDouble(m_landingGap);
11967 buf->putBit(m_mtextVisible ? 1 : 0);
11968 buf->putRawChar8(m_textAlignment);
11969 buf->putBit(m_enableFrameText ? 1 : 0);
11970
11971 dwgBufferW embeddedHandles;
11972 if (m_enableFrameText
11973 && !encodeEmbeddedMTextDwg(v, buf, strBuf, &embeddedHandles, *mtext))
11974 return false;
11975 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(v, buf, handleBuf))
11976 return false;
11977
11978 dwgBufferW *resolvedHandles = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
11979 appendBitBuffer(resolvedHandles, embeddedHandles);
11980 return true;
11981}
11982
11983bool DRW_Attrib::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
11984 // Multi-line ATTRIB (R2018+, ODA spec §20.4.4): an embedded MTEXT object
11985 // is introduced by the DXF subclass marker `100 / Embedded Object` (NOT
11986 // `AcDbMText`). After the marker, the standard MTEXT group codes follow
11987 // (10/20/30 insertion, 11/21/31 X-axis, 40 height, 41 rect width, 71
11988 // attachment point, 72 drawing direction, 1 formatted text, etc.), then
11989 // the ATTRIB-specific tail (tag=2, prompt=3 for ATTDEF, flags=70,
11990 // lock-position=280) which we must NOT route into the embedded MText.
11991 if (code == 100) {
11992 const std::string sub = reader->getString();
11993 if (sub == "Embedded Object" && !mtext) {
11994 mtext = std::make_unique<DRW_MText>();
11995 if (attVersion == 0) attVersion = 1;
11996 }
11997 dxfInAttributeSubclass = sub == "AcDbAttribute"
11998 || sub == "AcDbAttributeDefinition";
11999 return true;
12000 }
12001 if (dxfInAttributeSubclass && !mtext) {
12002 if (code == 71) {
12003 const int value = reader->getInt32();
12004 if (value < 0 || value > std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max())
12005 return false;
12006 m_attributeType = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value);
12007 return true;
12008 }
12009 if (code == 72) {
12010 (void)reader->getInt32();
12011 return true;
12012 }
12013 }
12014 // Inside the embedded MText scope, route MTEXT-owned codes to mtext but
12015 // keep ATTRIB-specific tail codes for ATTRIB / ATTDEF handling below.
12016 if (mtext) {
12017 switch (code) {
12018 case 2: // tag (ATTRIB-specific; group 1 in MText is text body)
12019 case 3: // prompt (ATTDEF-specific)
12020 case 70: // ATTRIB flags
12021 case 280: // ATTRIB lock-position
12022 break; // fall through to ATTRIB handling below
12023 default:
12024 return mtext->parseCode(code, reader);
12025 }
12026 }
12027 switch (code) {
12028 case 2:
12029 tag = reader->getUtf8String();
12030 break;
12031 case 70:
12032 attribFlags = reader->getInt32();
12033 break;
12034 case 73:
12035 // AcDbAttribute code 73 = field length (obsolete); NOT the vertical
12036 // alignment from AcDbText (which is code 73 in TEXT but 74 in ATTRIB).
12037 m_fieldLength = reader->getInt32();
12038 break;
12039 case 74:
12040 // AcDbAttribute vertical alignment (code 74); TEXT uses code 73 for
12041 // this but ATTRIB moves it here to free code 73 for field length.
12042 alignV = (VAlign)reader->getInt32();
12043 break;
12044 case 280:
12045 // Lock position flag (R2010+ DXF group code)
12046 lockPosition = reader->getInt32() != 0;
12047 break;
12048 default:
12049 return DRW_Text::parseCode(code, reader);
12050 }
12051 return true;
12052}
12053
12054void DRW_Attrib::resetAttribDwgState() {
12055 resetDwgState();
12056 tag.clear();
12057 attribFlags = 0;
12058 m_fieldLength = 0;
12059 lockPosition = false;
12060 attVersion = 0;
12061 m_attributeType = 1;
12062 keepDuplicateRecords = 0;
12063 mtext.reset();
12064 dxfInAttributeSubclass = false;
12065}
12066
12067bool DRW_Attrib::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
12068 resetAttribDwgState();
12069 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
12070 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
12071 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
12072 sourceBuf->invalidate();
12073 resetAttribDwgState();
12074 return false;
12075 };
12076 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
12077 return fail();
12078
12079 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
12080 buf = &bodyProbe;
12081 dwgBuffer sBuff = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
12082 dwgBuffer *sBuf = &bodyProbe;
12083 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
12084 sBuf = &sBuff; //separate buffer for strings
12085 }
12086 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
12087 if (!ret)
12088 return fail();
12089 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing attrib *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing attrib *********************************************\n"
);
12090
12091 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
12092 std::uint64_t stringStartBit = bodyEndBit;
12093 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
12094 if (version > DRW::AC1018
12095 && (!buf->getR2007StringStreamBounds(objSize, stringStartBit,
12096 stringEndBit)
12097 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit))
12098 return fail();
12099
12100 DwgTextBodyData parsedText;
12101 if (!readBoundedDwgTextBody(version, *buf, *sBuf, bodyEndBit,
12102 stringStartBit, stringEndBit, parsedText))
12103 return fail();
12104
12105 // R2010+ ATTRIB version follows the common TEXT data. R2018 adds the
12106 // attribute type immediately after it.
12107 std::uint8_t parsedAttVersion = 0;
12108 std::uint8_t parsedAttributeType = 1;
12109 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
12110 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAttVersion))
12111 return fail();
12112 }
12113 if (version >= DRW::AC1032) {
12114 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAttributeType))
12115 return fail();
12116 }
12117
12118 bool hasEmbeddedMText = false;
12119 EmbeddedMTextHandleInfo embeddedMTextHandles;
12120 std::unique_ptr<DRW_MText> parsedMText;
12121 if (version >= DRW::AC1032
12122 && parsedAttributeType != 0 && parsedAttributeType != 1) {
12123 parsedMText = std::make_unique<DRW_MText>();
12124 if (!parseEmbeddedMTextDwg(version, buf, sBuf, *parsedMText,
12125 embeddedMTextHandles, bodyEndBit,
12126 stringEndBit)) {
12127 DRW_DBG("R2018 multi-line ATTRIB payload failed\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("R2018 multi-line ATTRIB payload failed\n");
12128 return fail();
12129 }
12130 hasEmbeddedMText = true;
12131 }
12132
12133 // ATTRIB-specific fields
12134 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedTag;
12135 if (version <= DRW::AC1018 || stringStartBit < stringEndBit) {
12136 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
12137 parsedTag))
12138 return fail();
12139 }
12140
12141 std::uint16_t parsedFieldLength = 0;
12142 std::uint8_t parsedAttribFlags = 0;
12143 bool parsedLockPosition = false;
12144 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedFieldLength)
12145 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAttribFlags))
12146 return fail();
12147
12148 // lockPosition (DXF 280) appears since R2007 (AC1021) per ODA §20.4.x /
12149 // ACadSharp. Read gate lowered AC1024->AC1021 so R2007/8/9 imports keep
12150 // it. The writer emits the matching bit for AC1021 and later;
12151 // parseDwgEntHandle repositions to objSize for version>AC1018 before
12152 // consuming the handle stream.
12153 if (version >= DRW::AC1021) {
12154 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedLockPosition))
12155 return fail();
12156 }
12157
12158 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
12159 return fail();
12160
12161 /* Common Entity Handle Data */
12162 // The parent ATTRIB handle stream starts at objSize. Embedded MTEXT
12163 // handles follow it, so parse the parent first and consume the embedded
12164 // stream from the resulting position.
12165 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
12166 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
12167 handleEndBit))
12168 return fail();
12169 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
12170 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
12171 handleEndBit);
12172 if (!ret)
12173 return fail();
12174
12175 if (hasEmbeddedMText) {
12176 if (!consumeEmbeddedMTextHandles(version, &handleProbe,
12177 embeddedMTextHandles,
12178 parsedMText.get(), handleEndBit))
12179 return fail();
12180 }
12181
12182 dwgHandle parsedStyleH;
12183 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false, parsedStyleH)
12184 || !handleProbe.isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
12185 || currentDwgBit(buf) > bodyEndBit
12186 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit)
12187 return fail();
12188
12189 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
12190 basePoint = parsedText.basePoint;
12191 secPoint = parsedText.secPoint;
12192 extPoint = parsedText.extPoint;
12193 thickness = parsedText.thickness;
12194 oblique = parsedText.oblique;
12195 angle = parsedText.angle;
12196 height = parsedText.height;
12197 widthscale = parsedText.widthscale;
12198 text = std::move(parsedText.text);
12199 textgen = parsedText.textgen;
12200 alignH = parsedText.alignH;
12201 alignV = parsedText.alignV;
12202 attVersion = parsedAttVersion;
12203 m_attributeType = parsedAttributeType;
12204 mtext = std::move(parsedMText);
12205 tag = std::move(parsedTag);
12206 m_fieldLength = parsedFieldLength;
12207 attribFlags = parsedAttribFlags;
12208 lockPosition = parsedLockPosition;
12209 styleH = parsedStyleH;
12210 DRW_DBG("text style Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("text style Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(styleH.code, styleH.size, styleH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(styleH.code, styleH.size, styleH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
12211 return true;
12212}
12213
12214bool DRW_Attrib::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
12215 (void)bs;
12216 if (version >= DRW::AC1024 && version < DRW::AC1032 && (attVersion != 0 || mtext))
12217 return false;
12218 const std::uint8_t attributeType = (m_attributeType == 0) ? 1 : m_attributeType;
12219 const bool hasEmbeddedMText = version >= DRW::AC1032 && attributeType != 1;
12220 if (hasEmbeddedMText && !mtext)
12221 return false;
12222
12223 oType = 2; // ATTRIB class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1148
12224 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
12225
12226 // TEXT-body section — mirrors DRW_Attrib::parseDwg.
12227 // data_flags=0: emit every optional field unconditionally (same
12228 // strategy as DRW_Text::encodeDwg — simpler encoder, ~30 bytes larger).
12229 buf->putRawChar8(0); // data_flags=0
12230 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.z); // elevation RD
12231 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.x); // insertion 2RD
12232 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.y);
12233 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.x, secPoint.x); // alignment 2DD
12234 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.y, secPoint.y);
12235 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
12236 buf->putThickness(thickness, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
12237 buf->putRawDouble(oblique); // oblique angle RD
12238 buf->putRawDouble(angle / ARAD57.29577951308232); // angle in radians RD
12239 buf->putRawDouble(height); // text height RD
12240 buf->putRawDouble(widthscale); // width factor RD
12241 dwgBufferW *sb = strBuf ? strBuf : buf;
12242 sb->putVariableText(version, text); // text string TV
12243 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(textgen)); // generation flags BS
12244 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(alignH)); // horiz align BS
12245 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(alignV)); // vert align BS
12246
12247 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
12248 buf->putRawChar8(hasEmbeddedMText && attVersion == 0 ? 1 : attVersion);
12249 }
12250 if (version >= DRW::AC1032) {
12251 buf->putRawChar8(attributeType);
12252 }
12253
12254 dwgBufferW embeddedHandles;
12255 if (hasEmbeddedMText) {
12256 if (!encodeEmbeddedMTextDwg(version, buf, strBuf, &embeddedHandles, *mtext))
12257 return false;
12258 }
12259
12260 // ATTRIB-specific tail
12261 sb->putVariableText(version, tag); // tag TV
12262 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_fieldLength)); // fieldLen BS
12263 buf->putRawChar8(attribFlags); // flags RC
12264 if (version >= DRW::AC1021) {
12265 buf->putBit(lockPosition ? 1 : 0); // lock position B (R2007a+)
12266 }
12267
12268 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
12269
12270 dwgHandle sH;
12271 std::uint32_t sref = (styleH.ref == 0) ? 0x13 : styleH.ref;
12272 sH.code = 5;
12273 sH.ref = sref;
12274 sH.size = 0;
12275 if (sref != 0) { std::uint32_t t = sref; while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++sH.size; } }
12276 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
12277 appendBitBuffer(hb, embeddedHandles);
12278 hb->putHandle(sH);
12279 return buf->isGood() && sb->isGood() && hb->isGood();
12280}
12281
12282bool DRW_Attdef::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
12283 switch (code) {
12284 case 3:
12285 prompt = reader->getUtf8String();
12286 break;
12287 default:
12288 return DRW_Attrib::parseCode(code, reader);
12289 }
12290 return true;
12291}
12292
12293bool DRW_Attdef::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
12294 // ATTDEF mirrors ATTRIB layout but adds a prompt string after the tag.
12295 // Implementation duplicates ATTRIB::parseDwg in order to inject the
12296 // prompt read at the correct offset; refactor opportunity if a third
12297 // sibling appears.
12298 resetAttribDwgState();
12299 prompt.clear();
12300 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
12301 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
12302 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
12303 sourceBuf->invalidate();
12304 resetAttribDwgState();
12305 prompt.clear();
12306 return false;
12307 };
12308 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
12309 return fail();
12310
12311 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
12312 buf = &bodyProbe;
12313 dwgBuffer sBuff = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
12314 dwgBuffer *sBuf = &bodyProbe;
12315 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
12316 sBuf = &sBuff;
12317 }
12318 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
12319 if (!ret)
12320 return fail();
12321 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing attdef *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing attdef *********************************************\n"
);
12322 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
12323 std::uint64_t stringStartBit = bodyEndBit;
12324 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
12325 if (version > DRW::AC1018
12326 && (!buf->getR2007StringStreamBounds(objSize, stringStartBit,
12327 stringEndBit)
12328 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit))
12329 return fail();
12330
12331 DwgTextBodyData parsedText;
12332 if (!readBoundedDwgTextBody(version, *buf, *sBuf, bodyEndBit,
12333 stringStartBit, stringEndBit, parsedText))
12334 return fail();
12335
12336 std::uint8_t parsedAttVersion = 0;
12337 std::uint8_t parsedAttributeType = 1;
12338 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
12339 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAttVersion))
12340 return fail();
12341 }
12342 if (version >= DRW::AC1032) {
12343 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAttributeType))
12344 return fail();
12345 }
12346
12347 bool hasEmbeddedMText = false;
12348 EmbeddedMTextHandleInfo embeddedMTextHandles;
12349 std::unique_ptr<DRW_MText> parsedMText;
12350 if (version >= DRW::AC1032
12351 && parsedAttributeType != 0 && parsedAttributeType != 1) {
12352 parsedMText = std::make_unique<DRW_MText>();
12353 if (!parseEmbeddedMTextDwg(version, buf, sBuf, *parsedMText,
12354 embeddedMTextHandles, bodyEndBit,
12355 stringEndBit)) {
12356 DRW_DBG("R2018 multi-line ATTDEF payload failed\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("R2018 multi-line ATTDEF payload failed\n");
12357 return fail();
12358 }
12359 hasEmbeddedMText = true;
12360 }
12361
12362 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedTag;
12363 if (version <= DRW::AC1018 || stringStartBit < stringEndBit) {
12364 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
12365 parsedTag))
12366 return fail();
12367 }
12368
12369 std::uint16_t parsedFieldLength = 0;
12370 std::uint8_t parsedAttribFlags = 0;
12371 bool parsedLockPosition = false;
12372 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedFieldLength)
12373 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAttribFlags))
12374 return fail();
12375
12376 // lockPosition (DXF 280) is a bit in R2007+ DWG data.
12377 if (version >= DRW::AC1021) {
12378 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedLockPosition))
12379 return fail();
12380 }
12381
12382 // ATTDEF prompt follows attrib body
12383 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedPrompt;
12384 if (version <= DRW::AC1018 || stringStartBit < stringEndBit) {
12385 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
12386 parsedPrompt))
12387 return fail();
12388 }
12389
12390 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
12391 return fail();
12392
12393 // The parent ATTDEF handle stream precedes the embedded MTEXT handles.
12394 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
12395 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
12396 handleEndBit))
12397 return fail();
12398 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
12399 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
12400 handleEndBit);
12401 if (!ret)
12402 return fail();
12403
12404 if (hasEmbeddedMText) {
12405 if (!consumeEmbeddedMTextHandles(version, &handleProbe,
12406 embeddedMTextHandles,
12407 parsedMText.get(), handleEndBit))
12408 return fail();
12409 }
12410
12411 dwgHandle parsedStyleH;
12412 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false, parsedStyleH)
12413 || !handleProbe.isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
12414 || currentDwgBit(buf) > bodyEndBit
12415 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit)
12416 return fail();
12417
12418 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
12419 basePoint = parsedText.basePoint;
12420 secPoint = parsedText.secPoint;
12421 extPoint = parsedText.extPoint;
12422 thickness = parsedText.thickness;
12423 oblique = parsedText.oblique;
12424 angle = parsedText.angle;
12425 height = parsedText.height;
12426 widthscale = parsedText.widthscale;
12427 text = std::move(parsedText.text);
12428 textgen = parsedText.textgen;
12429 alignH = parsedText.alignH;
12430 alignV = parsedText.alignV;
12431 attVersion = parsedAttVersion;
12432 m_attributeType = parsedAttributeType;
12433 mtext = std::move(parsedMText);
12434 tag = std::move(parsedTag);
12435 m_fieldLength = parsedFieldLength;
12436 attribFlags = parsedAttribFlags;
12437 lockPosition = parsedLockPosition;
12438 prompt = std::move(parsedPrompt);
12439 styleH = parsedStyleH;
12440 return true;
12441}
12442
12443bool DRW_Attdef::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
12444 (void)bs;
12445 if (version >= DRW::AC1024 && version < DRW::AC1032 && (attVersion != 0 || mtext))
12446 return false;
12447 const std::uint8_t attributeType = (m_attributeType == 0) ? 1 : m_attributeType;
12448 const bool hasEmbeddedMText = version >= DRW::AC1032 && attributeType != 1;
12449 if (hasEmbeddedMText && !mtext)
12450 return false;
12451
12452 oType = 3; // ATTDEF class id — see dwgreader.cpp:1185
12453 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
12454
12455 // TEXT-body section — identical layout to DRW_Attrib::encodeDwg.
12456 buf->putRawChar8(0);
12457 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.z);
12458 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.x);
12459 buf->putRawDouble(basePoint.y);
12460 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.x, secPoint.x);
12461 buf->putDefaultDouble(basePoint.y, secPoint.y);
12462 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
12463 buf->putThickness(thickness, /*b_R2000_style=*/true);
12464 buf->putRawDouble(oblique);
12465 buf->putRawDouble(angle / ARAD57.29577951308232);
12466 buf->putRawDouble(height);
12467 buf->putRawDouble(widthscale);
12468 dwgBufferW *sb = strBuf ? strBuf : buf;
12469 sb->putVariableText(version, text);
12470 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(textgen));
12471 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(alignH));
12472 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(alignV));
12473
12474 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
12475 buf->putRawChar8(hasEmbeddedMText && attVersion == 0 ? 1 : attVersion);
12476 }
12477 if (version >= DRW::AC1032) {
12478 buf->putRawChar8(attributeType);
12479 }
12480
12481 dwgBufferW embeddedHandles;
12482 if (hasEmbeddedMText) {
12483 if (!encodeEmbeddedMTextDwg(version, buf, strBuf, &embeddedHandles, *mtext))
12484 return false;
12485 }
12486
12487 sb->putVariableText(version, tag);
12488 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_fieldLength)); // fieldLen BS
12489 buf->putRawChar8(attribFlags);
12490 if (version >= DRW::AC1021) {
12491 buf->putBit(lockPosition ? 1 : 0);
12492 }
12493
12494 // ATTDEF adds prompt between flags and handle stream
12495 sb->putVariableText(version, prompt);
12496
12497 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
12498
12499 dwgHandle sH;
12500 std::uint32_t sref = (styleH.ref == 0) ? 0x13 : styleH.ref;
12501 sH.code = 5;
12502 sH.ref = sref;
12503 sH.size = 0;
12504 if (sref != 0) { std::uint32_t t = sref; while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++sH.size; } }
12505 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
12506 appendBitBuffer(hb, embeddedHandles);
12507 hb->putHandle(sH);
12508 return buf->isGood() && sb->isGood() && hb->isGood();
12509}
12510
12511bool DRW_MText::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
12512 switch (code) {
12513 case 1:
12514 text += reader->getString();
12515 text = reader->toUtf8String(text);
12516 break;
12517 case 11:
12518 hasXAxisVec = true;
12519 return DRW_Text::parseCode(code, reader);
12520 case 3:
12521 text += reader->getString();
12522 break;
12523 case 44:
12524 interlin = reader->getDouble();
12525 break;
12526 case 50: // djm: per dxf docs, last of code 11 or code 50 prevails
12527 hasXAxisVec = false;
12528 angle = reader->getDouble();
12529 break;
12530 case 73: {
12531 const int value = reader->getInt32();
12532 if (value < 0 || value > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
12533 return false;
12534 linespacingStyle = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
12535 break;
12536 }
12537 case 42:
12538 m_r2018ExtentsWidth = reader->getDouble();
12539 break;
12540 case 43:
12541 m_r2018ExtentsHeight = reader->getDouble();
12542 break;
12543 case 45:
12544 m_backgroundScale = reader->getDouble();
12545 break;
12546 case 63:
12547 m_backgroundColor = reader->getInt32();
12548 break;
12549 case 90:
12550 m_backgroundFlags = reader->getInt32();
12551 break;
12552 case 421:
12553 m_backgroundColor = reader->getInt32();
12554 break;
12555 case 441:
12556 m_backgroundTransparency = reader->getInt32();
12557 break;
12558 default:
12559 return DRW_Text::parseCode(code, reader);
12560 }
12561
12562 return true;
12563}

12599
12600bool DRW_MText::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
12601 // A reader may reuse an entity carrier while walking a compound stream.
12602 // R2018 context data is version-gated, so clear it before parsing an
12603 // older MTEXT or stale column/annotative state can leak into the result.
12604 resetDwgState();
12605 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
12606 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
12607 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
12608 sourceBuf->invalidate();
12609 resetDwgState();
12610 return false;
12611 };
12612 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
12613 return fail();
12614
12615 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
12616 buf = &bodyProbe;
12617
12618 dwgBuffer sBuff = buf->forkIndependent();
12619 dwgBuffer *sBuf = buf;
12620 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
12621 sBuf = &sBuff; //separate buffer for strings
12622 }
12623 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
12624 if (!ret)
12625 return fail();
12626 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing mtext *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing mtext *********************************************\n"
);
12627
12628 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
12629 std::uint64_t stringStartBit = bodyEndBit;
12630 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
12631 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
12632 if (!buf->getR2007StringStreamBounds(objSize, stringStartBit,
12633 stringEndBit)
12634 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit)
12635 return fail();
12636 }
12637
12638 const bool hasStringStream = stringStartBit < stringEndBit;
12639 const auto readText = [&](UTF8STRINGstd::string& value) {
12640 if (version > DRW::AC1018 && !hasStringStream) {
12641 value.clear();
12642 return true;
12643 }
12644 const std::uint64_t endBit = version > DRW::AC1018
12645 ? stringEndBit : bodyEndBit;
12646 return readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, endBit, version, value);
12647 };
12648
12649 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
12650 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
12651 DRW_Coord parsedXAxisDirection;
12652 double parsedWidthScale = 0.0;
12653 double parsedRectangleHeight = 0.0;
12654 double parsedHeight = 0.0;
12655 std::uint16_t parsedAttachment = 1;
12656 std::uint16_t parsedDrawingDirection = 0;
12657 double ignoredExtentsHeight = 0.0;
12658 double ignoredExtentsWidth = 0.0;
12659 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedText;
12660 std::uint16_t parsedLineSpacingStyle = 1;
12661 double parsedInterlin = 1.0;
12662 std::int32_t parsedBackgroundFlags = 0;
12663 double parsedBackgroundScale = 0.0;
12664 std::uint32_t parsedBackgroundColor = 0;
12665 std::int32_t parsedBackgroundTransparency = 0;
12666 bool parsedIsNotAnnotative = false;
12667 bool parsedReallyLocked = false;
12668 std::uint16_t parsedR2018Version = 0;
12669 bool parsedDefaultFlag = false;
12670 std::int32_t parsedR2018Attachment = 0;
12671 DRW_Coord parsedR2018XAxisDirection;
12672 DRW_Coord parsedR2018InsertionPoint;
12673 double parsedR2018RectangleWidth = 0.0;
12674 double parsedR2018RectangleHeight = 0.0;
12675 double parsedR2018ExtentsHeight = 0.0;
12676 double parsedR2018ExtentsWidth = 0.0;
12677 std::uint16_t parsedColumnType = 0;
12678 std::int32_t parsedColumnCount = 0;
12679 double parsedColumnWidth = 0.0;
12680 double parsedColumnGutter = 0.0;
12681 bool parsedColumnAutoHeight = false;
12682 bool parsedColumnFlowReversed = false;
12683 std::vector<double> parsedColumnHeights;
12684
12685 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint)
12686 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedExtrusion)
12687 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedXAxisDirection)
12688 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedWidthScale)
12689 || (version > DRW::AC1018
12690 && !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12691 parsedRectangleHeight))
12692 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedHeight)
12693 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAttachment)
12694 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDrawingDirection)
12695 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredExtentsHeight)
12696 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredExtentsWidth)
12697 || !readText(parsedText))
12698 return fail();
12699
12700 if (version > DRW::AC1014
12701 && (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedLineSpacingStyle)
12702 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedInterlin)))
12703 return fail();
12704 bool ignoredBit = false;
12705 if (version > DRW::AC1014 && !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12706 ignoredBit))
12707 return fail();
12708
12709 if (version > DRW::AC1015) {
12710 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedBackgroundFlags))
12711 return fail();
12712 const bool hasBackgroundDetails = (parsedBackgroundFlags & 0x01) != 0
12713 || (version >= DRW::AC1032
12714 && (parsedBackgroundFlags & 0x10) != 0);
12715 if (hasBackgroundDetails
12716 && (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12717 parsedBackgroundScale)
12718 || !readBoundedCmColor(*buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version,
12719 parsedBackgroundColor, nullptr,
12720 nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
12721 stringEndBit)
12722 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12723 parsedBackgroundTransparency)))
12724 return fail();
12725 }
12726
12727 bool hasR2018AppId = false;
12728 if (version >= DRW::AC1032) {
12729 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedIsNotAnnotative))
12730 return fail();
12731 if (parsedIsNotAnnotative) {
12732 hasR2018AppId = true;
12733 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedR2018Version)
12734 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDefaultFlag)
12735 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12736 parsedR2018Attachment)
12737 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12738 parsedR2018XAxisDirection)
12739 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12740 parsedR2018InsertionPoint)
12741 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12742 parsedR2018RectangleWidth)
12743 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12744 parsedR2018RectangleHeight)
12745 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12746 parsedR2018ExtentsHeight)
12747 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12748 parsedR2018ExtentsWidth)
12749 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedColumnType)
12750 || parsedColumnType > 2)
12751 return fail();
12752 if (parsedColumnType != 0) {
12753 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedColumnCount)
12754 || !isValidCount(parsedColumnCount,
12755 kMaxMTextColumnHeights)
12756 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12757 parsedColumnWidth)
12758 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12759 parsedColumnGutter)
12760 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12761 parsedColumnAutoHeight)
12762 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12763 parsedColumnFlowReversed))
12764 return fail();
12765 if (!parsedColumnAutoHeight && parsedColumnType == 2
12766 && parsedColumnCount > 0) {
12767 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedColumnHeights,
12768 parsedColumnCount))
12769 return fail();
12770 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < parsedColumnCount; ++i) {
12771 double columnHeight = 0.0;
12772 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
12773 columnHeight)
12774 || !std::isfinite(columnHeight))
12775 return fail();
12776 parsedColumnHeights.push_back(columnHeight);
12777 }
12778 }
12779 }
12780 }
12781 }
12782
12783 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
12784 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
12785 && std::isfinite(point.z);
12786 };
12787 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
12788 || !finite(parsedBasePoint) || !finite(parsedExtrusion)
12789 || !finite(parsedXAxisDirection)
12790 || !std::isfinite(parsedWidthScale)
12791 || !std::isfinite(parsedRectangleHeight)
12792 || !std::isfinite(parsedHeight)
12793 || !std::isfinite(ignoredExtentsHeight)
12794 || !std::isfinite(ignoredExtentsWidth)
12795 || !std::isfinite(parsedInterlin)
12796 || !finite(parsedR2018XAxisDirection)
12797 || !finite(parsedR2018InsertionPoint)
12798 || !std::isfinite(parsedR2018RectangleWidth)
12799 || !std::isfinite(parsedR2018RectangleHeight)
12800 || !std::isfinite(parsedR2018ExtentsHeight)
12801 || !std::isfinite(parsedR2018ExtentsWidth))
12802 return fail();
12803
12804 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
12805 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
12806 handleEndBit))

12808 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();

12810 handleEndBit))

12813 dwgHandle parsedStyleH;

12815 parsedStyleH))
12816 return fail();
12817 dwgHandle parsedAppIdH;
12818 if (hasR2018AppId
12819 && !readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
12820 parsedAppIdH))
12821 return fail();
12822 if (!handleProbe.isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
12823 return fail();
12824
12825 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
12826 basePoint = parsedBasePoint;
12827 extPoint = parsedExtrusion;
12828 secPoint = parsedXAxisDirection;
12829 hasXAxisVec = true;
12830 widthscale = parsedWidthScale;
12831 height = parsedHeight;
12832 angle = atan2(secPoint.y, secPoint.x) * ARAD57.29577951308232;
12833 textgen = parsedAttachment;
12834 alignH = static_cast<HAlign>(parsedDrawingDirection);
12835 text = std::move(parsedText);
12836 linespacingStyle = parsedLineSpacingStyle;
12837 interlin = parsedInterlin;
12838 m_backgroundFlags = parsedBackgroundFlags;
12839 m_backgroundScale = parsedBackgroundScale;
12840 m_backgroundColor = static_cast<int>(parsedBackgroundColor);
12841 m_backgroundTransparency = parsedBackgroundTransparency;
12842 m_r2018IsNotAnnotative = parsedIsNotAnnotative;
12843 m_r2018Version = parsedR2018Version;
12844 m_r2018DefaultFlag = parsedDefaultFlag;
12845 m_r2018AppIdHandle = hasR2018AppId ? parsedAppIdH.ref : 0;
12846 m_r2018Attachment = parsedR2018Attachment;
12847 m_r2018XAxisDir = parsedR2018XAxisDirection;
12848 m_r2018InsertionPoint = parsedR2018InsertionPoint;
12849 m_r2018RectWidth = parsedR2018RectangleWidth;
12850 m_r2018RectHeight = parsedR2018RectangleHeight;
12851 m_r2018ExtentsHeight = parsedR2018ExtentsHeight;
12852 m_r2018ExtentsWidth = parsedR2018ExtentsWidth;
12853 m_r2018ColumnType = parsedColumnType;
12854 m_r2018ColumnCount = parsedColumnCount;
12855 m_r2018ColumnWidth = parsedColumnWidth;
12856 m_r2018ColumnGutter = parsedColumnGutter;
12857 m_r2018ColumnAutoHeight = parsedColumnAutoHeight;
12858 m_r2018ColumnFlowReversed = parsedColumnFlowReversed;
12859 m_r2018ColumnHeights = std::move(parsedColumnHeights);
12860 styleH = parsedStyleH;
12861 DRW_DBG("text style Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("text style Handle: "); DRW_DBG(styleH.code)DRW_dbg::dbg(styleH.code); DRW_DBG(".")DRW_dbg::dbg(".");
12862 DRW_DBG(styleH.size)DRW_dbg::dbg(styleH.size); DRW_DBG(".")DRW_dbg::dbg("."); DRW_DBG(styleH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbg(styleH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
12863 return true;

12872bool DRW_Polyline::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){

12897 break;

12902 return true;

12912 defendwidth = 0.0;

12924
12925bool DRW_Polyline::validatePayloadFields() const {
12926 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
12927 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
12928 && std::isfinite(point.z);
12929 };
12930 const auto validBitShort = [](int value) {
12931 return value >= 0
12932 && value <= std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max();
12933 };
12934 return flags >= 0 && flags <= std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max()
12935 && validBitShort(curvetype) && validBitShort(vertexcount)
12936 && validBitShort(facecount) && validBitShort(smoothM)
12937 && validBitShort(smoothN) && finite(basePoint)
12938 && finite(extPoint) && std::isfinite(defstawidth)
12939 && std::isfinite(defendwidth) && std::isfinite(thickness)
12940 && vertlist.size() <= dwgSafety::MaxOwnedObjectCount
12941 && vertlist.size()
12942 <= static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max())
12943 && std::all_of(vertlist.cbegin(), vertlist.cend(),
12944 [](const auto& vertex) { return vertex != nullptr; });
12945}
12946
12947bool DRW_Polyline::isDwgVertexCompatible(
12948 const DRW_Vertex& vertex) const noexcept {
12949 if ((flags & 64) != 0) {
12950 return vertex.dwgSubtype() == DRW_Vertex::DwgSubtype::Polyface
12951 || vertex.dwgSubtype() == DRW_Vertex::DwgSubtype::PolyfaceFace;
12952 }
12953 if ((flags & 16) != 0)
12954 return vertex.dwgSubtype() == DRW_Vertex::DwgSubtype::Mesh;
12955 if ((flags & 8) != 0)
12956 return vertex.dwgSubtype() == DRW_Vertex::DwgSubtype::Vertex3D;
12957 return vertex.dwgSubtype() == DRW_Vertex::DwgSubtype::Vertex2D;
12958}
