12960bool DRW_Polyline::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
12961 resetDwgState();
12962 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
12963 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
12964 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
12965 sourceBuf->invalidate();
12966 resetDwgState();
12967 return false;
12968 };
12969
12970 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
12971 return fail();
12972
12973 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
12974 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs)
12975 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
12976 return fail();
12977 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing polyline *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing polyline *********************************************\n"
);
12978
12979 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
12980 int parsedFlags = 0;
12981 double parsedDefStartWidth = 0.0;
12982 double parsedDefEndWidth = 0.0;
12983 int parsedVertexCount = 0;
12984 int parsedFaceCount = 0;
12985 int parsedSmoothM = 0;
12986 int parsedSmoothN = 0;
12987 int parsedCurveType = 0;
12988 double parsedThickness = 0.0;
12989 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
12990 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
12991 std::int32_t ooCount = 0;
12992 if (oType == 0x0F) { //pline 2D
12993 std::uint16_t value = 0;
12994 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
12995 return fail();
12996 parsedFlags = value;
12997 DRW_DBG("flags value: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags value: "); DRW_DBG(parsedFlags)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedFlags);
12998 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
12999 return fail();
13000 parsedCurveType = value;
13001 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedDefStartWidth)
13002 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedDefEndWidth)
13003 || !readBoundedThickness(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
13004 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedThickness)
13005 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint.z)
13006 || !readBoundedExtrusion(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
13007 version > DRW::AC1014, parsedExtrusion))
13008 return fail();
13009 } else if (oType == 0x10) { //pline 3D
13010 std::uint8_t tmpFlag = 0;
13011 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, tmpFlag))
13012 return fail();
13013 DRW_DBG("flags 1 value: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags 1 value: "); DRW_DBG(tmpFlag)DRW_dbg::dbg(tmpFlag);
13014 if (tmpFlag & 1)
13015 parsedCurveType = 5; // quadratic B-spline
13016 else if (tmpFlag & 2)
13017 parsedCurveType = 6; // cubic B-spline
13018 if (tmpFlag & 3)
13019 parsedFlags |= 4; // splined (bit 2); do NOT overwrite curvetype to 8
13020 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, tmpFlag))
13021 return fail();
13022 if (tmpFlag & 1)
13023 parsedFlags |= 1;
13024 parsedFlags |= 8; //indicate 3DPOL
13025 DRW_DBG("flags 2 value: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags 2 value: "); DRW_DBG(tmpFlag)DRW_dbg::dbg(tmpFlag);
13026 } else if (oType == 0x1D) { //PFACE
13027 std::uint16_t vertexValue = 0;
13028 std::uint16_t faceValue = 0;
13029 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, vertexValue)
13030 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, faceValue))
13031 return fail();
13032 parsedFlags = 64;
13033 parsedVertexCount = vertexValue;
13034 parsedFaceCount = faceValue;
13035 DRW_DBG("vertex count: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("vertex count: "); DRW_DBG(parsedVertexCount)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedVertexCount);
13036 DRW_DBG("face count: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("face count: "); DRW_DBG(parsedFaceCount)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedFaceCount);
13037 DRW_DBG("flags value: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags value: "); DRW_DBG(parsedFlags)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedFlags);
13038 } else if (oType == 0x1E) { //POLYLINE_MESH per ODA spec sec 19.4.31
13039 std::uint16_t value = 0;
13040 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13041 return fail();
13042 parsedFlags = value | 16; //bit 4 = 3D polygon mesh
13043 DRW_DBG("flags value: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags value: "); DRW_DBG(parsedFlags)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedFlags);
13044 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13045 return fail();
13046 parsedCurveType = value;
13047 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13048 return fail();
13049 parsedVertexCount = value; //M-count
13050 DRW_DBG(" M count: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" M count: "); DRW_DBG(parsedVertexCount)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedVertexCount);
13051 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13052 return fail();
13053 parsedFaceCount = value; //N-count
13054 DRW_DBG(" N count: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" N count: "); DRW_DBG(parsedFaceCount)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedFaceCount);
13055 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13056 return fail();
13057 parsedSmoothM = value; //M smooth-surface density, DXF 73
13058 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13059 return fail();
13060 parsedSmoothN = value; //N smooth-surface density, DXF 74
13061 DRW_DBG(" M/N density: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" M/N density: "); DRW_DBG(parsedSmoothM)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedSmoothM); DRW_DBG("/")DRW_dbg::dbg("/"); DRW_DBG(parsedSmoothN)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedSmoothN);
13062 } else {
13063 return fail();
13064 }
13065 if (version > DRW::AC1015){ //2004+
13066 if (!readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ooCount)
13067 || !dwgSafety::validOwnedObjectCount(
13068 ooCount, bodyProbe.numRemainingBytes())) {
13069 DRW_DBG("\nWARNING: Invalid POLYLINE owned-object count\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nWARNING: Invalid POLYLINE owned-object count\n"
);
13070 return fail();
13071 }
13072 }
13073
13074 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
13075 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
13076 handleEndBit))
13077 return fail();
13078 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
13079 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
13080 handleEndBit)
13081 || !handleProbe.isGood())
13082 return fail();
13083
13084 std::list<std::uint32_t> parsedHandles;
13085 std::uint32_t parsedFirstEH = 0;
13086 std::uint32_t parsedLastEH = 0;
13087
13088 if (version < DRW::AC1018){ //2000-
13089 dwgHandle objectH;
13090 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, true,
13091 objectH))
13092 return fail();
13093 parsedFirstEH = objectH.ref;
13094 DRW_DBG(" first Vertex Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" first Vertex Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(objectH.code, objectH.size, objectH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(objectH.code, objectH.size, objectH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
13095 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, true,
13096 objectH))
13097 return fail();
13098 parsedLastEH = objectH.ref;
13099 DRW_DBG(" last Vertex Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" last Vertex Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(objectH.code, objectH.size, objectH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(objectH.code, objectH.size, objectH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
13100 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
13101 } else {
13102 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < ooCount; ++i){
13103 dwgHandle objectH;
13104 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle,
13105 true, objectH))
13106 return fail();
13107 try {
13108 parsedHandles.push_back(objectH.ref);
13109 } catch (...) {
13110 return fail();
13111 }
13112 DRW_DBG(" Vertex Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" Vertex Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(objectH.code, objectH.size, objectH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(objectH.code, objectH.size, objectH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
13113 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
13114 }
13115 }
13116 dwgHandle parsedSeqEndH;
13117 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, true,
13118 parsedSeqEndH))
13119 return fail();
13120 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
13121 return fail();
13122 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
13123 flags = parsedFlags;
13124 defstawidth = parsedDefStartWidth;
13125 defendwidth = parsedDefEndWidth;
13126 vertexcount = parsedVertexCount;
13127 facecount = parsedFaceCount;
13128 smoothM = parsedSmoothM;
13129 smoothN = parsedSmoothN;
13130 curvetype = parsedCurveType;
13131 thickness = parsedThickness;
13132 basePoint = parsedBasePoint;
13133 extPoint = parsedExtrusion;
13134 firstEH = parsedFirstEH;
13135 lastEH = parsedLastEH;
13136 seqEndH = parsedSeqEndH;
13137 hadlesList = std::move(parsedHandles);
13138 DRW_DBG(" SEQEND Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" SEQEND Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(seqEndH.code, seqEndH.size, seqEndH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(seqEndH.code, seqEndH.size, seqEndH.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
13139 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(buf->numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(buf->numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
13140
13141// RS crc; //RS */
13142 return buf->isGood();
13143}

13145bool DRW_Vertex::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
13146 switch (code) {
13147 case 70:
13148 flags = reader->getInt32();
13149 break;
13150 case 40:
13151 stawidth = reader->getDouble();
13152 break;
13153 case 41:
13154 endwidth = reader->getDouble();
13155 break;
13156 case 42:
13157 bulge = reader->getDouble();
13158 break;
13159 case 50:
13160 tgdir = reader->getDouble();
13161 break;
13162 case 71:
13163 vindex1 = reader->getInt32();
13164 break;
13165 case 72:
13166 vindex2 = reader->getInt32();
13167 break;
13168 case 73:
13169 vindex3 = reader->getInt32();
13170 break;
13171 case 74:
13172 vindex4 = reader->getInt32();
13173 break;
13174 case 91:
13175 identifier = reader->getInt32();
13176 break;
13177 default:
13178 return DRW_Point::parseCode(code, reader);
13179 }
13180
13181 return true;
13182}

13189void DRW_Vertex::resetDwgState() {

13191 stawidth = 0.0;

13201bool DRW_Vertex::validatePayloadFields() const {
13202 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
13203 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
13204 && std::isfinite(point.z);
13205 };
13206 const auto validFaceIndex = [](int value) {
13207 return value >= std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::min()
13208 && value <= std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max();
13209 };
13210 const auto validInt32 = [](int value) {
13211 return value >= std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min()
13212 && value <= std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max();
13213 };
13214 return flags >= 0 && flags <= std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max()
13215 && validFaceIndex(vindex1) && validFaceIndex(vindex2)
13216 && validFaceIndex(vindex3) && validFaceIndex(vindex4)
13217 && validInt32(identifier) && finite(basePoint)
13218 && std::isfinite(stawidth) && std::isfinite(endwidth)
13219 && std::isfinite(bulge) && std::isfinite(tgdir);
13220}

13222bool DRW_Vertex::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs, double el){
13223 resetDwgState();
13224 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
13225 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
13226 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
13227 sourceBuf->invalidate();
13228 resetDwgState();
13229 return false;
13230 };
13231
13232 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
13233 return fail();
13234
13235 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
13236 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &bodyProbe, bs)
13237 || !bodyProbe.isGood())
13238 return fail();
13239 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing pline Vertex *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing pline Vertex *********************************************\n"
);
13240
13241 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
13242 DRW_Vertex::DwgSubtype parsedSubtype = DRW_Vertex::DwgSubtype::Auto;
13243 std::uint8_t parsedFlags = 0;
13244 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
13245 double parsedStartWidth = 0.0;
13246 double parsedEndWidth = 0.0;
13247 double parsedBulge = 0.0;
13248 double parsedTangentDirection = 0.0;
13249 int parsedIndex1 = 0;
13250 int parsedIndex2 = 0;
13251 int parsedIndex3 = 0;
13252 int parsedIndex4 = 0;
13253 int parsedIdentifier = 0;
13254 if (oType == 0x0A) { //pline 2D, needed example
13255 parsedSubtype = DwgSubtype::Vertex2D;
13256 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedFlags)
13257 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint)
13258 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedStartWidth))
13259 return fail();
13260 parsedBasePoint.z = el;
13261 DRW_DBG("flags value: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags value: "); DRW_DBG(parsedFlags)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedFlags);
13262 DRW_DBG("basePoint: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("basePoint: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedBasePoint.x, parsedBasePoint.y, parsedBasePoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedBasePoint.x, parsedBasePoint.y, parsedBasePoint
.z);
13263 if (parsedStartWidth < 0.0) {
13264 parsedEndWidth = parsedStartWidth = std::fabs(parsedStartWidth);
13265 } else if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
13266 parsedEndWidth)) {
13267 return fail();
13268 }
13269 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedBulge))
13270 return fail();
13271 if (version > DRW::AC1021) { //2010+
13272 if (!readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedIdentifier))
13273 return fail();
13274 DRW_DBG("Vertex ID: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Vertex ID: "); DRW_DBG(parsedIdentifier)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedIdentifier);
13275 }
13276 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
13277 parsedTangentDirection))
13278 return fail();
13279 } else if (oType == 0x0B || oType == 0x0C || oType == 0x0D) { //PFACE
13280 if (oType == 0x0B)
13281 parsedSubtype = DwgSubtype::Vertex3D;
13282 else if (oType == 0x0C)
13283 parsedSubtype = DwgSubtype::Mesh;
13284 else
13285 parsedSubtype = DwgSubtype::Polyface;
13286 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedFlags)
13287 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint))
13288 return fail();
13289 DRW_DBG("flags value: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags value: "); DRW_DBG(parsedFlags)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedFlags);
13290 DRW_DBG("basePoint: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("basePoint: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedBasePoint.x, parsedBasePoint.y, parsedBasePoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedBasePoint.x, parsedBasePoint.y, parsedBasePoint
.z);
13291 } else if (oType == 0x0E) { //PFACE FACE
13292 parsedSubtype = DwgSubtype::PolyfaceFace;
13293 auto signedIndex = [](std::uint16_t value) {
13294 return value > 32767 ? value - 65536 : value;
13295 };
13296 std::uint16_t value = 0;
13297 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13298 return fail();
13299 parsedIndex1 = signedIndex(value);
13300 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13301 return fail();
13302 parsedIndex2 = signedIndex(value);
13303 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13304 return fail();
13305 parsedIndex3 = signedIndex(value);
13306 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
13307 return fail();
13308 parsedIndex4 = signedIndex(value);
13309 } else {
13310 return fail();
13311 }
13312
13313 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
13314 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
13315 && std::isfinite(point.z);
13316 };
13317 if (!finite(parsedBasePoint) || !std::isfinite(parsedStartWidth)
13318 || !std::isfinite(parsedEndWidth) || !std::isfinite(parsedBulge)
13319 || !std::isfinite(parsedTangentDirection)
13320 || !std::isfinite(el))
13321 return fail();
13322
13323 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
13324 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
13325 handleEndBit))
13326 return fail();
13327 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
13328 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
13329 handleEndBit)
13330 || !handleProbe.isGood())
13331 return fail();
13332 // RS crc; //RS */
13333 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
13334 m_dwgSubtype = parsedSubtype;
13335 flags = parsedFlags;
13336 basePoint = parsedBasePoint;
13337 stawidth = parsedStartWidth;
13338 endwidth = parsedEndWidth;
13339 bulge = parsedBulge;
13340 tgdir = parsedTangentDirection;
13341 vindex1 = parsedIndex1;
13342 vindex2 = parsedIndex2;
13343 vindex3 = parsedIndex3;
13344 vindex4 = parsedIndex4;
13345 identifier = parsedIdentifier;
13346 return true;
13347}
13348
13349bool DRW_Hatch::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
13350 try {
13351 switch (code) {
13352 case 2:
13353 name = reader->getUtf8String();
13354 break;
13355 case 70:
13356 solid = reader->getInt32();
13357 break;
13358 case 71:
13359 associative = reader->getInt32();
13360 break;
13361 case 72: { /*edge type*/
13362 if (ispol){ // polyline path: 72 is the has-bulge flag. Do NOT fold it
13363 // into pline->flags — bit 0 there is the *closed* flag (set by code
13364 // 73), and the per-vertex bulges arrive via code 42 regardless. Some
13365 // writers (e.g. ezdxf MPOLYGON) emit 73 before 72; the old code let
13366 // 72 clear the closed bit 73 had just set, leaving the boundary open
13367 // so RS_Hatch::validate() rejected the area.
13368 break;
13369 }
13370 if (spline && !validateCurrentSplineDxf())
13371 return false;
13372 if (!loop
13373 || loop->objlist.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
13374 || (m_dxfLoopEdgeCountExpected >= 0
13375 && loop->objlist.size()
13376 >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfLoopEdgeCountExpected)))
13377 return false;
13378 const int edgeType = reader->getInt32();
13379 if (edgeType == 1){ //line
13380 addLine();
13381 } else if (edgeType == 2){ //arc
13382 addArc();
13383 } else if (edgeType == 3){ //elliptic arc
13384 addEllipse();
13385 } else if (edgeType == 4){ //spline
13386 addSpline();
13387 } else {
13388 return false;
13389 }
13390 break;
13391 }
13392 case 10:
13393 // Spline edge: 10 is a control-point x-coord.
13394 if (spline) {
13395 if (spline->controllist.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
13396 || (m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected >= 0
13397 && spline->controllist.size()
13398 >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected)))
13399 return false;
13400 spline->controllist.push_back(std::make_shared<DRW_Coord>(reader->getDouble(), 0.0, 0.0));
13401 break;
13402 }
13403 if (pt) pt->basePoint.x = reader->getDouble();
13404 else if (pline) {
13405 if (pline->vertlist.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
13406 || (m_dxfPolylineVertexCountExpected >= 0
13407 && pline->vertlist.size()
13408 >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfPolylineVertexCountExpected)))
13409 return false;
13410 plvert = pline->addVertex();
13411 plvert->x = reader->getDouble();
13412 } else if (m_dxfSeedPointsExpected < 0) {
13413 return DRW_Point::parseCode(code, reader);
13414 } else {
13415 // After group 98 the boundary path is closed; seed-point
13416 // coords arrive as group-10/20 pairs.
13417 if (seedPoints.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSeedPointsExpected))
13418 return false;
13419 DRW_Coord seed;
13420 seed.x = reader->getDouble();
13421 seedPoints.push_back(seed);
13422 }
13423 break;
13424 case 20:
13425 if (spline && !spline->controllist.empty()) {
13426 spline->controllist.back()->y = reader->getDouble();
13427 break;
13428 }
13429 if (pt) pt->basePoint.y = reader->getDouble();
13430 else if (plvert) plvert ->y = reader->getDouble();
13431 else if (m_dxfSeedPointsExpected >= 0) {
13432 if (seedPoints.empty())
13433 return false;
13434 seedPoints.back().y = reader->getDouble();
13435 } else {
13436 return DRW_Point::parseCode(code, reader);
13437 }
13438 break;
13439 case 11:
13440 // Spline edge: 11 is a fit-point x-coord.
13441 if (spline) {
13442 if (spline->fitlist.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
13443 || (m_dxfSplineFitCountExpected >= 0
13444 && spline->fitlist.size()
13445 >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSplineFitCountExpected)))
13446 return false;
13447 spline->fitlist.push_back(std::make_shared<DRW_Coord>(reader->getDouble(), 0.0, 0.0));
13448 break;
13449 }
13450 if (line) line->secPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
13451 else if (ellipse) ellipse->secPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
13452 break;
13453 case 21:
13454 if (spline && !spline->fitlist.empty()) {
13455 spline->fitlist.back()->y = reader->getDouble();
13456 break;
13457 }
13458 if (line) line->secPoint.y = reader->getDouble();
13459 else if (ellipse) ellipse->secPoint.y = reader->getDouble();
13460 break;
13461 case 12:
13462 if (spline) { spline->tgStart.x = reader->getDouble(); break; }
13463 break;
13464 case 22:
13465 if (spline) { spline->tgStart.y = reader->getDouble(); break; }
13466 break;
13467 case 13:
13468 if (spline) { spline->tgEnd.x = reader->getDouble(); break; }
13469 break;
13470 case 23:
13471 if (spline) { spline->tgEnd.y = reader->getDouble(); break; }
13472 break;
13473 case 40:
13474 // Spline edge: 40 is a knot value (occurs nknots times).
13475 if (spline) {
13476 if (spline->knotslist.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
13477 || (m_dxfSplineKnotCountExpected >= 0
13478 && spline->knotslist.size()
13479 >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSplineKnotCountExpected)))
13480 return false;
13481 spline->knotslist.push_back(reader->getDouble());
13482 break;
13483 }
13484 if (arc) arc->radious = reader->getDouble();
13485 else if (ellipse) ellipse->ratio = reader->getDouble();
13486 break;
13487 case 41:
13488 scale = reader->getDouble();
13489 break;
13490 case 42:
13491 // Spline edge: 42 is a per-control-point weight.
13492 if (spline) {
13493 if (spline->weightlist.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
13494 || (m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected >= 0
13495 && spline->weightlist.size()
13496 >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected)))
13497 return false;
13498 spline->weightlist.push_back(reader->getDouble());
13499 break;
13500 }
13501 if (plvert) plvert ->bulge = reader->getDouble();
13502 break;
13503 case 50:
13504 if (arc) arc->staangle = reader->getDouble()/ARAD57.29577951308232;
13505 else if (ellipse) ellipse->staparam = reader->getDouble()/ARAD57.29577951308232;
13506 break;
13507 case 51:
13508 if (arc) arc->endangle = reader->getDouble()/ARAD57.29577951308232;
13509 else if (ellipse) ellipse->endparam = reader->getDouble()/ARAD57.29577951308232;
13510 break;
13511 case 47:
13512 pixelSize = reader->getDouble();
13513 break;
13514 case 52:
13515 angle = reader->getDouble();
13516 break;
13517 case 53: // pattern line angle — starts a new PatternLine record
13518 if (!validateCurrentPatternLineDxf())
13519 return false;
13520 if (m_dxfPatternLineCountExpected >= 0
13521 && patternLines.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfPatternLineCountExpected))
13522 return false;
13523 if (patternLines.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems))
13524 return false;
13525 patternLines.push_back(PatternLine());
13526 patternLines.back().angle = reader->getDouble();
13527 m_dxfPatternDashCountExpected = -1;
13528 m_dxfPatternDashCountSeen = false;
13529 break;
13530 case 43:
13531 if (!patternLines.empty()) patternLines.back().baseX = reader->getDouble();
13532 break;
13533 case 44:
13534 if (!patternLines.empty()) patternLines.back().baseY = reader->getDouble();
13535 break;
13536 case 45:
13537 if (!patternLines.empty()) patternLines.back().offsetX = reader->getDouble();
13538 break;
13539 case 46:
13540 if (!patternLines.empty()) patternLines.back().offsetY = reader->getDouble();
13541 break;
13542 case 79: // dash count — the 49s that follow will accumulate
13543 if (patternLines.empty() || m_dxfPatternDashCountSeen)
13544 return false;
13545 m_dxfPatternDashCountExpected = reader->getInt32();
13546 if (!isValidCount(m_dxfPatternDashCountExpected, kMaxHatchItems))
13547 return false;
13548 m_dxfPatternDashCountSeen = true;
13549 return DRW::reserve(patternLines.back().dashList, m_dxfPatternDashCountExpected);
13550 case 49:
13551 if (patternLines.empty()
13552 || patternLines.back().dashList.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
13553 || (m_dxfPatternDashCountExpected >= 0
13554 && patternLines.back().dashList.size()
13555 >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfPatternDashCountExpected)))
13556 return false;
13557 patternLines.back().dashList.push_back(reader->getDouble());
13558 break;
13559 case 73:
13560 // Spline edge: 73 is the rational flag (1 = rational).
13561 if (spline) {
13562 if (reader->getInt32()) spline->flags |= 0x4;
13563 break;
13564 }
13565 if (arc) arc->isccw = reader->getInt32();
13566 // polyline path: 73 is the is-closed flag -> set bit 0 only, leaving the
13567 // rest of pline->flags untouched (order-independent vs code 72).
13568 else if (pline) pline->flags = (pline->flags & ~1) | (reader->getInt32() ? 1 : 0);
13569 break;
13570 case 74:
13571 // Spline edge: 74 is the periodic flag (1 = periodic/closed).
13572 if (spline) {
13573 if (reader->getInt32()) spline->flags |= 0x2;
13574 }
13575 break;
13576 case 94:
13577 // Spline edge degree.
13578 if (spline) {
13579 spline->degree = reader->getInt32();
13580 return isValidCount(spline->degree, kMaxSplineDegree)
13581 && spline->degree != 0;
13582 }
13583 break;
13584 case 95:
13585 // Spline edge number of knots.
13586 if (spline) {
13587 if (m_dxfSplineKnotCountExpected >= 0)
13588 return false;
13589 spline->nknots = reader->getInt32();
13590 if (!isValidCount(spline->nknots, kMaxHatchItems))
13591 return false;
13592 m_dxfSplineKnotCountExpected = spline->nknots;
13593 return DRW::reserve(spline->knotslist, spline->nknots);
13594 }
13595 break;
13596 case 96:
13597 // Spline edge number of control points.
13598 if (spline) {
13599 if (m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected >= 0)
13600 return false;
13601 spline->ncontrol = reader->getInt32();
13602 if (!isValidCount(spline->ncontrol, kMaxHatchItems))
13603 return false;
13604 m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected = spline->ncontrol;
13605 return DRW::reserve(spline->controllist, spline->ncontrol);
13606 }
13607 break;
13608 case 97:
13609 if (spline) {
13610 if (!m_splineNfitSet) {
13611 // First 97 in this spline edge = fit-point count (nfit).
13612 spline->nfit = reader->getInt32();
13613 if (!isValidCount(spline->nfit, kMaxHatchItems))
13614 return false;
13615 if (m_dxfSplineFitCountExpected >= 0)
13616 return false;
13617 m_dxfSplineFitCountExpected = spline->nfit;
13618 if (!DRW::reserve(spline->fitlist, spline->nfit))
13619 return false;
13620 if (spline->nfit == 0) {
13621 if (!validateCurrentSplineDxf())
13622 return false;
13623 // No fit points or tangents follow; safe to clear spline
13624 // so the next code-97 (loop boundary count) is not
13625 // misinterpreted as another nfit.
13626 spline.reset();
13627 } else {
13628 m_splineNfitSet = true;
13629 }
13630 } else {
13631 // Second 97 while spline is active = loop boundary handle count.
13632 if (!validateCurrentSplineDxf())
13633 return false;
13634 spline.reset();
13635 m_splineNfitSet = false;
13636 m_boundaryHandleCount = reader->getInt32();
13637 if (!isValidCount(m_boundaryHandleCount, kMaxHatchItems))
13638 return false;
13639 if (m_dxfBoundaryHandleCountSeen)
13640 return false;
13641 m_dxfBoundaryHandleCountSeen = true;
13642 if (m_boundaryHandleCount > 0 && loop
13643 && !DRW::reserve(loop->m_boundaryHandles, m_boundaryHandleCount))
13644 return false;
13645 }
13646 break;
13647 }
13648 // No active spline: this is the loop boundary handle count.
13649 m_splineNfitSet = false;
13650 if (m_dxfBoundaryHandleCountSeen)
13651 return false;
13652 m_boundaryHandleCount = reader->getInt32();
13653 if (!isValidCount(m_boundaryHandleCount, kMaxHatchItems))
13654 return false;
13655 m_dxfBoundaryHandleCountSeen = true;
13656 if (m_boundaryHandleCount > 0 && loop
13657 && !DRW::reserve(loop->m_boundaryHandles, m_boundaryHandleCount))
13658 return false;
13659 break;
13660 case 330:
13661 if (m_boundaryHandleCount > 0 && loop) {
13662 // getHandleString() converts the hex string to int for us.
13663 loop->m_boundaryHandles.push_back(
13664 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getHandleString()));
13665 --m_boundaryHandleCount;
13666 break;
13667 }
13668 if (m_dxfBoundaryHandleCountSeen)
13669 return false;
13670 return DRW_Point::parseCode(code, reader);
13671 case 75:
13672 hstyle = reader->getInt32();
13673 break;
13674 case 76:
13675 hpattern = reader->getInt32();
13676 break;
13677 case 77:
13678 doubleflag = reader->getInt32();
13679 break;
13680 case 78:
13681 if (m_dxfPatternLineCountSeen)
13682 return false;
13683 deflines = reader->getInt32();
13684 if (!isValidCount(deflines, kMaxHatchItems))
13685 return false;
13686 m_dxfPatternLineCountExpected = deflines;
13687 m_dxfPatternLineCountSeen = true;
13688 if (patternLines.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(deflines))
13689 return false;
13690 break;
13691 case 91:
13692 if (m_dxfLoopCountSeen)
13693 return false;
13694 loopsnum = reader->getInt32();
13695 if (!isValidCount(loopsnum, kMaxHatchItems))
13696 return false;
13697 m_dxfLoopCountExpected = loopsnum;
13698 m_dxfLoopCountSeen = true;
13699 return DRW::reserve( looplist, loopsnum);
13700 case 92: {
13701 if (!validateCurrentBoundaryPathDxf())
13702 return false;
13703 if (m_dxfLoopCountExpected >= 0
13704 && looplist.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfLoopCountExpected))
13705 return false;
13706 clearEntities();
13707 m_dxfLoopEdgeCountExpected = -1;
13708 m_dxfLoopEdgeCountSeen = false;
13709 m_dxfPolylineVertexCountExpected = -1;
13710 m_dxfPolylineVertexCountSeen = false;
13711 m_dxfBoundaryHandleCountSeen = false;
13712 m_boundaryHandleCount = 0;
13713 loop = std::make_shared<DRW_HatchLoop>(reader->getInt32());
13714 looplist.push_back(loop);
13715 if (reader->getInt32() & 2) {
13716 ispol = true;
13717 clearEntities();
13718 pline = std::make_shared<DRW_LWPolyline>();
13719 loop->objlist.push_back(pline);
13720 } else ispol = false;
13721 break;
13722 }
13723 case 93:
13724 if (pline) {
13725 if (m_dxfPolylineVertexCountSeen)
13726 return false;
13727 pline->vertexnum = reader->getInt32();
13728 if (!isValidCount(pline->vertexnum, kMaxHatchItems))
13729 return false;
13730 m_dxfPolylineVertexCountExpected = pline->vertexnum;
13731 m_dxfPolylineVertexCountSeen = true;
13732 } else if (loop) {
13733 if (m_dxfLoopEdgeCountSeen)
13734 return false;
13735 loop->numedges = reader->getInt32();//aqui reserve
13736 if (!isValidCount(loop->numedges, kMaxHatchItems))
13737 return false;
13738 if (loop->objlist.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(loop->numedges))
13739 return false;
13740 m_dxfLoopEdgeCountExpected = loop->numedges;
13741 m_dxfLoopEdgeCountSeen = true;
13742 }
13743 break;
13744 case 98: { // seed-point count; coords follow as group-10/20 pairs
13745 if (!validateCurrentBoundaryPathDxf() || !validateCurrentPatternLineDxf())
13746 return false;
13747 if (m_dxfSeedPointCountSeen)
13748 return false;
13749 clearEntities();
13750 const int count = reader->getInt32();
13751 if (!isValidCount(count, kMaxHatchItems)
13752 || !DRW::reserve(seedPoints, count))
13753 return false;
13754 m_dxfSeedPointsExpected = count;
13755 m_dxfSeedPointCountSeen = true;
13756 break;
13757 }
13758 case 450:
13759 isGradient = reader->getInt32();
13760 break;
13761 case 451:
13762 gradReserved = reader->getInt32();
13763 break;
13764 case 452:
13765 singleColor = reader->getInt32();
13766 break;
13767 case 453: {
13768 if (m_dxfGradientColorCountSeen)
13769 return false;
13770 const int n = reader->getInt32();
13771 if (!isValidCount(n, kMaxHatchItems)
13772 || !DRW::reserve(gradColors, n))
13773 return false;
13774 m_dxfGradientColorCountExpected = n;
13775 m_dxfGradientColorCountSeen = true;
13776 break;
13777 }
13778 case 460:
13779 gradAngle = reader->getDouble();
13780 break;
13781 case 461:
13782 gradShift = reader->getDouble();
13783 break;
13784 case 462:
13785 gradTint = reader->getDouble();
13786 break;
13787 case 463: {
13788 if (m_dxfGradientColorCountExpected >= 0
13789 && gradColors.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfGradientColorCountExpected))
13790 return false;
13791 if (gradColors.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems))
13792 return false;
13793 DRW_Hatch::GradientStop stop;
13794 stop.value = reader->getDouble();
13795 gradColors.push_back(stop);
13796 break;
13797 }
13798 case 421:
13799 if (!gradColors.empty())
13800 gradColors.back().rgb = reader->getInt32();
13801 break;
13802 case 63:
13803 if (!gradColors.empty())
13804 gradColors.back().aciColor = reader->getInt32();
13805 else
13806 return DRW_Point::parseCode(code, reader);
13807 break;
13808 case 431:
13809 if (!gradColors.empty())
13810 gradColors.back().colorMethod = reader->getInt32();
13811 break;
13812 case 432:
13813 if (!gradColors.empty())
13814 gradColors.back().colorName = reader->getUtf8String();
13815 break;
13816 case 433:
13817 if (!gradColors.empty())
13818 gradColors.back().colorBookName = reader->getUtf8String();
13819 break;
13820 case 470:
13821 gradName = reader->getUtf8String();
13822 break;
13823 default:
13824 return DRW_Point::parseCode(code, reader);
13825 }
13826
13827 return true;
13828 }
13829 catch (...) {
13830 return false;
13831 }
13832}
13833
13834bool DRW_Hatch::validateCurrentSplineDxf() const {
13835 if (!spline)
13836 return true;
13837 if (m_dxfSplineKnotCountExpected >= 0
13838 && spline->knotslist.size()
13839 != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSplineKnotCountExpected))
13840 return false;
13841 if (m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected >= 0
13842 && spline->controllist.size()
13843 != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected))
13844 return false;
13845 if (m_dxfSplineFitCountExpected >= 0
13846 && spline->fitlist.size()
13847 != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSplineFitCountExpected))
13848 return false;
13849 if (spline->flags & 0x4)
13850 return m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected < 0
13851 || spline->weightlist.size()
13852 == static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSplineControlCountExpected);
13853 return spline->weightlist.empty();
13854}
13855
13856bool DRW_Hatch::validateCurrentPatternLineDxf() const {
13857 if (patternLines.empty() || m_dxfPatternDashCountExpected < 0)
13858 return true;
13859 return patternLines.back().dashList.size()
13860 == static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfPatternDashCountExpected);
13861}
13862
13863bool DRW_Hatch::validateCurrentBoundaryPathDxf() const {
13864 if (m_boundaryHandleCount != 0 || !validateCurrentSplineDxf())
13865 return false;
13866 if (!loop)
13867 return true;
13868 if (ispol) {
13869 std::shared_ptr<DRW_LWPolyline> polyline = pline;
13870 if (!polyline && loop->objlist.size() == 1)
13871 polyline = std::dynamic_pointer_cast<DRW_LWPolyline>(loop->objlist.front());
13872 if (!polyline)
13873 return false;
13874 return !m_dxfPolylineVertexCountSeen
13875 || polyline->vertlist.size()
13876 == static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfPolylineVertexCountExpected);
13877 }
13878 return !m_dxfLoopEdgeCountSeen
13879 || loop->objlist.size()
13880 == static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfLoopEdgeCountExpected);
13881}
13882
13883bool DRW_Hatch::validateDxf() const {
13884 if (!validateCurrentBoundaryPathDxf()
13885 || !validateCurrentPatternLineDxf())
13886 return false;
13887 if (m_dxfLoopCountExpected >= 0
13888 && looplist.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfLoopCountExpected))
13889 return false;
13890 if (m_dxfPatternLineCountExpected >= 0
13891 && patternLines.size()
13892 != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfPatternLineCountExpected))
13893 return false;
13894 if (m_dxfGradientColorCountExpected >= 0
13895 && gradColors.size()
13896 != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfGradientColorCountExpected))
13897 return false;
13898 return m_dxfSeedPointsExpected < 0
13899 || seedPoints.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfSeedPointsExpected);
13900}
13901
13902bool DRW_MPolygon::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
13903 // MPOLYGON shares HATCH's boundary/pattern/gradient codes, so delegate those
13904 // to DRW_Hatch::parseCode. It adds a trailer that plain HATCH never emits:
13905 // 63 / 421 / 430 fill color (ACI / RGB / book-name) — the filled area's
13906 // color, which may differ from the boundary outline color;
13907 // 11 / 21 boundary x-direction vector (no render impact; left to
13908 // the base, which ignores it outside an edge context);
13909 // 99 count of degenerate boundary paths.
13910 // 63/421 are also gradient sub-codes in HATCH, so only claim them here when no
13911 // gradient is being accumulated (gradColors empty) — otherwise defer to base.
13912 switch (code) {
13913 case 63:
13914 if (gradColors.empty()) { fillColorAci = reader->getInt32(); return true; }
13915 break;
13916 case 421:
13917 if (gradColors.empty()) { fillColorRgb = reader->getInt32(); return true; }
13918 break;
13919 case 430:
13920 fillColorName = reader->getUtf8String();
13921 return true;
13922 case 99:
13923 degenerateLoops = reader->getInt32();
13924 return true;
13925 default:
13926 break;
13927 }
13928 return DRW_Hatch::parseCode(code, reader);
13929}
13930
13931// DRW_MPolygon::parseDwg — AcDbMPolygon DWG body.
13932// Layout mirrors HATCH except (per ACadSharp MPolygon / libreDWG dwg.spec):
13933// * a leading BS `style` (DXF group 75) precedes the gradient block, and
13934// * the trailer is a fill CMC + boundary x-direction (2RD) + degenerate-path
13935// count (BL) instead of HATCH's pixel-size + seed points.
13936// The gradient/elevation/extrusion/name/solid/associative prologue and the whole
13937// boundary-loop body are identical, so they reuse DRW_Hatch::parseDwgBoundaryData.
13938// DWG runtime coverage uses testdata/mpolygon_solid.dwg, ODA-synthesized from
13939// the ezdxf-verified inline DXF in mpolygon_tests.cpp and confirmed with the
13940// dwg-parser oracle.
13941bool DRW_MPolygon::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
13942 resetDwgState();
13943 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
13944 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
13945 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
13946 sourceBuf->invalidate();
13947 resetDwgState();
13948 return false;
13949 };
13950 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
13951 return fail();
13952
13953 fillColorAci = 0;
13954 fillColorRgb = -1;
13955 fillColorName.clear();
13956 xDirX = 0.0;
13957 xDirY = 0.0;
13958 degenerateLoops = 0;
13959 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
13960 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
13961 buf = &bodyProbe;
13962 dwgBuffer *sBuf = version > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringProbe : buf;
13963 std::uint32_t totalBoundItems = 0;
13964 bool havePixelSize = false;
13965 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(
13966 version, buf, version > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringProbe : nullptr, bs)
13967 || !buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
13968 return fail();
13969 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing mpolygon *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing mpolygon *********************************************\n"
);
13970 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
13971 std::uint64_t stringStartBit = bodyEndBit;
13972 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
13973 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
13974 stringStartBit = currentDwgBit(sBuf);
13975 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
13976 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
13977 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*sBuf, version, objSize,
13978 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
13979 return fail();
13980 }
13981 }
13982
13983 // Leading BS style (group 75) — read once here and again after the loops
13984 // below (HATCH has only the latter); matches the reference parser, which
13985 // discards this first read.
13986 std::uint16_t parsedLeadingStyle = 0;
13987 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedLeadingStyle))
13988 return fail();
13989 hstyle = parsedLeadingStyle;
13990
13991 if (version > DRW::AC1015) { //2004+ gradient (same layout as HATCH)
13992 if (!readBoundedHatchGradient(
13993 *buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version, isGradient, gradReserved,
13994 gradAngle, gradShift, singleColor, gradTint, gradName,
13995 gradColors, stringEndBit))
13996 return fail();
13997 }
13998 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint.z)
13999 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, extPoint)
14000 || !std::isfinite(basePoint.z)
14001 || !std::isfinite(extPoint.x)
14002 || !std::isfinite(extPoint.y)
14003 || !std::isfinite(extPoint.z))
14004 return fail();
14005 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedName;
14006 if (version > DRW::AC1018 && stringStartBit >= stringEndBit) {
14007 parsedName.clear();
14008 } else if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
14009 parsedName)) {
14010 return fail();
14011 }
14012 bool parsedSolid = false;
14013 bool parsedAssociative = false;
14014 if (!sBuf->isGood()
14015 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit
14016 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedSolid)
14017 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAssociative))
14018 return fail();
14019 solid = parsedSolid;
14020 associative = parsedAssociative;
14021 name = std::move(parsedName);
14022
14023 if (!parseDwgBoundaryData(version, buf, totalBoundItems, havePixelSize))
14024 return fail();
14025
14026 std::uint16_t parsedStyle = 0;
14027 std::uint16_t parsedPattern = 0;
14028 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedStyle)
14029 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedPattern))
14030 return fail();
14031 hstyle = parsedStyle;
14032 hpattern = parsedPattern;
14033 if (!solid){
14034 double parsedAngle = 0.0;
14035 double parsedScale = 0.0;
14036 bool parsedDoubleFlag = false;
14037 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAngle)
14038 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedScale)
14039 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDoubleFlag)
14040 || !std::isfinite(parsedAngle)
14041 || !std::isfinite(parsedScale))
14042 return fail();
14043 angle = parsedAngle;
14044 scale = parsedScale;
14045 doubleflag = parsedDoubleFlag;
14046 std::uint32_t parsedDeflines = 0;
14047 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxHatchItems, 12,
14048 parsedDeflines))
14049 return fail();
14050 if (!DRW::reserve(patternLines, parsedDeflines))
14051 return fail();
14052 deflines = static_cast<int>(parsedDeflines);
14053 for (std::uint32_t i = 0 ; i < parsedDeflines; ++i){
14054 PatternLine patternLine;
14055 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, patternLine.angle)
14056 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, patternLine.baseX)
14057 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, patternLine.baseY)
14058 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, patternLine.offsetX)
14059 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, patternLine.offsetY)
14060 || !std::isfinite(patternLine.angle)
14061 || !std::isfinite(patternLine.baseX)
14062 || !std::isfinite(patternLine.baseY)
14063 || !std::isfinite(patternLine.offsetX)
14064 || !std::isfinite(patternLine.offsetY))
14065 return fail();
14066 std::uint32_t numDashL = 0;
14067 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxHatchItems, 2,
14068 numDashL)
14069 || !proxyEntityHasBits(
14070 *buf, bodyEndBit, static_cast<std::uint64_t>(numDashL) * 2u)
14071 || !DRW::reserve(patternLine.dashList, numDashL))
14072 return fail();
14073 for (std::uint32_t d = 0 ; d < numDashL; ++d) {
14074 double dash = 0.0;
14075 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, dash)
14076 || !std::isfinite(dash))
14077 return fail();
14078 patternLine.dashList.push_back(dash);
14079 }
14080 patternLines.push_back(std::move(patternLine));
14081 }
14082 }
14083
14084 // MPOLYGON trailer (differs from HATCH): fill CMC + x-direction + degenerate
14085 // path count. No pixel size / seed points here.
14086 std::int32_t rgb = -1;
14087 UTF8STRINGstd::string colName;
14088 std::uint32_t parsedFillColor = 0;
14089 if (!readBoundedCmColor(*buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version,
14090 parsedFillColor, &rgb, nullptr, &colName))
14091 return fail();
14092 fillColorAci = static_cast<int>(parsedFillColor);
14093 fillColorRgb = rgb;
14094 fillColorName = colName;
14095 DRW_Coord xdir;
14096 if (!readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, xdir)
14097 || !std::isfinite(xdir.x) || !std::isfinite(xdir.y))
14098 return fail();
14099 xDirX = xdir.x;
14100 xDirY = xdir.y;
14101 std::uint32_t parsedDegenerateLoops = 0;
14102 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxHatchItems, 0,
14103 parsedDegenerateLoops))
14104 return fail();
14105 degenerateLoops = static_cast<std::int32_t>(parsedDegenerateLoops);
14106
14107 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
14108 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
14109 handleEndBit))
14110 return fail();
14111 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
14112 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
14113 handleEndBit)
14114 || !handleProbe.isGood())
14115 return fail();
14116 for (std::uint32_t i = 0 ; i < totalBoundItems; ++i) {
14117 dwgHandle boundaryHandle;
14118 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, false,
14119 boundaryHandle))
14120 return fail();
14121 }
14122 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
14123 return fail();
14124
14125 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
14126 return true;
14127}
14128
14129// Shared DWG boundary-loop reader for HATCH and MPOLYGON (ODA §20.4.36).
14130// Reads the loop count and, per loop, the derived-boundary flag plus its edge
14131// list or polyline. Accumulates the running boundary-source-handle total and
14132// whether any loop is derived (needs a trailing pixel size). Extracted from
14133// DRW_Hatch::parseDwg so DRW_MPolygon::parseDwg reuses the identical body while
14134// supplying its own differing leading (BS style) and trailing (fill CMC +
14135// x-direction + degenerate count) field order.
14136bool validateDwgHatchData(const DRW_Hatch& hatch) {
14137 if (hatch.looplist.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
14138 || hatch.patternLines.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
14139 || hatch.gradColors.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
14140 || hatch.seedPoints.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems))
14141 return false;
14142
14143 for (const auto& loop : hatch.looplist) {
14144 if (!loop
14145 || loop->objlist.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
14146 || loop->m_boundaryHandles.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems))
14147 return false;
14148
14149 if ((loop->type & 2) != 0) {
14150 if (loop->objlist.size() != 1)
14151 return false;
14152 const auto* polyline =
14153 dynamic_cast<const DRW_LWPolyline*>(loop->objlist.front().get());
14154 if (!polyline || polyline->vertlist.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems))
14155 return false;
14156 for (const auto& vertex : polyline->vertlist) {
14157 if (!vertex)
14158 return false;
14159 }
14160 continue;
14161 }
14162
14163 for (const auto& entity : loop->objlist) {
14164 if (dynamic_cast<const DRW_Line*>(entity.get())
14165 || dynamic_cast<const DRW_Arc*>(entity.get())
14166 || dynamic_cast<const DRW_Ellipse*>(entity.get())) {
14167 continue;
14168 }
14169 const auto* spline = dynamic_cast<const DRW_Spline*>(entity.get());
14170 if (!spline
14171 || spline->knotslist.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
14172 || spline->controllist.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems)
14173 || spline->fitlist.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems))
14174 return false;
14175 for (const auto& point : spline->controllist) {
14176 if (!point)
14177 return false;
14178 }
14179 for (const auto& point : spline->fitlist) {
14180 if (!point)
14181 return false;
14182 }
14183 }
14184 }
14185
14186 for (const auto& line : hatch.patternLines) {
14187 if (line.dashList.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxHatchItems))
14188 return false;
14189 }
14190 return true;
14191}
14192
14193bool DRW_MPolygon::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
14194 std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf,
14195 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
14196 (void)bs;
14197 if (!validateDwgHatchData(*this)
14198 || !isValidCount(degenerateLoops, kMaxHatchItems))
14199 return false;
14200 oType = kDwgClassNum;
14201 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf, strBuf))
14202 return false;
14203
14204 dwgBufferW *sb = strBuf ? strBuf : buf;
14205
14206 // AcDbMPolygon has a leading style field before the HATCH-like gradient
14207 // prologue. The same style is emitted again after the boundary data.
14208 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(hstyle));
14209 encodeDwgGradientData(version, buf, sb);
14210
14211 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
14212 buf->put3BitDouble(extPoint);
14213 sb->putVariableText(version, name);
14214 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(solid));
14215 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(associative));
14216 if (!encodeDwgBoundaryData(version, buf)) return false;
14217
14218 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(hstyle));
14219 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(hpattern));
14220
14221 if (!solid) {
14222 buf->putBitDouble(angle);
14223 buf->putBitDouble(scale);
14224 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(doubleflag));
14225 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(patternLines.size()));
14226 for (const PatternLine& pl : patternLines) {
14227 buf->putBitDouble(pl.angle);
14228 buf->putBitDouble(pl.baseX);
14229 buf->putBitDouble(pl.baseY);
14230 buf->putBitDouble(pl.offsetX);
14231 buf->putBitDouble(pl.offsetY);
14232 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(pl.dashList.size()));
14233 for (double dash : pl.dashList)
14234 buf->putBitDouble(dash);
14235 }
14236 }
14237
14238 buf->putCmColor(version,
14239 static_cast<std::uint16_t>(fillColorAci),
14240 fillColorRgb,
14241 fillColorName,
14242 {},
14243 sb);
14244 buf->put2RawDouble(DRW_Coord{xDirX, xDirY, 0.0});
14245 buf->putBitLong(degenerateLoops);
14246
14247 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
14248}
14249
14250bool DRW_Hatch::parseDwgBoundaryData(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
14251 std::uint32_t &totalBoundItems, bool &havePixelSize) {
14252 try {
14253 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
14254 std::uint32_t parsedLoopCount = 0;
14255 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxHatchItems, 4,
14256 parsedLoopCount))
14257 return false;
14258 if (!DRW::reserve(looplist, parsedLoopCount))
14259 return false;
14260 loopsnum = static_cast<std::int32_t>(parsedLoopCount);
14261 DRW_DBG("solid: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("solid: "); DRW_DBG(solid)DRW_dbg::dbg(solid); DRW_DBG(" associative: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" associative: "); DRW_DBG(associative)DRW_dbg::dbg(associative);
14262 DRW_DBG(" loopsnum: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" loopsnum: "); DRW_DBG(loopsnum)DRW_dbg::dbg(loopsnum); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
14263
14264 //read loops
14265 for (std::uint32_t i = 0 ; i < parsedLoopCount; ++i){
14266 std::int32_t loopType = 0;
14267 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, loopType)
14268 || loopType < 0)
14269 return false;
14270 loop = std::make_shared<DRW_HatchLoop>(loopType);
14271 havePixelSize = havePixelSize || ((loop->type & 4) != 0);
14272 DRW_DBG(" loop[")DRW_dbg::dbg(" loop["); DRW_DBG(i)DRW_dbg::dbg(i); DRW_DBG("] type: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("] type: "); DRW_DBG(loop->type)DRW_dbg::dbg(loop->type);
14273 if (!(loop->type & 2)){ //Not polyline
14274 std::uint32_t numPathSeg = 0;
14275 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxHatchItems, 8,
14276 numPathSeg))
14277 return false;
14278 if (!DRW::reserve(loop->objlist, numPathSeg))
14279 return false;
14280 DRW_DBG(" numPathSeg: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" numPathSeg: "); DRW_DBG(numPathSeg)DRW_dbg::dbg(numPathSeg); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
14281 for (std::uint32_t j = 0; j<numPathSeg;++j){
14282 std::uint8_t typePath = 0;
14283 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, typePath)
14284 || typePath < 1 || typePath > 4)
14285 return false;
14286 DRW_DBG(" seg[")DRW_dbg::dbg(" seg["); DRW_DBG(j)DRW_dbg::dbg(j); DRW_DBG("] typePath: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("] typePath: "); DRW_DBG(typePath)DRW_dbg::dbg(typePath); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
14287 if (typePath == 1){ //line
14288 DRW_Coord basePoint;
14289 DRW_Coord secPoint;
14290 if (!readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint)
14291 || !readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, secPoint))
14292 return false;
14293 addLine();
14294 line->basePoint = basePoint;
14295 line->secPoint = secPoint;
14296 } else if (typePath == 2){ //circle arc
14297 DRW_Coord basePoint;
14298 double radius = 0.0;
14299 double startAngle = 0.0;
14300 double endAngle = 0.0;
14301 bool isCcw = false;
14302 if (!readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint)
14303 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, radius)
14304 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, startAngle)
14305 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, endAngle)
14306 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, isCcw)
14307 || !std::isfinite(basePoint.x)
14308 || !std::isfinite(basePoint.y)
14309 || !std::isfinite(radius)
14310 || !std::isfinite(startAngle)
14311 || !std::isfinite(endAngle))
14312 return false;
14313 addArc();
14314 arc->basePoint = basePoint;
14315 arc->radious = radius;
14316 arc->staangle = startAngle;
14317 arc->endangle = endAngle;
14318 arc->isccw = isCcw;
14319 } else if (typePath == 3){ //ellipse arc
14320 DRW_Coord basePoint;
14321 DRW_Coord secPoint;
14322 double ratio = 0.0;
14323 double startParam = 0.0;
14324 double endParam = 0.0;
14325 bool isCcw = false;
14326 if (!readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint)
14327 || !readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, secPoint)
14328 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ratio)
14329 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, startParam)
14330 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, endParam)
14331 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, isCcw)
14332 || !std::isfinite(basePoint.x)
14333 || !std::isfinite(basePoint.y)
14334 || !std::isfinite(secPoint.x)
14335 || !std::isfinite(secPoint.y)
14336 || !std::isfinite(ratio)
14337 || !std::isfinite(startParam)
14338 || !std::isfinite(endParam))
14339 return false;
14340 addEllipse();
14341 ellipse->basePoint = basePoint;
14342 ellipse->secPoint = secPoint;
14343 ellipse->ratio = ratio;
14344 ellipse->staparam = startParam;
14345 ellipse->endparam = endParam;
14346 ellipse->isccw = isCcw;
14347 } else if (typePath == 4){ //spline
14348 std::int32_t degree = 0;
14349 bool isRational = false;
14350 bool isPeriodic = false;
14351 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, degree)
14352 || !isValidSplineDegree(degree)
14353 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, isRational)
14354 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, isPeriodic))
14355 return false;
14356 std::uint32_t knotCount = 0;
14357 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize,
14358 kMaxHatchItems, 2, knotCount)) {
14359 return false;
14360 }
14361 std::uint32_t controlCount = 0;
14362 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize,
14363 kMaxHatchItems, 128, controlCount)) {
14364 return false;
14365 }
14366 DRW_Spline parsedSpline;
14367 parsedSpline.degree = degree;
14368 parsedSpline.nknots = static_cast<std::int32_t>(knotCount);
14369 parsedSpline.ncontrol = static_cast<std::int32_t>(controlCount);
14370 parsedSpline.flags = (isRational ? 4 : 0)
14371 | (isPeriodic ? 2 : 0);
14372 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedSpline.knotslist, knotCount)
14373 || !DRW::reserve(parsedSpline.controllist, controlCount))
14374 return false;
14375 for (std::uint32_t j = 0; j < knotCount;++j){
14376 double knot = 0.0;
14377 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, knot)
14378 || !std::isfinite(knot))
14379 return false;
14380 parsedSpline.knotslist.push_back(knot);
14381 }
14382 for (std::uint32_t j = 0; j < controlCount;++j){
14383 DRW_Coord control;
14384 if (!readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, control)
14385 || !std::isfinite(control.x)
14386 || !std::isfinite(control.y))
14387 return false;
14388 if (isRational) {
14389 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, control.z)
14390 || !std::isfinite(control.z))
14391 return false;
14392 }
14393 parsedSpline.controllist.push_back(
14394 std::make_shared<DRW_Coord>(control));
14395 }
14396 if (version > DRW::AC1021) { //2010+
14397 std::uint32_t fitCount = 0;
14398 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize,
14399 kMaxHatchItems, 128, fitCount))
14400 return false;
14401 parsedSpline.nfit = static_cast<std::int32_t>(fitCount);
14402 // Fit points AND the start/end tangents are present only
14403 // when nfit > 0 (matches ACadSharp's `if (nfitPoints > 0)`).
14404 // Reading the two tangents unconditionally on an nfit==0
14405 // spline edge over-runs the entity body and fails the parse
14406 // (e.g. svg/export_sample.dwg: a degree-3 non-rational
14407 // spline boundary edge with 9 control points / 0 fit points).
14408 if (parsedSpline.nfit > 0) {
14409 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedSpline.fitlist, fitCount)) {
14410 return false;
14411 }
14412 for (std::uint32_t j = 0; j < fitCount;++j){
14413 DRW_Coord fit;
14414 if (!readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, fit)
14415 || !std::isfinite(fit.x)
14416 || !std::isfinite(fit.y))
14417 return false;
14418 parsedSpline.fitlist.push_back(
14419 std::make_shared<DRW_Coord>(fit));
14420 }
14421 if (!readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
14422 parsedSpline.tgStart)
14423 || !readBounded2RawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
14424 parsedSpline.tgEnd)
14425 || !std::isfinite(parsedSpline.tgStart.x)
14426 || !std::isfinite(parsedSpline.tgStart.y)
14427 || !std::isfinite(parsedSpline.tgEnd.x)
14428 || !std::isfinite(parsedSpline.tgEnd.y))
14429 return false;
14430 }
14431 }
14432 addSpline();
14433 *spline = std::move(parsedSpline);
14434 }
14435 }
14436 } else { //end not pline, start polyline
14437 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, 2))
14438 return false;
14439 bool asBulge = false;
14440 bool closed = false;
14441 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, asBulge)
14442 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, closed))
14443 return false;
14444 std::uint32_t numVert = 0;
14445 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxHatchItems,
14446 128, numVert))
14447 return false;
14448 if (!DRW::reserve(loop->objlist, 1))
14449 return false;
14450 DRW_DBG(" asBulge: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" asBulge: "); DRW_DBG(asBulge)DRW_dbg::dbg(asBulge); DRW_DBG(" closed: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" closed: "); DRW_DBG(closed)DRW_dbg::dbg(closed);
14451 DRW_DBG(" numVert: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" numVert: "); DRW_DBG(numVert)DRW_dbg::dbg(numVert); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
14452 std::vector<DRW_Vertex2D> vertices;
14453 if (!DRW::reserve(vertices, numVert))
14454 return false;
14455 for (std::uint32_t j = 0; j<numVert;++j){
14456 DRW_Vertex2D v;
14457 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, v.x)
14458 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, v.y)
14459 || !std::isfinite(v.x) || !std::isfinite(v.y))
14460 return false;
14461 if (asBulge
14462 && (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, v.bulge)
14463 || !std::isfinite(v.bulge)))
14464 return false;

14467 pline = std::make_shared<DRW_LWPolyline>();

14473 loop->update();

14476 boundaryHandleCount)

14481 DRW_DBG(" totalBoundItems: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" totalBoundItems: "); DRW_DBG(totalBoundItems)DRW_dbg::dbg(totalBoundItems);

14719 } else if (const auto* arc = dynamic_cast<const DRW_Arc*>(seg.get())) {
14720 buf->putRawChar8(2); // circular arc

14723 buf->putBitDouble(arc->staangle);
14724 buf->putBitDouble(arc->endangle);
14725 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(arc->isccw));
14726 } else if (const auto* el = dynamic_cast<const DRW_Ellipse*>(seg.get())) {
14727 buf->putRawChar8(3); // ellipse arc
14728 buf->put2RawDouble(el->basePoint);
14729 buf->put2RawDouble(el->secPoint);
14730 buf->putBitDouble(el->ratio);
14731 buf->putBitDouble(el->staparam);
14732 buf->putBitDouble(el->endparam);
14733 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(el->isccw));
14734 } else if (const auto* sp = dynamic_cast<const DRW_Spline*>(seg.get())) {
14735 buf->putRawChar8(4); // spline
14736 buf->putBitLong(sp->degree);
14737 bool isRational = (sp->flags & 4) != 0;
14738 bool isPeriodic = (sp->flags & 2) != 0;
14739 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(isRational));
14740 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(isPeriodic));
14741 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(sp->knotslist.size()));
14742 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(sp->controllist.size()));
14743 for (double k : sp->knotslist)
14744 buf->putBitDouble(k);

14746 DRW_Coord c2{cp->x, cp->y, 0.0};
14747 buf->put2RawDouble(c2);
14748 if (isRational)
14749 buf->putBitDouble(cp->z);
14750 }
14751 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
14752 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(sp->fitlist.size()));
14753 for (const auto& fp : sp->fitlist) {
14754 DRW_Coord f2{fp->x, fp->y, 0.0};
14755 buf->put2RawDouble(f2);
14756 }
14757 buf->put2RawDouble(sp->tgStart);
14758 buf->put2RawDouble(sp->tgEnd);
14759 }
14760 } else {
14761 return false;
14762 }
14763 }
14764 } else {
14765 const DRW_LWPolyline* pl = nullptr;
14766 if (!lp->objlist.empty())
14767 pl = dynamic_cast<const DRW_LWPolyline*>(lp->objlist[0].get());
14768 if (!pl)
14769 return false;
14770
14771 bool asBulge = false;
14772 for (const auto& v : pl->vertlist)
14773 if (v->bulge != 0.0) { asBulge = true; break; }
14774
14775 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(asBulge));
14776 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(pl->flags & 1));
14777 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(pl->vertlist.size()));
14778 for (const auto& v : pl->vertlist) {
14779 buf->putRawDouble(v->x);
14780 buf->putRawDouble(v->y);
14781 if (asBulge)
14782 buf->putBitDouble(v->bulge);
14783 }
14784 }
14785
14786 buf->putBitLong(0); // numBoundHandles for this loop (0 = non-associative)
14787 }
14788
14789 return true;
14790}

14979 && fitlist.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(nfit))
14980 return false;
14981 return validatePayloadFields(/*allowMixedLists=*/true);
14982}
14983
14984bool DRW_Spline::validatePayloadFields(bool allowMixedLists) const {
14985 const auto finite = [](double value) { return std::isfinite(value); };
14986 const auto finiteCoord = [&finite](const DRW_Coord& point) {
14987 return finite(point.x) && finite(point.y) && finite(point.z);
14988 };
14989 const auto validCount = [](std::size_t count) {
14990 return count <= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxSplineItems)
14991 && count <= static_cast<std::size_t>(
14992 std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max());
14993 };
14994 const auto validPointList = [&finiteCoord, &validCount](const auto& points) {
14995 return validCount(points.size())
14996 && std::all_of(points.cbegin(), points.cend(),
14997 [&finiteCoord](const auto& point) {
14998 return point != nullptr && finiteCoord(*point);
14999 });
15000 };
15001
15002 if (!isValidSplineDegree(degree)
15003 || flags < 0
15004 || (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(flags) & ~0x1Fu) != 0u
15005 || !finiteCoord(normalVec) || !finiteCoord(tgStart)
15006 || !finiteCoord(tgEnd) || !finite(tolknot)
15007 || !finite(tolcontrol) || !finite(tolfit)
15008 || !validCount(knotslist.size())
15009 || !std::all_of(knotslist.cbegin(), knotslist.cend(), finite)
15010 || !validCount(weightlist.size())
15011 || !std::all_of(weightlist.cbegin(), weightlist.cend(), finite)
15012 || !validPointList(controllist) || !validPointList(fitlist)
15013 || weightlist.size() > controllist.size())
15014 return false;
15015
15016 // The DWG body has disjoint control-point and fit-point scenarios. When
15017 // both lists are present, the encoder selects control points and would
15018 // silently discard the fit points, so reject that lossy representation.
15019 if (!allowMixedLists && !fitlist.empty() && !controllist.empty())
15020 return false;
15021 if (!fitlist.empty() && !controllist.empty())
15022 return isValidControlSplineLayout(
15023 degree, static_cast<std::int32_t>(knotslist.size()),
15024 static_cast<std::int32_t>(controllist.size()))
15025 && isValidFitSplineLayout(
15026 degree, static_cast<std::int32_t>(fitlist.size()));
15027 if (!fitlist.empty())
15028 return isValidFitSplineLayout(
15029 degree, static_cast<std::int32_t>(fitlist.size()));
15030 return isValidControlSplineLayout(
15031 degree, static_cast<std::int32_t>(knotslist.size()),
15032 static_cast<std::int32_t>(controllist.size()));
15033}
15034
15035bool DRW_Helix::validateDxf() const {
15036 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
15037 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
15038 && std::isfinite(point.z);
15039 };
15040 return DRW_Spline::validateDxf()
15041 && finite(axisBasePt) && finite(startPt) && finite(axisVector)
15042 && std::isfinite(radius) && std::isfinite(turns)
15043 && std::isfinite(turnHeight);
15044}
15045
15046bool DRW_Helix::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
15047 if (code == 100) {
15048 const std::string subclass = reader->getString();
15049 m_parsingHelixSubclass = (subclass == "AcDbHelix");
15050 return true;
15051 }
15052
15053 if (!m_parsingHelixSubclass)
15054 return DRW_Spline::parseCode(code, reader);
15055
15056 switch (code) {
15057 case 90:
15058 m_majorVersion = reader->getInt32();
15059 break;
15060 case 91:
15061 m_maintVersion = reader->getInt32();
15062 break;
15063 case 10:
15064 axisBasePt.x = reader->getDouble();
15065 break;
15066 case 20:
15067 axisBasePt.y = reader->getDouble();
15068 break;
15069 case 30:
15070 axisBasePt.z = reader->getDouble();
15071 break;
15072 case 11:
15073 startPt.x = reader->getDouble();
15074 break;
15075 case 21:
15076 startPt.y = reader->getDouble();
15077 break;
15078 case 31:
15079 startPt.z = reader->getDouble();
15080 break;
15081 case 12:
15082 axisVector.x = reader->getDouble();
15083 break;
15084 case 22:
15085 axisVector.y = reader->getDouble();
15086 break;
15087 case 32:
15088 axisVector.z = reader->getDouble();
15089 break;
15090 case 40:
15091 radius = reader->getDouble();
15092 break;
15093 case 41:
15094 turns = reader->getDouble();
15095 break;
15096 case 42:
15097 turnHeight = reader->getDouble();
15098 break;
15099 case 290:
15100 {
15101 int value = 0;
15102 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 1, value))
15103 return false;
15104 handedness = value != 0;
15105 }
15106 break;
15107 case 280:
15108 {
15109 int value = 0;
15110 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 0xFF, value))
15111 return false;
15112 constraintType = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value);
15113 }
15114 break;
15115 default:
15116 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
15117 }
15118
15119 return true;
15120}

15122void DRW_Spline::resetDwgState() {
15123 DRW_Entity::reset();
15124 normalVec = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
15125 tgStart = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
15126 tgEnd = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
15127 flags = 0;
15128 degree = 0;
15129 m_scenario = 0;
15130 m_splineFlags1 = 0;
15131 m_knotParam = 15;
15132 nknots = 0;
15133 ncontrol = 0;
15134 nfit = 0;
15135 tolknot = 0.0000001;
15136 tolcontrol = 0.0000001;
15137 tolfit = 0.0000001;
15138 knotslist.clear();
15139 weightlist.clear();
15140 controllist.clear();
15141 fitlist.clear();
15142 controlpoint.reset();
15143 fitpoint.reset();
15144 m_dxfDegreeSeen = false;
15145 m_dxfKnotCountSeen = false;
15146 m_dxfControlCountSeen = false;
15147 m_dxfFitCountSeen = false;
15148}
15149
15150bool DRW_Spline::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
15151 resetDwgState();
15152 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
15153 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
15154 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
15155 sourceBuf->invalidate();
15156 resetDwgState();
15157 return false;
15158 };
15159 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
15160 return fail();
15161
15162 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
15163 buf = &bodyProbe;
15164 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, NULL__null, bs);
15165 if (!ret)
15166 return fail();
15167 if (!parseDwgSplineBody(version, buf))
15168 return fail();
15169
15170 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
15171 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
15172 handleEndBit))
15173 return fail();
15174 /* Common Entity Handle Data */
15175 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
15176 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
15177 handleEndBit);
15178 if (!ret || !handleProbe.isGood())
15179 return fail();
15180// RS crc; //RS */
15181 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
15182 return true;
15183}
15184
15185// Spline body decode: the scenario/degree/knots/ctrl/fit section, WITHOUT
15186// the leading DRW_Entity::parseDwg(common) or the trailing parseDwgEntHandle.
15187// Factored out so DRW_Helix can reuse the identical spline payload before its
15188// AcDbHelix trailer (Phase 8a-1).
15189bool DRW_Spline::parseDwgSplineBody(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf){
15190 try {
15191 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing spline *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing spline *********************************************\n"
);
15192 if (buf == nullptr || !buf->isGood())
15193 return false;
15194 std::uint8_t weight = 0; // RLZ ??? flags, weight, code 70, bit 4 (16)
15195 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
15196 std::uint64_t controlBits = 0;
15197
15198 std::int32_t scenario = 0;
15199 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, scenario))
15200 return false;
15201 m_scenario = scenario;
15202 DRW_DBG("scenario: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("scenario: "); DRW_DBG(scenario)DRW_dbg::dbg(scenario);
15203 if (version > DRW::AC1024) {
15204 std::int32_t splFlag1 = 0;
15205 std::int32_t knotParam = 0;
15206 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, splFlag1)
15207 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, knotParam))
15208 return false;
15209 m_splineFlags1 = splFlag1;
15210 m_knotParam = knotParam;
15211 if (knotParam == kSplineKnotParamCustom || !(splFlag1 & kSplineFlagUseKnotParameter)) {
15212 scenario = 1;
15213 } else if (splFlag1 & kSplineFlagMethodFitPoints) {
15214 scenario = 2;
15215 }
15216 m_scenario = scenario;
15217 DRW_DBG(" 2013 splFlag1: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" 2013 splFlag1: "); DRW_DBG(splFlag1)DRW_dbg::dbg(splFlag1);
15218 DRW_DBG(" 2013 knotParam: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" 2013 knotParam: "); DRW_DBG(knotParam)DRW_dbg::dbg(knotParam);
15219// DRW_DBG("unk bit: "); DRW_DBG(buf->getBit());
15220 }
15221 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, degree))
15222 return false;
15223 DRW_DBG(" degree: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" degree: "); DRW_DBG(degree)DRW_dbg::dbg(degree); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
15224 if (!isValidSplineDegree(degree)) {
15225 DRW_DBG("\ndwg Spline, invalid degree ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ndwg Spline, invalid degree "); DRW_DBG(degree)DRW_dbg::dbg(degree); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
15226 return false;
15227 }
15228 if (scenario == 2) {
15229 flags = 8;//scenario 2 = not rational & planar
15230 if (m_splineFlags1 & kSplineFlagClosed)
15231 flags |= 1;
15232 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, tolfit)
15233 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, tgStart)
15234 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, tgEnd))
15235 return false;
15236 DRW_DBG("flags: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags: "); DRW_DBG(flags)DRW_dbg::dbg(flags); DRW_DBG(" tolfit: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" tolfit: "); DRW_DBG(tolfit)DRW_dbg::dbg(tolfit);
15237 DRW_DBG(" Start Tangent: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" Start Tangent: "); DRW_DBGPT(tgStart.x, tgStart.y, tgStart.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(tgStart.x, tgStart.y, tgStart.z);
15238 DRW_DBG("\nEnd Tangent: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nEnd Tangent: "); DRW_DBGPT(tgEnd.x, tgEnd.y, tgEnd.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(tgEnd.x, tgEnd.y, tgEnd.z);
15239 std::uint32_t parsedFitCount = 0;
15240 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxSplineItems, 6,
15241 parsedFitCount)) {
15242 return false;
15243 }
15244 nfit = static_cast<std::int32_t>(parsedFitCount);
15245 if (!isValidFitSplineLayout(degree, nfit)) {
15246 DRW_DBG("\ndwg Spline, invalid fit layout degree/count: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ndwg Spline, invalid fit layout degree/count: "
);
15247 DRW_DBG(degree)DRW_dbg::dbg(degree); DRW_DBG("/")DRW_dbg::dbg("/"); DRW_DBG(nfit)DRW_dbg::dbg(nfit); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
15248 return false;
15249 }
15250 DRW_DBG("\nnumber of fit points: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nnumber of fit points: "); DRW_DBG(nfit)DRW_dbg::dbg(nfit);
15251 } else if (scenario == 1) {
15252 flags = 8;//scenario 1 = rational & planar
15253 bool rational = false;
15254 bool closed = false;
15255 bool periodic = false;
15256 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, rational)
15257 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, closed)
15258 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, periodic)
15259 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, tolknot)
15260 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, tolcontrol))
15261 return false;
15262 flags |= rational ? 4 : 0;
15263 flags |= closed ? 1 : 0;
15264 flags |= periodic ? 2 : 0;
15265 DRW_DBG("flags: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("flags: "); DRW_DBG(flags)DRW_dbg::dbg(flags); DRW_DBG(" knot tolerance: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" knot tolerance: "); DRW_DBG(tolknot)DRW_dbg::dbg(tolknot);
15266 DRW_DBG(" control point tolerance: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" control point tolerance: "); DRW_DBG(tolcontrol)DRW_dbg::dbg(tolcontrol);
15267 std::uint32_t parsedKnotCount = 0;
15268 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxSplineItems, 2,
15269 parsedKnotCount)) {
15270 return false;
15271 }
15272 nknots = static_cast<std::int32_t>(parsedKnotCount);
15273 std::uint32_t parsedControlCount = 0;
15274 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxSplineItems, 6,
15275 parsedControlCount)) {
15276 return false;
15277 }
15278 ncontrol = static_cast<std::int32_t>(parsedControlCount);
15279 if (!isValidControlSplineLayout(degree, nknots, ncontrol)) {
15280 DRW_DBG("\ndwg Spline, invalid control layout degree/knots/control: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ndwg Spline, invalid control layout degree/knots/control: "
);
15281 DRW_DBG(degree)DRW_dbg::dbg(degree); DRW_DBG("/")DRW_dbg::dbg("/"); DRW_DBG(nknots)DRW_dbg::dbg(nknots); DRW_DBG("/")DRW_dbg::dbg("/");
15282 DRW_DBG(ncontrol)DRW_dbg::dbg(ncontrol); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
15283 return false;
15284 }
15285 bool hasWeights = false;
15286 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, hasWeights))
15287 return false;
15288 weight = hasWeights ? 1 : 0; // flags bit 4: weights present (code 70)
15289 if (weight) flags |= 0x10;
15290 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(ncontrol),
15291 weight ? 8u : 6u, controlBits))
15292 return false;
15293 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, controlBits)) {
15294 return false;
15295 }
15296 DRW_DBG("\nnum of knots: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nnum of knots: "); DRW_DBG(nknots)DRW_dbg::dbg(nknots); DRW_DBG(" num of control pt: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" num of control pt: ");
15297 DRW_DBG(ncontrol)DRW_dbg::dbg(ncontrol); DRW_DBG(" weight bit: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" weight bit: "); DRW_DBG(weight)DRW_dbg::dbg(weight);
15298 } else {
15299 DRW_DBG("\ndwg Spline, unknown scenario ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ndwg Spline, unknown scenario "); DRW_DBG(scenario)DRW_dbg::dbg(scenario);
15300 DRW_DBG(" (expected 1 or 2)\n")DRW_dbg::dbg(" (expected 1 or 2)\n");
15301 return false; //RLZ: from doc only 1 or 2 are ok ?
15302 }
15303
15304 std::vector<double> parsedKnots;
15305 std::vector<double> parsedWeights;
15306 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<DRW_Coord>> parsedControls;
15307 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<DRW_Coord>> parsedFits;
15308 std::uint64_t knotBits = 0;
15309 std::uint64_t fitBits = 0;
15310 std::uint64_t requiredBits = 0;
15311 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(nknots), 2,
15312 knotBits)
15313 || !dwgSafety::multiply(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(nfit), 6,
15314 fitBits)
15315 || !dwgSafety::add(knotBits, controlBits, requiredBits)
15316 || !dwgSafety::add(requiredBits, fitBits, requiredBits)
15317 || !proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, requiredBits)) {
15318 return false;
15319 }
15320 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedKnots, nknots)) {
15321 return false;
15322 }
15323 for (std::int32_t i= 0; i<nknots; ++i){
15324 double knot = 0.0;
15325 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, knot)
15326 || !std::isfinite(knot))
15327 return false;
15328 parsedKnots.push_back(knot);
15329 }
15330 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedControls, ncontrol)) {
15331 return false;
15332 }
15333 if (weight && !DRW::reserve(parsedWeights, ncontrol)) {
15334 return false;
15335 }
15336 for (std::int32_t i= 0; i<ncontrol; ++i){
15337 DRW_Coord control;
15338 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, control)
15339 || !std::isfinite(control.x)
15340 || !std::isfinite(control.y)
15341 || !std::isfinite(control.z))
15342 return false;
15343 parsedControls.push_back(std::make_shared<DRW_Coord>(control));
15344 if (weight) {
15345 //per-control-point weight; required for hyperbola/parabola
15346 //conic detection in consumers (e.g. LibreCAD addSpline)
15347 double w = 0.0; //RLZ Warning: D (BD or RD)
15348 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, w)
15349 || !std::isfinite(w))
15350 return false;
15351 parsedWeights.push_back(w);
15352 DRW_DBG("\n w: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n w: "); DRW_DBG(w)DRW_dbg::dbg(w);
15353 }
15354 }
15355 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedFits, nfit)) {
15356 return false;
15357 }
15358 for (std::int32_t i= 0; i<nfit; ++i) {
15359 DRW_Coord fit;
15360 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, fit)
15361 || !std::isfinite(fit.x)
15362 || !std::isfinite(fit.y)
15363 || !std::isfinite(fit.z))
15364 return false;
15365 parsedFits.push_back(std::make_shared<DRW_Coord>(fit));
15366 }
15367
15368 if (DRW_DBGGLDRW_dbg::getInstance()->getLevel() == DRW_dbg::Level::Debug) {
15369 DRW_DBG("\nknots list: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nknots list: ");
15370 for (auto const& v: parsedKnots) {
15371 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n"); DRW_DBG(v)DRW_dbg::dbg(v);
15372 }
15373 DRW_DBG("\ncontrol point list: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ncontrol point list: ");
15374 for (auto const& v: parsedControls) {
15375 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n"); DRW_DBGPT(v->x, v->y, v->z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(v->x, v->y, v->z);
15376 }
15377 DRW_DBG("\nfit point list: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nfit point list: ");
15378 for (auto const& v: parsedFits) {
15379 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n"); DRW_DBGPT(v->x, v->y, v->z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(v->x, v->y, v->z);
15380 }
15381 }
15382
15383 if (!buf->isGood())
15384 return false;
15385 knotslist = std::move(parsedKnots);
15386 weightlist = std::move(parsedWeights);
15387 controllist = std::move(parsedControls);
15388 fitlist = std::move(parsedFits);
15389 return true;
15390 } catch (...) {
15391 return false;
15392 }
15393}
15394
15395// AcDbHelix trailer order (libreDWG dwg2.spec:2493-2503):
15396// major_version BL, maint_version BL, axis_base_pt 3BD, start_pt 3BD,
15397// axis_vector 3BD, radius BD, turns BD, turn_height BD, handedness B,
15398// constraint_type RC.
15399void DRW_Helix::resetDwgState() {
15400 DRW_Spline::resetDwgState();
15401 m_majorVersion = 0;
15402 m_maintVersion = 0;
15403 axisBasePt = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
15404 startPt = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
15405 axisVector = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
15406 radius = 0.0;
15407 turns = 0.0;
15408 turnHeight = 0.0;
15409 handedness = false;
15410 constraintType = 0;
15411 m_parsingHelixSubclass = false;
15412}
15413
15414bool DRW_Helix::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
15415 resetDwgState();
15416 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
15417 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
15418 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
15419 sourceBuf->invalidate();
15420 resetDwgState();
15421 return false;
15422 };
15423 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
15424 return fail();
15425
15426 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
15427 buf = &bodyProbe;
15428 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, NULL__null, bs);
15429 if (!ret)
15430 return fail();
15431 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing helix *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing helix *********************************************\n"
);
15432 if (!parseDwgSplineBody(version, buf))
15433 return fail();
15434
15435 // AcDbHelix trailer (see field order above).
15436 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
15437 std::int32_t parsedMajorVersion = 0;
15438 std::int32_t parsedMaintVersion = 0;
15439 DRW_Coord parsedAxisBasePt;
15440 DRW_Coord parsedStartPt;
15441 DRW_Coord parsedAxisVector;
15442 double parsedRadius = 0.0;
15443 double parsedTurns = 0.0;
15444 double parsedTurnHeight = 0.0;
15445 bool parsedHandedness = false;
15446 std::uint8_t parsedConstraintType = 0;
15447 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedMajorVersion)
15448 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedMaintVersion)
15449 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAxisBasePt)
15450 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedStartPt)
15451 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAxisVector)
15452 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedRadius)
