15453 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedTurns)
15454 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedTurnHeight)
15455 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedHandedness)
15456 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedConstraintType)
15457 || !std::isfinite(parsedAxisBasePt.x)
15458 || !std::isfinite(parsedAxisBasePt.y)
15459 || !std::isfinite(parsedAxisBasePt.z)
15460 || !std::isfinite(parsedStartPt.x)
15461 || !std::isfinite(parsedStartPt.y)
15462 || !std::isfinite(parsedStartPt.z)
15463 || !std::isfinite(parsedAxisVector.x)
15464 || !std::isfinite(parsedAxisVector.y)
15465 || !std::isfinite(parsedAxisVector.z)
15466 || !std::isfinite(parsedRadius)
15467 || !std::isfinite(parsedTurns)
15468 || !std::isfinite(parsedTurnHeight))
15469 return fail();
15470 DRW_DBG("\nhelix radius: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nhelix radius: "); DRW_DBG(parsedRadius)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedRadius); DRW_DBG(" turns: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" turns: "); DRW_DBG(parsedTurns)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedTurns);
15471
15472 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
15473 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
15474 handleEndBit))
15475 return fail();
15476 /* Common Entity Handle Data */
15477 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
15478 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
15479 handleEndBit);
15480 if (!ret || !handleProbe.isGood())
15481 return fail();
15482 // RS crc; //RS */
15483 m_majorVersion = parsedMajorVersion;
15484 m_maintVersion = parsedMaintVersion;
15485 axisBasePt = parsedAxisBasePt;
15486 startPt = parsedStartPt;
15487 axisVector = parsedAxisVector;
15488 radius = parsedRadius;
15489 turns = parsedTurns;
15490 turnHeight = parsedTurnHeight;
15491 handedness = parsedHandedness;
15492 constraintType = parsedConstraintType;
15493 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
15494 return true;
15495}
15496
15497bool DRW_Image::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
15498 switch (code) {
15499 case 12:
15500 vVector.x = reader->getDouble();
15501 break;
15502 case 22:
15503 vVector.y = reader->getDouble();
15504 break;
15505 case 32:
15506 vVector.z = reader->getDouble();
15507 break;
15508 case 13:
15509 sizeu = reader->getDouble();
15510 break;
15511 case 23:
15512 sizev = reader->getDouble();
15513 break;
15514 case 70:
15515 {
15516 int value = 0;
15517 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 0xFFFF, value))
15518 return false;
15519 m_displayProps = value;
15520 }
15521 break;
15522 case 90: {
15523 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
15524 if (value < 0 || value > kMaxClassVersion)
15525 return false;
15526 m_classVersion = value;
15527 break;
15528 }
15529 case 340:
15530 ref = reader->getHandleString();
15531 break;
15532 case 360:
15533 m_imageDefReactorHandle = reader->getHandleString();
15534 break;
15535 case 280:
15536 {
15537 int value = 0;
15538 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 1, value))
15539 return false;
15540 clip = value;
15541 }
15542 break;
15543 case 281:
15544 {
15545 int value = 0;
15546 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 100, value))
15547 return false;
15548 brightness = value;
15549 }
15550 break;
15551 case 282:
15552 {
15553 int value = 0;
15554 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 100, value))
15555 return false;
15556 contrast = value;
15557 }
15558 break;
15559 case 283:
15560 {
15561 int value = 0;
15562 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 100, value))
15563 return false;
15564 fade = value;
15565 }
15566 break;
15567 case 71:
15568 {
15569 int value = 0;
15570 if (!readDxfIntInRange(reader, 0, 2, value))
15571 return false;
15572 m_clipBoundaryType = value;
15573 }
15574 break;
15575 case 91:
15576 // The declared count is a structural invariant: reject negative or
15577 // implausibly large values before reserve() can allocate unboundedly.
15578 {
15579 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
15580 if (count < 0 || count > static_cast<std::int32_t>(DRW_Image::kMaxClipVertices))
15581 return false;
15582 clipPath.clear();
15583 if (!DRW::reserve(clipPath, count))
15584 return false;
15585 m_declaredClipVertexCount = count;
15586 m_clipPathHasOpenVertex = false;
15587 }
15588 break;
15589 case 14:
15590 // WIPEOUT polygon vertex x — start a new vertex. Group 24 (y) follows.
15591 if (m_clipPathHasOpenVertex)
15592 return false;
15593 clipPath.emplace_back(reader->getDouble(), 0.0);
15594 m_clipPathHasOpenVertex = true;
15595 break;
15596 case 24:
15597 // WIPEOUT polygon vertex y — complete the most recently started vertex.
15598 if (!m_clipPathHasOpenVertex || clipPath.empty())
15599 return false;
15600 clipPath.back().y = reader->getDouble();
15601 m_clipPathHasOpenVertex = false;
15602 break;
15603 case 290:
15604 // R2010+ Clip mode (IMAGE/WIPEOUT, ODA spec §20.4.80):
15605 // 0 = mask outside the polygon, 1 = mask inside.
15606 clipMode = reader->getBool();
15607 break;
15608 default:
15609 return DRW_Line::parseCode(code, reader);
15610 }
15611
15612 return true;
15613}
15614
15615bool DRW_Image::hasValidClipBoundary() const {
15616 if (m_clipPathHasOpenVertex
15617 || (m_declaredClipVertexCount >= 0
15618 && static_cast<std::size_t>(m_declaredClipVertexCount) != clipPath.size())) {
15619 return false;
15620 }
15621 switch (m_clipBoundaryType) {
15622 case 0:
15623 return clipPath.empty();
15624 case 1:
15625 return clipPath.size() == 2;
15626 case 2:
15627 return clipPath.size() >= 3;
15628 default:
15629 return false;
15630 }
15631}
15632
15633bool DRW_Image::validatePayloadFields() const {
15634 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
15635 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
15636 && std::isfinite(point.z);
15637 };
15638 return m_classVersion >= 0 && m_classVersion <= kMaxClassVersion
15639 && m_displayProps >= 0 && m_displayProps <= 0xffff
15640 && clip >= 0 && clip <= 1
15641 && brightness >= 0 && brightness <= 0xff
15642 && contrast >= 0 && contrast <= 0xff
15643 && fade >= 0 && fade <= 0xff
15644 && std::isfinite(sizeu) && std::isfinite(sizev)
15645 && finite(basePoint) && finite(secPoint) && finite(vVector)
15646 && clipPath.size() <= kMaxClipVertices
15647 && std::all_of(clipPath.cbegin(), clipPath.cend(),
15648 [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
15649 return std::isfinite(point.x)
15650 && std::isfinite(point.y);
15651 });
15652}
15653
15654void DRW_Image::resetDwgState() {
15655 DRW_Line::resetDwgState();
15656 m_classVersion = 0;
15657 ref = 0;
15658 m_imageDefReactorHandle = 0;
15659 m_displayProps = 0;
15660 vVector = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
15661 sizeu = 0.0;
15662 sizev = 0.0;
15663 dz = 0.0;
15664 clip = 0;
15665 brightness = 50;
15666 contrast = 50;
15667 fade = 0;
15668 m_clipBoundaryType = 0;
15669 clipPath.clear();
15670 clipMode = false;
15671 m_declaredClipVertexCount = -1;
15672 m_clipPathHasOpenVertex = false;
15673}
15674
15675bool DRW_Image::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
15676 resetDwgState();
15677 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
15678 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
15679 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
15680 sourceBuf->invalidate();
15681 resetDwgState();
15682 return false;
15683 };
15684 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
15685 return fail();
15686
15687 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
15688 buf = &bodyProbe;
15689 dwgBuffer sBuff = buf->forkIndependent();
15690 dwgBuffer *sBuf = buf;
15691 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
15692 sBuf = &sBuff; //separate buffer for strings
15693 }
15694 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
15695 if (!ret)
15696 return fail();
15697 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing image *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing image *********************************************\n"
);
15698
15699 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
15700 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
15701 && std::isfinite(point.z);
15702 };
15703 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
15704 std::int32_t parsedClassVersion = 0;
15705 DRW_Coord parsedBasePoint;
15706 DRW_Coord parsedSecPoint;
15707 DRW_Coord parsedVVector;
15708 double parsedSizeU = 0.0;
15709 double parsedSizeV = 0.0;
15710 std::uint16_t parsedDisplayProps = 0;
15711 bool parsedClip = false;
15712 std::uint8_t parsedBrightness = 0;
15713 std::uint8_t parsedContrast = 0;
15714 std::uint8_t parsedFade = 0;
15715 bool parsedClipMode = false;
15716 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedClassVersion)
15717 || parsedClassVersion < 0 || parsedClassVersion > kMaxClassVersion
15718 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedBasePoint)
15719 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedSecPoint)
15720 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedVVector)
15721 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedSizeU)
15722 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedSizeV)
15723 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDisplayProps)
15724 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedClip)
15725 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedBrightness)
15726 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedContrast)
15727 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedFade)
15728 || (version > DRW::AC1021
15729 && !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedClipMode))
15730 || !finite(parsedBasePoint) || !finite(parsedSecPoint)
15731 || !finite(parsedVVector) || !std::isfinite(parsedSizeU)
15732 || !std::isfinite(parsedSizeV))
15733 return fail();
15734 DRW_DBG("class Version: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("class Version: "); DRW_DBG(parsedClassVersion)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedClassVersion);
15735 DRW_DBG("\nbase point: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nbase point: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedBasePoint.x, parsedBasePoint.y, parsedBasePoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedBasePoint.x, parsedBasePoint.y, parsedBasePoint
.z);
15736 DRW_DBG("\nU vector: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nU vector: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedSecPoint.x, parsedSecPoint.y, parsedSecPoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedSecPoint.x, parsedSecPoint.y, parsedSecPoint
.z);
15737 DRW_DBG("\nV vector: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nV vector: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedVVector.x, parsedVVector.y, parsedVVector.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedVVector.x, parsedVVector.y, parsedVVector
.z);
15738 DRW_DBG("\nsize U: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nsize U: "); DRW_DBG(parsedSizeU)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedSizeU); DRW_DBG("\nsize V: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nsize V: "); DRW_DBG(parsedSizeV)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedSizeV);
15739 DRW_DBG("\ndisplay props: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ndisplay props: "); DRW_DBG(parsedDisplayProps)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedDisplayProps);
15740
15741 std::uint16_t parsedClipBoundaryType = 0;
15742 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedClipBoundaryType))
15743 return fail();
15744 std::vector<DRW_Coord> parsedClipPath;
15745 std::int32_t parsedDeclaredClipVertexCount = -1;
15746 if (parsedClipBoundaryType == 0) {
15747 // No clip boundary payload.
15748 } else if (parsedClipBoundaryType == 1){
15749 // Rectangles are encoded as exactly two opposite corners. Keep that
15750 // canonical payload intact; rendering expands it independently.
15751 DRW_Coord ll;
15752 DRW_Coord ur;
15753 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ll.x)
15754 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ll.y)
15755 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ur.x)
15756 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ur.y)
15757 || !finite(ll) || !finite(ur))
15758 return fail();
15759 parsedClipPath.push_back(ll);
15760 parsedClipPath.push_back(ur);
15761 parsedDeclaredClipVertexCount = 2;
15762 } else if (parsedClipBoundaryType == 2) {
15763 std::uint32_t numVerts = 0;
15764 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize,
15765 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kMaxClipVertices),
15766 128, numVerts))
15767 return fail();
15768 std::uint64_t vertexBits = 0;
15769 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(numVerts), 128,
15770 vertexBits)
15771 || !proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, vertexBits)
15772 || !DRW::reserve(parsedClipPath, numVerts))
15773 return fail();
15774 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < numVerts; ++i) {
15775 DRW_Coord point;
15776 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, point.x)
15777 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, point.y)
15778 || !finite(point))
15779 return fail();
15780 parsedClipPath.push_back(point);
15781 }
15782 parsedDeclaredClipVertexCount = static_cast<std::int32_t>(numVerts);
15783 } else {
15784 DRW_DBG("unsupported image clip type: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("unsupported image clip type: "); DRW_DBG(parsedClipBoundaryType)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedClipBoundaryType); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
15785 return fail();
15786 }
15787
15788 if ((parsedClipBoundaryType == 0 && !parsedClipPath.empty())
15789 || (parsedClipBoundaryType == 2 && parsedClipPath.size() < 3))
15790 return fail();
15791
15792 if (!buf->isGood())
15793 return fail();
15794 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
15795 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
15796 handleEndBit))
15797 return fail();
15798 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
15799 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
15800 handleEndBit);
15801 if (!ret)
15802 return fail();
15803 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
15804
15805 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 8))
15806 return fail();
15807 dwgHandle biH;
15808 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, false, biH))
15809 return fail();
15810 DRW_DBG("ImageDef Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("ImageDef Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(biH.code, biH.size, biH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(biH.code, biH.size, biH.ref);
15811 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 8))
15812 return fail();
15813 dwgHandle reactorH;
15814 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, false,
15815 reactorH))
15816 return fail();
15817 DRW_DBG("ImageDefReactor Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("ImageDefReactor Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(reactorH.code, reactorH.size, reactorH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(reactorH.code, reactorH.size, reactorH.ref);
15818 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
15819 if (!handleProbe.isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
15820 return fail();
15821 m_classVersion = parsedClassVersion;
15822 basePoint = parsedBasePoint;
15823 secPoint = parsedSecPoint;
15824 vVector = parsedVVector;
15825 sizeu = parsedSizeU;
15826 sizev = parsedSizeV;
15827 m_displayProps = parsedDisplayProps;
15828 clip = parsedClip ? 1 : 0;
15829 brightness = parsedBrightness;
15830 contrast = parsedContrast;
15831 fade = parsedFade;
15832 clipMode = parsedClipMode;
15833 m_clipBoundaryType = parsedClipBoundaryType;
15834 clipPath = std::move(parsedClipPath);
15835 m_declaredClipVertexCount = parsedDeclaredClipVertexCount;
15836 m_clipPathHasOpenVertex = false;
15837 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
15838 ref = biH.ref;
15839 m_imageDefReactorHandle = reactorH.ref;
15840 return true;
15841}
15842
15843// DRW_Image::encodeDwg — inverse of DRW_Image::parseDwg above (libreDWG
15844// dwg.spec:5533-5563). Body field order: BL class_version, 3 x 3BD
15845// (base/uvec/vvec), 2 x RD (sizeu/sizev), BS display_props, B clip,
15846// 3 x RC (brightness/contrast/fade), [R2010+ B clip_mode], BS
15847// clip_boundary_type + verts. Both handles (imagedef code 5 + reactor
15848// code 3) are emitted UNCONDITIONALLY at the END of the handle stream,
15849// matching parseDwg's order — NOT the spec's interleaved mid-stream slots.
15850bool DRW_Image::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
15851 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
15852 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
15853 if (!validatePayloadFields()) {
15854 DRW_DBG("IMAGE has an invalid scalar or clip field\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("IMAGE has an invalid scalar or clip field\n");
15855 return false;
15856 }
15857 // Callers sometimes populate clipPath without setting m_clipBoundaryType
15858 // (DXF import historically stored only the vertices). Infer a coherent type
15859 // so encode does not reject a well-formed polygon/rectangle path.
15860 if (m_clipBoundaryType == 0 && !clipPath.empty()) {
15861 if (clipPath.size() == 2)
15862 m_clipBoundaryType = 1;
15863 else if (clipPath.size() >= 3)
15864 m_clipBoundaryType = 2;
15865 }
15866 if (!hasValidClipBoundary()) {
15867 DRW_DBG("IMAGE has invalid clip boundary\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("IMAGE has invalid clip boundary\n");
15868 return false;
15869 }
15870 oType = 101; // IMAGE class id — see dwgreader.cpp case 101
15871 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
15872
15873 buf->putBitLong(m_classVersion);
15874 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.x); buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.y); buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
15875 buf->putBitDouble(secPoint.x); buf->putBitDouble(secPoint.y); buf->putBitDouble(secPoint.z); // uvec
15876 buf->putBitDouble(vVector.x); buf->putBitDouble(vVector.y); buf->putBitDouble(vVector.z);
15877 buf->putRawDouble(sizeu);
15878 buf->putRawDouble(sizev);
15879 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_displayProps));
15880 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(clip & 1));
15881 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(brightness));
15882 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(contrast));
15883 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(fade));
15884 if (version > DRW::AC1021) { // 2010+ clip mode
15885 buf->putBit(clipMode ? 1 : 0);
15886 }
15887 if (m_clipBoundaryType == 0) {
15888 buf->putBitShort(0); // clip_boundary_type 0 = none
15889 } else if (m_clipBoundaryType == 1) {
15890 buf->putBitShort(1);
15891 buf->put2RawDouble(clipPath[0]);
15892 buf->put2RawDouble(clipPath[1]);
15893 } else {
15894 buf->putBitShort(2);
15895 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(clipPath.size()));
15896 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < clipPath.size(); ++i)
15897 buf->put2RawDouble(clipPath[i]);
15898 }
15899
15900 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
15901
15902 // Emit both trailing handles UNCONDITIONALLY in parseDwg order:
15903 // imagedef (hard pointer, code 5) then imagedefreactor (hard owner, code 3).
15904 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
15905 auto makeHandle = [](std::uint8_t code, std::uint32_t r) {
15906 dwgHandle h;
15907 h.code = (r == 0) ? 0 : code;
15908 h.ref = r;
15909 h.size = 0;
15910 if (r != 0) { std::uint32_t t = r; while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++h.size; } }
15911 return h;
15912 };
15913 hb->putHandle(makeHandle(5, ref)); // imagedef (340)
15914 hb->putHandle(makeHandle(3, m_imageDefReactorHandle)); // imagedefreactor (360)
15915 return true;
15916}
15917
15918bool DRW_Wipeout::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
15919 return DRW_Image::parseCode(code, reader);
15920}
15921
15922bool DRW_Wipeout::hasValidBoundary() const {
15923 return m_clipBoundaryType != 0 && hasValidClipBoundary();
15924}
15925
15926bool DRW_Wipeout::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs) {
15927 if (buf == nullptr)
15928 return false;
15929
15930 // Image parsing is transactional; keep it on a second cursor because a
15931 // valid image payload is still invalid for WIPEOUT when it has no clip
15932 // boundary. The wrapper must preserve the same failure contract.
15933 dwgBuffer probe = buf->forkIndependent();
15934 if (!DRW_Image::parseDwg(version, &probe, bs)) {
15935 buf->invalidate();
15936 resetDwgState();
15937 return false;
15938 }
15939 if (!hasValidBoundary()) {
15940 buf->invalidate();
15941 resetDwgState();
15942 return false;
15943 }
15944 *buf = probe;
15945 return true;
15946}
15947
15948bool DRW_Wipeout::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
15949 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
15950 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
15951 if (!validatePayloadFields()) {
15952 DRW_DBG("WIPEOUT has an invalid scalar or clip field\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("WIPEOUT has an invalid scalar or clip field\n");
15953 return false;
15954 }
15955 if (clipPath.size() > DRW_Image::kMaxClipVertices) {
15956 DRW_DBG("WIPEOUT clip vertices exceed DWG limit\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("WIPEOUT clip vertices exceed DWG limit\n");
15957 return false;
15958 }
15959 if (!hasValidBoundary()) {
15960 DRW_DBG("WIPEOUT has invalid clip boundary\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("WIPEOUT has invalid clip boundary\n");
15961 return false;
15962 }
15963 // WIPEOUT is fixed DWG entity type 1109. It is not a custom class and
15964 // must not depend on a file-local CLASSES ordinal.
15965 oType = dwgType::WIPEOUT;
15966 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
15967
15968 buf->putBitLong(0);
15969 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.x); buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.y); buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
15970 buf->putBitDouble(secPoint.x); buf->putBitDouble(secPoint.y); buf->putBitDouble(secPoint.z);
15971 buf->putBitDouble(vVector.x); buf->putBitDouble(vVector.y); buf->putBitDouble(vVector.z);
15972 buf->putRawDouble(sizeu);
15973 buf->putRawDouble(sizev);
15974 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(m_displayProps));
15975 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(clip & 1));
15976 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(brightness));
15977 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(contrast));
15978 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(fade));
15979 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
15980 buf->putBit(clipMode ? 1 : 0);
15981 }
15982 if (m_clipBoundaryType == 1) {
15983 buf->putBitShort(1);
15984 buf->put2RawDouble(clipPath[0]);
15985 buf->put2RawDouble(clipPath[1]);
15986 } else {
15987 buf->putBitShort(2);
15988 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(clipPath.size()));
15989 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < clipPath.size(); ++i)
15990 buf->put2RawDouble(clipPath[i]);
15991 }
15992
15993 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
15994
15995 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
15996 auto makeHandle = [](std::uint8_t code, std::uint32_t r) {
15997 dwgHandle h;
15998 h.code = (r == 0) ? 0 : code;
15999 h.ref = r;
16000 h.size = 0;
16001 if (r != 0) { std::uint32_t t = r; while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++h.size; } }
16002 return h;
16003 };
16004 hb->putHandle(makeHandle(5, ref));
16005 hb->putHandle(makeHandle(3, m_imageDefReactorHandle));
16006 return true;
16007}
16008
16009bool DRW_NavisworksModel::parseCode(
16010 int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
16011 if (code == 100) {
16012 const std::string subclass = reader->getString();
16013 if (subclass == "AcDbNavisworksModel")
16014 m_dxfInBody = true;
16015 return true;
16016 }
16017 if (!m_dxfInBody)
16018 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
16019
16020 switch (code) {
16021 case 70: {
16022 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
16023 if (value < 0 || value > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
16024 return false;
16025 flags = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(value);
16026 m_dxfSawFlags = true;
16027 return true;
16028 }
16029 case 340:
16030 definitionHandle = reader->getHandleString();
16031 m_dxfSawDefinition = true;
16032 return true;
16033 case 40:
16034 if (m_dxfTransformCount < kTransformSize) {
16035 transform[m_dxfTransformCount++] = reader->getDouble();
16036 return true;
16037 }
16038 if (m_dxfSawUnitFactor)
16039 return false;
16040 unitFactor = reader->getDouble();
16041 m_dxfSawUnitFactor = true;
16042 return true;
16043 default:
16044 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
16045 }
16046}
16047
16048bool DRW_NavisworksModel::finalizeDxf() {
16049 return m_dxfTransformCount == kTransformSize && m_dxfSawUnitFactor
16050 && std::isfinite(unitFactor)
16051 && std::all_of(transform.begin(), transform.end(),
16052 [](double value) { return std::isfinite(value); });
16053}
16054
16055void DRW_NavisworksModel::resetDwgState() {
16056 DRW_Entity::reset();
16057 flags = 0;
16058 definitionHandle = 0;
16059 transform = {1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
16060 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0,
16061 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0,
16062 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
16063 unitFactor = 1.0;
16064}
16065
16066bool DRW_NavisworksModel::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
16067 std::uint32_t bs) {
16068 resetDwgState();
16069 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
16070 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
16071 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
16072 sourceBuf->invalidate();
16073 resetDwgState();
16074 return false;
16075 };
16076 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
16077 return fail();
16078 if (version < DRW::AC1015)
16079 return fail();
16080
16081 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
16082 dwgBuffer stringBuffer = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
16083 dwgBuffer *stringBuf = version > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringBuffer : &bodyProbe;
16084 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, &bodyProbe, stringBuf, bs))
16085 return fail();
16086
16087 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
16088 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
16089 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
16090 handleEndBit))
16091 return fail();
16092 // BS is an unsigned bit-short at the codec boundary. The flags are a
16093 // mask, so values with bit 15 set must survive instead of being rejected
16094 // through an intermediate signed conversion.
16095 std::uint16_t parsedFlags = 0;
16096 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedFlags))
16097 return fail();
16098
16099 std::uint32_t parsedDefinitionHandle = 0;
16100 if (version <= DRW::AC1018) {
16101 dwgHandle definition;
16102 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(bodyProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
16103 definition))
16104 return fail();
16105 parsedDefinitionHandle = definition.ref;
16106 }
16107
16108 std::array<double, 16> parsedTransform{};
16109 for (double& value : parsedTransform) {
16110 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, value))
16111 return fail();
16112 }
16113 double parsedUnitFactor = 0.0;
16114 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedUnitFactor))
16115 return fail();
16116 if (!std::all_of(parsedTransform.begin(), parsedTransform.end(),
16117 [](double value) { return std::isfinite(value); })
16118 || !std::isfinite(parsedUnitFactor)) {
16119 return fail();
16120 }
16121
16122 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &bodyProbe, true,
16123 handleEndBit))
16124 return fail();
16125 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
16126 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
16127 dwgHandle definition;
16128 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
16129 definition))
16130 return fail();
16131 parsedDefinitionHandle = definition.ref;
16132 }
16133 if (!handleProbe.isGood() || !stringBuf->isGood())
16134 return fail();
16135 flags = parsedFlags;
16136 transform = parsedTransform;
16137 unitFactor = parsedUnitFactor;
16138 definitionHandle = parsedDefinitionHandle;
16139 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
16140 return true;
16141}
16142
16143bool DRW_NavisworksModel::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
16144 std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf,
16145 dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
16146 (void)bs;
16147 if (version < DRW::AC1015
16148 || !std::isfinite(unitFactor)
16149 || !std::all_of(transform.begin(), transform.end(),
16150 [](double value) { return std::isfinite(value); }))
16151 return false;
16152
16153 oType = kDwgClassNum;
16154 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf, strBuf))
16155 return false;
16156
16157 buf->putBitShort(flags);
16158 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
16159 auto makeHandle = [](std::uint8_t code, std::uint32_t ref) {
16160 dwgHandle handle;
16161 handle.code = ref == 0 ? 0 : code;
16162 handle.ref = ref;
16163 handle.size = 0;
16164 for (std::uint32_t value = ref; value != 0; value >>= 8)
16165 ++handle.size;
16166 return handle;
16167 };
16168
16169 // AC1015/AC1018 place this entity-specific handle before the matrix in
16170 // the legacy data stream. AC1021+ places it after the common handles.
16171 if (version <= DRW::AC1018)
16172 buf->putHandle(makeHandle(2, definitionHandle));
16173 for (double value : transform)
16174 buf->putBitDouble(value);
16175 buf->putBitDouble(unitFactor);
16176
16177 if (!DRW_Entity::encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf))
16178 return false;
16179 if (version > DRW::AC1018)
16180 hb->putHandle(makeHandle(2, definitionHandle));
16181 return true;
16182}
16183
16184bool DRW_PointCloud::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
16185 if (code == 100) {
16186 m_dxfInBody = reader->getString() == "AcDbPointCloud";
16187 return true;
16188 }
16189 if (!m_dxfInBody)
16190 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
16191 switch (code) {
16192 case 70:
16193 m_dxfSawClassVersion = true;
16194 classVersion = reader->getInt32();
16195 break;
16196 case 10: origin.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16197 case 20: origin.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16198 case 30: origin.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16199 case 1: savedFilename = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
16200 case 90:
16201 if (m_dxfSawSourceCount)
16202 return false;
16203 m_dxfSawSourceCount = true;
16204 sourceFileCount = reader->getInt32();
16205 if (!isValidCount(sourceFileCount,
16206 static_cast<std::int32_t>(kMaxItems))) {
16207 return false;
16208 }
16209 sourceFiles.clear();
16210 if (!DRW::reserve(sourceFiles, sourceFileCount))
16211 return false;
16212 break;
16213 case 2:
16214 if (sourceFiles.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceFileCount))
16215 return false;
16216 sourceFiles.push_back(reader->getUtf8String());
16217 break;
16218 case 3: ucsName = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
16219 case 11: extentsMin.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16220 case 21: extentsMin.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16221 case 31: extentsMin.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16222 case 12: extentsMax.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16223 case 22: extentsMax.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16224 case 32: extentsMax.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16225 case 92: {
16226 if (m_dxfSawPointCount)
16227 return false;
16228 m_dxfSawPointCount = true;
16229 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
16230 if (count < 0)
16231 return false;
16232 pointCount = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(count);
16233 break;
16234 }
16235 case 13: ucsOrigin.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16236 case 23: ucsOrigin.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16237 case 33: ucsOrigin.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16238 case 210: ucsXDirection.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16239 case 220: ucsXDirection.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16240 case 230: ucsXDirection.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16241 case 211: ucsYDirection.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16242 case 221: ucsYDirection.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16243 case 231: ucsYDirection.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16244 case 212: ucsZDirection.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16245 case 222: ucsZDirection.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16246 case 232: ucsZDirection.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16247 case 330:
16248 if (!m_dxfInBody)
16249 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
16250 definitionHandle = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getHandleString());
16251 break;
16252 case 360: reactorHandle = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getHandleString()); break;
16253 case 71: intensityScheme = reader->getInt32(); break;
16254 case 40: intensityStyle.minIntensity = reader->getDouble(); break;
16255 case 41: intensityStyle.maxIntensity = reader->getDouble(); break;
16256 case 42: intensityStyle.lowThreshold = reader->getDouble(); break;
16257 case 43: intensityStyle.highThreshold = reader->getDouble(); break;
16258 default:
16259 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
16260 }
16261 return true;
16262}
16263
16264bool DRW_PointCloud::finalizeDxf() {
16265 return m_dxfSawClassVersion && m_dxfSawSourceCount && m_dxfSawPointCount
16266 && isValidCount(sourceFileCount,
16267 static_cast<std::int32_t>(kMaxItems))
16268 && sourceFiles.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceFileCount);
16269}
16270
16271void DRW_PointCloud::resetDwgState() {
16272 DRW_Entity::reset();
16273 classVersion = 0;
16274 origin = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16275 savedFilename.clear();
16276 sourceFileCount = 0;
16277 sourceFiles.clear();
16278 extentsMin = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16279 extentsMax = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16280 pointCount = 0;
16281 ucsName.clear();
16282 ucsOrigin = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16283 ucsXDirection = DRW_Coord{1.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16284 ucsYDirection = DRW_Coord{0.0, 1.0, 0.0};
16285 ucsZDirection = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
16286 definitionHandle = 0;
16287 reactorHandle = 0;
16288 showIntensity = false;
16289 intensityScheme = 0;
16290 intensityStyle = DRW_PointCloudIntensityStyle{};
16291 showClipping = false;
16292 clippingCount = 0;
16293 clippings.clear();
16294 m_dxfInBody = false;
16295 m_dxfSawClassVersion = false;
16296 m_dxfSawSourceCount = false;
16297 m_dxfSawPointCount = false;
16298}
16299
16300bool DRW_PointCloud::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs) {
16301 resetDwgState();
16302 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
16303 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
16304 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
16305 sourceBuf->invalidate();
16306 resetDwgState();
16307 return false;
16308 };
16309 if (sourceBuf == nullptr || version <= DRW::AC1018)
16310 return fail();
16311
16312 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
16313 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
16314 && std::isfinite(point.z);
16315 };
16316
16317 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
16318 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
16319 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, &bodyProbe, &stringProbe, bs))
16320 return fail();
16321
16322 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
16323 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
16324 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
16325 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
16326 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(stringProbe, version, objSize,
16327 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
16328 return fail();
16329 }
16330 std::uint16_t parsedClassVersion = 0;
16331 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedClassVersion)
16332 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, origin))
16333 return fail();
16334 classVersion = parsedClassVersion;
16335 if (!finite(origin))
16336 return fail();
16337 if (!readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, version,
16338 savedFilename))
16339 return fail();
16340 std::uint32_t declaredSourceFiles = 0;
16341 if (!readTableBodyCount(
16342 version, &bodyProbe, objSize,
16343 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kMaxItems), 2,
16344 declaredSourceFiles)) {
16345 return fail();
16346 }
16347 sourceFileCount = static_cast<int>(declaredSourceFiles);
16348 sourceFiles.clear();
16349
16350 if (sourceFileCount == 0) {
16351 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, extentsMin)
16352 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, extentsMax)
16353 || !readBoundedRawLong64(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, pointCount))
16354 return fail();
16355 if (!finite(extentsMin) || !finite(extentsMax))
16356 return fail();
16357 if (!readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, version,
16358 ucsName))
16359 return fail();
16360 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ucsOrigin)
16361 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ucsXDirection)
16362 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ucsYDirection)
16363 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ucsZDirection))
16364 return fail();
16365 if (!finite(ucsOrigin) || !finite(ucsXDirection)
16366 || !finite(ucsYDirection) || !finite(ucsZDirection)) {
16367 return fail();
16368 }
16369
16370 if (version > DRW::AC1024) {
16371 std::uint16_t parsedIntensityScheme = 0;
16372 if (!readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, showIntensity)
16373 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16374 parsedIntensityScheme)
16375 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16376 intensityStyle.minIntensity)
16377 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16378 intensityStyle.maxIntensity)
16379 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16380 intensityStyle.lowThreshold)
16381 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16382 intensityStyle.highThreshold))
16383 return fail();
16384 intensityScheme = static_cast<int>(parsedIntensityScheme);
16385 if (!std::isfinite(intensityStyle.minIntensity)
16386 || !std::isfinite(intensityStyle.maxIntensity)
16387 || !std::isfinite(intensityStyle.lowThreshold)
16388 || !std::isfinite(intensityStyle.highThreshold)) {
16389 return fail();
16390 }
16391 if (!readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, showClipping))
16392 return fail();
16393
16394 std::uint32_t declaredClippings = 0;
16395 if (!readTableBodyCount(
16396 version, &bodyProbe, objSize,
16397 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kMaxItems), 2,
16398 declaredClippings)) {
16399 return fail();
16400 }
16401 clippingCount = static_cast<int>(declaredClippings);
16402 clippings.clear();
16403 if (!DRW::reserve(clippings, clippingCount))
16404 return fail();
16405 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < clippingCount; ++i) {
16406 DRW_PointCloudClipping clipping;
16407 if (!readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16408 clipping.isInverted))
16409 return fail();
16410 std::uint16_t clippingType = 0;
16411 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, clippingType))
16412 return fail();
16413 clipping.type = clippingType;
16414 if (clipping.type < 1 || clipping.type > 3)
16415 return fail();
16416 std::uint32_t vertexCount = 2;
16417 if (clipping.type == 3
16418 && !readTableBodyCount(
16419 version, &bodyProbe, objSize,
16420 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kMaxItems), 128,
16421 vertexCount)) {
16422 return fail();
16423 }
16424 clipping.vertexCount = static_cast<int>(vertexCount);
16425 if (!DRW::reserve(clipping.vertices, clipping.vertexCount))
16426 return fail();
16427 for (std::int32_t j = 0; j < clipping.vertexCount; ++j) {
16428 DRW_Coord vertex;
16429 if (!readBounded2RawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, vertex))
16430 return fail();
16431 clipping.vertices.push_back(vertex);
16432 }
16433 if (clipping.type == 1) {
16434 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16435 clipping.zMin)
16436 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16437 clipping.zMax))
16438 return fail();
16439 }
16440 if (!std::all_of(
16441 clipping.vertices.begin(), clipping.vertices.end(),
16442 finite)
16443 || !std::isfinite(clipping.zMin)
16444 || !std::isfinite(clipping.zMax)) {
16445 return fail();
16446 }
16447 clippings.push_back(std::move(clipping));
16448 }
16449 } else {
16450 showIntensity = false;
16451 intensityScheme = 0;
16452 showClipping = false;
16453 clippingCount = 0;
16454 clippings.clear();
16455 }
16456 }
16457
16458 if (!DRW::reserve(sourceFiles, sourceFileCount))
16459 return fail();
16460 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < sourceFileCount; ++i) {
16461 UTF8STRINGstd::string sourceFile;
16462 if (!readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, version,
16463 sourceFile))
16464 return fail();
16465 sourceFiles.push_back(std::move(sourceFile));
16466 }
16467
16468 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood()
16469 || currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe) > bodyEndBit
16470 || currentDwgBit(&stringProbe) > stringEndBit)
16471 return fail();
16472
16473 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
16474 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
16475 handleEndBit))
16476 return fail();
16477 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
16478 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
16479 handleEndBit)
16480 || !handleProbe.isGood())
16481 return fail();
16482 std::uint32_t parsedDefinitionHandle = 0;
16483 std::uint32_t parsedReactorHandle = 0;
16484 if (version > DRW::AC1024 && sourceFileCount == 0) {
16485 dwgHandle definition;
16486 dwgHandle reactor;
16487 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
16488 definition)
16489 || !readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
16490 reactor))
16491 return fail();
16492 parsedDefinitionHandle = definition.ref;
16493 parsedReactorHandle = reactor.ref;
16494 }
16495 if (!handleProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood())
16496 return fail();
16497 definitionHandle = parsedDefinitionHandle;
16498 reactorHandle = parsedReactorHandle;
16499 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
16500 return true;
16501}
16502
16503bool DRW_PointCloud::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
16504 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
16505 (void)bs;
16506 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
16507 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
16508 && std::isfinite(point.z);
16509 };
16510 if (version <= DRW::AC1018
16511 || classVersion > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()
16512 || sourceFileCount < 0
16513 || sourceFileCount > static_cast<int>(kMaxItems)
16514 || sourceFiles.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceFileCount)
16515 || clippingCount < 0
16516 || (sourceFileCount == 0 && clippings.size() > kMaxItems)
16517 || (sourceFileCount != 0
16518 && (clippingCount != 0 || !clippings.empty()
16519 || showIntensity || showClipping))
16520 || intensityScheme < 0
16521 || intensityScheme > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()
16522 || clippings.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(clippingCount)) {
16523 return false;
16524 }
16525 if (!finite(origin) || !finite(extentsMin) || !finite(extentsMax)
16526 || !finite(ucsOrigin) || !finite(ucsXDirection)
16527 || !finite(ucsYDirection) || !finite(ucsZDirection)
16528 || !std::isfinite(intensityStyle.minIntensity)
16529 || !std::isfinite(intensityStyle.maxIntensity)
16530 || !std::isfinite(intensityStyle.lowThreshold)
16531 || !std::isfinite(intensityStyle.highThreshold)) {
16532 return false;
16533 }
16534 for (const DRW_PointCloudClipping& clipping : clippings) {
16535 if (clipping.type < 1 || clipping.type > 3
16536 || clipping.vertexCount < 0
16537 || clipping.vertexCount > static_cast<int>(kMaxItems)
16538 || clipping.vertices.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(clipping.vertexCount)
16539 || (clipping.type != 3 && clipping.vertexCount != 2)
16540 || !std::isfinite(clipping.zMin)
16541 || !std::isfinite(clipping.zMax)) {
16542 return false;
16543 }
16544 for (const DRW_Coord& vertex : clipping.vertices) {
16545 if (!finite(vertex))
16546 return false;
16547 }
16548 }
16549
16550 oType = kDwgClassNum;
16551 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf, strBuf))
16552 return false;
16553 dwgBufferW *sBuf = strBuf ? strBuf : buf;
16554 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(classVersion));
16555 buf->put3BitDouble(origin);
16556 sBuf->putVariableText(version, savedFilename);
16557 buf->putBitLong(sourceFileCount);
16558 if (sourceFileCount == 0) {
16559 buf->put3BitDouble(extentsMin);
16560 buf->put3BitDouble(extentsMax);
16561 buf->putRawLong64(pointCount);
16562 sBuf->putVariableText(version, ucsName);
16563 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsOrigin);
16564 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsXDirection);
16565 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsYDirection);
16566 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsZDirection);
16567
16568 if (version > DRW::AC1024) {
16569 buf->putBit(showIntensity ? 1 : 0);
16570 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(intensityScheme));
16571 buf->putBitDouble(intensityStyle.minIntensity);
16572 buf->putBitDouble(intensityStyle.maxIntensity);
16573 buf->putBitDouble(intensityStyle.lowThreshold);
16574 buf->putBitDouble(intensityStyle.highThreshold);
16575 buf->putBit(showClipping ? 1 : 0);
16576 buf->putBitLong(clippingCount);
16577 for (const DRW_PointCloudClipping& clipping : clippings) {
16578 buf->putBit(clipping.isInverted ? 1 : 0);
16579 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(clipping.type));
16580 if (clipping.type == 3)
16581 buf->putBitLong(clipping.vertexCount);
16582 for (const DRW_Coord& vertex : clipping.vertices)
16583 buf->put2RawDouble(vertex);
16584 if (clipping.type == 1) {
16585 buf->putBitDouble(clipping.zMin);
16586 buf->putBitDouble(clipping.zMax);
16587 }
16588 }
16589 }
16590 }
16591 for (const UTF8STRINGstd::string& sourceFile : sourceFiles)
16592 sBuf->putVariableText(version, sourceFile);
16593
16594 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf))
16595 return false;
16596 if (version > DRW::AC1024 && sourceFileCount == 0) {
16597 dwgBufferW *hBuf = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
16598 auto putHandle = [hBuf](std::uint8_t code, std::uint32_t ref) {
16599 dwgHandle handle;
16600 handle.code = ref == 0 ? 0 : code;
16601 handle.ref = ref;
16602 handle.size = 0;
16603 for (std::uint32_t value = ref; value != 0; value >>= 8)
16604 ++handle.size;
16605 hBuf->putHandle(handle);
16606 };
16607 putHandle(5, definitionHandle);
16608 putHandle(3, reactorHandle);
16609 }
16610 return true;
16611}
16612
16613bool DRW_PointCloudEx::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
16614 if (code == 100) {
16615 m_dxfInBody = reader->getString() == "AcDbPointCloud";
16616 return true;
16617 }
16618 if (!m_dxfInBody)
16619 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
16620 switch (code) {
16621 case 70:
16622 if (m_dxfSeen70++ != 0) return false;
16623 classVersion = reader->getInt32();
16624 break;
16625 case 10: extentsMin.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16626 case 20: extentsMin.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16627 case 30: extentsMin.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16628 case 11: extentsMax.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16629 case 21: extentsMax.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16630 case 31: extentsMax.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16631 case 12: ucsOrigin.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16632 case 22: ucsOrigin.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16633 case 32: ucsOrigin.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16634 case 210: ucsXDirection.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16635 case 220: ucsXDirection.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16636 case 230: ucsXDirection.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16637 case 211: ucsYDirection.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16638 case 221: ucsYDirection.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16639 case 231: ucsYDirection.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16640 case 212: ucsZDirection.x = reader->getDouble(); break;
16641 case 222: ucsZDirection.y = reader->getDouble(); break;
16642 case 232: ucsZDirection.z = reader->getDouble(); break;
16643 case 290:
16644 if (m_dxfHasCropping) {
16645 if (m_dxfSeen290 % 2 == 0)
16646 m_dxfCurrentCropping.isInside = reader->getBool();
16647 else
16648 m_dxfCurrentCropping.isInverted = reader->getBool();
16649 ++m_dxfSeen290;
16650 } else {
16651 if (m_dxfSeen290++ != 0) return false;
16652 isLocked = reader->getBool();
16653 }
16654 break;
16655 case 330:
16656 if (!m_dxfInBody)
16657 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
16658 definitionHandle = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getHandleString());
16659 break;
16660 case 360:
16661 reactorHandle = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(reader->getHandleString());
16662 break;
16663 case 1:
16664 switch (m_dxfTextCount++) {
16665 case 0: name = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
16666 case 1: intensityColorScheme = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
16667 case 2: currentColorScheme = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
16668 case 3: classificationColorScheme = reader->getUtf8String(); break;
16669 default: return false;
16670 }
16671 break;
16672 case 291: showIntensity = reader->getBool(); break;
16673 case 295: showCropping = reader->getBool(); break;
16674 case 71:
16675 if (m_dxfSeen71++ == 0)
16676 stylizationType = reader->getInt32();
16677 else if (m_dxfSeen71 == 2)
16678 intensityOutOfRangeBehavior = reader->getInt32();
16679 else
16680 return false;
16681 break;
16682 case 72: elevationOutOfRangeBehavior = reader->getInt32(); break;
16683 case 40:
16684 if (m_dxfSeen40++ == 0)
16685 elevationMin = reader->getDouble();
16686 else if (m_dxfSeen40 == 2)
16687 elevationMax = reader->getDouble();
16688 else
16689 return false;
16690 break;
16691 case 41: elevationMax = reader->getDouble(); break;
16692 case 90:
16693 if (m_dxfSeen90++ != 0) return false;
16694 intensityMin = reader->getInt32();
16695 break;
16696 case 91:
16697 if (m_dxfSeen91++ != 0) return false;
16698 intensityMax = reader->getInt32();
16699 break;
16700 case 292: elevationApplyToFixedRange = reader->getBool(); break;
16701 case 293: intensityAsGradient = reader->getBool(); break;
16702 case 294: elevationAsGradient = reader->getBool(); break;
16703 case 92: {
16704 if (m_dxfSawCroppingCount) return false;
16705 const std::int32_t count = reader->getInt32();
16706 if (!isValidCount(count, static_cast<std::int32_t>(kMaxItems)))
16707 return false;
16708 croppingCount = count;
16709 m_dxfSawCroppingCount = true;
16710 break;
16711 }
16712 case 93:
16713 if (m_dxfHasCropping) {
16714 if (m_dxfSeen93++ != 0) return false;
16715 m_dxfCurrentCropping.pointCount = reader->getInt32();
16716 if (!isValidCount(m_dxfCurrentCropping.pointCount,
16717 static_cast<std::int32_t>(kMaxItems))) {
16718 return false;
16719 }
16720 m_dxfCurrentCropping.points.clear();
16721 if (!DRW::reserve(m_dxfCurrentCropping.points,
16722 m_dxfCurrentCropping.pointCount))
16723 return false;
16724 } else if (m_dxfSawCroppingCount && croppingCount == 0) {
16725 if (m_dxfSeen93++ == 0)
16726 unknownInt0 = reader->getInt32();
16727 else if (m_dxfSeen93 == 2)
16728 unknownInt1 = reader->getInt32();
16729 else
16730 return false;
16731 } else {
16732 return false;
16733 }
16734 break;
16735 case 280:
16736 if (!m_dxfSawCroppingCount || croppingCount == 0
16737 || !finishDxfCropping()) {
16738 return false;
16739 }
16740 m_dxfCurrentCropping = DRW_PointCloudExCropping{};
16741 m_dxfCurrentCropping.type = reader->getInt32();
16742 if (m_dxfCurrentCropping.type < 0
16743 || m_dxfCurrentCropping.type > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()) {
16744 return false;
16745 }
16746 m_dxfHasCropping = true;
16747 m_dxfSeen290 = 0;
16748 m_dxfSeen93 = 0;
16749 m_dxfDirectionComponent = 0;
16750 m_dxfCropPlaneComponent = 0;
16751 m_dxfCropPointOpen = false;
16752 break;
16753 case 13:
16754 case 23:
16755 case 33:
16756 if (!m_dxfHasCropping) {
16757 if (code == 13) ucsOrigin.x = reader->getDouble();
16758 else if (code == 23) ucsOrigin.y = reader->getDouble();
16759 else ucsOrigin.z = reader->getDouble();
16760 } else if (m_dxfCropPlaneComponent < 3) {
16761 if (code == 13 && m_dxfCropPlaneComponent != 0) return false;
16762 if (code == 23 && m_dxfCropPlaneComponent != 1) return false;
16763 if (code == 33 && m_dxfCropPlaneComponent != 2) return false;
16764 const double value = reader->getDouble();
16765 if (code == 13) m_dxfCurrentCropping.cropPlane.x = value;
16766 else if (code == 23) m_dxfCurrentCropping.cropPlane.y = value;
16767 else m_dxfCurrentCropping.cropPlane.z = value;
16768 ++m_dxfCropPlaneComponent;
16769 } else {
16770 if (code == 13) {
16771 if (m_dxfCropPointOpen) return false;
16772 m_dxfCropPoint = DRW_Coord{};
16773 m_dxfCropPointOpen = true;
16774 } else if (!m_dxfCropPointOpen) {
16775 return false;
16776 }
16777 const double value = reader->getDouble();
16778 if (code == 13) m_dxfCropPoint.x = value;
16779 else if (code == 23) m_dxfCropPoint.y = value;
16780 else m_dxfCropPoint.z = value;
16781 if (code == 33) {
16782 m_dxfCurrentCropping.points.push_back(m_dxfCropPoint);
16783 m_dxfCropPointOpen = false;
16784 }
16785 }
16786 break;
16787 case 213:
16788 case 223:
16789 case 233: {
16790 if (!m_dxfHasCropping || m_dxfDirectionComponent >= 6)
16791 return false;
16792 const double value = reader->getDouble();
16793 DRW_Coord *direction = m_dxfDirectionComponent < 3
16794 ? &m_dxfCurrentCropping.cropXDirection
16795 : &m_dxfCurrentCropping.cropYDirection;
16796 const int component = static_cast<int>(m_dxfDirectionComponent % 3);
16797 if ((component == 0 && code != 213)
16798 || (component == 1 && code != 223)
16799 || (component == 2 && code != 233)) {
16800 return false;
16801 }
16802 if (component == 0) direction->x = value;
16803 else if (component == 1) direction->y = value;
16804 else direction->z = value;
16805 ++m_dxfDirectionComponent;
16806 break;
16807 }
16808 default:
16809 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
16810 }
16811 return true;
16812}
16813
16814bool DRW_PointCloudEx::finishDxfCropping() {
16815 if (!m_dxfHasCropping)
16816 return true;
16817 if (m_dxfSeen290 != 2 || m_dxfDirectionComponent != 6
16818 || m_dxfCropPlaneComponent != 3 || m_dxfCropPointOpen
16819 || m_dxfSeen93 != 1
16820 || m_dxfCurrentCropping.points.size()
16821 != static_cast<std::size_t>(m_dxfCurrentCropping.pointCount)) {
16822 return false;
16823 }
16824 croppings.push_back(m_dxfCurrentCropping);
16825 m_dxfHasCropping = false;
16826 return true;
16827}
16828
16829bool DRW_PointCloudEx::finalizeDxf() {
16830 if (!finishDxfCropping())
16831 return false;
16832 if (m_dxfSeen70 != 1 || !m_dxfSawCroppingCount)
16833 return false;
16834 if (croppingCount == 0)
16835 return m_dxfSeen93 == 2 && croppings.empty();
16836 return croppings.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(croppingCount);
16837}
16838
16839void DRW_PointCloudEx::resetDwgState() {
16840 DRW_Entity::reset();
16841 classVersion = 0;
16842 extentsMin = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16843 extentsMax = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16844 ucsOrigin = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16845 ucsXDirection = DRW_Coord{1.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16846 ucsYDirection = DRW_Coord{0.0, 1.0, 0.0};
16847 ucsZDirection = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
16848 isLocked = false;
16849 definitionHandle = 0;
16850 reactorHandle = 0;
16851 name.clear();
16852 showIntensity = false;
16853 showCropping = false;
16854 croppingCount = 0;
16855 unknownInt0 = 0;
16856 unknownInt1 = 0;
16857 stylizationType = 0;
16858 intensityColorScheme.clear();
16859 currentColorScheme.clear();
16860 classificationColorScheme.clear();
16861 elevationMin = 0.0;
16862 elevationMax = 0.0;
16863 intensityMin = 0.0;
16864 intensityMax = 0.0;
16865 intensityOutOfRangeBehavior = 0;
16866 elevationOutOfRangeBehavior = 0;
16867 elevationApplyToFixedRange = false;
16868 intensityAsGradient = false;
16869 elevationAsGradient = false;
16870 croppings.clear();
16871 m_dxfCurrentCropping = DRW_PointCloudExCropping{};
16872 m_dxfTextCount = 0;
16873 m_dxfSeen70 = 0;
16874 m_dxfSeen71 = 0;
16875 m_dxfSeen90 = 0;
16876 m_dxfSeen91 = 0;
16877 m_dxfSeen93 = 0;
16878 m_dxfSeen290 = 0;
16879 m_dxfSeen40 = 0;
16880 m_dxfDirectionComponent = 0;
16881 m_dxfCropPlaneComponent = 0;
16882 m_dxfSawCroppingCount = false;
16883 m_dxfInBody = false;
16884 m_dxfHasCropping = false;
16885 m_dxfCropPointOpen = false;
16886 m_dxfCropPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
16887}
16888
16889bool DRW_PointCloudEx::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs) {
16890 resetDwgState();
16891 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
16892 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
16893 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
16894 sourceBuf->invalidate();
16895 resetDwgState();
16896 return false;
16897 };
16898 if (sourceBuf == nullptr || version <= DRW::AC1024)
16899 return fail();
16900
16901 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
16902 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
16903 && std::isfinite(point.z);
16904 };
16905 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
16906 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
16907 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, &bodyProbe, &stringProbe, bs))
16908 return fail();
16909
16910 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
16911 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
16912 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
16913 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
16914 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(stringProbe, version, objSize,
16915 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
16916 return fail();
16917 }
16918 std::uint16_t parsedClassVersion = 0;
16919 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedClassVersion)
16920 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, extentsMin)
16921 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, extentsMax)
16922 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ucsOrigin)
16923 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ucsXDirection)
16924 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ucsYDirection)
16925 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ucsZDirection))
16926 return fail();
16927 classVersion = parsedClassVersion;
16928 if (!finite(extentsMin) || !finite(extentsMax) || !finite(ucsOrigin)
16929 || !finite(ucsXDirection) || !finite(ucsYDirection)
16930 || !finite(ucsZDirection)) {
16931 return fail();
16932 }
16933 if (!readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, isLocked))
16934 return fail();
16935 if (!readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, version, name))
16936 return fail();
16937 if (!readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, showIntensity)
16938 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, showCropping))
16939 return fail();
16940 std::uint32_t declaredCroppings = 0;
16941 if (!readTableBodyCount(
16942 version, &bodyProbe, objSize,
16943 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kMaxItems), 24,
16944 declaredCroppings)) {
16945 return fail();
16946 }
16947 croppingCount = static_cast<int>(declaredCroppings);
16948 croppings.clear();
16949 if (croppingCount == 0) {
16950 std::uint16_t parsedStylizationType = 0;
16951 if (!readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, unknownInt0)
16952 || !readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, unknownInt1)
16953 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16954 parsedStylizationType))
16955 return fail();
16956 stylizationType = parsedStylizationType;
16957 if (!readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, version,
16958 intensityColorScheme)
16959 || !readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, version,
16960 currentColorScheme)
16961 || !readBoundedVariableText(stringProbe, stringEndBit, version,
16962 classificationColorScheme))
16963 return fail();
16964 std::int32_t parsedIntensityMin = 0;
16965 std::int32_t parsedIntensityMax = 0;
16966 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, elevationMin)
16967 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, elevationMax)
16968 || !readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedIntensityMin)
16969 || !readBoundedBitLong(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedIntensityMax))
16970 return fail();
16971 intensityMin = static_cast<double>(parsedIntensityMin);
16972 intensityMax = static_cast<double>(parsedIntensityMax);
16973 if (!std::isfinite(elevationMin) || !std::isfinite(elevationMax))
16974 return fail();
16975 std::uint16_t parsedIntensityBehavior = 0;
16976 std::uint16_t parsedElevationBehavior = 0;
16977 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16978 parsedIntensityBehavior)
16979 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16980 parsedElevationBehavior)
16981 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
16982 elevationApplyToFixedRange)
16983 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, intensityAsGradient)
16984 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, elevationAsGradient))
16985 return fail();
16986 intensityOutOfRangeBehavior = parsedIntensityBehavior;
16987 elevationOutOfRangeBehavior = parsedElevationBehavior;
16988 } else {
16989 unknownInt0 = 0;
16990 unknownInt1 = 0;
16991 }
16992 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood()
16993 || currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe) > bodyEndBit
16994 || currentDwgBit(&stringProbe) > stringEndBit)
16995 return fail();
16996
16997 if (!DRW::reserve(croppings, croppingCount))
16998 return fail();
16999 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < declaredCroppings; ++i) {
17000 DRW_PointCloudExCropping cropping;
17001 std::uint16_t croppingType = 0;
17002 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, croppingType)
17003 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, cropping.isInside)
17004 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, cropping.isInverted)
17005 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
17006 cropping.cropPlane)
17007 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
17008 cropping.cropXDirection)
17009 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
17010 cropping.cropYDirection)) {
17011 return fail();
17012 }
17013 cropping.type = static_cast<int>(croppingType);
17014 if (!finite(cropping.cropPlane) || !finite(cropping.cropXDirection)
17015 || !finite(cropping.cropYDirection)) {
17016 return fail();
17017 }
17018 std::uint32_t declaredPoints = 0;
17019 if (!readTableBodyCount(
17020 version, &bodyProbe, objSize,
17021 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kMaxItems),
17022 6, declaredPoints)) {
17023 return fail();
17024 }
17025 std::uint64_t pointBits = 0;
17026 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(declaredPoints, 6, pointBits)
17027 || !proxyEntityHasBits(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, pointBits)) {
17028 return fail();
17029 }
17030 cropping.pointCount = static_cast<int>(declaredPoints);
17031 if (!DRW::reserve(cropping.points, cropping.pointCount))
17032 return fail();
17033 for (std::uint32_t j = 0; j < declaredPoints; ++j) {
17034 DRW_Coord point;
17035 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, point))
17036 return fail();
17037 cropping.points.push_back(point);
17038 }
17039 if (!std::all_of(cropping.points.begin(), cropping.points.end(), finite))
17040 return fail();
17041 croppings.push_back(std::move(cropping));
17042 }
17043
17044 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
17045 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
17046 handleEndBit))
17047 return fail();
17048 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
17049 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
17050 handleEndBit)
17051 || !handleProbe.isGood())
17052 return fail();
17053 dwgHandle definition;
17054 dwgHandle reactor;
17055 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
17056 definition)
17057 || !readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
17058 reactor))
17059 return fail();
17060 const std::uint32_t parsedDefinitionHandle = definition.ref;
17061 const std::uint32_t parsedReactorHandle = reactor.ref;
17062 if (!handleProbe.isGood() || !stringProbe.isGood())
17063 return fail();
17064 definitionHandle = parsedDefinitionHandle;
17065 reactorHandle = parsedReactorHandle;
17066 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
17067 return true;
17068}
17069
17070bool DRW_PointCloudEx::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
17071 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
17072 (void)bs;
17073 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
17074 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
17075 && std::isfinite(point.z);
17076 };
17077 const auto fitsUint16 = [](int value) {
17078 return value >= 0
17079 && value <= std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max();
17080 };
17081 if (version <= DRW::AC1024
17082 || classVersion > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()
17083 || croppingCount < 0
17084 || croppingCount > static_cast<int>(kMaxItems)
17085 || croppings.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(croppingCount)) {
17086 return false;
17087 }
17088 for (const DRW_PointCloudExCropping& cropping : croppings) {
17089 if (cropping.pointCount < 0
17090 || cropping.pointCount > static_cast<int>(kMaxItems)
17091 || cropping.points.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(cropping.pointCount)) {
17092 return false;
17093 }
17094 if (!fitsUint16(cropping.type) || !finite(cropping.cropPlane)
17095 || !finite(cropping.cropXDirection)
17096 || !finite(cropping.cropYDirection)) {
17097 return false;
17098 }
17099 for (const DRW_Coord& point : cropping.points) {
17100 if (!finite(point))
17101 return false;
17102 }
17103 }
17104 if (!finite(extentsMin) || !finite(extentsMax) || !finite(ucsOrigin)
17105 || !finite(ucsXDirection) || !finite(ucsYDirection)
17106 || !finite(ucsZDirection) || !std::isfinite(elevationMin)
17107 || !std::isfinite(elevationMax)
17108 || !fitsUint16(stylizationType)
17109 || !fitsUint16(intensityOutOfRangeBehavior)
17110 || !fitsUint16(elevationOutOfRangeBehavior)) {
17111 return false;
17112 }
17113 const auto integral32 = [](double value) {
17114 return std::isfinite(value)
17115 && value >= static_cast<double>(std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min())
17116 && value <= static_cast<double>(std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max())
17117 && std::floor(value) == value;
17118 };
17119 if (croppingCount == 0
17120 && (!integral32(intensityMin) || !integral32(intensityMax))) {
17121 return false;
17122 }
17123
17124 oType = kDwgClassNum;
17125 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf, strBuf))
17126 return false;
17127 dwgBufferW *sBuf = strBuf ? strBuf : buf;
17128 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(classVersion));
17129 buf->put3BitDouble(extentsMin);
17130 buf->put3BitDouble(extentsMax);
17131 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsOrigin);
17132 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsXDirection);
17133 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsYDirection);
17134 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsZDirection);
17135 buf->putBit(isLocked ? 1 : 0);
17136 sBuf->putVariableText(version, name);
17137 buf->putBit(showIntensity ? 1 : 0);
17138 buf->putBit(showCropping ? 1 : 0);
17139 buf->putBitLong(croppingCount);
17140 if (croppingCount == 0) {
17141 buf->putBitLong(unknownInt0);
17142 buf->putBitLong(unknownInt1);
17143 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(stylizationType));
17144 sBuf->putVariableText(version, intensityColorScheme);
17145 sBuf->putVariableText(version, currentColorScheme);
17146 sBuf->putVariableText(version, classificationColorScheme);
17147 buf->putBitDouble(elevationMin);
17148 buf->putBitDouble(elevationMax);
17149 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(intensityMin));
17150 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(intensityMax));
17151 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(intensityOutOfRangeBehavior));
17152 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(elevationOutOfRangeBehavior));
17153 buf->putBit(elevationApplyToFixedRange ? 1 : 0);
17154 buf->putBit(intensityAsGradient ? 1 : 0);
17155 buf->putBit(elevationAsGradient ? 1 : 0);
17156 }
17157 for (const DRW_PointCloudExCropping& cropping : croppings) {
17158 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(cropping.type));
17159 buf->putBit(cropping.isInside ? 1 : 0);
17160 buf->putBit(cropping.isInverted ? 1 : 0);
17161 buf->put3BitDouble(cropping.cropPlane);
17162 buf->put3BitDouble(cropping.cropXDirection);
17163 buf->put3BitDouble(cropping.cropYDirection);
17164 buf->putBitLong(cropping.pointCount);
17165 for (const DRW_Coord& point : cropping.points)
17166 buf->put3BitDouble(point);
17167 }
17168 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf))
17169 return false;
17170
17171 dwgBufferW *hBuf = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
17172 auto putHandle = [hBuf](std::uint8_t code, std::uint32_t ref) {
17173 dwgHandle handle;
17174 handle.code = ref == 0 ? 0 : code;
17175 handle.ref = ref;
17176 handle.size = 0;
17177 for (std::uint32_t value = ref; value != 0; value >>= 8)
17178 ++handle.size;
17179 hBuf->putHandle(handle);
17180 };
17181 putHandle(5, definitionHandle);
17182 putHandle(3, reactorHandle);
17183 return true;
17184}
17185
17186bool DRW_Surface::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
17187 switch (code) {
17188 case 1:
17189 case 3:
17190 // SURFACE ACIS payloads use text groups in the AcDbModelerGeometry
17191 // subclass. Keep the bytes verbatim; group 3 is a continuation of
17192 // the same payload and must not be interpreted as a surface field.
17193 if (!appendTextBytesChecked(rawAcisData, reader->getString(),
17194 dwgSafety::MaxBufferSize))
17195 return false;
17196 break;
17197 case 70:
17198 modelerFormatVersion = reader->getInt32();
17199 break;
17200 case 71:
17201 uIsolines = reader->getInt32();
17202 break;
17203 case 72:
17204 vIsolines = reader->getInt32();
17205 break;
17206 case 310:
17207 {
17208 std::vector<std::uint8_t> decoded;
17209 if (!decodeHexBytes(reader->getString(), decoded))
17210 return false;
17211 if (!appendBytesChecked(rawAcisData, decoded,
17212 dwgSafety::MaxBufferSize))
17213 return false;
17214 }
17215 break;
17216 default:
17217 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
17218 }
17219 return true;
17220}

17222bool DRW_ExtrudedSurface::parseCode(
17223 int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
17224 switch (code) {
17225 case 100: {
17226 const std::string marker = reader->getString();
17227 if (marker == "AcDbExtrudedSurface")
17228 m_dxfInSubtype = true;
17229 else if (marker == "AcDbModelerGeometry"
17230 || marker == "AcDbSurface")
17231 m_dxfInSubtype = false;
17232 break;
17233 }
17234 case 90:
17235 if (m_dxfClassIdSeen)
17236 return false;
17237 {
17238 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
17239 if (value < 0)
17240 return false;
17241 classId = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value);
17242 m_dxfClassIdSeen = true;
17243 }
17244 break;
17245 case 10:
17246 sweepVector.x = reader->getDouble();
17247 break;
17248 case 20:
17249 sweepVector.y = reader->getDouble();
17250 break;
17251 case 30:
17252 sweepVector.z = reader->getDouble();
17253 break;
17254 case 11:
17255 referenceVector.x = reader->getDouble();
17256 break;
17257 case 21:
17258 referenceVector.y = reader->getDouble();
17259 break;
17260 case 31:
17261 referenceVector.z = reader->getDouble();
17262 break;
17263 case 40:
17264 if (m_dxfExtrudedTransformCount >= extrudedTransform.size())
17265 return false;
17266 extrudedTransform[m_dxfExtrudedTransformCount++] = reader->getDouble();
17267 break;
17268 case 41:
17269 // Code 41 is not part of the AcDbExtrudedSurface mapping. Keep an
17270 // unexpected value out of the common entity state.
17271 return false;
17272 case 42:
17273 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17274 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17275 draftAngle = reader->getDouble();
17276 break;
17277 case 43:
17278 draftStartDistance = reader->getDouble();
17279 break;
17280 case 44:
17281 draftEndDistance = reader->getDouble();
17282 break;
17283 case 45:
17284 twistAngle = reader->getDouble();
17285 break;
17286 case 46:
17287 if (m_dxfSweepTransformCount >= sweepEntityTransform.size())
17288 return false;
17289 sweepEntityTransform[m_dxfSweepTransformCount++] = reader->getDouble();
17290 break;
17291 case 47:
17292 if (m_dxfPathTransformCount >= pathEntityTransform.size())
17293 return false;
17294 pathEntityTransform[m_dxfPathTransformCount++] = reader->getDouble();
17295 break;
17296 case 48:
17297 scaleFactor = reader->getDouble();
17298 break;
17299 case 49:
17300 alignAngle = reader->getDouble();
17301 break;
17302 case 70:
17303 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17304 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17305 {
17306 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
17307 if (value < 0 || value > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
17308 return false;
17309 sweepAlignmentFlags = value;
17310 }
17311 break;
17312 case 71:
17313 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17314 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17315 {
17316 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
17317 if (value < 0 || value > std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
17318 return false;
17319 pathFlags = value;
17320 }
17321 break;
17322 case 290:
17323 solid = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17324 break;
17325 case 292:
17326 alignStart = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17327 break;
17328 case 293:
17329 bank = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17330 break;
17331 case 294:
17332 basePointSet = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17333 break;
17334 case 295:
17335 sweepEntityTransformComputed = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17336 break;
17337 case 296:
17338 pathEntityTransformComputed = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17339 break;
17340 default:
17341 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17342 }
17343 return true;
17344}

17372 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17373 {
17374 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();

17418 break;

17423 referenceVector.z = reader->getDouble();
17424 break;
17425 case 40:
17426 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17427 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);

17431 sweepEntityTransformed[m_dxfSweepTransformCount++] = reader->getDouble();

17460 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)

17465 case 46:

17488 break;
17489 case 49:

17495 case 70:

17500 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();

17502 return false;
17503 sweepAlignmentFlags = value;

17505 break;
17506 case 71:
17507 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)

17509 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;

17515 }
17516 break;
17517 case 290:
17518 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17519 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);

17521 solid = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17522 break;
17523 case 292:
17524 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17525 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);

17528 break;
17529 case 293:

17534 break;

17541 case 295:

17544 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;

17547 case 296:
17548 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17549 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17550 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;

17570bool DRW_LoftedSurface::parseCode(
17571 int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
17572 switch (code) {
17573 case 100: {
17574 const std::string marker = reader->getString();
17575 if (marker == "AcDbLoftedSurface")
17576 m_dxfInSubtype = true;
17577 else if (marker == "AcDbModelerGeometry"
17578 || marker == "AcDbSurface")
17579 m_dxfInSubtype = false;
17580 break;
17581 }
17582 case 40:
17583 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17584 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17585 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17586 if (m_dxfTransformCount >= loftEntityTransform.size())
17587 return false;
17588 loftEntityTransform[m_dxfTransformCount++] = reader->getDouble();
17589 break;
17590 case 70:
17591 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17592 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17593 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17594 planeNormalLoftingType = reader->getInt32();
17595 break;
17596 case 41:
17597 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17598 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17599 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17600 startDraftAngle = reader->getDouble();
17601 break;
17602 case 42:
17603 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17604 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17605 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17606 endDraftAngle = reader->getDouble();
17607 break;
17608 case 43:
17609 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17610 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17611 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17612 startDraftMagnitude = reader->getDouble();
17613 break;
17614 case 44:
17615 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17616 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17617 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17618 endDraftMagnitude = reader->getDouble();
17619 break;
17620 case 90: {
17621 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17622 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17623 if (m_dxfReferenceTokenCount >= kMaxReferenceTokenCount)
17624 return false;
17625 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
17626 if (value < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(value)
17627 > kMaxReferenceTokenCount)
17628 return false;
17629 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17630 dxfReferenceData.emplace_back(90, value);
17631 ++m_dxfReferenceTokenCount;
17632 break;
17633 }
17634 case 310: {
17635 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17636 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17637 std::vector<std::uint8_t> decoded;
17638 if (!decodeHexBytes(reader->getString(), decoded))
17639 return false;
17640 if (m_dxfReferenceTokenCount >= kMaxReferenceTokenCount
17641 || decoded.size() > kMaxReferenceDataSize
17642 || m_dxfReferenceDataSize
17643 > kMaxReferenceDataSize - decoded.size())
17644 return false;
17645 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17646 dxfReferenceData.emplace_back(310, std::move(decoded));
17647 m_dxfReferenceDataSize += dxfReferenceData.back().binary()->size();
17648 ++m_dxfReferenceTokenCount;
17649 break;
17650 }
17651 case 290:
17652 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17653 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17654 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17655 arcLengthParameterization = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17656 break;
17657 case 291:
17658 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17659 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17660 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17661 noTwist = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17662 break;
17663 case 292:
17664 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17665 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17666 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17667 alignDirection = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17668 break;
17669 case 293:
17670 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17671 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17672 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17673 simpleSurfaces = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17674 break;
17675 case 294:
17676 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17677 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17678 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17679 closedSurfaces = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17680 break;
17681 case 295:
17682 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17683 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17684 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17685 solid = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17686 break;
17687 case 296:
17688 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17689 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17690 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17691 ruledSurface = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17692 break;
17693 case 297:
17694 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17695 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17696 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17697 virtualGuide = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17698 break;
17699 case 5:
17700 if (!m_dxfInSubtype)
17701 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17702 if (!reader->isValidHandleString())
17703 return false;
17704 m_dxfTypedFieldSeen = true;
17705 pathCurveHandle = reader->getHandleString();
17706 break;
17707 default:
17708 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17709 }
17710 return true;
17711}

17713bool DRW_LoftedSurface::finalizeDxf() const {
17714 if (!m_dxfTypedFieldSeen)

17716 return m_dxfInSubtype
17717 && m_dxfTransformCount == loftEntityTransform.size()
17718 && std::all_of(loftEntityTransform.begin(), loftEntityTransform.end(),

17720 && std::isfinite(startDraftAngle)
17721 && std::isfinite(endDraftAngle)
17722 && std::isfinite(startDraftMagnitude)
17723 && std::isfinite(endDraftMagnitude);

17844
17845bool DRW_NurbsSurface::finalizeDxf() const {
17846 if (!m_dxfTypedFieldSeen)
17847 return true;
17848 const bool coordinatesSeen = std::any_of(
17849 m_dxfCoordinateMask.begin(), m_dxfCoordinateMask.end(),
17850 [](std::uint8_t mask) { return mask != 0; });
17851 if (!m_dxfInSubtype
17852 || (coordinatesSeen && std::any_of(
17853 m_dxfCoordinateMask.begin(), m_dxfCoordinateMask.end(),
17854 [](std::uint8_t mask) { return mask != 7; }))) {
17855 return false;
17856 }
17857 return std::all_of(m_dxfCoordinateMask.begin(), m_dxfCoordinateMask.end(),
17858 [](std::uint8_t mask) { return mask == 0 || mask == 7; })
17859 && std::isfinite(uvec1.x) && std::isfinite(uvec1.y)
17860 && std::isfinite(uvec1.z) && std::isfinite(vvec1.x)
17861 && std::isfinite(vvec1.y) && std::isfinite(vvec1.z)
17862 && std::isfinite(uvec2.x) && std::isfinite(uvec2.y)
17863 && std::isfinite(uvec2.z) && std::isfinite(vvec2.x)
17864 && std::isfinite(vvec2.y) && std::isfinite(vvec2.z);
17865}
17866
17867bool DRW_RevolvedSurface::parseCode(
17868 int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
17869 switch (code) {
17870 case 90:
17871 if (!m_dxfClassIdSeen) {
17872 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
17873 if (value < 0)
17874 return false;
17875 classId = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value);
17876 m_dxfClassIdSeen = true;
17877 } else {
17878 const std::int32_t value = reader->getInt32();
17879 if (value < 0)
17880 return false;
17881 id = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value);
17882 }
17883 break;
17884 case 10:
17885 axisPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
17886 break;
17887 case 20:
17888 axisPoint.y = reader->getDouble();
17889 break;
17890 case 30:
17891 axisPoint.z = reader->getDouble();
17892 break;
17893 case 11:
17894 axisVector.x = reader->getDouble();
17895 break;
17896 case 21:
17897 axisVector.y = reader->getDouble();
17898 break;
17899 case 31:
17900 axisVector.z = reader->getDouble();
17901 break;
17902 case 40:
17903 revolveAngle = reader->getDouble();
17904 break;
17905 case 41:
17906 startAngle = reader->getDouble();
17907 break;
17908 case 42:
17909 if (m_dxfTransformCount >= transform.size())
17910 return false;
17911 transform[m_dxfTransformCount++] = reader->getDouble();
17912 break;
17913 case 43:
17914 draftAngle = reader->getDouble();
17915 break;
17916 case 44:
17917 draftStartDistance = reader->getDouble();
17918 break;
17919 case 45:
17920 draftEndDistance = reader->getDouble();
17921 break;
17922 case 46:
17923 twistAngle = reader->getDouble();
17924 break;
17925 case 290:
17926 solid = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17927 break;
17928 case 291:
17929 closeToAxis = reader->getInt32() != 0;
17930 break;
17931 default:
17932 return DRW_Surface::parseCode(code, reader);
17933 }
17934 return true;
17935}

17937void DRW_Surface::resetDwgState() {

17953 m_wireframeDecoded = false;
17954

17956 return std::array<double, DRW_ExtrudedSurface::kTransformSize>{
17957 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
17958 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0,
