17974 surface->scaleFactor = 0.0;
17975 surface->alignAngle = 0.0;
17976 surface->solid = false;
17977 surface->sweepAlignmentFlags = 0;
17978 surface->pathFlags = 0;
17979 surface->alignStart = false;
17980 surface->bank = false;
17981 surface->basePointSet = false;
17982 surface->sweepEntityTransformComputed = false;
17983 surface->pathEntityTransformComputed = false;
17984 surface->referenceVector = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
17985 break;
17986 }
17987 case DRW::REVOLVEDSURFACE: {
17988 auto *surface = static_cast<DRW_RevolvedSurface *>(this);
17989 surface->classId = 0;
17990 surface->id = 0;
17991 surface->axisPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
17992 surface->axisVector = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
17993 surface->revolveAngle = 0.0;
17994 surface->startAngle = 0.0;
17995 surface->transform = identity();
17996 surface->draftAngle = 0.0;
17997 surface->draftStartDistance = 0.0;
17998 surface->draftEndDistance = 0.0;
17999 surface->twistAngle = 0.0;
18000 surface->solid = false;
18001 surface->closeToAxis = false;
18002 break;
18003 }
18004 case DRW::SWEPTSURFACE: {
18005 auto *surface = static_cast<DRW_SweptSurface *>(this);
18006 surface->classVersion = 0;
18007 surface->sweepEntityId = 0;
18008 surface->sweepData.clear();
18009 surface->pathEntityId = 0;
18010 surface->pathData.clear();
18011 surface->sweepEntityTransform = identity();
18012 surface->pathEntityTransform = identity();
18013 surface->draftAngle = 0.0;
18014 surface->draftStartDistance = 0.0;
18015 surface->draftEndDistance = 0.0;
18016 surface->twistAngle = 0.0;
18017 surface->scaleFactor = 1.0;
18018 surface->alignAngle = 0.0;
18019 surface->sweepEntityTransformed = identity();
18020 surface->pathEntityTransformed = identity();
18021 surface->solid = false;
18022 surface->sweepAlignmentFlags = 0;
18023 surface->pathFlags = 0;
18024 surface->alignStart = false;
18025 surface->bank = false;
18026 surface->basePointSet = false;
18027 surface->sweepEntityTransformComputed = false;
18028 surface->pathEntityTransformComputed = false;
18029 surface->referenceVector = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
18030 break;
18031 }
18032 case DRW::LOFTEDSURFACE: {
18033 auto *surface = static_cast<DRW_LoftedSurface *>(this);
18034 surface->loftEntityTransform = identity();
18035 surface->planeNormalLoftingType = 0;
18036 surface->startDraftAngle = 0.0;

18039 surface->endDraftMagnitude = 0.0;
18040 surface->arcLengthParameterization = false;
18041 surface->noTwist = true;

18048 surface->numCrossSections = 0;
18049 surface->numGuideCurves = 0;
18050 surface->dxfReferenceData.clear();
18051 surface->pathCurveHandle = 0;
18052 break;

18054 case DRW::NURBSURFACE: {

18068
18069bool DRW_Surface::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs) {
18070 resetDwgState();
18071 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
18072 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
18073 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
18074 sourceBuf->invalidate();
18075 resetDwgState();
18076 return false;
18077 };
18078 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
18079 return fail();
18080
18081 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
18082 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
18083 dwgBuffer *stringStream = version > DRW::AC1018 ? &stringProbe : nullptr;
18084 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, &bodyProbe, stringStream, bs))
18085 return fail();
18086 buf = &bodyProbe;
18087 const std::uint64_t bodyStartBit = currentDwgBit(buf);
18088
18089 // Surface bodies are opaque here, but their bounded bytes still carry the
18090 // ACIS payload and must be available for rendering and metadata replay.
18091 std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = bodyStartBit;
18092 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(
18093 stringStream != nullptr ? *stringStream : bodyProbe,
18094 version, objSize, bodyEndBit))
18095 return fail();
18096 if (bodyEndBit < bodyStartBit)
18097 return fail();
18098 if (bodyEndBit > bodyStartBit
18099 && bodyEndBit - bodyStartBit > std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())
18100 return fail();
18101 hasRawDwgBody = bodyEndBit > bodyStartBit;
18102 rawDwgBodyBitSize = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
18103 bodyEndBit >= bodyStartBit ? bodyEndBit - bodyStartBit : 0);
18104 rawDwgBodyVersion = version;
18105 dwgClassNum = oType >= 0 ? static_cast<std::uint16_t>(oType) : 0;
18106 dwgPayloadDecoded = false;
18107 crossSectionHandles.clear();
18108 guideCurveHandles.clear();
18109 if (bodyEndBit > bodyStartBit
18110 && !copyDwgBitRange(*buf, bodyStartBit, bodyEndBit, rawAcisData)) {
18111 return fail();
18112 }
18113
18114 // When has_ds_data is set, the bounded body is an inline DataStorage/SAB
18115 // payload. Keep it opaque, matching the cross-project reader contract;
18116 // interpreting its bytes as subtype fields can fabricate counts and make
18117 // a valid surface fail while reading a nonexistent handle tail.
18118 if (bodyEndBit > bodyStartBit && !hasDsData) {
18119 SurfaceDwgPayloadInfo payload;
18120 if (readSurfaceDwgPayload(
18121 rawAcisData, bodyEndBit - bodyStartBit, version, eType,
18122 surfaceHasModelerFormatVersion(eType),
18123 surfaceModelerFormatVersionLimit(eType), payload)) {
18124 acisEmpty = payload.acisEmpty;
18125 acisVersion = payload.acisVersion;
18126 modelerFormatVersion = payload.modelerFormatVersion;
18127 uIsolines = payload.uIsolines;
18128 vIsolines = payload.vIsolines;
18129 if (payload.extrudedFieldsValid
18130 && eType == DRW::EXTRUDEDSURFACE) {
18131 auto *extruded = static_cast<DRW_ExtrudedSurface *>(this);
18132 extruded->sweepVector = payload.extrudedSweepVector;
18133 extruded->extrudedTransform = payload.extrudedTransform;
18134 extruded->sweepEntityTransform =
18135 payload.extrudedSweepEntityTransform;
18136 extruded->pathEntityTransform =
18137 payload.extrudedPathEntityTransform;
18138 extruded->draftAngle = payload.extrudedDraftAngle;
18139 extruded->draftStartDistance =
18140 payload.extrudedDraftStartDistance;
18141 extruded->draftEndDistance = payload.extrudedDraftEndDistance;
18142 extruded->twistAngle = payload.extrudedTwistAngle;
18143 extruded->scaleFactor = payload.extrudedScaleFactor;
18144 extruded->alignAngle = payload.extrudedAlignAngle;
18145 extruded->solid = payload.extrudedSolid;
18146 extruded->sweepAlignmentFlags =
18147 payload.extrudedSweepAlignmentFlags;
18148 extruded->pathFlags = payload.extrudedPathFlags;
18149 extruded->alignStart = payload.extrudedAlignStart;
18150 extruded->bank = payload.extrudedBank;
18151 extruded->basePointSet = payload.extrudedBasePointSet;
18152 extruded->sweepEntityTransformComputed =
18153 payload.extrudedSweepEntityTransformComputed;
18154 extruded->pathEntityTransformComputed =
18155 payload.extrudedPathEntityTransformComputed;
18156 extruded->referenceVector = payload.extrudedReferenceVector;
18157 }
18158 if (payload.sweptFieldsValid && eType == DRW::SWEPTSURFACE) {
18159 auto *swept = static_cast<DRW_SweptSurface *>(this);
18160 swept->classVersion = payload.sweptClassVersion;
18161 swept->sweepEntityId = payload.sweptEntityId;
18162 swept->sweepData = payload.sweptData;
18163 swept->pathEntityId = payload.sweptPathEntityId;
18164 swept->pathData = payload.sweptPathData;
18165 swept->sweepEntityTransform = payload.sweptEntityTransform;
18166 swept->pathEntityTransform = payload.sweptPathEntityTransform;
18167 swept->draftAngle = payload.sweptDraftAngle;
18168 swept->draftStartDistance = payload.sweptDraftStartDistance;
18169 swept->draftEndDistance = payload.sweptDraftEndDistance;
18170 swept->twistAngle = payload.sweptTwistAngle;
18171 swept->scaleFactor = payload.sweptScaleFactor;
18172 swept->alignAngle = payload.sweptAlignAngle;
18173 swept->solid = payload.sweptSolid;
18174 swept->sweepAlignmentFlags = payload.sweptAlignmentFlags;
18175 swept->pathFlags = payload.sweptPathFlags;
18176 swept->alignStart = payload.sweptAlignStart;
18177 swept->bank = payload.sweptBank;
18178 swept->basePointSet = payload.sweptBasePointSet;
18179 swept->sweepEntityTransformComputed =
18180 payload.sweptEntityTransformComputed;
18181 swept->pathEntityTransformComputed =
18182 payload.sweptPathEntityTransformComputed;
18183 swept->referenceVector = payload.sweptReferenceVector;
18184 }
18185 if (payload.loftedFieldsValid && eType == DRW::LOFTEDSURFACE) {
18186 auto *lofted = static_cast<DRW_LoftedSurface *>(this);
18187 lofted->loftEntityTransform = payload.loftedEntityTransform;
18188 lofted->planeNormalLoftingType =
18189 payload.loftedPlaneNormalLoftingType;
18190 lofted->startDraftAngle = payload.loftedStartDraftAngle;
18191 lofted->endDraftAngle = payload.loftedEndDraftAngle;
18192 lofted->startDraftMagnitude =
18193 payload.loftedStartDraftMagnitude;
18194 lofted->endDraftMagnitude = payload.loftedEndDraftMagnitude;
18195 lofted->arcLengthParameterization =
18196 payload.loftedArcLengthParameterization;
18197 lofted->noTwist = payload.loftedNoTwist;
18198 lofted->alignDirection = payload.loftedAlignDirection;
18199 lofted->simpleSurfaces = payload.loftedSimpleSurfaces;
18200 lofted->closedSurfaces = payload.loftedClosedSurfaces;
18201 lofted->solid = payload.loftedSolid;
18202 lofted->ruledSurface = payload.loftedRuledSurface;
18203 lofted->virtualGuide = payload.loftedVirtualGuide;
18204 lofted->numCrossSections = payload.loftedNumCrossSections;
18205 lofted->numGuideCurves = payload.loftedNumGuideCurves;
18206 }
18207 if (payload.nurbsFieldsValid && eType == DRW::NURBSURFACE) {
18208 auto *nurbs = static_cast<DRW_NurbsSurface *>(this);
18209 nurbs->short170 = payload.nurbsShort170;
18210 nurbs->cvHullDisplay = payload.nurbsCvHullDisplay;
18211 nurbs->uvec1 = payload.nurbsUvec1;
18212 nurbs->vvec1 = payload.nurbsVvec1;
18213 nurbs->uvec2 = payload.nurbsUvec2;
18214 nurbs->vvec2 = payload.nurbsVvec2;
18215 }
18216 dwgPayloadDecoded = true;
18217 if (payload.revolvedFieldsValid
18218 && eType == DRW::REVOLVEDSURFACE) {
18219 auto *revolved = static_cast<DRW_RevolvedSurface *>(this);
18220 revolved->classId = payload.revolvedClassId;
18221 revolved->id = payload.revolvedId;
18222 revolved->axisPoint = payload.revolvedAxisPoint;
18223 revolved->axisVector = payload.revolvedAxisVector;
18224 revolved->revolveAngle = payload.revolvedAngle;
18225 revolved->startAngle = payload.revolvedStartAngle;
18226 revolved->transform = payload.revolvedTransform;
18227 revolved->draftAngle = payload.revolvedDraftAngle;
18228 revolved->draftStartDistance = payload.revolvedDraftStartDistance;
18229 revolved->draftEndDistance = payload.revolvedDraftEndDistance;
18230 revolved->twistAngle = payload.revolvedTwistAngle;
18231 revolved->solid = payload.revolvedSolid;
18232 revolved->closeToAxis = payload.revolvedCloseToAxis;
18233 }
18234 }
18235 }
18236
18237 // R13-R2004 keep the handle stream inline; seek to the documented body
18238 // boundary before the common handle parser. R2007+ performs that seek in
18239 // parseDwgEntHandle() itself.
18240 dwgBuffer handleProbe = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
18241 if (version <= DRW::AC1018 && bodyEndBit > bodyStartBit) {
18242 if (!handleProbe.setPosition(bodyEndBit >> 3))
18243 return fail();
18244 handleProbe.setBitPos(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bodyEndBit & 7u));
18245 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
18246 return fail();
18247 }
18248 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
18249 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
18250 handleEndBit))
18251 return fail();
18252 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
18253 handleEndBit)
18254 || !handleProbe.isGood())
18255 return fail();
18256 std::vector<std::uint32_t> parsedCrossSectionHandles;
18257 std::vector<std::uint32_t> parsedGuideCurveHandles;
18258 std::uint32_t parsedPathCurveHandle = 0;
18259 const auto readHandleList = [&](std::int32_t count,
18260 std::vector<std::uint32_t>& values) {
18261 if (count < 0
18262 || count > static_cast<std::int32_t>(
18263 DRW_LoftedSurface::kMaxReferenceTokenCount)
18264 || !DRW::reserve(values, count))
18265 return false;
18266 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
18267 dwgHandle value;
18268 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, true,
18269 value))
18270 return false;
18271 values.push_back(value.ref);
18272 }
18273 return true;
18274 };
18275 if (eType == DRW::LOFTEDSURFACE && dwgPayloadDecoded) {
18276 auto *lofted = static_cast<DRW_LoftedSurface *>(this);
18277 if (!readHandleList(lofted->numCrossSections,
18278 parsedCrossSectionHandles)
18279 || !readHandleList(lofted->numGuideCurves,
18280 parsedGuideCurveHandles))
18281 return fail();
18282 dwgHandle pathCurve;
18283 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, true,
18284 pathCurve))
18285 return fail();
18286 parsedPathCurveHandle = pathCurve.ref;
18287 }
18288 if (!handleProbe.isGood())
18289 return fail();
18290 crossSectionHandles = std::move(parsedCrossSectionHandles);
18291 guideCurveHandles = std::move(parsedGuideCurveHandles);
18292 if (eType == DRW::LOFTEDSURFACE)
18293 static_cast<DRW_LoftedSurface *>(this)->pathCurveHandle =
18294 parsedPathCurveHandle;
18295 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
18296 return true;
18297}
18298
18299bool DRW_Surface::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
18300 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
18301 (void)bs;
18302 if (buf == nullptr || version < DRW::AC1021 || dwgClassNum == 0)
18303 return false;
18304
18305 const auto validBitShort = [](int value) {
18306 return value >= 0
18307 && value <= std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max();
18308 };
18309 const auto validCount = [](std::int32_t value, std::size_t limit) {
18310 return value >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(value) <= limit;
18311 };
18312 const auto validTypedPayload = [&]() {
18313 if (!acisEmpty && !rawAcisData.empty())
18314 return false;
18315 if (surfaceHasModelerFormatVersion(eType)
18316 && (!validBitShort(modelerFormatVersion)
18317 || (eType == DRW::LOFTEDSURFACE
18318 && modelerFormatVersion
18319 > surfaceModelerFormatVersionLimit(eType))))
18320 return false;
18321 if (!validBitShort(uIsolines) || !validBitShort(vIsolines))
18322 return false;
18323
18324 switch (eType) {
18325 case DRW::EXTRUDEDSURFACE: {
18326 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_ExtrudedSurface *>(this);
18327 return std::isfinite(surface->draftAngle)
18328 && std::isfinite(surface->draftStartDistance)
18329 && std::isfinite(surface->draftEndDistance)
18330 && std::isfinite(surface->twistAngle)
18331 && std::isfinite(surface->scaleFactor)
18332 && std::isfinite(surface->alignAngle)
18333 && finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->referenceVector)
18334 && finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->sweepVector)
18335 && validBitShort(surface->sweepAlignmentFlags)
18336 && validBitShort(surface->pathFlags)
18337 && finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->extrudedTransform)
18338 && finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->sweepEntityTransform)
18339 && finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->pathEntityTransform);
18340 }
18341 case DRW::LOFTEDSURFACE: {
18342 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_LoftedSurface *>(this);
18343 return std::isfinite(surface->startDraftAngle)
18344 && std::isfinite(surface->endDraftAngle)
18345 && std::isfinite(surface->startDraftMagnitude)
18346 && std::isfinite(surface->endDraftMagnitude)
18347 && validCount(surface->numCrossSections,
18348 DRW_LoftedSurface::kMaxReferenceTokenCount)
18349 && validCount(surface->numGuideCurves,
18350 DRW_LoftedSurface::kMaxReferenceTokenCount)
18351 && surface->crossSectionHandles.size()
18352 == static_cast<std::size_t>(surface->numCrossSections)
18353 && surface->guideCurveHandles.size()
18354 == static_cast<std::size_t>(surface->numGuideCurves)
18355 && finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->loftEntityTransform);
18356 }
18357 case DRW::REVOLVEDSURFACE: {
18358 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_RevolvedSurface *>(this);
18359 return surface->classId <= std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()
18360 && surface->id <= std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()
18361 && finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->axisPoint)
18362 && finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->axisVector)
18363 && std::isfinite(surface->revolveAngle)
18364 && std::isfinite(surface->startAngle)
18365 && std::isfinite(surface->draftAngle)
18366 && std::isfinite(surface->draftStartDistance)
18367 && std::isfinite(surface->draftEndDistance)
18368 && std::isfinite(surface->twistAngle)
18369 && finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->transform);
18370 }
18371 case DRW::SWEPTSURFACE: {
18372 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_SweptSurface *>(this);
18373 return surface->classVersion <= 10
18374 && surface->sweepEntityId
18375 <= std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()
18376 && surface->pathEntityId
18377 <= std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()
18378 && surface->sweepData.size()
18379 <= DRW_SweptSurface::kMaxSweepDataSize
18380 && surface->pathData.size()
18381 <= DRW_SweptSurface::kMaxSweepDataSize
18382 && std::isfinite(surface->draftAngle)
18383 && std::isfinite(surface->draftStartDistance)
18384 && std::isfinite(surface->draftEndDistance)
18385 && std::isfinite(surface->twistAngle)
18386 && std::isfinite(surface->scaleFactor)
18387 && std::isfinite(surface->alignAngle)
18388 && finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->referenceVector)
18389 && validBitShort(surface->sweepAlignmentFlags)
18390 && validBitShort(surface->pathFlags)
18391 && finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->sweepEntityTransform)
18392 && finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->pathEntityTransform);
18393 }
18394 case DRW::NURBSURFACE:
18395 if (version < DRW::AC1027)
18396 return true;
18397 {
18398 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_NurbsSurface *>(this);
18399 return finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->uvec1)
18400 && finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->vvec1)
18401 && finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->uvec2)
18402 && finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->vvec2);
18403 }
18404 case DRW::PLANESURFACE:
18405 return true;
18406 default:
18407 return false;
18408 }
18409 };
18410
18411 if (hasRawDwgBody && rawDwgBodyVersion == version) {
18412 if (rawDwgBodyBitSize == 0
18413 || rawDwgBodyBitSize > surfaceRawBitCapacity(rawAcisData))
18414 return false;
18415 } else if (!validTypedPayload()) {
18416 return false;
18417 }
18418 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf, strBuf))
18419 return false;
18420
18421 if (hasRawDwgBody && rawDwgBodyVersion == version) {
18422 if (!putSurfaceRawBits(buf, rawAcisData, rawDwgBodyBitSize))
18423 return false;
18424 } else {
18425 // DXF ACIS/SAB bytes are not the bit-packed DWG ACTION_3DSOLID body.
18426 // Do not place them directly into a DWG object. Native ACIS emission
18427 // remains a separate conversion step; empty modeler bodies are valid
18428 // and allow metadata-only surfaces to round-trip safely.
18429 if (!acisEmpty && !rawAcisData.empty())
18430 return false;
18431 buf->putBit(1); // ACTION_3DSOLID: no ACIS body
18432
18433 const bool hasModelerFormat = surfaceHasModelerFormatVersion(eType);
18434 if (hasModelerFormat) {
18435 if (modelerFormatVersion < 0
18436 || modelerFormatVersion > 0xFFFF
18437 || (eType == DRW::LOFTEDSURFACE && modelerFormatVersion > 3))
18438 return false;
18439 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(modelerFormatVersion));
18440 }
18441 if (uIsolines < 0 || uIsolines > 0xFFFF
18442 || vIsolines < 0 || vIsolines > 0xFFFF)
18443 return false;
18444 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(uIsolines));
18445 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(vIsolines));
18446
18447 auto putCoord = [&](const DRW_Coord& value) {
18448 if (!finiteSurfaceCoord(value))
18449 return false;
18450 buf->put3BitDouble(value);
18451 return true;
18452 };
18453 auto putBool = [&](bool value) { buf->putBit(value ? 1 : 0); };
18454 auto putCount = [&](std::int32_t value, std::size_t limit) {
18455 return value >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(value) <= limit;
18456 };
18457
18458 switch (eType) {
18459 case DRW::EXTRUDEDSURFACE: {
18460 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_ExtrudedSurface *>(this);
18461 if (!std::isfinite(surface->draftAngle)
18462 || !std::isfinite(surface->draftStartDistance)
18463 || !std::isfinite(surface->draftEndDistance)
18464 || !std::isfinite(surface->twistAngle)
18465 || !std::isfinite(surface->scaleFactor)
18466 || !std::isfinite(surface->alignAngle)
18467 || !finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->referenceVector)
18468 || !finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->sweepVector)
18469 || surface->sweepAlignmentFlags < 0
18470 || surface->sweepAlignmentFlags > 0xFFFF
18471 || surface->pathFlags < 0 || surface->pathFlags > 0xFFFF
18472 || !finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->sweepEntityTransform)
18473 || !finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->pathEntityTransform))
18474 return false;
18475 buf->putBitDouble(surface->draftAngle);
18476 buf->putBitDouble(surface->draftStartDistance);
18477 buf->putBitDouble(surface->draftEndDistance);
18478 buf->putBitDouble(surface->twistAngle);
18479 buf->putBitDouble(surface->scaleFactor);
18480 buf->putBitDouble(surface->alignAngle);
18481 // The matrices were validated above; emit them in their specified
18482 // position after SweepOptions' scalar fields.
18483 for (double value : surface->sweepEntityTransform)
18484 buf->putBitDouble(value);
18485 for (double value : surface->pathEntityTransform)
18486 buf->putBitDouble(value);
18487 putBool(surface->solid);
18488 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(surface->sweepAlignmentFlags));
18489 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(surface->pathFlags));
18490 putBool(surface->alignStart);
18491 putBool(surface->bank);
18492 putBool(surface->basePointSet);
18493 putBool(surface->sweepEntityTransformComputed);
18494 putBool(surface->pathEntityTransformComputed);
18495 if (!finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->referenceVector)
18496 || !finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->sweepVector)
18497 || !finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->extrudedTransform))
18498 return false;
18499 putCoord(surface->referenceVector);
18500 putCoord(surface->sweepVector);
18501 for (double value : surface->extrudedTransform)
18502 buf->putBitDouble(value);
18503 break;
18504 }
18505 case DRW::LOFTEDSURFACE: {
18506 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_LoftedSurface *>(this);
18507 if (!std::isfinite(surface->startDraftAngle)
18508 || !std::isfinite(surface->endDraftAngle)
18509 || !std::isfinite(surface->startDraftMagnitude)
18510 || !std::isfinite(surface->endDraftMagnitude)
18511 || !putCount(surface->numCrossSections,
18512 DRW_LoftedSurface::kMaxReferenceTokenCount)
18513 || !putCount(surface->numGuideCurves,
18514 DRW_LoftedSurface::kMaxReferenceTokenCount)
18515 || !finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->loftEntityTransform))
18516 return false;
18517 for (double value : surface->loftEntityTransform)
18518 buf->putBitDouble(value);
18519 buf->putBitLong(surface->planeNormalLoftingType);
18520 buf->putBitDouble(surface->startDraftAngle);
18521 buf->putBitDouble(surface->endDraftAngle);
18522 buf->putBitDouble(surface->startDraftMagnitude);
18523 buf->putBitDouble(surface->endDraftMagnitude);
18524 putBool(surface->arcLengthParameterization);
18525 putBool(surface->noTwist);
18526 putBool(surface->alignDirection);
18527 putBool(surface->simpleSurfaces);
18528 putBool(surface->closedSurfaces);
18529 putBool(surface->solid);
18530 putBool(surface->ruledSurface);
18531 putBool(surface->virtualGuide);
18532 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(surface->numCrossSections));
18533 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(surface->numGuideCurves));
18534 break;
18535 }
18536 case DRW::REVOLVEDSURFACE: {
18537 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_RevolvedSurface *>(this);
18538 if (surface->classId > std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()
18539 || surface->id > std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()
18540 || !finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->axisPoint)
18541 || !finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->axisVector)
18542 || !std::isfinite(surface->revolveAngle)
18543 || !std::isfinite(surface->startAngle)
18544 || !std::isfinite(surface->draftAngle)
18545 || !std::isfinite(surface->draftStartDistance)
18546 || !std::isfinite(surface->draftEndDistance)
18547 || !std::isfinite(surface->twistAngle)
18548 || !finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->transform))
18549 return false;
18550 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(surface->classId));
18551 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(surface->id));
18552 buf->put3BitDouble(surface->axisPoint);
18553 buf->put3BitDouble(surface->axisVector);
18554 buf->putBitDouble(surface->revolveAngle);
18555 buf->putBitDouble(surface->startAngle);
18556 for (double value : surface->transform)
18557 buf->putBitDouble(value);
18558 buf->putBitDouble(surface->draftAngle);
18559 buf->putBitDouble(surface->draftStartDistance);
18560 buf->putBitDouble(surface->draftEndDistance);
18561 buf->putBitDouble(surface->twistAngle);
18562 putBool(surface->solid);
18563 putBool(surface->closeToAxis);
18564 break;
18565 }
18566 case DRW::SWEPTSURFACE: {
18567 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_SweptSurface *>(this);
18568 if (surface->classVersion > 10
18569 || surface->sweepEntityId > std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()
18570 || surface->pathEntityId > std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max()
18571 || surface->sweepData.size() > DRW_SweptSurface::kMaxSweepDataSize
18572 || surface->pathData.size() > DRW_SweptSurface::kMaxSweepDataSize
18573 || !std::isfinite(surface->draftAngle)
18574 || !std::isfinite(surface->draftStartDistance)
18575 || !std::isfinite(surface->draftEndDistance)
18576 || !std::isfinite(surface->twistAngle)
18577 || !std::isfinite(surface->scaleFactor)
18578 || !std::isfinite(surface->alignAngle)
18579 || !finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->referenceVector)
18580 || surface->sweepAlignmentFlags < 0
18581 || surface->sweepAlignmentFlags > 0xFFFF
18582 || surface->pathFlags < 0 || surface->pathFlags > 0xFFFF
18583 || !finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->sweepEntityTransform)
18584 || !finiteSurfaceMatrix(surface->pathEntityTransform))
18585 return false;
18586 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(surface->classVersion));
18587 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(surface->sweepEntityId));
18588 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(surface->sweepData.size()));
18589 if (!surface->sweepData.empty())
18590 buf->putBytes(surface->sweepData.data(), surface->sweepData.size());
18591 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(surface->pathEntityId));
18592 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(surface->pathData.size()));
18593 if (!surface->pathData.empty())
18594 buf->putBytes(surface->pathData.data(), surface->pathData.size());
18595 buf->putBitDouble(surface->draftAngle);
18596 buf->putBitDouble(surface->draftStartDistance);
18597 buf->putBitDouble(surface->draftEndDistance);
18598 buf->putBitDouble(surface->twistAngle);
18599 buf->putBitDouble(surface->scaleFactor);
18600 buf->putBitDouble(surface->alignAngle);
18601 for (double value : surface->sweepEntityTransform)
18602 buf->putBitDouble(value);
18603 for (double value : surface->pathEntityTransform)
18604 buf->putBitDouble(value);
18605 putBool(surface->solid);
18606 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(surface->sweepAlignmentFlags));
18607 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(surface->pathFlags));
18608 putBool(surface->alignStart);
18609 putBool(surface->bank);
18610 putBool(surface->basePointSet);
18611 putBool(surface->sweepEntityTransformComputed);
18612 putBool(surface->pathEntityTransformComputed);
18613 if (!finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->referenceVector))
18614 return false;
18615 putCoord(surface->referenceVector);
18616 break;
18617 }
18618 case DRW::NURBSURFACE: {
18619 if (version < DRW::AC1027)
18620 break;
18621 const auto *surface = static_cast<const DRW_NurbsSurface *>(this);
18622 if (!finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->uvec1)
18623 || !finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->vvec1)
18624 || !finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->uvec2)
18625 || !finiteSurfaceCoord(surface->vvec2))
18626 return false;
18627 buf->putBitShort(surface->short170);
18628 putBool(surface->cvHullDisplay);
18629 buf->put3BitDouble(surface->uvec1);
18630 buf->put3BitDouble(surface->vvec1);
18631 buf->put3BitDouble(surface->uvec2);
18632 buf->put3BitDouble(surface->vvec2);
18633 break;
18634 }
18635 case DRW::PLANESURFACE:
18636 break;
18637 default:
18638 return false;
18639 }
18640 }
18641
18642 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf))
18643 return false;
18644 if (eType == DRW::LOFTEDSURFACE) {
18645 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf != nullptr ? handleBuf : buf;
18646 for (std::uint32_t ref : crossSectionHandles)
18647 putSurfaceHandle(hb, ref);
18648 for (std::uint32_t ref : guideCurveHandles)
18649 putSurfaceHandle(hb, ref);
18650 putSurfaceHandle(hb,
18651 static_cast<const DRW_LoftedSurface *>(this)
18652 ->pathCurveHandle);
18653 }
18654 return true;
18655}

18861
18862bool DRW_Dimension::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, dwgBuffer *sBuf, std::uint32_t bs /*= 0*/) {
18863 (void)sBuf;
18864 resetDwgState();
18865 if (buf == nullptr)
18866 return false;
18867
18868 dwgBuffer sBuff = *buf;
18869 dwgBuffer *commonStringBuffer = buf;
18870 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
18871 commonStringBuffer = &sBuff; //separate buffer for strings
18872 }
18873
18874 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, commonStringBuffer, bs))
18875 return false;
18876
18877 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing dimension *********************************************")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing dimension *********************************************"
);
18878 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
18879 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
18880 dwgBuffer stringProbe = sBuff;
18881 dwgBuffer *textBuffer = &bodyProbe;
18882 if (version > DRW::AC1018)
18883 textBuffer = &stringProbe;
18884 std::uint64_t stringStartBit = bodyEndBit;
18885 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
18886 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
18887 stringStartBit = currentDwgBit(textBuffer);
18888 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
18889 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
18890 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*textBuffer, version, objSize,
18891 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
18892 return false;
18893 }
18894 }
18895
18896 std::uint8_t parsedDimVersion = 0;
18897 if (version > DRW::AC1021) { //2010+
18898 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedDimVersion))
18899 return false;
18900 DRW_DBG("\ndimVersion: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ndimVersion: "); DRW_DBG(parsedDimVersion)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedDimVersion);
18901 }
18902
18903 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
18904 DRW_Coord parsedTextPoint;
18905 DRW_Coord ignoredInsertionPoint;
18906 double parsedTextPointZ = 0.0;
18907 double ignoredInsertionRotation = 0.0;
18908 std::uint8_t parsedType = 0;
18909 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedExtrusion)
18910 || !readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedTextPoint.x)
18911 || !readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedTextPoint.y)
18912 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedTextPointZ)
18913 || !readBoundedRawChar8(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedType)) {
18914 return false;
18915 }
18916 parsedTextPoint.z = parsedTextPointZ;
18917
18918 // ODA §20.4.22: Extrusion is plain 3BD (NOT BE) — confirmed by libreDWG dwg_spec_shared.h
18919 DRW_DBG("\nextPoint: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nextPoint: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedExtrusion.x, parsedExtrusion.y,DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedExtrusion.x, parsedExtrusion.y, parsedExtrusion
.z)
18920 parsedExtrusion.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedExtrusion.x, parsedExtrusion.y, parsedExtrusion
.z);
18921 DRW_DBG("\ntextPoint: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ntextPoint: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedTextPoint.x, parsedTextPoint.y,DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedTextPoint.x, parsedTextPoint.y, parsedTextPoint
.z)
18922 parsedTextPoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedTextPoint.x, parsedTextPoint.y, parsedTextPoint
.z);
18923 DRW_DBG("\ntype (70) read: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ntype (70) read: "); DRW_DBG(parsedType)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedType);
18924 const std::uint8_t parsedDimensionType =
18925 static_cast<std::uint8_t>((parsedType & 1) ? parsedType & 0x7F
18926 : parsedType | 0x80);
18927 int parsedTypeValue = (parsedDimensionType & 2) ? parsedDimensionType | 0x20
18928 : parsedDimensionType & 0xDF;
18929 DRW_DBG(" type (70) set: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" type (70) set: "); DRW_DBG(parsedTypeValue)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedTypeValue);
18930 //clear last 3 bits to set integer dim type
18931 parsedTypeValue &= 0xF8;
18932 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedText;
18933 if (version > DRW::AC1018 && stringStartBit >= stringEndBit) {
18934 parsedText.clear();
18935 } else if (!readBoundedVariableText(*textBuffer, stringEndBit, version,
18936 parsedText)) {
18937 return false;
18938 }
18939 DRW_DBG("\nforced dim text: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nforced dim text: "); DRW_DBG(parsedText.c_str())DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedText.c_str());
18940 double parsedRot = 0.0;
18941 double parsedHDir = 0.0;
18942 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedRot)
18943 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedHDir)
18944 || !readBoundedBitCoord(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ignoredInsertionPoint)
18945 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
18946 ignoredInsertionRotation)) {
18947 return false;
18948 }
18949 DRW_DBG("\ninspoint: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ninspoint: "); DRW_DBGPT(ignoredInsertionPoint.x,DRW_dbg::dbgPT(ignoredInsertionPoint.x, ignoredInsertionPoint
.y, ignoredInsertionPoint.z)
18950 ignoredInsertionPoint.y,DRW_dbg::dbgPT(ignoredInsertionPoint.x, ignoredInsertionPoint
.y, ignoredInsertionPoint.z)
18951 ignoredInsertionPoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(ignoredInsertionPoint.x, ignoredInsertionPoint
.y, ignoredInsertionPoint.z);
18952 DRW_DBG(" insRot_code54: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" insRot_code54: "); DRW_DBG(ignoredInsertionRotation)DRW_dbg::dbg(ignoredInsertionRotation);
18953
18954 std::uint16_t parsedAlign = 5;
18955 std::uint16_t parsedLineStyle = 1;
18956 double parsedLineFactor = 1.0;
18957 double parsedMeasureValue = 0.0;
18958 bool parsedFlipArrow1 = false;
18959 bool parsedFlipArrow2 = false;
18960 if (version > DRW::AC1014) { //2000+
18961 if (!readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedAlign)
18962 || !readBoundedBitShort(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedLineStyle)
18963 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedLineFactor)
18964 || !readBoundedBitDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit,
18965 parsedMeasureValue))
18966 return false;
18967 DRW_DBG("\n actMeas_code42: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n actMeas_code42: "); DRW_DBG(parsedMeasureValue)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedMeasureValue);
18968 if (version > DRW::AC1018) { //2007+
18969 bool ignoredBit = false;
18970 if (!readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, ignoredBit)
18971 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedFlipArrow1)
18972 || !readBoundedBit(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedFlipArrow2))
18973 return false;
18974 DRW_DBG("\n2007, unk, flip1, flip2: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n2007, unk, flip1, flip2: "); DRW_DBG(ignoredBit)DRW_dbg::dbg(ignoredBit);
18975 DRW_DBG(parsedFlipArrow1)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedFlipArrow1); DRW_DBG(parsedFlipArrow2)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedFlipArrow2);
18976 }
18977 }
18978 DRW_Coord parsedClonePoint;
18979 if (!readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedClonePoint.x)
18980 || !readBoundedRawDouble(bodyProbe, bodyEndBit, parsedClonePoint.y))
18981 return false;
18982 parsedClonePoint.z = 0.0;
18983 if (!bodyProbe.isGood() || !textBuffer->isGood()
18984 || currentDwgBit(&bodyProbe) > bodyEndBit
18985 || currentDwgBit(textBuffer) > stringEndBit
18986 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.x)
18987 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.y)
18988 || !std::isfinite(parsedExtrusion.z)
18989 || !std::isfinite(parsedTextPoint.x)
18990 || !std::isfinite(parsedTextPoint.y)
18991 || !std::isfinite(parsedTextPoint.z)
18992 || !std::isfinite(ignoredInsertionPoint.x)
18993 || !std::isfinite(ignoredInsertionPoint.y)
18994 || !std::isfinite(ignoredInsertionPoint.z)
18995 || !std::isfinite(parsedRot)
18996 || !std::isfinite(parsedHDir)
18997 || !std::isfinite(ignoredInsertionRotation)
18998 || !std::isfinite(parsedLineFactor)

19010 align = parsedAlign;

19012 linefactor = parsedLineFactor;

19040bool DRW_DimAligned::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){

19045 sourceBuf->invalidate();

19050 return fail();

19055 buf = &probe;

19057 if (oType == 0x15)
19058 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing dim linear *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing dim linear *********************************************\n"
);

19060 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing dim aligned *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing dim aligned *********************************************\n"
);

19063 DRW_Coord parsedDef2;

19068 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDef2)
19069 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDimPoint)
19070 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedOblique))
19071 return fail();
19072 if (oType == 0x15
19073 && !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAngle))
19074 return fail();
19075 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
19076 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
19077 && std::isfinite(point.z);
19078 };
19079 if (!std::isfinite(parsedOblique) || !std::isfinite(parsedAngle)
19080 || !finite(parsedDef1) || !finite(parsedDef2)
19081 || !finite(parsedDimPoint)) {
19082 return fail();

19085 setPt4(parsedDef2);
19086 setDefPoint(parsedDimPoint);

19089 setAn50(parsedAngle * ARAD57.29577951308232);
19090 else
19091 type |= 1;
19092 DRW_DBG("\n type (70) final: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n type (70) final: "); DRW_DBG(type)DRW_dbg::dbg(type); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
19093
19094 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
19095 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs, handleEndBit)
19096 || !parseDwgDimensionHandles(version, buf, handleEndBit)) {
19097 DRW_DBG("Failed: parseDwgEntHandle() in DRW_DimAligned::parseDwg()\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("Failed: parseDwgEntHandle() in DRW_DimAligned::parseDwg()\n"
);
19098 return fail();
19099 }

19101 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(buf->numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(buf->numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
19102
19103 // RS crc; //RS */
19104 if (!buf->isGood())
19105 return fail();
19106 *sourceBuf = probe;
19107 return true;

19172// DRW_DimLargeRadial (AcDbRadialDimensionLarge, LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION).
19173// DXF group-code parser: the AcDbRadialDimensionLarge subclass overloads codes
19174// 13/14/15/40 (chord / override center / jog point / jog angle), so gate them on
19175// the subclass marker (like DRW_DimArc). The chord point is stored as the radial
19176// diameter point so the existing addDimRadial consumer renders center→chord.
19177bool DRW_DimLargeRadial::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
19178 if (code == 100) {
19179 std::string s = reader->getString();
19180 if (s == "AcDbRadialDimensionLarge") {
19181 m_largeRadialSubclassSeen = true;
19182 return true;
19183 }
19184 return DRW_Dimension::parseCode(code, reader);
19185 }
19186 if (m_largeRadialSubclassSeen) {
19187 DRW_Coord chord;
19188 switch (code) {
19189 case 13: chord = getPt5(); chord.x = reader->getDouble(); setPt5(chord); return true;
19190 case 23: chord = getPt5(); chord.y = reader->getDouble(); setPt5(chord); return true;
19191 case 33: chord = getPt5(); chord.z = reader->getDouble(); setPt5(chord); return true;
19192 case 14: overrideCenterPoint.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19193 case 24: overrideCenterPoint.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19194 case 34: overrideCenterPoint.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19195 case 15: jogPoint.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19196 case 25: jogPoint.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19197 case 35: jogPoint.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19198 case 40: jogAngle = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19199 default: break;
19200 }
19201 }
19202 return DRW_Dimension::parseCode(code, reader);
19203}
19204
19205// DRW_DimLargeRadial DWG body: five subclass reads then the dim-style and
19206// anon-block handles. The three subclass points are ordered
19207// definition point, JOG point, jog angle, CHORD point, OVERRIDDEN center
19208// so that the decoded fields match the DXF group codes (chord=13, override=14,
19209// jog=15) and libdxfrw's own DXF parseCode. The read-only reference parser
19210// (parseLargeRadialDimension) labels the 2nd/4th/5th reads chord/override/jog,
19211// i.e. a cyclic rotation of the point roles; that is inconsistent with the DXF
19212// semantics and with an ODA File Converter DXF↔DWG round-trip (which preserves
19213// codes 13/14/15 exactly). Verified by large_radial_dim_dwg_tests.cpp against
19214// an ODA-synthesized fixture, cross-checked with the dwg-parser's DXF read.
19215// Only the field labels change vs. the reference parser — the read sizes/order
19216// (3BD, 3BD, BD, 3BD, 3BD) are identical, so buffer alignment is unchanged.
19217bool DRW_DimLargeRadial::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
19218 DRW_Dimension::resetDwgState();
19219 overrideCenterPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
19220 jogPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
19221 jogAngle = 0.0;
19222 m_largeRadialSubclassSeen = false;
19223 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
19224 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
19225 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
19226 sourceBuf->invalidate();
19227 DRW_Dimension::resetDwgState();
19228 overrideCenterPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
19229 jogPoint = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
19230 jogAngle = 0.0;
19231 m_largeRadialSubclassSeen = false;
19232 return false;
19233 };
19234 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
19235 return fail();
19236
19237 dwgBuffer probe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
19238 if (!DRW_Dimension::parseDwg(version, &probe, nullptr, bs))
19239 return fail();
19240 buf = &probe;
19241 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
19242 DRW_Coord parsedDefPoint;
19243 DRW_Coord parsedJogPoint;
19244 DRW_Coord parsedChordPoint;
19245 DRW_Coord parsedOverrideCenter;
19246 double parsedJogAngle = 0.0;
19247 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDefPoint)
19248 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedJogPoint)
19249 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedJogAngle)
19250 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedChordPoint)
19251 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedOverrideCenter)
19252 || !std::isfinite(parsedDefPoint.x)
19253 || !std::isfinite(parsedDefPoint.y)
19254 || !std::isfinite(parsedDefPoint.z)
19255 || !std::isfinite(parsedJogPoint.x)
19256 || !std::isfinite(parsedJogPoint.y)
19257 || !std::isfinite(parsedJogPoint.z)
19258 || !std::isfinite(parsedChordPoint.x)
19259 || !std::isfinite(parsedChordPoint.y)
19260 || !std::isfinite(parsedChordPoint.z)
19261 || !std::isfinite(parsedOverrideCenter.x)
19262 || !std::isfinite(parsedOverrideCenter.y)
19263 || !std::isfinite(parsedOverrideCenter.z)
19264 || !std::isfinite(parsedJogAngle))
19265 return fail();
19266 setDefPoint(parsedDefPoint); // definition point (code 10)
19267 jogPoint = parsedJogPoint; // jog vertex (code 15)
19268 jogAngle = parsedJogAngle; // jog transverse angle (code 40)
19269 setPt5(parsedChordPoint); // chord point (code 13)
19270 overrideCenterPoint = parsedOverrideCenter; // overridden center (code 14)
19271 type |= 4; // radial dimension type bit
19272 if (!buf->isGood())
19273 return fail();
19274 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
19275 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs, handleEndBit)
19276 || !parseDwgDimensionHandles(version, buf, handleEndBit)) {
19277 return fail();
19278 }
19279 *sourceBuf = probe;
19280 return true;
19281}

19484bool DRW_DimOrdinate::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
19485 DRW_Dimension::resetDwgState();
19486 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
19487 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
19488 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
19489 sourceBuf->invalidate();
19490 DRW_Dimension::resetDwgState();
19491 return false;
19492 };
19493 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
19494 return fail();
19495
19496 dwgBuffer probe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
19497 if (!DRW_Dimension::parseDwg(version, &probe, nullptr, bs))
19498 return fail();
19499 buf = &probe;
19500
19501 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing dim ordinate *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing dim ordinate *********************************************\n"
);
19502 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
19503 DRW_Coord parsedDefPoint;
19504 DRW_Coord parsedDef1;
19505 DRW_Coord parsedDef2;
19506 std::uint8_t type2 = 0;
19507 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDefPoint)
19508 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDef1)
19509 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDef2)
19510 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, type2))
19511 return fail();
19512 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
19513 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
19514 && std::isfinite(point.z);
19515 };
19516 if (!finite(parsedDefPoint) || !finite(parsedDef1) || !finite(parsedDef2))
19517 return fail();
19518 setDefPoint(parsedDefPoint);
19519 DRW_DBG("defPoint: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("defPoint: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedDefPoint.x, parsedDefPoint.y,DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedDefPoint.x, parsedDefPoint.y, parsedDefPoint
.z)
19520 parsedDefPoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedDefPoint.x, parsedDefPoint.y, parsedDefPoint
.z);
19521 setPt3(parsedDef1); //def1
19522 DRW_DBG("\ndef1: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ndef1: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedDef1.x, parsedDef1.y, parsedDef1.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedDef1.x, parsedDef1.y, parsedDef1.z);
19523 setPt4(parsedDef2);
19524 DRW_DBG("\ndef2: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ndef2: "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedDef2.x, parsedDef2.y, parsedDef2.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedDef2.x, parsedDef2.y, parsedDef2.z);
19525 DRW_DBG("type2 (70) read: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("type2 (70) read: "); DRW_DBG(type2)DRW_dbg::dbg(type2);
19526 // 0B.1: x-vs-y ordinate flag is DXF group-70 bit 6 (0x40), matching the
19527 // filter (rs_filterdxfrw.cpp `type & 64`) and the DWG parseCode path.
19528 // (Previously set bit 7/0x80, which the filter never checks.) The clear
19529 // mask 0xBF already clears 0x40. The DIMENSION base type byte (bit 7) is
19530 // a separate field — see :6141/:6409/:6660, NOT touched here.
19531 int parsedType = type;
19532 parsedType = (type2 & 1) ? parsedType | 0x40 : parsedType & 0xBF;
19533 DRW_DBG(" type (70) set: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" type (70) set: "); DRW_DBG(parsedType)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedType);
19534 parsedType |= 6;
19535 DRW_DBG("\n type (70) final: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n type (70) final: "); DRW_DBG(parsedType)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedType); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
19536
19537 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
19538 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs, handleEndBit)
19539 || !parseDwgDimensionHandles(version, buf, handleEndBit)) {
19540 DRW_DBG("Failed: parseDwgEntHandle() in DRW_DimAligned::parseDwg()\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("Failed: parseDwgEntHandle() in DRW_DimAligned::parseDwg()\n"
);
19541 return fail();
19542 }
19543 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(buf->numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(buf->numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
19544 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(buf->numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(buf->numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
19545
19546 // RS crc; //RS */
19547 if (!buf->isGood())
19548 return fail();
19549 type = parsedType;
19550 *sourceBuf = probe;
19551 return true;
19552}

19554// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19555// DRW_Dimension shared base encoder (R2000 / AC1015)
19556// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19557bool DRW_Dimension::encodeDwgDimBase(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
19558 dwgBufferW *strBuf) const {
19559 // ODA §20.4.22: version RC present for R2010+ (mirrors parseDwg read at version > AC1021)
19560 if (version > DRW::AC1021)
19561 buf->putRawChar8(0);
19562 // R2007+: the dim text below is routed to strBuf (the separate string
19563 // stream) via the (strBuf ? strBuf : buf) selector in putVariableText.
19564 buf->put3BitDouble(extPoint); // 3BD per ODA §20.4.22 (NOT BE, NO padding bits)
19565 buf->putRawDouble(textPoint.x);
19566 buf->putRawDouble(textPoint.y);
19567 buf->putBitDouble(textPoint.z);
19568 // Reverse the parseDwg type-byte transformation:
19569 // parseDwg bit0=0 → type bit7 set; bit0=1 → type bit7 clear
19570 // parseDwg bit1=1 → type bit5 set; bit1=0 → type bit5 clear
19571 std::uint8_t rawByte = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(
19572 ((type & 0x80) ? 0 : 1) | ((type & 0x20) ? 2 : 0));
19573 buf->putRawChar8(rawByte);
19574 (strBuf ? strBuf : buf)->putVariableText(version, text);
19575 buf->putBitDouble(rot);
19576 buf->putBitDouble(hdir);
19577 // ins_scale (3BD) of the dimension's anonymous block — not stored by the
19578 // reader, but ODA/libreDWG default it to (1,1,1) (dwg.spec FIELD_3BD_1), not
19579 // (0,0,0). A zero scale is degenerate for ODA consumers. (write-review #46)
19580 const DRW_Coord insScale{1.0, 1.0, 1.0};
19581 buf->put3BitDouble(insScale);
19582 buf->putBitDouble(0.0); // ins_rotation (code 54) — default 0, not stored
19583 // R2000 (version > AC1014): alignment, spacing, line factor, measure
19584 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(align));
19585 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(linesty));
19586 buf->putBitDouble(linefactor);
19587 buf->putBitDouble(measureValue);
19588 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
19589 buf->putBit(0); // unknown R2007+ bit
19590 buf->putBit(flipArrow1 ? 1 : 0);
19591 buf->putBit(flipArrow2 ? 1 : 0);
19592 }
19593 buf->putRawDouble(clonePoint.x);
19594 buf->putRawDouble(clonePoint.y);
19595 return true;
19596}
19597
19598// Helper: emit dimStyleH (defaults to STANDARD=0x15) and blockH.
19599static void putDimHandles(dwgBufferW *buf, const dwgHandle& dimStyleH, const dwgHandle& blockH,
19600 dwgBufferW *hBuf = nullptr) {
19601 dwgBufferW *hb = hBuf ? hBuf : buf;
19602 dwgHandle dsH;
19603 dsH.code = 5;
19604 dsH.ref = (dimStyleH.ref == 0) ? 0x15 : dimStyleH.ref;
19605 dsH.size = 0;
19606 if (dsH.ref != 0) { std::uint32_t t = dsH.ref; while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++dsH.size; } }
19607 hb->putHandle(dsH);
19608
19609 dwgHandle bhH;
19610 bhH.code = (blockH.ref == 0) ? 0 : 5;
19611 bhH.ref = blockH.ref;
19612 bhH.size = 0;
19613 if (bhH.ref != 0) { std::uint32_t t = bhH.ref; while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++bhH.size; } }
19614 hb->putHandle(bhH);
19615}

19631 return true;

19741// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19742// DRW_DimArc::parseCode (DXF group-code parser)
19743// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19744bool DRW_DimArc::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader) {
19745 if (code == 100) {
19746 std::string s = reader->getString();
19747 if (s == "AcDbArcDimension") {
19748 m_arcSubclassSeen = true;
19749 return true;
19750 }
19751 // Fall through for AcDbEntity / AcDbDimension so base classes see them
19752 return DRW_Dimension::parseCode(code, reader);
19753 }
19754 if (m_arcSubclassSeen) {
19755 switch (code) {
19756 case 40: arcStartAngle = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19757 case 41: arcEndAngle = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19758 case 70: arcSymbol = reader->getInt32(); return true;
19759 case 71: isPartial = reader->getInt32() != 0; return true;
19760 }
19761 }
19762 switch (code) {
19763 case 17: leaderPt2.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19764 case 27: leaderPt2.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19765 case 37: leaderPt2.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
19766 }
19767 return DRW_Dimension::parseCode(code, reader);
19768}

19770// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19771// DRW_DimArc::parseDwg (ODA DWG spec §20.4.19)
19772// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19773bool DRW_DimArc::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs) {
19774 DRW_Dimension::resetDwgState();
19775 leaderPt2 = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
19776 arcStartAngle = 0.0;
19777 arcEndAngle = 0.0;
19778 arcSymbol = 0;
19779 isPartial = false;
19780 hasLeader = false;
19781 m_arcSubclassSeen = false;
19782 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
19783 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
19784 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
19785 sourceBuf->invalidate();
19786 DRW_Dimension::resetDwgState();
19787 leaderPt2 = DRW_Coord{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
19788 arcStartAngle = 0.0;
19789 arcEndAngle = 0.0;
19790 arcSymbol = 0;
19791 isPartial = false;
19792 hasLeader = false;
19793 m_arcSubclassSeen = false;
19794 return false;
19795 };
19796 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
19797 return fail();
19798
19799 dwgBuffer probe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
19800 if (!DRW_Dimension::parseDwg(version, &probe, nullptr, bs))
19801 return fail();
19802 buf = &probe;
19803 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
19804 DRW_Coord parsedDefPoint;
19805 DRW_Coord parsedDef1;
19806 DRW_Coord parsedDef2;
19807 DRW_Coord parsedCenter;
19808 DRW_Coord parsedLeaderPoint1;
19809 DRW_Coord parsedLeaderPoint2;
19810 bool parsedPartial = false;
19811 double parsedStartAngle = 0.0;
19812 double parsedEndAngle = 0.0;
19813 bool parsedHasLeader = false;
19814 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDefPoint)
19815 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDef1)
19816 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedDef2)
19817 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedCenter)
19818 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedPartial)
19819 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedStartAngle)
19820 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedEndAngle)
19821 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedHasLeader)
19822 // ODA §20.4.19: leader points are unconditional in the stream.
19823 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedLeaderPoint1)
19824 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedLeaderPoint2))
19825 return fail();
19826 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
19827 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
19828 && std::isfinite(point.z);
19829 };
19830 if (!finite(parsedDefPoint) || !finite(parsedDef1) || !finite(parsedDef2)
19831 || !finite(parsedCenter) || !finite(parsedLeaderPoint1)
19832 || !finite(parsedLeaderPoint2) || !std::isfinite(parsedStartAngle)
19833 || !std::isfinite(parsedEndAngle))
19834 return fail();
19835 setDefPoint(parsedDefPoint);
19836 setPt3(parsedDef1);
19837 setPt4(parsedDef2);
19838 setPt5(parsedCenter);
19839 setPt6(parsedLeaderPoint1);
19840 leaderPt2 = parsedLeaderPoint2;
19841 isPartial = parsedPartial;
19842 arcStartAngle = parsedStartAngle;
19843 arcEndAngle = parsedEndAngle;
19844 hasLeader = parsedHasLeader;
19845 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
19846 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs, handleEndBit)
19847 || !parseDwgDimensionHandles(version, buf, handleEndBit))
19848 return fail();
19849 *sourceBuf = probe;
19850 return true;
19851}

19853// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19854// DRW_DimArc::encodeDwg (oType=500 — dynamic class, classNum from writeDwgClasses)
19855// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19856bool DRW_DimArc::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
19857 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
19858 (void)bs;
19859 oType = DRW_DimArc::kDwgClassNum; // assigned in writeDwgClasses; reader resolves via classesmap
19860 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
19861 if (!encodeDwgDimBase(version, buf, strBuf)) return false;
19862 buf->put3BitDouble(getDefPoint()); // arc dim-line arc point (code 10)
19863 buf->put3BitDouble(getPt3()); // extension line 1 (code 13)
19864 buf->put3BitDouble(getPt4()); // extension line 2 (code 14)
19865 buf->put3BitDouble(getPt5()); // arc center (code 15)
19866 buf->putBit(isPartial ? 1 : 0);
19867 buf->putBitDouble(arcStartAngle);
19868 buf->putBitDouble(arcEndAngle);
19869 buf->putBit(hasLeader ? 1 : 0);
19870 // ODA §20.4.19: leader points are UNCONDITIONAL — always written; default to ext-line pts
19871 DRW_Coord lp1 = hasLeader ? getPt6() : getPt3();
19872 DRW_Coord lp2 = hasLeader ? leaderPt2 : getPt4();
19873 buf->put3BitDouble(lp1); // leader point 1 (code 16)
19874 buf->put3BitDouble(lp2); // leader point 2 (code 17)
19875 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
19876 putDimHandles(buf, dimStyleH, blockH, handleBuf);
19877 return true;
19878}

19880// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19881// DRW_DimOrdinate::encodeDwg (oType=20)
19882// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
19883bool DRW_DimOrdinate::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs, dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
19884 (void)bs;
19885 oType = 20;
19886 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
19887 if (!encodeDwgDimBase(version, buf, strBuf)) return false;
19888 buf->put3BitDouble(getDefPoint()); // origin/definition point (code 10)
19889 buf->put3BitDouble(getPt3()); // feature location point (code 13)
19890 buf->put3BitDouble(getPt4()); // leader end point (code 14)
19891 // type2 byte encodes the x-vs-y ordinate flag (bit 6 / 0x40 of type, per
19892 // 0B.1) — keeps the DWG byte round-trip self-consistent with the parse
19893 // side while making the filter's `type & 64` check fire.
19894 std::uint8_t type2byte = (type & 0x40) ? 1 : 0;
19895 buf->putRawChar8(type2byte);
19896 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
19897 putDimHandles(buf, dimStyleH, blockH, handleBuf);
19898 return true;
19899}

19901bool DRW_Leader::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
19902 switch (code) {
19903 case 3:
19904 style = reader->getUtf8String();
19905 break;
19906 case 71:
19907 arrow = reader->getInt32();
19908 break;
19909 case 72:
19910 leadertype = reader->getInt32();
19911 break;
19912 case 73:
19913 flag = reader->getInt32();
19914 break;
19915 case 74:
19916 hookline = reader->getInt32();
19917 break;
19918 case 75:
19919 hookflag = reader->getInt32();
19920 break;
19921 case 76:
19922 vertnum = reader->getInt32();
19923 hasVertexCount = true;
19924 break;
19925 case 77:
19926 coloruse = reader->getInt32();
19927 break;
19928 case 40:
19929 textheight = reader->getDouble();
19930 break;
19931 case 41:
19932 textwidth = reader->getDouble();
19933 break;
19934 case 10:
19935 vertexpoint= std::make_shared<DRW_Coord>();
19936 vertexlist.push_back(vertexpoint);
19937 vertexpoint->x = reader->getDouble();
19938 break;
19939 case 20:
19940 if(vertexpoint)
19941 vertexpoint->y = reader->getDouble();
19942 break;
19943 case 30:
19944 if(vertexpoint)
19945 vertexpoint->z = reader->getDouble();
19946 break;
19947 case 340:
19948 annotHandle = reader->getHandleString();
19949 break;
19950 case 210:
19951 extrusionPoint.x = reader->getDouble();
19952 break;
19953 case 220:
19954 extrusionPoint.y = reader->getDouble();
19955 break;
19956 case 230:
19957 extrusionPoint.z = reader->getDouble();
19958 break;
19959 case 211:
19960 horizdir.x = reader->getDouble();
19961 break;
19962 case 221:
19963 horizdir.y = reader->getDouble();
19964 break;
19965 case 231:
19966 horizdir.z = reader->getDouble();
19967 break;
19968 case 212:
19969 offsetblock.x = reader->getDouble();
19970 break;
19971 case 222:
19972 offsetblock.y = reader->getDouble();
19973 break;
19974 case 232:
19975 offsetblock.z = reader->getDouble();
19976 break;
19977 case 213:
19978 offsettext.x = reader->getDouble();
19979 break;
19980 case 223:
19981 offsettext.y = reader->getDouble();
19982 break;
19983 case 233:
19984 offsettext.z = reader->getDouble();
19985 break;
19986 default:
19987 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
19988 }
19989
19990 return true;
19991}
19992
19993bool DRW_Leader::validatePayloadFields() const {
19994 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
19995 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
19996 && std::isfinite(point.z);
19997 };
19998 if ((arrow != 0 && arrow != 1) || (hookline != 0 && hookline != 1)
19999 || (hookflag != 0 && hookflag != 1) || leadertype < 0
20000 || leadertype > 1 || flag < 0 || flag > 3
20001 || coloruse < 0
20002 || coloruse > static_cast<int>(std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
20003 || vertexlist.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxLeaderVertices)
20004 || !std::isfinite(textheight) || !std::isfinite(textwidth)
20005 || !finite(origin) || !finite(extrusionPoint) || !finite(horizdir)
20006 || !finite(offsetblock) || !finite(offsettext)) {
20007 return false;
20008 }
20009 return std::all_of(vertexlist.begin(), vertexlist.end(),
20010 [&finite](const std::shared_ptr<DRW_Coord>& point) {
20011 return point != nullptr && finite(*point);
20012 });
20013}
20014
20015bool DRW_Leader::validateDxf() const {
20016 if (!validatePayloadFields())
20017 return false;
20018 if (!hasVertexCount)
20019 return true;
20020 return vertnum >= 0
20021 && vertnum <= kMaxLeaderVertices
20022 && static_cast<std::size_t>(vertnum) == vertexlist.size();
20023}

20050bool DRW_Leader::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
20051 resetDwgState();
20052 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
20053 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
20054 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
20055 sourceBuf->invalidate();
20056 resetDwgState();
20057 return false;
20058 };
20059 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
20060 return fail();
20061
20062 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
20063 buf = &bodyProbe;
20064
20065 dwgBuffer sBuff = buf->forkIndependent();
20066 dwgBuffer *sBuf = buf;
20067 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+

20073 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing leader *********************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing leader *********************************************\n"
);
20074 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
20075 bool ignoredBit = false;
20076 std::uint16_t ignoredShort = 0;
20077 std::uint16_t parsedAnnotationType = 0;
20078 std::uint16_t parsedLeaderType = 0;
