20080 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedAnnotationType)
20081 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedLeaderType))
20082 return fail();
20083 if (parsedAnnotationType > 3 || parsedLeaderType > 1)
20084 return fail();
20085 DRW_DBG(" Path type ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" Path type "); DRW_DBG(parsedLeaderType)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedLeaderType);
20086 std::uint32_t parsedPointCount = 0;
20087 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxLeaderVertices, 6,
20088 parsedPointCount))
20089 return fail();
20090 const std::int32_t nPt = static_cast<std::int32_t>(parsedPointCount);
20091 DRW_DBG(" Num pts ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" Num pts "); DRW_DBG(nPt)DRW_dbg::dbg(nPt);
20092 std::uint64_t pointBits = 0;
20093 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(parsedPointCount, 6, pointBits)
20094 || !proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, pointBits))
20095 return fail();
20096
20097 // add vertexes
20098 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<DRW_Coord>> parsedVertices;
20099 if (!DRW::reserve(parsedVertices, nPt))
20100 return fail();
20101 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < parsedPointCount; i++){
20102 DRW_Coord vertex;
20103 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, vertex))
20104 return fail();
20105 parsedVertices.push_back(std::make_shared<DRW_Coord>(vertex));
20106 DRW_DBG("\nvertex ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nvertex "); DRW_DBGPT(vertex.x, vertex.y, vertex.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(vertex.x, vertex.y, vertex.z);
20107 }
20108 DRW_Coord parsedOrigin;
20109 DRW_Coord parsedExtrusion;
20110 DRW_Coord parsedHorizdir;
20111 DRW_Coord parsedOffsetblock;
20112 DRW_Coord parsedOffsettext{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
20113 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedOrigin)
20114 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedExtrusion)
20115 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedHorizdir)
20116 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedOffsetblock))
20117 return fail();
20118 DRW_DBG("\norigin ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\norigin "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedOrigin.x, parsedOrigin.y, parsedOrigin.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedOrigin.x, parsedOrigin.y, parsedOrigin.z
);
20119 // ODA §20.4.47: Extrusion is plain 3DPOINT (3BD), not BE — confirmed by libreDWG dwg.spec:3439
20120 if (leaderHasEndpointProjection(version)) {
20121 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedOffsettext))
20122 return fail();
20123 DRW_DBG("\nEndptproj ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nEndptproj "); DRW_DBGPT(parsedOffsettext.x, parsedOffsettext.y, parsedOffsettext.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(parsedOffsettext.x, parsedOffsettext.y, parsedOffsettext
.z);
20124 }
20125 if (version < DRW::AC1015) { //R14 -
20126 double ignoredDouble = 0.0;
20127 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredDouble))
20128 return fail();
20129 }
20130 double parsedTextheight = 0.0;
20131 double parsedTextwidth = 0.0;
20132 bool parsedHookline = false;
20133 bool parsedArrow = false;
20134 std::uint16_t parsedColoruse = 7;
20135 if ((leaderHasTextBox(version)
20136 && (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedTextheight)
20137 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedTextwidth)))
20138 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedHookline)
20139 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedArrow))
20140 return fail();
20141 DRW_DBG("\ntextheight ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\ntextheight "); DRW_DBG(parsedTextheight)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedTextheight); DRW_DBG(" textwidth ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" textwidth "); DRW_DBG(parsedTextwidth)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedTextwidth);
20142 DRW_DBG(" hookline ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" hookline "); DRW_DBG(parsedHookline)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedHookline); DRW_DBG(" arrow flag ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" arrow flag "); DRW_DBG(parsedArrow)DRW_dbg::dbg(parsedArrow);
20143
20144 // ODA §20.4.47 places arrowhead type immediately after the hook and
20145 // arrow flags in every DWG version. R2000+ keeps the field even though
20146 // the remaining legacy arrowhead data is absent.
20147 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredShort))
20148 return fail();
20149 if (version < DRW::AC1015) { //R14 -
20150 double ignoredDimSize = 0.0;
20151 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredDimSize)
20152 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBit)
20153 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBit)
20154 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredShort)
20155 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedColoruse)
20156 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBit)
20157 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBit))
20158 return fail();
20159 } else { //R2000+
20160 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBit)
20161 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBit))
20162 return fail();
20163 }
20164 DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
20165 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
20166 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
20167 handleEndBit))
20168 return fail();
20169
20170 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
20171 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &handleProbe, true,
20172 handleEndBit);
20173 if (!ret || !handleProbe.isGood())
20174 return fail();
20175 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
20176 dwgHandle parsedAnnotH;
20177 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, false,
20178 parsedAnnotH))
20179 return fail();
20180 dwgHandle parsedDimStyleH;
20181 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, handle, false,
20182 parsedDimStyleH))
20183 return fail(); /* H 7 STYLE (hard pointer) */
20184 DRW_DBG("annot block Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("annot block Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(parsedAnnotH.code, parsedAnnotH.size, parsedAnnotH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(parsedAnnotH.code, parsedAnnotH.size, parsedAnnotH
.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
20185 DRW_DBG("dim style Handle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("dim style Handle: "); DRW_DBGHL(parsedDimStyleH.code, parsedDimStyleH.size, parsedDimStyleH.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(parsedDimStyleH.code, parsedDimStyleH.size, parsedDimStyleH
.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
20186 DRW_DBG("Remaining bytes: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Remaining bytes: "); DRW_DBG(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes())DRW_dbg::dbg(handleProbe.numRemainingBytes()); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
20187// RS crc; //RS */
20188 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
20189 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
20190 && std::isfinite(point.z);
20191 };
20192 if (!handleProbe.isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
20193 || !finite(parsedOrigin) || !finite(parsedExtrusion)
20194 || !finite(parsedHorizdir) || !finite(parsedOffsetblock)
20195 || !finite(parsedOffsettext) || !std::isfinite(parsedTextheight)
20196 || !std::isfinite(parsedTextwidth)
20197 || !std::all_of(parsedVertices.begin(), parsedVertices.end(),
20198 [](const std::shared_ptr<DRW_Coord>& point) {
20199 return point != nullptr
20200 && std::isfinite(point->x)
20201 && std::isfinite(point->y)
20202 && std::isfinite(point->z);
20203 }))
20204 return fail();
20205 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
20206 flag = static_cast<int>(parsedAnnotationType);
20207 leadertype = parsedLeaderType;
20208 vertnum = nPt;
20209 origin = parsedOrigin;
20210 extrusionPoint = parsedExtrusion;
20211 horizdir = parsedHorizdir;
20212 offsetblock = parsedOffsetblock;
20213 offsettext = parsedOffsettext;
20214 textheight = parsedTextheight;
20215 textwidth = parsedTextwidth;
20216 hookline = parsedHookline;
20217 arrow = parsedArrow;
20218 coloruse = static_cast<int>(parsedColoruse);
20219 AnnotH = parsedAnnotH;
20220 annotHandle = AnnotH.ref;
20221 dimStyleH = parsedDimStyleH;
20222 vertexlist = std::move(parsedVertices);
20223 return true;
20224}
20225
20226// DXF CONTEXT_DATA{} nested-block state machine (§20.4.86). The nested blocks
20227// open with 300 "CONTEXT_DATA{" / 302 "LEADER{" / 304 "LEADER_LINE{" and close
20228// with the distinct codes 301 / 303 / 305, so the open block is tracked with a
20229// single state int (no stack needed). The numeric group codes are overloaded
20230// by block — e.g. 40 is the overall scale in CONTEXT, the landing distance in
20231// LEADER and the arrow size in LEADER_LINE; 10/20/30 are the content base point,
20232// the connection point and a polyline vertex respectively — so they are routed
20233// per state into `context`. Returns true when the code belongs to the context
20234// block (consumed); false at entity level so parseCode handles it.
20235bool DRW_MLeader::parseDxfContextCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
20236 try {
20237 switch (code) { // block open/close markers
20238 case 300:
20239 if (m_dxfCtxState != 0 || reader->getString() != "CONTEXT_DATA{")
20240 return false;
20241 m_dxfCtxState = 1;
20242 return true;
20243 case 301:
20244 if (m_dxfCtxState != 1 || reader->getString() != "}")
20245 return false;
20246 m_dxfCtxState = 0;
20247 return true;
20248 case 302:
20249 if (m_dxfCtxState != 1 || reader->getString() != "LEADER{"
20250 || context.roots.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMLeaderItems))
20251 return false;
20252 context.roots.emplace_back();
20253 m_dxfCtxState = 2;
20254 return true;
20255 case 303:
20256 if (m_dxfCtxState != 2 || reader->getString() != "}")
20257 return false;
20258 m_dxfCtxState = 1;
20259 return true;
20260 case 304:
20261 if (m_dxfCtxState == 1) {
20262 context.textLabel = reader->getUtf8String();
20263 return true;
20264 }
20265 if (m_dxfCtxState != 2 || reader->getString() != "LEADER_LINE{"
20266 || context.roots.empty()
20267 || context.roots.back().leaderLines.size()
20268 >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMLeaderItems))
20269 return false;
20270 context.roots.back().leaderLines.emplace_back();
20271 m_dxfCtxState = 3;
20272 return true;
20273 case 305:
20274 if (m_dxfCtxState != 3 || reader->getString() != "}")
20275 return false;
20276 m_dxfCtxState = 2;
20277 return true;
20278 default: break;
20279 }
20280
20281 if (m_dxfCtxState == 0)
20282 return false; // entity level — parseCode handles it
20283
20284 if (m_dxfCtxState == 3) { // LEADER_LINE{}: a polyline + overrides
20285 DRW_MLeaderRoot* root = context.roots.empty() ? nullptr : &context.roots.back();
20286 DRW_MLeaderLeaderLine* line =
20287 (root && !root->leaderLines.empty()) ? &root->leaderLines.back() : nullptr;
20288 if (line) switch (code) {
20289 case 10:
20290 if (line->points.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxLeaderVertices))
20291 return false;
20292 line->points.emplace_back(reader->getDouble(), 0.0, 0.0);
20293 return true;
20294 case 20: if (!line->points.empty()) line->points.back().y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20295 case 30: if (!line->points.empty()) line->points.back().z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20296 case 40: line->arrowSize = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20297 case 90: line->segmentIndex = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20298 case 91: line->leaderLineIndex = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20299 case 92: line->color = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20300 case 93: line->overrideFlags = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20301 case 170: line->leaderType = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20302 case 171: line->lineWeight = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20303 default: break;
20304 }
20305 return true; // swallow other line codes
20306 }
20307
20308 if (m_dxfCtxState == 2) { // LEADER{}: one root attachment
20309 DRW_MLeaderRoot* root = context.roots.empty() ? nullptr : &context.roots.back();
20310 if (root) switch (code) {
20311 case 290: root->isContentValid = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20312 case 291: root->unknown291 = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20313 case 10: root->connectionPoint.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20314 case 20: root->connectionPoint.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20315 case 30: root->connectionPoint.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20316 case 11: root->direction.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20317 case 21: root->direction.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20318 case 31: root->direction.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20319 case 90: root->leaderIndex = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20320 case 40: root->landingDistance = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20321 case 271: root->attachmentDirection = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20322 default: break;
20323 }
20324 return true; // swallow other leader codes
20325 }
20326
20327 switch (code) { // m_dxfCtxState == 1: CONTEXT_DATA{}
20328 case 40: context.overallScale = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20329 case 10: context.contentBasePoint.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20330 case 20: context.contentBasePoint.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20331 case 30: context.contentBasePoint.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20332 case 41: context.textHeight = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20333 case 140: context.arrowHeadSize = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20334 case 145: context.landingGap = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20335 case 174: context.styleLeftAttach = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20336 case 175: context.styleRightAttach = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20337 case 176: context.textAlignType = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20338 case 177: context.attachmentType = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20339 case 290: context.hasTextContents = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20340 /* text-content branch */
20341 case 11: context.textNormal.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20342 case 21: context.textNormal.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20343 case 31: context.textNormal.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20344 case 12: context.textLocation.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20345 case 22: context.textLocation.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20346 case 32: context.textLocation.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20347 case 13: context.textDirection.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20348 case 23: context.textDirection.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20349 case 33: context.textDirection.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20350 case 42: context.textRotation = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20351 case 43: context.boundaryWidth = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20352 case 44: context.boundaryHeight = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20353 case 45: context.lineSpacingFactor = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20354 case 170: context.lineSpacingStyle = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20355 case 90: context.textColor = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20356 case 171: context.alignment = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20357 case 172: context.flowDirection = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20358 case 91: context.bgFillColor = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20359 case 141: context.bgScaleFactor = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20360 case 92: context.bgTransparency = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20361 case 291: context.bgFillEnabled = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20362 case 292: context.bgMaskFillOn = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20363 case 173: context.columnType = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20364 case 293: context.textHeightAuto = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20365 case 142: context.columnWidth = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20366 case 143: context.columnGutter = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20367 case 294: context.columnFlowReversed = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20368 case 144:
20369 if (context.columnSizes.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(kMaxMLeaderItems))
20370 return false;
20371 context.columnSizes.push_back(reader->getDouble());
20372 return true;
20373 case 295: context.wordBreak = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20374 /* block-content branch */
20375 case 296: context.hasContentsBlock = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20376 case 14: context.blockNormal.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20377 case 24: context.blockNormal.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20378 case 34: context.blockNormal.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20379 case 15: context.blockLocation.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20380 case 25: context.blockLocation.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20381 case 35: context.blockLocation.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20382 case 16: context.blockScale.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20383 case 26: context.blockScale.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20384 case 36: context.blockScale.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20385 case 46: context.blockRotation = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20386 case 93: context.blockColor = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20387 /* common tail */
20388 case 110: context.basePoint.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20389 case 120: context.basePoint.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20390 case 130: context.basePoint.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20391 case 111: context.baseDirection.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20392 case 121: context.baseDirection.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20393 case 131: context.baseDirection.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20394 case 112: context.baseVertical.x = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20395 case 122: context.baseVertical.y = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20396 case 132: context.baseVertical.z = reader->getDouble(); return true;
20397 case 297: context.isNormalReversed = (reader->getInt32() != 0); return true;
20398 case 272: context.styleBottomAttach = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20399 case 273: context.styleTopAttach = reader->getInt32(); return true;
20400 default: return true; // swallow any other context code
20401 }
20402 } catch (...) {
20403 return false;
20404 }
20405}
20406
20407bool DRW_MLeader::parseCode(int code, const std::unique_ptr<dxfReader>& reader){
20408 // The embedded CONTEXT_DATA{} block (§20.4.86) is routed by the nested-block
20409 // state machine; the remaining (entity-level) fields are read below and
20410 // mirror the DWG body parser.
20411 if (parseDxfContextCode(code, reader))
20412 return true;
20413 // A failed nested parse must not fall through to the permissive base
20414 // parser: that would silently discard malformed controls or over-limit
20415 // collections and still publish the entity.
20416 if (m_dxfCtxState != 0 || (code >= 300 && code <= 305))
20417 return false;
20418 switch (code) {
20419 case 170: leaderType = reader->getInt32(); break;
20420 case 171: leaderLineWeight = reader->getInt32(); break;
20421 case 172: styleContentType = reader->getInt32(); break;
20422 case 173: styleLeftAttach = reader->getInt32(); break;
20423 case 95: styleRightAttach = reader->getInt32(); break;
20424 case 174: styleTextAngleType = reader->getInt32(); break;
20425 case 175: unknown175 = reader->getInt32(); break;
20426 case 176: styleAttachmentType = reader->getInt32(); break;
20427 case 178: ipeAlign = reader->getInt32(); break;
20428 case 179: justification = reader->getInt32(); break;
20429 case 271: attachmentDirection = reader->getInt32(); break;
20430 case 272: styleBottomAttach = reader->getInt32(); break;
20431 case 273: styleTopAttach = reader->getInt32(); break;
20432 case 90: overrideFlags = reader->getInt32(); break;
20433 case 91: leaderColor = reader->getInt32(); break;
20434 case 92: styleTextColor = reader->getInt32(); break;
20435 case 93: styleBlockColor = reader->getInt32(); break;
20436 case 41: landingDistance = reader->getDouble(); break;
20437 case 42: defaultArrowHeadSize = reader->getDouble(); break;
20438 case 43: styleBlockRotation = reader->getDouble(); break;
20439 case 45: scaleFactor = reader->getDouble(); break;
20440 case 290: landingEnabled = (reader->getInt32() != 0); break;
20441 case 291: doglegEnabled = (reader->getInt32() != 0); break;
20442 case 292: styleTextFrameEnabled = (reader->getInt32() != 0); break;
20443 case 293: isAnnotative = (reader->getInt32() != 0); break;
20444 case 294: isTextDirectionNegative = (reader->getInt32() != 0); break;
20445 case 295: leaderExtendedToText = (reader->getInt32() != 0); break;
20446 default:
20447 return DRW_Entity::parseCode(code, reader);
20448 }
20449 return true;
20450}
20451
20452// Helper: parse one AcDbMLeaderObjectContextData::LeaderRoot entry (§20.4.86).
20453//
20454// Each root has: connection point + direction, optional break pairs, leader
20455// index, landing distance, then a count-and-list of leader lines. Lines
20456// themselves carry: point list, break-info pairs, and (R2010+) per-line
20457// style overrides. The handles inside (line-type / arrow per leader line)
20458// are deferred to the entity-level handle stream and not stored here.
20459static bool parseMLeaderRoot(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
20460 std::uint32_t objectSize,
20461 std::uint64_t bodyEndBit,
20462 DRW_MLeaderRoot& root) {
20463 // Layout per libreDWG dwg2.spec:1316-1366 (Dwg_LEADER_Node + Dwg_LEADER_Line).
20464 // The two 3BD coords at the head of the node are conditional on the
20465 // preceding B flags; reading them unconditionally drifts the bit stream
20466 // when either flag is 0.
20467 bool hasLastPt = false;
20468 bool hasDogleg = false;
20469 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, hasLastPt)
20470 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, hasDogleg))
20471 return false; // 290 has_lastleaderlinepoint, 291 has_dogleg
20472 root.isContentValid = hasLastPt;
20473 root.unknown291 = hasDogleg;
20474 if (hasLastPt) {
20475 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, root.connectionPoint))
20476 return false;
20477 }
20478 if (hasDogleg) {
20479 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, root.direction))
20480 return false;
20481 }
20482
20483 std::uint32_t nBreaks = 0;
20484 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objectSize, kMaxMLeaderItems, 12,
20485 nBreaks))
20486 return false;
20487 if (!DRW::reserve(root.breaks, static_cast<int>(nBreaks)))
20488 return false;
20489 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nBreaks; ++i) {
20490 DRW_Coord a;
20491 DRW_Coord b;
20492 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, a)
20493 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, b))
20494 return false;
20495 root.breaks.emplace_back(a, b);
20496 }
20497
20498 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, root.leaderIndex)
20499 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, root.landingDistance))
20500 return false;
20501
20502 std::uint32_t nLines = 0;
20503 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objectSize, kMaxMLeaderItems, 6,
20504 nLines))
20505 return false;
20506 if (!DRW::reserve(root.leaderLines, static_cast<int>(nLines)))
20507 return false;
20508 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nLines; ++i) {
20509 DRW_MLeaderLeaderLine line;
20510 // Per libreDWG: BL num_points, points, BL num_breaks, breaks, BL line_index.
20511 // The previous 5-BL layout (brkInfoCount + segmentIndex + nPairs +
20512 // pairs + leaderLineIndex) inserted two spurious BL reads, drifting
20513 // every subsequent entity-level field (overallScale, contentType, …).
20514 std::uint32_t nPts = 0;
20515 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objectSize, kMaxMLeaderItems, 6,
20516 nPts))
20517 return false;
20518 if (!DRW::reserve(line.points, static_cast<int>(nPts)))
20519 return false;
20520 for (std::uint32_t j = 0; j < nPts; ++j) {
20521 DRW_Coord point;
20522 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, point))
20523 return false;
20524 line.points.push_back(point);
20525 }
20526 std::uint32_t nLineBreaks = 0;
20527 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objectSize, kMaxMLeaderItems,
20528 12, nLineBreaks))
20529 return false;
20530 for (std::uint32_t j = 0; j < nLineBreaks; ++j) {
20531 DRW_Coord a;
20532 DRW_Coord b;
20533 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, a)
20534 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, b))
20535 return false;
20536 line.breaks.emplace_back(a, b);
20537 }
20538 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, line.leaderLineIndex))
20539 return false;
20540
20541 // R2010+ per-line override block. The spec marks this block "R2010"
20542 // (§20.4.86 page 215); the override flags BL 93 says which fields
20543 // were overridden. The handle fields (340 line-type, 341 arrow) are
20544 // deferred to the trailing handle stream.
20545 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
20546 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, line.leaderType))
20547 return false;
20548 std::uint32_t parsedColor = 0;
20549 if (!readBoundedCmColor(*buf, nullptr, bodyEndBit, version,
20550 parsedColor))
20551 return false;
20552 line.color = static_cast<int>(parsedColor);
20553 // line type handle 340 — read from handles section later
20554 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, line.lineWeight)
20555 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, line.arrowSize)
20556 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit,
20557 line.overrideFlags))
20558 return false;
20559 // arrow handle 341 — handles section
20560 }
20561 root.leaderLines.push_back(std::move(line));
20562 }
20563
20564 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
20565 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, root.attachmentDirection))
20566 return false;
20567 }
20568
20569 return buf->isGood();
20570}
20571
20572// Helper: parse the AcDbMLeaderObjectContextData (§20.4.86) payload, the
20573// large embedded block at the start of the MLEADER body that carries the
20574// leader geometry plus either text or block content.
20575static bool parseMLeaderAnnotContext(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf,
20576 dwgBuffer *sBuf,
20577 std::uint32_t objectSize,
20578 std::uint64_t bodyEndBit,
20579 std::uint64_t stringEndBit,
20580 DRW_MLeaderAnnotContext& ctx) {
20581 // NOTE: when AcDbMLeaderObjectContextData is embedded INSIDE the MLEADER
20582 // entity body (rather than serialized as a standalone object), the
20583 // AcDbObjectContextData base preamble (BS version, B has-file-ext-dict,
20584 // B default-flag) does NOT appear in the bit stream — those fields are
20585 // standalone-object metadata. The embedded AnnotContext starts directly
20586 // with the leader-roots count. Its standalone-object scale handle is
20587 // likewise absent from this embedded payload.
20588
20589 // Number of leader roots.
20590 std::int32_t nRoots = 0;
20591 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, nRoots))
20592 return false;
20593 if (nRoots == 0) {
20594 if (!proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, 7))
20595 return false;
20596 bool rootCountBits[7] = {};
20597 for (bool& rootCountBit : rootCountBits) {
20598 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, rootCountBit))
20599 return false;
20600 }
20601 nRoots = rootCountBits[5] ? 2 : 1;
20602 }
20603 if (!isValidCount(nRoots, kMaxMLeaderItems)) return false;
20604 std::uint64_t minimumRootBits = 0;
20605 if (!dwgSafety::multiply(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(nRoots), 10,
20606 minimumRootBits)
20607 || !proxyEntityHasBits(*buf, bodyEndBit, minimumRootBits)) {
20608 return false;
20609 }
20610 ctx.roots.clear();
20611 if (!DRW::reserve(ctx.roots, nRoots))
20612 return false;
20613 for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < nRoots; ++i) {
20614 DRW_MLeaderRoot root;
20615 if (!parseMLeaderRoot(version, buf, objectSize, bodyEndBit, root))
20616 return false;
20617 ctx.roots.push_back(std::move(root));
20618 }
20619
20620 // Common content fields.
20621 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.overallScale)
20622 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.contentBasePoint)
20623 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.textHeight)
20624 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.arrowHeadSize)
20625 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.landingGap)
20626 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.styleLeftAttach)
20627 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.styleRightAttach)
20628 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.textAlignType)
20629 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.attachmentType)
20630 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.hasTextContents))
20631 return false;
20632
20633 if (ctx.hasTextContents) {
20634 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
20635 ctx.textLabel))
20636 return false;
20637 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.textNormal))
20638 return false;
20639 // text style handle 340 — handles section
20640 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.textLocation)
20641 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.textDirection)
20642 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.textRotation)
20643 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.boundaryWidth)
20644 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.boundaryHeight)
20645 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
20646 ctx.lineSpacingFactor)
20647 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.lineSpacingStyle))
20648 return false;
20649 std::uint32_t parsedTextColor = 0;
20650 if (!readBoundedCmColor(*buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version,
20651 parsedTextColor, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
20652 nullptr, stringEndBit))
20653 return false;
20654 ctx.textColor = static_cast<int>(parsedTextColor);
20655 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.alignment)
20656 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.flowDirection))
20657 return false;
20658 std::uint32_t parsedBgFillColor = 0;
20659 if (!readBoundedCmColor(*buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version,
20660 parsedBgFillColor, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
20661 nullptr, stringEndBit))
20662 return false;
20663 ctx.bgFillColor = static_cast<int>(parsedBgFillColor);
20664 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.bgScaleFactor)
20665 || !readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.bgTransparency)
20666 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.bgFillEnabled)
20667 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.bgMaskFillOn)
20668 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.columnType)
20669 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.textHeightAuto)
20670 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.columnWidth)
20671 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.columnGutter)
20672 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.columnFlowReversed))
20673 return false;
20674 std::uint32_t nColSizes = 0;
20675 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objectSize, kMaxMLeaderItems, 2,
20676 nColSizes))
20677 return false;
20678 if (!DRW::reserve(ctx.columnSizes, static_cast<int>(nColSizes)))
20679 return false;
20680 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nColSizes; ++i) {
20681 double columnSize = 0.0;
20682 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, columnSize))
20683 return false;
20684 ctx.columnSizes.push_back(columnSize);
20685 }
20686 bool ignoredBit = false;
20687 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.wordBreak)
20688 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ignoredBit))
20689 return false; // unknown trailing bit
20690 } else {
20691 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.hasContentsBlock))
20692 return false;
20693 if (ctx.hasContentsBlock) {
20694 // BlockTableRecord handle 341 — deferred
20695 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.blockNormal)
20696 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.blockLocation)
20697 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.blockScale)
20698 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
20699 ctx.blockRotation))
20700 return false;
20701 std::uint32_t parsedBlockColor = 0;
20702 if (!readBoundedCmColor(*buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version,
20703 parsedBlockColor, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
20704 nullptr, stringEndBit))
20705 return false;
20706 ctx.blockColor = static_cast<int>(parsedBlockColor);
20707 for (size_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
20708 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit,
20709 ctx.blockTransform[i]))
20710 return false;
20711 }
20712 }
20713 }
20714
20715 // Common tail.
20716 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.basePoint)
20717 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.baseDirection)
20718 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.baseVertical)
20719 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.isNormalReversed))
20720 return false;
20721
20722 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
20723 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.styleTopAttach)
20724 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ctx.styleBottomAttach))
20725 return false;
20726 }
20727
20728 return buf->isGood() && sBuf->isGood();
20729}
20730
20731static bool encodeMLeaderRoot(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
20732 const DRW_MLeaderRoot& root) {
20733 if (root.breaks.size() > DRW_MLeader::kMaxLeaderPoints
20734 || root.leaderLines.size() > DRW_MLeader::kMaxLeaderLines)
20735 return false;
20736
20737 buf->putBit(root.isContentValid ? 1 : 0);
20738 buf->putBit(root.unknown291 ? 1 : 0);
20739 if (root.isContentValid)
20740 buf->put3BitDouble(root.connectionPoint);
20741 if (root.unknown291)
20742 buf->put3BitDouble(root.direction);
20743
20744 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(root.breaks.size()));
20745 for (const auto& brk : root.breaks) {
20746 buf->put3BitDouble(brk.first);
20747 buf->put3BitDouble(brk.second);
20748 }
20749
20750 buf->putBitLong(root.leaderIndex);
20751 buf->putBitDouble(root.landingDistance);
20752
20753 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(root.leaderLines.size()));
20754 for (const DRW_MLeaderLeaderLine& line : root.leaderLines) {
20755 if (line.points.size() > DRW_MLeader::kMaxLeaderPoints
20756 || line.breaks.size() > DRW_MLeader::kMaxLeaderPoints)
20757 return false;
20758 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(line.points.size()));
20759 for (const DRW_Coord& point : line.points)
20760 buf->put3BitDouble(point);
20761
20762 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(line.breaks.size()));
20763 for (const auto& brk : line.breaks) {
20764 buf->put3BitDouble(brk.first);
20765 buf->put3BitDouble(brk.second);
20766 }
20767 buf->putBitLong(line.leaderLineIndex);
20768
20769 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
20770 buf->putBitShort(line.leaderType);
20771 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(line.color));
20772 buf->putBitLong(line.lineWeight);
20773 buf->putBitDouble(line.arrowSize);
20774 buf->putBitLong(line.overrideFlags);
20775 }
20776 }
20777
20778 if (version >= DRW::AC1024)
20779 buf->putBitShort(root.attachmentDirection);
20780
20781 return true;
20782}
20783
20784static bool encodeMLeaderAnnotContext(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf,
20785 dwgBufferW *strBuf,
20786 const DRW_MLeaderAnnotContext& ctx) {
20787 if (ctx.roots.size() > DRW_MLeader::kMaxRoots
20788 || ctx.columnSizes.size() > DRW_MLeader::kMaxLeaderPoints)
20789 return false;
20790 if (ctx.hasContentsBlock)
20791 return false;
20792
20793 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(ctx.roots.size()));
20794 for (const DRW_MLeaderRoot& root : ctx.roots) {
20795 if (!encodeMLeaderRoot(version, buf, root))
20796 return false;
20797 }
20798
20799 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.overallScale);
20800 buf->put3BitDouble(ctx.contentBasePoint);
20801 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.textHeight);
20802 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.arrowHeadSize);
20803 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.landingGap);
20804 buf->putBitShort(ctx.styleLeftAttach);
20805 buf->putBitShort(ctx.styleRightAttach);
20806 buf->putBitShort(ctx.textAlignType);
20807 buf->putBitShort(ctx.attachmentType);
20808 buf->putBit(ctx.hasTextContents ? 1 : 0);
20809
20810 if (ctx.hasTextContents) {
20811 (strBuf ? strBuf : buf)->putVariableText(version, ctx.textLabel);
20812 buf->put3BitDouble(ctx.textNormal);
20813 buf->put3BitDouble(ctx.textLocation);
20814 buf->put3BitDouble(ctx.textDirection);
20815 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.textRotation);
20816 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.boundaryWidth);
20817 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.boundaryHeight);
20818 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.lineSpacingFactor);
20819 buf->putBitShort(ctx.lineSpacingStyle);
20820 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(ctx.textColor));
20821 buf->putBitShort(ctx.alignment);
20822 buf->putBitShort(ctx.flowDirection);
20823 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(ctx.bgFillColor));
20824 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.bgScaleFactor);
20825 buf->putBitLong(ctx.bgTransparency);
20826 buf->putBit(ctx.bgFillEnabled ? 1 : 0);
20827 buf->putBit(ctx.bgMaskFillOn ? 1 : 0);
20828 buf->putBitShort(ctx.columnType);
20829 buf->putBit(ctx.textHeightAuto ? 1 : 0);
20830 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.columnWidth);
20831 buf->putBitDouble(ctx.columnGutter);
20832 buf->putBit(ctx.columnFlowReversed ? 1 : 0);
20833 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(ctx.columnSizes.size()));
20834 for (double columnSize : ctx.columnSizes)
20835 buf->putBitDouble(columnSize);
20836 buf->putBit(ctx.wordBreak ? 1 : 0);
20837 buf->putBit(0);
20838 } else {
20839 buf->putBit(0); // hasContentsBlock
20840 }
20841
20842 buf->put3BitDouble(ctx.basePoint);
20843 buf->put3BitDouble(ctx.baseDirection);
20844 buf->put3BitDouble(ctx.baseVertical);
20845 buf->putBit(ctx.isNormalReversed ? 1 : 0);
20846
20847 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
20848 buf->putBitShort(ctx.styleTopAttach);
20849 buf->putBitShort(ctx.styleBottomAttach);
20850 }
20851
20852 return true;
20853}
20854
20855void DRW_MLeader::resetDwgState() {
20856 DRW_Entity::reset();
20857 context = DRW_MLeaderAnnotContext{};
20858 classVersion = 2;
20859 styleHandle = dwgHandle{};
20860 overrideFlags = 0;
20861 leaderType = 1;
20862 leaderColor = 0;
20863 leaderLineTypeHandle = dwgHandle{};
20864 leaderLineWeight = 0;
20865 landingEnabled = true;
20866 doglegEnabled = true;
20867 landingDistance = 0.0;
20868 arrowHeadHandle = dwgHandle{};
20869 defaultArrowHeadSize = 0.0;
20870 styleContentType = 2;
20871 styleTextStyleHandle = dwgHandle{};
20872 styleLeftAttach = 0;
20873 styleRightAttach = 0;
20874 styleTextAngleType = 0;
20875 unknown175 = 0;
20876 styleTextColor = 0;
20877 styleTextFrameEnabled = false;
20878 styleBlockHandle = dwgHandle{};
20879 styleBlockColor = 0;
20880 styleBlockScale = DRW_Coord{1.0, 1.0, 1.0};
20881 styleBlockRotation = 0.0;
20882 styleAttachmentType = 0;
20883 isAnnotative = false;
20884 arrowHeads.clear();
20885 blockLabels.clear();
20886 isTextDirectionNegative = false;
20887 ipeAlign = 0;
20888 justification = 0;
20889 scaleFactor = 1.0;
20890 attachmentDirection = 0;
20891 styleTopAttach = 0;
20892 styleBottomAttach = 0;
20893 leaderExtendedToText = false;
20894 m_dxfCtxState = 0;
20895}
20896
20897bool DRW_MLeader::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
20898 resetDwgState();
20899 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
20900 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
20901 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
20902 sourceBuf->invalidate();
20903 resetDwgState();
20904 return false;
20905 };
20906 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
20907 return fail();
20908
20909 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
20910 buf = &bodyProbe;
20911
20912 dwgBuffer sBuff = buf->forkIndependent();
20913 dwgBuffer *sBuf = buf;
20914 if (version > DRW::AC1018) { // 2007+
20915 sBuf = &sBuff;
20916 }
20917 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
20918 if (!ret) return fail();
20919 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing MLEADER ***************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing MLEADER ***************\n"
);
20920 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
20921 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
20922 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
20923 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
20924 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*sBuf, version, objSize,
20925 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
20926 return fail();
20927 }
20928
20929 // R2010b+ class version (BS, default 2; <=R2004 was 1). libreDWG
20930 // dwg2.spec:1303-1306. Absent in R2007 streams; reading it would drift.
20931 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
20932 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, classVersion))
20933 return fail();
20934 if (classVersion > 10) {
20935 DRW_DBG("\nMLEADER: implausible classVersion=")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nMLEADER: implausible classVersion=");
20936 DRW_DBG(static_cast<int>(classVersion))DRW_dbg::dbg(static_cast<int>(classVersion));
20937 DRW_DBG(", aborting body\n")DRW_dbg::dbg(", aborting body\n");
20938 return fail();
20939 }
20940 }
20941
20942 // Phase 4 — embedded AcDbMLeaderObjectContextData / MLeaderAnnotContext.
20943 if (!parseMLeaderAnnotContext(version, buf, sBuf, objSize, bodyEndBit,
20944 stringEndBit, context)) {
20945 DRW_DBG("\nMLEADER: AnnotContext parse failed\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nMLEADER: AnnotContext parse failed\n");
20946 return fail();
20947 }
20948
20949 // Phase 3 — entity-level fields per §20.4.48 (after the AnnotContext).
20950 // Many handle slots are deferred to the trailing handle stream and not
20951 // stored here yet (resolution comes in Phase 7).
20952 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, overrideFlags)
20953 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, leaderType))
20954 return fail();
20955 std::uint32_t parsedColor = 0;
20956 if (!readBoundedCmColor(*buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version, parsedColor,
20957 nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
20958 stringEndBit))
20959 return fail();
20960 leaderColor = static_cast<int>(parsedColor);
20961 // leader line type handle 341 — handle stream
20962 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, leaderLineWeight)
20963 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, landingEnabled)
20964 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, doglegEnabled)
20965 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, landingDistance))
20966 return fail();
20967 // arrow head handle 342 — handle stream
20968 if (!readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, defaultArrowHeadSize)
20969 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleContentType))
20970 return fail();
20971 // text style handle 343 — handle stream
20972 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleLeftAttach)
20973 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleRightAttach)
20974 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleTextAngleType)
20975 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, unknown175))
20976 return fail();
20977 if (!readBoundedCmColor(*buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version, parsedColor,
20978 nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
20979 stringEndBit))
20980 return fail();
20981 styleTextColor = static_cast<int>(parsedColor);
20982 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleTextFrameEnabled))
20983 return fail();
20984 // style block handle 344 — handle stream (optional)
20985 if (!readBoundedCmColor(*buf, sBuf, bodyEndBit, version, parsedColor,
20986 nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
20987 stringEndBit))
20988 return fail();
20989 styleBlockColor = static_cast<int>(parsedColor);
20990 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleBlockScale)
20991 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleBlockRotation)
20992 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleAttachmentType)
20993 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, isAnnotative))
20994 return fail();
20995
20996 // R2007 arrays (pre-R2010 only): per spec §20.4.48. Bounds-check the
20997 // counts; a misaligned bit stream would produce huge nonsense values.
20998 if (version < DRW::AC1024) {
20999 std::uint32_t nArrows = 0;
21000 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxMLeaderItems, 1,
21001 nArrows))
21002 return fail();
21003 if (!DRW::reserve(arrowHeads, static_cast<int>(nArrows)))
21004 return fail();
21005 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nArrows; ++i) {
21006 ArrowHeadEntry e;
21007 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, e.isDefault))
21008 return fail();
21009 arrowHeads.push_back(e);
21010 }
21011 std::uint32_t nLabels = 0;
21012 if (!readTableBodyCount(version, buf, objSize, kMaxMLeaderItems, 4,
21013 nLabels))
21014 return fail();
21015 if (!DRW::reserve(blockLabels, static_cast<int>(nLabels)))
21016 return fail();
21017 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nLabels; ++i) {
21018 BlockLabelEntry e;
21019 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
21020 e.labelText))
21021 return fail();
21022 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, e.uiIndex)
21023 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, e.width))
21024 return fail();
21025 blockLabels.push_back(std::move(e));
21026 }
21027 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, isTextDirectionNegative)
21028 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, ipeAlign)
21029 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, justification)
21030 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, scaleFactor))
21031 return fail();
21032 } else { // R2010+
21033 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, attachmentDirection)
21034 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleTopAttach)
21035 || !readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, styleBottomAttach))
21036 return fail();
21037 }
21038 if (version >= DRW::AC1027) { // R2013+
21039 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, leaderExtendedToText))
21040 return fail();
21041 }
21042
21043 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
21044 || currentDwgBit(buf) > bodyEndBit
21045 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit)
21046 return fail();
21047
21048 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
21049 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
21050 handleEndBit))
21051 return fail();
21052 // Common entity handles first (owner/reactors/xdic/layer/ltype/...) —
21053 // entity-specific handles follow in declared order from libreDWG
21054 // dwg2.spec. Read order in the trailing handle stream:
21055 // 1. (R2010b+ only) per-leader-line ltype + arrow handles, in the
21056 // same iteration order as the body block.
21057 // 2. AnnotContext content handle (text_style 340 if hasTextContents,
21058 // else block_table 341 if hasContentsBlock).
21059 // 3. mleaderstyle (340), line_ltype (341), arrow_handle (342),
21060 // text_style (343), block_style (344) entity-level handles.
21061 // 4. (R14-R2007 only) per-arrowhead + per-blocklabel handles.
21062 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, buf, true, handleEndBit);
21063 if (!ret)
21064 return fail();
21065
21066 auto safeHandle = [&](dwgHandle& slot, const char* tag) {
21067 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(*buf, handleEndBit, 0, false, slot))
21068 return false;
21069 DRW_DBG(" ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" "); DRW_DBG(tag)DRW_dbg::dbg(tag); DRW_DBG(": ")DRW_dbg::dbg(": ");
21070 DRW_DBGHL(slot.code, slot.size, slot.ref)DRW_dbg::dbgHL(slot.code, slot.size, slot.ref); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
21071 return true;
21072 };
21073
21074 // 1. R2010b+ per-line handles, in body iteration order.
21075 if (version >= DRW::AC1024) {
21076 for (auto& root : context.roots) {
21077 for (auto& line : root.leaderLines) {
21078 if (!safeHandle(line.lineTypeHandle, "line.ltype")) return fail();
21079 if (!safeHandle(line.arrowHandle, "line.arrow")) return fail();
21080 }
21081 }
21082 }
21083
21084 // 2. AnnotContext content handle.
21085 if (context.hasTextContents) {
21086 if (!safeHandle(context.textStyleHandle, "ctx.text_style")) return fail();
21087 } else if (context.hasContentsBlock) {
21088 if (!safeHandle(context.blockTableRecordHandle, "ctx.block_table")) return fail();
21089 }
21090
21091 // 3. Entity-level handles.
21092 if (!safeHandle(styleHandle, "mleaderstyle")) return fail();
21093 if (!safeHandle(leaderLineTypeHandle, "line_ltype")) return fail();
21094 if (!safeHandle(arrowHeadHandle, "arrow_handle")) return fail();
21095 if (!safeHandle(styleTextStyleHandle, "text_style")) return fail();
21096 if (!safeHandle(styleBlockHandle, "block_style")) return fail();
21097
21098 // 4. R14-R2007 per-arrowhead + per-blocklabel handles (counts came
21099 // from the body-side arrays read earlier).
21100 if (version < DRW::AC1024) {
21101 for (auto& a : arrowHeads)
21102 if (!safeHandle(a.handle, "arrowheads.handle")) return fail();
21103 for (auto& bl : blockLabels)
21104 if (!safeHandle(bl.attDefHandle, "blocklabels.attdef")) return fail();
21105 }
21106
21107 const int rb = buf->numRemainingBytes();
21108 DRW_DBG("\nMLEADER tail rb=")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nMLEADER tail rb="); DRW_DBG(rb)DRW_dbg::dbg(rb); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
21109 if (rb > 4) {
21110 DRW_DBG("MLEADER: handle-stream tail ")DRW_dbg::dbg("MLEADER: handle-stream tail "); DRW_DBG(rb)DRW_dbg::dbg(rb);
21111 DRW_DBG(" bytes unconsumed (handle ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" bytes unconsumed (handle ");
21112 DRW_DBGH(handle)DRW_dbg::dbgH(handle); DRW_DBG(") — review tail handle list\n")DRW_dbg::dbg(") — review tail handle list\n");
21113 }
21114
21115 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
21116 return fail();
21117 *sourceBuf = *buf;
21118 return true;
21119}
21120
21121bool DRW_MLeader::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
21122 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
21123 (void)bs;
21124 if (version < DRW::AC1024)
21125 return false;
21126
21127 oType = kDwgClassNum;
21128 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf, strBuf))
21129 return false;
21130
21131 buf->putBitShort(classVersion == 0 ? 2 : classVersion);
21132 if (!encodeMLeaderAnnotContext(version, buf, strBuf, context))
21133 return false;
21134
21135 buf->putBitLong(overrideFlags);
21136 buf->putBitShort(leaderType);
21137 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(leaderColor));
21138 buf->putBitLong(leaderLineWeight);
21139 buf->putBit(landingEnabled ? 1 : 0);
21140 buf->putBit(doglegEnabled ? 1 : 0);
21141 buf->putBitDouble(landingDistance);
21142 buf->putBitDouble(defaultArrowHeadSize);
21143 buf->putBitShort(styleContentType);
21144 buf->putBitShort(styleLeftAttach);
21145 buf->putBitShort(styleRightAttach);
21146 buf->putBitShort(styleTextAngleType);
21147 buf->putBitShort(unknown175);
21148 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(styleTextColor));
21149 buf->putBit(styleTextFrameEnabled ? 1 : 0);
21150 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(styleBlockColor));
21151 buf->put3BitDouble(styleBlockScale);
21152 buf->putBitDouble(styleBlockRotation);
21153 buf->putBitShort(styleAttachmentType);
21154 buf->putBit(isAnnotative ? 1 : 0);
21155 buf->putBitShort(attachmentDirection);
21156 buf->putBitShort(styleTopAttach);
21157 buf->putBitShort(styleBottomAttach);
21158 if (version >= DRW::AC1027)
21159 buf->putBit(leaderExtendedToText ? 1 : 0);
21160
21161 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf))
21162 return false;
21163
21164 dwgBufferW *hb = handleBuf ? handleBuf : buf;
21165 for (const DRW_MLeaderRoot& root : context.roots) {
21166 for (const DRW_MLeaderLeaderLine& line : root.leaderLines) {
21167 putHardPointerHandle(hb, line.lineTypeHandle.ref);
21168 putHardPointerHandle(hb, line.arrowHandle.ref);
21169 }
21170 }
21171
21172 if (context.hasTextContents) {
21173 putHardPointerHandle(hb, context.textStyleHandle.ref);
21174 } else if (context.hasContentsBlock) {
21175 putHardPointerHandle(hb, context.blockTableRecordHandle.ref);
21176 }
21177
21178 putHardPointerHandle(hb, styleHandle.ref);
21179 putHardPointerHandle(hb, leaderLineTypeHandle.ref);
21180 putHardPointerHandle(hb, arrowHeadHandle.ref);
21181 putHardPointerHandle(hb, styleTextStyleHandle.ref);
21182 putHardPointerHandle(hb, styleBlockHandle.ref);
21183
21184 return true;
21185}

21388
21389bool DRW_Viewport::validatePayloadFields() const {
21390 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
21391 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
21392 && std::isfinite(point.z);
21393 };
21394 const auto fitsSignedShort = [](int value) {
21395 return value >= static_cast<int>(std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::min())
21396 && value <= static_cast<int>(std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max());
21397 };
21398 const auto fitsByte = [](int value) {
21399 return value >= 0
21400 && value <= static_cast<int>(std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max());
21401 };
21402 const auto fitsBitShort = [](int value) {
21403 return value >= 0
21404 && value <= static_cast<int>(std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max());
21405 };
21406 const bool integralCircleZoom = std::isfinite(circleZoom)
21407 && std::trunc(circleZoom) == circleZoom;
21408 return finite(basePoint) && finite(viewTarget) && finite(viewDir)
21409 && finite(ucsOrigin) && finite(ucsXAxis) && finite(ucsYAxis)
21410 && std::isfinite(pswidth) && std::isfinite(psheight)
21411 && std::isfinite(centerPX) && std::isfinite(centerPY)
21412 && std::isfinite(snapPX) && std::isfinite(snapPY)
21413 && std::isfinite(snapSpPX) && std::isfinite(snapSpPY)
21414 && std::isfinite(gridSpX) && std::isfinite(gridSpY)
21415 && std::isfinite(viewLength) && std::isfinite(frontClip)
21416 && std::isfinite(backClip) && std::isfinite(viewHeight)
21417 && std::isfinite(snapAngle) && std::isfinite(twistAngle)
21418 && std::isfinite(ucsElevation) && std::isfinite(brightness)
21419 && std::isfinite(contrast) && fitsSignedShort(vpstatus)
21420 && fitsSignedShort(vpID) && integralCircleZoom
21421 && circleZoom >= 0.0
21422 && circleZoom <= static_cast<double>(std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max())
21423 && fitsBitShort(majorGridLines) && fitsByte(renderMode)
21424 && fitsBitShort(ucsOrthographicType) && fitsBitShort(shadePlotMode)
21425 && fitsByte(defaultLightingType)
21426 && ambientColor <= std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()
21427 && ambientColorRgb >= -1 && ambientColorRgb <= 0xFFFFFF
21428 && frozenLayerHandles.size() <= kMaxViewportFrozenLayers;
21429}
21430
21431bool DRW_Viewport::validateDxf() const {
21432 return validatePayloadFields();
21433}

21484bool DRW_Viewport::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs){
21485 resetDwgState();
21486 dwgBuffer *sourceBuf = buf;
21487 auto fail = [this, sourceBuf]() {
21488 if (sourceBuf != nullptr)
21489 sourceBuf->invalidate();
21490 resetDwgState();
21491 return false;
21492 };
21493 if (sourceBuf == nullptr)
21494 return fail();
21495
21496 dwgBuffer bodyProbe = sourceBuf->forkIndependent();
21497 buf = &bodyProbe;
21498 dwgBuffer sBuff = bodyProbe.forkIndependent();
21499 dwgBuffer *sBuf = buf;
21500 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
21501 sBuf = &sBuff; //separate buffer for strings
21502 }
21503 bool ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwg(version, buf, sBuf, bs);
21504 if (!ret)
21505 return fail();
21506 DRW_DBG("\n***************************** parsing viewport *****************************************\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n***************************** parsing viewport *****************************************\n"
);
21507 const std::uint64_t bodyEndBit = dwgDataEndBit;
21508 std::uint64_t stringEndBit = bodyEndBit;
21509 if (version > DRW::AC1021) {
21510 std::uint64_t ignoredBodyEndBit = 0;
21511 if (!entityBodyDataEndBit(*sBuf, version, objSize,
21512 ignoredBodyEndBit, &stringEndBit))
21513 return fail();
21514 }
21515 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, basePoint)
21516 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, pswidth)
21517 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, psheight))
21518 return fail();
21519 DRW_DBG("center ")DRW_dbg::dbg("center "); DRW_DBGPT(basePoint.x, basePoint.y, basePoint.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(basePoint.x, basePoint.y, basePoint.z);
21520 DRW_DBG("\nWidth: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nWidth: "); DRW_DBG(pswidth)DRW_dbg::dbg(pswidth); DRW_DBG(", Height: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", Height: "); DRW_DBG(psheight)DRW_dbg::dbg(psheight); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
21521 //RLZ TODO: complete in dxf
21522 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {//2000+
21523 if (!readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, viewTarget)
21524 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, viewDir)
21525 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, twistAngle)
21526 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, viewHeight)
21527 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, viewLength)
21528 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, frontClip)
21529 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, backClip)
21530 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, snapAngle)
21531 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, centerPX)
21532 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, centerPY)
21533 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, snapPX)
21534 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, snapPY)
21535 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, snapSpPX)
21536 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, snapSpPY)
21537 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, gridSpX)
21538 || !readBoundedRawDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, gridSpY))
21539 return fail();
21540 DRW_DBG("view Target ")DRW_dbg::dbg("view Target "); DRW_DBGPT(viewTarget.x, viewTarget.y, viewTarget.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(viewTarget.x, viewTarget.y, viewTarget.z);
21541 DRW_DBG("\nview direction ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nview direction "); DRW_DBGPT(viewDir.x, viewDir.y, viewDir.z)DRW_dbg::dbgPT(viewDir.x, viewDir.y, viewDir.z);
21542 DRW_DBG("\nView twist Angle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nView twist Angle: "); DRW_DBG(twistAngle)DRW_dbg::dbg(twistAngle);
21543 DRW_DBG("\nview Height: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nview Height: "); DRW_DBG(viewHeight)DRW_dbg::dbg(viewHeight);
21544 DRW_DBG(" Lens Length: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" Lens Length: "); DRW_DBG(viewLength)DRW_dbg::dbg(viewLength);
21545 DRW_DBG("\nfront Clip Z: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nfront Clip Z: "); DRW_DBG(frontClip)DRW_dbg::dbg(frontClip);
21546 DRW_DBG(" back Clip Z: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(" back Clip Z: "); DRW_DBG(backClip)DRW_dbg::dbg(backClip);
21547 DRW_DBG("\n snap Angle: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n snap Angle: "); DRW_DBG(snapAngle)DRW_dbg::dbg(snapAngle);
21548 DRW_DBG("\nview center X: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nview center X: "); DRW_DBG(centerPX)DRW_dbg::dbg(centerPX); DRW_DBG(", Y: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", Y: "); DRW_DBG(centerPX)DRW_dbg::dbg(centerPX);
21549 DRW_DBG("\nSnap base point X: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nSnap base point X: "); DRW_DBG(snapPX)DRW_dbg::dbg(snapPX); DRW_DBG(", Y: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", Y: "); DRW_DBG(snapPY)DRW_dbg::dbg(snapPY);
21550 DRW_DBG("\nSnap spacing X: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("\nSnap spacing X: "); DRW_DBG(snapSpPX)DRW_dbg::dbg(snapSpPX); DRW_DBG(", Y: ")DRW_dbg::dbg(", Y: "); DRW_DBG(snapSpPY)DRW_dbg::dbg(snapSpPY);
21551 std::uint16_t parsedCircleZoom = 0;
21552 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedCircleZoom))
21553 return fail();
21554 circleZoom = parsedCircleZoom;
21555 }
21556 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
21557 std::uint16_t parsedMajorGridLines = 0;
21558 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedMajorGridLines))
21559 return fail();
21560 majorGridLines = parsedMajorGridLines;
21561 }
21562 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {//2000+
21563 std::int32_t parsedFrozenLyCount = 0;
21564 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedFrozenLyCount))
21565 return fail();
21566 if (!isValidCount(parsedFrozenLyCount, kMaxViewportFrozenLayers))
21567 return fail();
21568 frozenLyCount = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parsedFrozenLyCount);
21569 DRW_DBG("Frozen Layer count?: ")DRW_dbg::dbg("Frozen Layer count?: "); DRW_DBG(frozenLyCount)DRW_dbg::dbg(frozenLyCount); DRW_DBG("\n")DRW_dbg::dbg("\n");
21570 if (!readBoundedBitLong(*buf, bodyEndBit, statusFlags))
21571 return fail();
21572 if (!readBoundedVariableText(*sBuf, stringEndBit, version,
21573 styleSheet))
21574 return fail();
21575 std::uint8_t parsedRenderMode = 0;
21576 if (!readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedRenderMode))
21577 return fail();
21578 renderMode = parsedRenderMode;
21579 // ODA order is UCS-at-origin (74), then UCS-per-viewport (71).
21580 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ucsAtOrigin)
21581 || !readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, ucsPerViewport)
21582 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ucsOrigin)
21583 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ucsXAxis)
21584 || !readBoundedBitCoord(*buf, bodyEndBit, ucsYAxis)
21585 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, ucsElevation))
21586 return fail();
21587 std::uint16_t parsedUcsOrthographicType = 0;
21588 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit,
21589 parsedUcsOrthographicType))
21590 return fail();
21591 ucsOrthographicType = parsedUcsOrthographicType;
21592 }
21593 if (version > DRW::AC1015) {//2004+
21594 std::uint16_t parsedShadePlotMode = 0;
21595 if (!readBoundedBitShort(*buf, bodyEndBit, parsedShadePlotMode))
21596 return fail();
21597 shadePlotMode = parsedShadePlotMode;
21598 }
21599 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
21600 std::uint8_t parsedDefaultLightingType = 0;
21601 if (!readBoundedBit(*buf, bodyEndBit, useDefaultLighting)
21602 || !readBoundedRawChar8(*buf, bodyEndBit,
21603 parsedDefaultLightingType)
21604 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, brightness)
21605 || !readBoundedBitDouble(*buf, bodyEndBit, contrast))
21606 return fail();
21607 defaultLightingType = parsedDefaultLightingType;
21608 // ODA §20.4.38: ambient color is CMC, not ENC — confirmed by libreDWG dwg.spec:2512
21609 bool hasRgbColor = false;
21610 int parsedAmbientColorRgb = -1;
21611 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedAmbientColorName;
21612 UTF8STRINGstd::string parsedAmbientColorBookName;
21613 dwgBuffer colorProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
21614 dwgBuffer colorStringProbe = sBuf->forkIndependent();
21615 const std::uint32_t parsedAmbientColor = colorProbe.getCmColor(
21616 version, &parsedAmbientColorRgb, &colorStringProbe,
21617 &parsedAmbientColorName, &parsedAmbientColorBookName,
21618 &hasRgbColor);
21619 if (!colorProbe.isGood() || !colorStringProbe.isGood()
21620 || currentDwgBit(&colorProbe) > bodyEndBit
21621 || currentDwgBit(&colorStringProbe) > stringEndBit)
21622 return fail();
21623 *buf = colorProbe;
21624 *sBuf = colorStringProbe;
21625 ambientColor = parsedAmbientColor;
21626 ambientColorRgb = parsedAmbientColorRgb;
21627 ambientColorName = parsedAmbientColorBookName.empty()
21628 ? std::move(parsedAmbientColorName)
21629 : (parsedAmbientColorBookName + "$"
21630 + parsedAmbientColorName);
21631 if (!hasRgbColor)
21632 ambientColorRgb = -1;
21633 }
21634 const auto finite = [](const DRW_Coord& point) {
21635 return std::isfinite(point.x) && std::isfinite(point.y)
21636 && std::isfinite(point.z);
21637 };
21638 if (!finite(basePoint) || !finite(viewTarget) || !finite(viewDir)
21639 || !finite(ucsOrigin) || !finite(ucsXAxis) || !finite(ucsYAxis)
21640 || !std::isfinite(pswidth) || !std::isfinite(psheight)
21641 || !std::isfinite(centerPX) || !std::isfinite(centerPY)
21642 || !std::isfinite(snapPX) || !std::isfinite(snapPY)
21643 || !std::isfinite(snapSpPX) || !std::isfinite(snapSpPY)
21644 || !std::isfinite(gridSpX) || !std::isfinite(gridSpY)
21645 || !std::isfinite(viewLength) || !std::isfinite(frontClip)
21646 || !std::isfinite(backClip) || !std::isfinite(viewHeight)
21647 || !std::isfinite(snapAngle) || !std::isfinite(twistAngle)
21648 || !std::isfinite(ucsElevation) || !std::isfinite(brightness)
21649 || !std::isfinite(contrast))
21650 return fail();
21651 if (!validatePayloadFields())
21652 return fail();
21653 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
21654 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*sourceBuf, version, objSize, bs,
21655 handleEndBit))
21656 return fail();
21657 ret = DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, buf, true, handleEndBit);
21658 if (!ret || !buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
21659 return fail();
21660
21661 if (!buf->isGood() || !sBuf->isGood()
21662 || currentDwgBit(sBuf) > stringEndBit)
21663 return fail();
21664
21665 dwgBuffer handleProbe = buf->forkIndependent();
21666 auto readHandleRef = [&handleProbe, handleEndBit](std::uint32_t& target) {
21667 dwgHandle parsed;
21668 if (!readBoundedDwgHandle(handleProbe, handleEndBit, 0, false,
21669 parsed)) {
21670 return false;
21671 }
21672 target = parsed.ref;
21673 return true;
21674 };
21675 if (version < DRW::AC1015) {//R13 & R14 only
21676 if (!readHandleRef(vpHeaderHandle))
21677 return fail();
21678 }
21679 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {//2000+
21680 if (!DRW::reserve(frozenLayerHandles, static_cast<int>(frozenLyCount)))
21681 return fail();
21682 for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < frozenLyCount; ++i) {
21683 std::uint32_t ref = 0;
21684 if (!readHandleRef(ref))
21685 return fail();
21686 frozenLayerHandles.push_back(ref);
21687 }
21688 if (!readHandleRef(clipBoundaryHandle))
21689 return fail();
21690 if (version == DRW::AC1015) {//2000 only
21691 if (!readHandleRef(vpHeaderHandle))
21692 return fail();
21693 }
21694 if (!readHandleRef(namedUcsHandle) || !readHandleRef(baseUcsHandle))
21695 return fail();
21696 }
21697 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {//2007+
21698 if (!readHandleRef(backgroundHandle)
21699 || !readHandleRef(visualStyleHandle)
21700 || !readHandleRef(shadePlotHandle))
21701 return fail();
21702 }
21703 if (version > DRW::AC1018 && !readHandleRef(m_sunHandle))
21704 return fail();
21705 if (!handleProbe.isGood() || !sBuf->isGood())
21706 return fail();
21707 *sourceBuf = handleProbe;
21708 return true;
21709}

21711// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21712// Write helpers shared by the new encoders below.
21713// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21714
21715namespace {
21716// ODA handle reference codes: 3 hard owner, 4 soft pointer, 5 hard pointer.
21717static void putTypedHandle(dwgBufferW *hb, std::uint32_t ref,
21718 std::uint8_t code) {
21719 dwgHandle h;
21720 h.code = ref == 0 ? 0 : code;
21721 h.ref = ref;
21722 h.ref64 = ref;
21723 h.size = 0;
21724 if (h.ref != 0) {
21725 std::uint32_t t = h.ref;
21726 while (t != 0) { t >>= 8; ++h.size; }
21727 }
21728 hb->putHandle(h);
21729}
21730
21731static void putAbsHandle(dwgBufferW *hb, std::uint32_t ref) {
21732 putTypedHandle(hb, ref, 5);
21733}
21734} // namespace
21735
21736// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21737// DRW_MLine::encodeDwg — OT=47 (AC1015/AC1018/AC1024)
21738// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21739
21740bool DRW_MLine::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
21741 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
21742 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
21743 if (!validatePayloadFields())
21744 return false;
21745 oType = 47;
21746 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
21747
21748 buf->putBitDouble(scale);
21749 buf->putRawChar8(justification);
21750 buf->put3BitDouble(basePoint);
21751 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, false); // false = pre-2000 style (getExtrusion(false) in parser)
21752 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(openClosed));
21753 buf->putRawChar8(numLines);
21754 buf->putBitShort(numVerts);
21755
21756 for (const auto& vtx : vertlist) {
21757 buf->put3BitDouble(vtx.position);
21758 buf->put3BitDouble(vtx.vertexDir);
21759 buf->put3BitDouble(vtx.miterDir);
21760 for (int li = 0; li < static_cast<int>(numLines); ++li) {
21761 const auto& segs = (li < static_cast<int>(vtx.segParms.size()))
21762 ? vtx.segParms[li] : std::vector<double>{};
21763 const auto& fills = (li < static_cast<int>(vtx.areaFillParms.size()))
21764 ? vtx.areaFillParms[li] : std::vector<double>{};
21765 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(segs.size()));
21766 for (double s : segs) buf->putBitDouble(s);
21767 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(fills.size()));
21768 for (double f : fills) buf->putBitDouble(f);
21769 }
21770 }
21771
21772 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
21773
21774 // MLINE style handle — extra handle after standard entity handles.
21775 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {
21776 dwgBufferW *hb = (handleBuf != nullptr) ? handleBuf : buf;
21777 putAbsHandle(hb, styleHandle);
21778 }
21779 return true;
21780}
21781
21782// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21783// DRW_Vertex::encodeDwg — OT varies by flags
21784// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21785
21786bool DRW_Vertex::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
21787 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
21788 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
21789 if (buf == nullptr || !validatePayloadFields())
21790 return false;
21791 switch (m_dwgSubtype) {
21792 case DwgSubtype::Vertex2D: oType = 0x0A; break;
21793 case DwgSubtype::Vertex3D: oType = 0x0B; break;
21794 case DwgSubtype::Mesh: oType = 0x0C; break;
21795 case DwgSubtype::Polyface: oType = 0x0D; break;
21796 case DwgSubtype::PolyfaceFace: oType = 0x0E; break;
21797 case DwgSubtype::Auto:
21798 if ((flags & 64) != 0)
21799 oType = 0x0D; // VERTEX_PFACE coordinate vertex
21800 else if ((flags & 128) != 0)
21801 oType = 0x0E; // VERTEX_PFACE_FACE
21802 else if ((flags & 16) != 0)
21803 oType = 0x0C; // VERTEX_MESH
21804 else if ((flags & 32) != 0 || (flags & 8) != 0)
21805 oType = 0x0B; // VERTEX_3D
21806 else
21807 oType = 0x0A; // VERTEX_2D
21808 break;
21809 }
21810
21811 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
21812
21813 if (oType == 0x0A) {
21814 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(flags));
21815 buf->put3BitDouble(basePoint);
21816 buf->putBitDouble(stawidth);
21817 buf->putBitDouble(endwidth);
21818 buf->putBitDouble(bulge);
21819 if (version > DRW::AC1021)
21820 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(identifier));
21821 buf->putBitDouble(tgdir);
21822 } else if (oType == 0x0B || oType == 0x0C || oType == 0x0D) {
21823 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(flags));
21824 buf->put3BitDouble(basePoint);
21825 } else { // 0x0E pface face
21826 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(vindex1));
21827 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(vindex2));
21828 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(vindex3));
21829 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(vindex4));
21830 }
21831
21832 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
21833}
21834
21835bool DRW_SeqEnd::parseDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBuffer *buf, std::uint32_t bs) {
21836 DRW_Entity::reset();
21837 if (buf == nullptr)
21838 return false;
21839
21840 auto fail = [this, buf]() {
21841 buf->invalidate();
21842 DRW_Entity::reset();
21843 return false;
21844 };
21845 dwgBuffer probe = buf->forkIndependent();
21846 if (!DRW_Entity::parseDwgCommon(version, &probe, bs)
21847 || !probe.isGood())
21848 return fail();
21849 std::uint64_t handleEndBit = 0;
21850 if (!dwgHandleStreamEndBit(*buf, version, objSize, bs, handleEndBit)
21851 || !DRW_Entity::parseDwgEntHandle(version, &probe, true,
21852 handleEndBit)
21853 || !probe.isGood())
21854 return fail();
21855
21856 *buf = probe;
21857 return true;
21858}
21859
21860bool DRW_SeqEnd::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
21861 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
21862 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
21863 oType = 0x06;
21864 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf))
21865 return false;
21866 return encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf);
21867}
21868
21869// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21870// DRW_Polyline::encodeDwg — OT varies by flags; vertex handles emitted here.
21871// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21872
21873bool DRW_Polyline::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
21874 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
21875 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
21876 if (buf == nullptr || !validatePayloadFields())
21877 return false;
21878 // Determine object type from stored flags (mirror of parseDwg dispatch).
21879 if (flags & 64) oType = 0x1D; // POLYLINE_PFACE
21880 else if (flags & 16) oType = 0x1E; // POLYLINE_MESH
21881 else if (flags & 8) oType = 0x10; // POLYLINE_3D
21882 else oType = 0x0F; // POLYLINE_2D
21883
21884 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
21885
21886 if (oType == 0x0F) {
21887 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(flags));
21888 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(curvetype));
21889 buf->putBitDouble(defstawidth);
21890 buf->putBitDouble(defendwidth);
21891 buf->putThickness(thickness, version > DRW::AC1014);
21892 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
21893 buf->putExtrusion(extPoint, version > DRW::AC1014);
21894 } else if (oType == 0x10) {
21895 // curvetype → 2 RC flag bytes (mirror of parser decode)
21896 std::uint8_t rc1 = 0;
21897 if (curvetype == 5) rc1 = 1;
21898 else if (curvetype == 6) rc1 = 2;
21899 else if (curvetype == 8) rc1 = 3;
21900 buf->putRawChar8(rc1);
21901 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(flags & 1)); // bit 0 = closed
21902 } else if (oType == 0x1D) {
21903 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(vertexcount));
21904 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(facecount));
21905 } else { // 0x1E MESH
21906 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(flags & ~16)); // strip reader-added bit 4
21907 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(curvetype));
21908 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(vertexcount)); // M count
21909 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(facecount)); // N count
21910 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(smoothM)); // mDensity, DXF 73
21911 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(smoothN)); // nDensity, DXF 74
21912 }
21913
21914 // AC2004+ (>AC1015): emit vertex count before the handle section.
21915 std::int32_t ooCount = static_cast<std::int32_t>(vertlist.size());
21916 if (version > DRW::AC1015)
21917 buf->putBitLong(ooCount);
21918
21919 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
21920
21921 dwgBufferW *hb = (handleBuf != nullptr) ? handleBuf : buf;
21922
21923 if (version < DRW::AC1018) {
21924 // R2000-: first/last vertex handles (absolute hard pointers).
21925 putAbsHandle(hb, vertlist.empty() ? 0u : vertlist.front()->handle);
21926 putAbsHandle(hb, vertlist.empty() ? 0u : vertlist.back()->handle);
21927 } else {
21928 // R2004+: one handle per vertex.
21929 for (const auto& v : vertlist)
21930 putAbsHandle(hb, v ? v->handle : 0u);
21931 }
21932 putAbsHandle(hb, seqEndH.ref);
21933
21934 return true;
21935}
21936
21937// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21938// DRW_Leader::encodeDwg — OT=45 (AC1015/AC1018/AC1024)
21939// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21940
21941bool DRW_Leader::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
21942 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
21943 (void)bs; (void)strBuf;
21944 if (buf == nullptr || !validatePayloadFields())
21945 return false;
21946 oType = 45;
21947 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
21948
21949 buf->putBit(0); // unknown bit
21950 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(flag)); // annotation type
21951 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::int16_t>(leadertype)); // pathType (DXF code 72)
21952 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(vertexlist.size()));
21953 for (const auto& vp : vertexlist)
21954 buf->put3BitDouble(*vp);
21955 buf->put3BitDouble(origin); // leader plane origin
21956 // ODA §20.4.47: Extrusion is plain 3DPOINT (3BD), not BE — matches parseDwg.
21957 buf->put3BitDouble(extrusionPoint);
21958
21959 buf->put3BitDouble(horizdir);
21960 buf->put3BitDouble(offsetblock);
21961
21962 if (leaderHasEndpointProjection(version))
21963 buf->put3BitDouble(offsettext); // endpoint projection
21964
21965 if (version < DRW::AC1015)
21966 buf->putBitDouble(0.0); // dimgap (pre-R2000)
21967
21968 if (leaderHasTextBox(version)) {
21969 buf->putBitDouble(textheight);
21970 buf->putBitDouble(textwidth);
21971 }
21972
21973 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(hookline));
21974 buf->putBit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(arrow));
21975
21976 buf->putBitShort(0); // arrowHeadType (present in every DWG version)
21977 if (version < DRW::AC1015) {
21978 buf->putBitDouble(0.0); // dimasz
21979 buf->putBit(0); // unk
21980 buf->putBit(0); // unk
21981 buf->putBitShort(0); // unk short
21982 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(coloruse)); // byBlock color
21983 buf->putBit(0); // unk
21984 buf->putBit(0); // unk
21985 } else {
21986 buf->putBit(0); // unk
21987 buf->putBit(0); // unk
21988 }
21989
21990 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
21991
21992 dwgBufferW *hb = (handleBuf != nullptr) ? handleBuf : buf;
21993 putAbsHandle(hb, 0); // AnnotH — null (no annotation entity)
21994 putAbsHandle(hb, 0x15); // dimStyleH — hard ptr to STANDARD (handle 0x15)
21995
21996 return buf->isGood() && hb->isGood();
21997}
21998
21999// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
22000// DRW_Viewport::encodeDwg — OT=34 (AC1015/AC1018/AC1024)
22001// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
22002
22003bool DRW_Viewport::encodeDwg(DRW::Version version, dwgBufferW *buf, std::uint32_t bs,
22004 dwgBufferW *strBuf, dwgBufferW *handleBuf) {
22005 (void)bs;
22006 if (buf == nullptr || !validatePayloadFields())
22007 return false;
22008 oType = 34;
22009 // Use strBuf for TV strings in AC1024; for AC1015/AC1018 strings go inline.
22010 dwgBufferW *sb = (strBuf && version > DRW::AC1018) ? strBuf : buf;
22011 if (!encodeDwgCommon(version, buf)) return false;
22012
22013 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.x);
22014 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.y);
22015 buf->putBitDouble(basePoint.z);
22016 buf->putBitDouble(pswidth);
22017 buf->putBitDouble(psheight);
22018
22019 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {
22020 buf->putBitDouble(viewTarget.x);
22021 buf->putBitDouble(viewTarget.y);
22022 buf->putBitDouble(viewTarget.z);
22023 buf->putBitDouble(viewDir.x);
22024 buf->putBitDouble(viewDir.y);
22025 buf->putBitDouble(viewDir.z);
22026 buf->putBitDouble(twistAngle);
22027 buf->putBitDouble(viewHeight);
22028 buf->putBitDouble(viewLength); // lens length
22029 buf->putBitDouble(frontClip);
22030 buf->putBitDouble(backClip);
22031 buf->putBitDouble(snapAngle);
22032 buf->putRawDouble(centerPX);
22033 buf->putRawDouble(centerPY);
22034 buf->putRawDouble(snapPX);
22035 buf->putRawDouble(snapPY);
22036 buf->putRawDouble(snapSpPX);
22037 buf->putRawDouble(snapSpPY);
22038 buf->putRawDouble(gridSpX);
22039 buf->putRawDouble(gridSpY);
22040 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(circleZoom));
22041 }
22042
22043 if (version > DRW::AC1018)
22044 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(majorGridLines));
22045
22046 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {
22047 buf->putBitLong(static_cast<std::int32_t>(frozenLayerHandles.size()));
22048 buf->putBitLong(statusFlags);
22049 sb->putVariableText(version, styleSheet);
22050 buf->putRawChar8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(renderMode));
22051 buf->putBit(ucsAtOrigin ? 1 : 0);
22052 buf->putBit(ucsPerViewport ? 1 : 0);
22053 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsOrigin);
22054 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsXAxis);
22055 buf->put3BitDouble(ucsYAxis);
22056 buf->putBitDouble(ucsElevation);
22057 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(ucsOrthographicType));
22058 }
22059
22060 if (version > DRW::AC1015)
22061 buf->putBitShort(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(shadePlotMode));
22062
22063 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
22064 buf->putBit(useDefaultLighting ? 1 : 0);
22065 buf->putRawChar8(defaultLightingType);
22066 buf->putBitDouble(brightness);
22067 buf->putBitDouble(contrast);
22068 if (ambientColorRgb >= 0) {
22069 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(ambientColor),
22070 ambientColorRgb, ambientColorName, "", strBuf);
22071 } else {
22072 buf->putCmColor(version, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(ambientColor));
22073 }
22074 }
22075
22076 if (!encodeDwgEntHandle(version, buf, handleBuf)) return false;
22077
22078 dwgBufferW *hb = (handleBuf != nullptr) ? handleBuf : buf;
22079
22080 if (version < DRW::AC1015) {
22081 putTypedHandle(hb, vpHeaderHandle, 5);
22082 }
22083 if (version > DRW::AC1014) {
22084 const std::uint8_t frozenCode = version == DRW::AC1015 ? 5 : 4;
22085 for (const std::uint32_t ref : frozenLayerHandles)
22086 putTypedHandle(hb, ref, frozenCode);
22087 putTypedHandle(hb, clipBoundaryHandle, 4);
22088 if (version == DRW::AC1015)
22089 putTypedHandle(hb, vpHeaderHandle, 5);
22090 putTypedHandle(hb, namedUcsHandle, 5);
22091 putTypedHandle(hb, baseUcsHandle, 5);
22092 }
22093 if (version > DRW::AC1018) {
22094 putTypedHandle(hb, backgroundHandle, 4);
22095 putTypedHandle(hb, visualStyleHandle, 5);
22096 putTypedHandle(hb, shadePlotHandle, 4);
22097 putTypedHandle(hb, m_sunHandle, 3);
22098 }
22099
22100 return buf->isGood() && sb->isGood() && hb->isGood();
22101}
